source_text: in the beginning god created the heauen and the earth.
target_text: uru-uru tèka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: and the earth was without forme and void, and darkenesse was vpon the deepe, and the spirit of god mooued vpon the waters.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, aa'i-aa'i dhae mèci mèka. dhu abhu, èi. aa maroga aatu-aatu saguru nare ne. ka roh lamatua lela ètu dedha èi èèna.

source_text: then god said, let there be light: and there was light.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka, hud'i ku dènge saraa. ropa peka nare sèmi ne'e, ka saraa j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god saw the light that it was good, and god separated the light from the darkenes.
target_text: ropa nèdhi saraa ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. hèia na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga, sèna ka èci-èci ka dènge taa na.

source_text: and god called the light, day, and the darkenes, he called night. so the euening and the morning were the first day.
target_text: ka pangare saraa ne ‘mèu', aa maroga na ‘mèda'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èci kèna.

source_text: againe god said, let there be a firmament in the mids of the waters: and let it separate the waters from the waters. then god made the firmament, and separated the waters, which were vnder the firmament, from the waters which were aboue the firmament: and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, na peka, hud'i dènge ku era talele, sèna ka hag'e eele èi. nèti èèna ka, èi re dedha, aa abhu kahèi èi re haha. ropa peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia èi b'agi dènge mi dua.

source_text: and god called the firmament heauen. so the euening and the morning were the second day.
target_text: ka na pangare èi re dedha na, ‘liru'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka dua kèna.

source_text: god said againe, let the waters vnder the heauen be gathered into one place, and let the dry land appeare. and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, èi re haha hud'i pakaboko ku mi ca era, sèna ka abhu rai kamango. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka rai mango.

source_text: and god called the dry land, earth, and he called the gathering together of the waters, seas: and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka era rai mango, na pangare na ‘rai-dedha'; aa era èi dhu kaboko èèna, na pangare na ‘dhasi'. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: then god said, let the earth bud forth the bud of the herbe, that seedeth seed, the fruitfull tree, which beareth fruite according to his kinde, which hath his seede in it selfe vpon the earth: and it was so.
target_text: ka ama lamatua lii hari, peka na, rai hud'i pamamuri ku rupa-rupa ana aaj'u. sèna ka abhu aj'u dhu hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru. sèna ka aj'u-aj'u se, hua-hela madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka ana aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and the earth brought foorth the bud of the herbe, that seedeth seede according to his kind, also the tree that beareth fruit, which hath his seed in it selfe according to his kinde: and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ètu dedha-rai, ana aaj'u se hua-hela ka madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: so the euening and the morning were the third day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka tèlu kèna.

source_text: and god said, let there be lights in the firmament of the heauen, to separate the day from the night, and let them be for signes, and for seasons, and for dayes and yeeres. and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heauen to giue light vpon the earth: and it was so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, aku nèngu na, re bèka dedha, hud'i abhu ku mèdha dhu saraa, ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. hud'i abhu mèdha dhu pasaraa re mèu, aa abhu kahèi dhu pasaraa re mèda. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, j'aj'i tadha, ho sèna ka bisa ige lod'o, hèru, dènge tèu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, mèdha dhu heo aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: god then made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesse light to rule the night: he made also the starres.
target_text: ka na tao ka mèdha kapai dua dhu pasaraa rai-haha. dhu kapai risi, pasaraa re mèu; aa dhu ako ana iiki, pasaraa re mèda. aa na tao hua-hètu kahèi.

source_text: and god set them in the firmament of the heauen, to shine vpon the earth,
target_text: na tèke mèdha dhu saraa sèra ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka loti mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and to rule in the day, and in the night, and to separate the light from the darkenesse: and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka mèdha se, pasaraa ka re mèu, aa pasaraa re mèda. dènge j'ara ne'e, na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: so the euening and the morning were the fourth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka èpa kèna.

source_text: afterward god said, let the waters bring foorth in abundance euery creeping thing that hath life: and let the foule flie vpon the earth in the open firmament of the heauen.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua padhai lii hari, peka na, hud'i abhu ku ae-ae dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. dènge hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa manu-bhui dhu lela ètu dedha rai-haha ne.

source_text: then god created the great whales, and euery thing liuing and mouing, which the waters brought foorth in abundance according to their kinde, and euery fethered foule according to his kinde: and god sawe that it was good.
target_text: ka na tao ka i'a aa'i-aa'i dènge badha kapai dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. na paj'aj'i kahèi manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: then god blessed them, saying, bring foorth fruite and multiplie, and fill the waters in the seas, and let the foule multiplie in the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, peka na, i'a se, hud'i laa bèba-kacanga sèna ka papènu èi ètu mia-mia. aa manu-bhui, asa tabha kahèi.

source_text: so the euening and the morning were the fifte day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka lèmi kèna.

source_text: moreouer god said, let the earth bring foorth the liuing thing according to his kinde, cattel, and that which creepeth, and the beast of the earth, according to his kinde. and it was so. and god made the beast of the earth according to his kinde, and the cattell according to his kinde, and euery creeping thing of the earth according to his kind: and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, na, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa badha dhu mamuri ètu rai-dedha. sèmi: badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, èci-èci ka dènge rupa na. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, badha aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: furthermore god said, let vs make man in our image according to our likenes, and let them rule ouer the fish of the sea, and ouer the foule of the heauen, and ouer the beastes, and ouer all the earth, and ouer euery thing that creepeth and moueth on the earth.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, hua iia, mai ta paj'aj'i dhèu, madhutu rupa èdhi. hud'i laa ra leru dènge ator i'a aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, badha-manu dhu ani, dènge badha leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: thus god created the man in his image: in the image of god created he him: he created them male and female.
target_text: hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha ne madhutu rupa na. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and god blessed them, and god said to them, bring forth fruite and multiplie, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule ouer the fish of the sea, and ouer the foule of the heauen, and ouer euery beast that moueth vpon the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bèba-kacanga ku, sèna ka pea papènu rai-haha ne, ho mi ator ne. ja'a hia miu koasa, sèna ka mi ator i'a, manu-bhui, dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said, beholde, i haue giuen vnto you euery herbe bearing seede, which is vpon al the earth, and euery tree, wherein is the fruite of a tree bearing seede: that shall be to you for meate.
target_text: mi nanene paie-iie! ja'a hia miu rupa-rupa nganga'a ètu rai-haha ne'e. sèmi: ana aaj'u dhu dènge hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru.

source_text: likewise to euery beast of the earth, and to euery foule of the heauen, and to euery thing that moueth vpon the earth, which hath life in it selfe, euery greene herbe shall be for meate. and it was so.
target_text: ja'a hia rupa-rupa ana aaj'u kahèi sèna ka j'aj'i nganga'a badha. nganga'a hia badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, nganga'a badha sèra aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god sawe all that he had made, and loe, it was very good. so the euening and the morning were the sixt day.
target_text: ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èna kèna.

source_text: thus the heauens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for in the seuenth day god ended his worke which he had made, and the seuenth day he rested from al his worke, which he had made.
target_text: ropa na sab'a èle, asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu. hèia na ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: so god blessed the seuenth day, and sanctified it, because that in it he had rested from all his worke, which god had created and made.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, na tao lod'o ka pidhu ne, lod'o dhu kapai risi nèti lod'o dhu leo sèra. na tao sèmi èèna, lula na pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a na, ka ètu d'ara lod'o ka pidhu na, na ae.

source_text: these are the generations of the heauens and of the earth, when they were created, in the day that the lord god made the earth and the heauens,
target_text: d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. lod'o ama lamatua heka paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha èèna,

source_text: and euery plant of the fielde, before it was in the earth, and euery herbe of the field, before it grewe: for the lord god had not caused it to raine vpon the earth, neither was there a man to till the ground, but a myst went vp from the earth, and watered all the earth.
target_text: dhae abhu mèka ana aaj'u, lula na papuru mèka èj'i. taa èèna, dhoka sèb'u èi di, mai nèti d'ara rai ho pabasa rai re dedha. aa abhu mèka dhèu rai-haha dhu tao oka-tedhe.

source_text: the lord god also made the man of the dust of the grounde, and breathed in his face breath of life, and the man was a liuing soule.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. hèia na tiu a'ae na asa d'ara sahènga dhèu na, ka na mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and the lord god planted a garden eastward in eden, and there he put the man whom he had made.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua bhoke oka cue ètu rai eden, re bèka dhimu. hèia na hia dhèu ne pea ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: for out of the ground made the lord god to grow euery tree pleasant to the sight, and good for meate: the tree of life also in the mids of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and of euill.
target_text: ètu d'ara oka èèna, na pamamuri rupa-rupa aj'u dhu be'a, dhu dhèu bisa ra'a. aa na pamamuri kahèi aj'u dua kapua ètu talora aae oka èèna. ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci, na mamuri taa-taa. aa ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci hari, ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and out of eden went a riuer to water the garden, and from thence it was deuided, and became into foure heads.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu loko èci dhu hae nèti d'ara oka èèna. loko èèna, èpa kacanga.

source_text: the name of one is pishon: the same compasseth the whole land of hauilah, where is golde.
target_text: kacanga ka èci na, ngara na pison. nèngu ka dhu hae pale-lème rai hawila dhu abhu hualaa ae-ae.

source_text: and the golde of that land is good: there is bdelium, and the onix stone.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, abhu poe-pai, aj'u dhu raa na hèu mèngi, dènge hadhu kale'e.

source_text: and the name of the seconde riuer is gihon: the same compasseth the whole lande of cush.
target_text: kacanga ka dua, ngara na gihon. kacanga ne, hae pale-lème rai kus.

source_text: the name also of the third riuer is hiddekel: this goeth toward the eastside of asshur: and the fourth riuer is perath
target_text: kacanga ka tèlu, ngara na tigris. kacanga ne'e ka, j'aj'i mi too rai asyur re ca bèka dhimu. kacanga ka èpa, ngara na efrat.

source_text: then the lord god tooke the man, and put him into the garden of eden, that he might dresse it and keepe it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua hia dhèu pea ètu d'ara eden, ho na ladhe-leru oka èèna.

source_text: and the lord god commanded the man, saying, thou shalt eate freely of euery tree of the garden,
target_text: hèia na hia paredha mi dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne, èu bisa mu'a.

source_text: but of the tree of knowledge of good and euill, thou shalt not eate of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof, thou shalt die the death.
target_text: te ngaa èci dhu èu bisa boe mu'a. nuka hua nèti aj'u dhu ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe. ladhe mu'a, èu madhe dènge.

source_text: also the lord god saide, it is not good that the man should be himself alone: i wil make him an helpe meete for him.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu haru lii na, aku nèngu na, babe'a na aad'o, ladhe dhèu ne mamuri mesa na. de ja'a neo paj'aj'i hia ne, anga ca dhèu dhu pamèci dènge ne.

source_text: so the lord god formed of the earth euery beast of the fielde, and euery foule of the heauen, and brought them vnto the man to see howe he would call them: for howsoeuer the man named the liuing creature, so was the name thereof. the man therefore gaue names vnto all cattell, and to the foule of the heauen, and to euery beast of the fielde: but for adam founde he not an helpe meete for him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na tao rupa-rupa badha dènge manu-bhui. hèia na pangèd'u si asa dhèu ne, sèna ka na pangare si. ka dhèu ne pangare badha se dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra, èci-èci ka dènge ngara ra. te ngaa dhèu ne abhu mèka anga dhu pamèci dènge nèngu.

source_text: therefore the lord god caused an heauie sleepe to fall vpon the man, and he slept: and he tooke one of his ribbes, and closed vp the flesh in steade thereof.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pabhèj'i luu dhèu ne'e. ropa na bhèj'i, ama lamatua nare rui karasa na calaa, ka na pakateme hari nu'a deo na.

source_text: and the ribbe which the lord god had taken from the man, made he a woman, and brought her to the man.
target_text: nèti rui ne, na paj'aj'i bhèni ca dhèu. hèia na pangèd'u bhèni ne mi dhèu èèna.

source_text: then the man said, this now is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. she shalbe called woman, because she was taken out of man.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi bhèni ne, ka dhèu na peka, aku nèngu na, waaa! ne'e ne ku! sèmi ne'e ku, heka pamèci dènge ja'a kèna! rui na, sama èci èèna ka dènge rui ja'a. aa isi na, sama kahèi dènge isi ja'a. lula nèngu ne, j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone, nèti èèna ka ja'a pangare ne, ‘dhèu bhèni'.

source_text: therefore shall man leaue his father and his mother, and shall cleaue to his wife, and they shall be one flesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, lula dua ra, j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: and they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dua ra dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ra makae boe.

source_text: now the serpent was more subtill then any beast of the fielde, which the lord god had made: and he said to the woman, yea, hath god in deede said, ye shall not eate of euery tree of the garden?
target_text: nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, mege ka dhu mèu risi kapod'e-kabèli. ca lod'o, mege karèi bhèni na, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? ama lamatua kai miu baku mi'a hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne'e.

source_text: and the woman said vnto the serpent, we eate of the fruite of the trees of the garden, but of the fruite of the tree which is in the middes of the garden, god hath said, ye shall not eate of it, neither shall ye touche it, lest ye die.
target_text: ka bhèni na b'ala, aad'o! ji'i bisa nga'a! dhodhoka aj'u ca kapua ètu talora oka ne, ama lamatua kai, baku nga'a hua na. na peka na, ji'i baku nga'a, aa baku g'ag'e hua èèna kahèi, te aad'o na, ji'i madhe!

source_text: then the serpent said to the woman, ye shall not die at all,
target_text: te ngaa mege na dhaa, aku nèngu na, waa! sèmi boe èèna! miu se madhe boe!

source_text: but god doeth knowe, that when ye shall eate thereof, your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and euill.
target_text: ama lamatua mema kai tare'a sèmi èèna, lula dhu ne'a le, ladhe mi'e hua aaj'u èèna, miu j'aj'i d'èlu-mèu sèmi nèngu. ho èèna na me'a mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: so the woman seeing that the tree was good for meate, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to get knowledge tooke of the fruite thereof, and did eate, and gaue also to her husband with her, and he did eate.
target_text: aa bhèni ne ladhe na aj'u ne be'a titu kèna, dènge hua na ele boe kee. na ngee, ladhe ja'a ku'a hua aj'u ne'e, ja'a d'èlu-mèu. hèia puu nare ka hua aj'u èèna, ka na'e. na'e nare, nèti hia dhèu èmu na, ka na'a kahèi.

source_text: then the eyes of them both were opened, and they knewe that they were naked, and they sewed figge tree leaues together, and made them selues breeches.
target_text: ra'a rare ka, heka re'a na rèngu dhu pake boe mèdha dhu hutu ua rèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra lui rèu aj'u ho pa'abhe era makae rèngu.

source_text: afterward they heard the voyce of the lord god walking in the garden in the coole of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselues from the presence of the lord god among the trees of the garden.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, dua ra tadèngi lii core haga ama lamatua ètu d'ara oka èèna. ka dua ra rai lasi lu'u asa ca bèka aj'u, sèna ka lamatua baku nèdhi si.

source_text: but the lord god called to the man, and said vnto him, where art thou?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua paroa mi dhèu mone èèna, aku nèngu na, adam! èu ètu mia?

source_text: who saide, i heard thy voyce in the garden, and was afraide: because i was naked, therefore i hid my selfe.
target_text: hèia mone na dhaa, ja'a tadèngi lii lamatua ètu ne'e. te ngaa ja'a makae, lula ja'a pake boe mèdha ètu ua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a rai pahuni iisi.

source_text: and he saide, who tolde thee, that thou wast naked? hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof i commanded thee that thou shouldest not eate?
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, cee ka dhu peka, na èu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake? de tasamia? tatu èu mu'a le hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai na, sina ma?

source_text: then the man saide, the woman which thou gauest to be with me, she gaue me of the tree, and i did eate.
target_text: ka na b'ala, peka na, bhèni dhu èu hia ho pa'anga dènge ja'a èèna, ka dhu hia ja'a ku'a!

source_text: and the lord god saide to the woman, why hast thou done this? and the woman said, the serpent beguiled me, and i did eate.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu ad'u madha j'ara èèna? ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te mege ne ka dhu ag'o ja'a! nèti èèna ka, ja'a ku'a.

source_text: then the lord god said to the serpent, because thou hast done this, thou art cursed aboue all cattell, and aboue euery beast of the fielde: vpon thy belly shalt thou goe, and dust shalt thou eate all the dayes of thy life.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua dhoo mege èèna, aku nèngu na, ja'a huku èu, lula tatao èu. nèti badha aa'i-aa'i, dhoka èu di dhu abhu huku sèmi ne'e. mulai nèti deo ne'e toke èu madhe, èu dhoka rod'o dènge kakara, aa mu'a ètu rai di.

source_text: i will also put enimitie betweene thee and the woman, and betweene thy seede and her seede. he shall breake thine head, and thou shalt bruise his heele.
target_text: ja'a tao sèna ka, èu loe boe pamusu dènge bhèni ne. aa ana-èpu miu dua mi sèmi èèna kahèi. ana-èpu èu, èèna na kadhi hui tèdhu dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu nèti ana-èpu bhèni ne, èèna na dhedhe palaho kètu èu.

source_text: vnto the woman he said, i will greatly increase thy sorowes, and thy conceptions. in sorowe shalt thou bring foorth children, and thy desire shalbe subiect to thine husband, and he shall rule ouer thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni ne, èèna na, ja'a pasusa tabha èu, ropa èu dènge babia; lod'o mora iisi, èu asa tabha j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara èu d'èi taruu dhèu èmu èu, aa nèngu ka dhu ator èu.

source_text: also to adam he said, because thou hast obeyed the voyce of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, whereof i commanded thee, saying, thou shalt not eate of it cursed is the earth for thy sake: in sorowe shalt thou eate of it all the dayes of thy life.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge mone ne, èu madhutu boe lii paredha ja'a, te ngaa èu nanene dhoka lii dhèu èmu èu di, ka èu mu'a hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai èèna. nèti èèna ka, èu abhu huku kahèi. aa rai lèke huku kahèi. nèti deo ne'e, toke d'ai èu madhe, hud'i èu kabèli rai, heka èu abhu nganga'a kèna. dènge sab'a bia sèmi ne'e ka, èu heka mamuri kèna.

source_text: thornes also, and thistles shall it bring foorth to thee, and thou shalt eate the herbe of the fielde.
target_text: masi ka èu sèle rupa-rupa hini èèna ka, te ngaa dhu muri mai dhodhoka dhudhu-sete di.

source_text: in the sweate of thy face shalt thou eate bread, till thou returne to the earth: for out of it wast thou taken, because thou art dust, and to dust shalt thou returne.
target_text: hud'i èu èi kabhèsu haa ku, heka rai hia èu nganga'a kèna. èu hud'i sab'a bia sèmi èèna ku, toke d'ai lod'o èu madhe. èu ne, ja'a paj'aj'i nèti rai. de ladhe èu madhe, èu j'aj'i hari rai.

source_text: and the man called his wiues name heuah, because she was the mother of all liuing
target_text: èle èèna ka, adam pangare dhèu èmu na ‘hawa' dhu sasoa na ‘dhu mamuri', te nèngu ka j'aj'i ina nèti dhèu dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: vnto adam also and to his wife did the lord god make coates of skinnes, and clothed them.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua tao mèdha-papake nèti ka'uri badha, ka papake dua ra.

source_text: and the lord god said, beholde, the man is become as one of vs, to knowe good and euill. and nowe lest he put foorth his hand, and take also of ye tree of life and eate and liue for euer,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka, limuri ne, dhèu re'a le, mia dhu be'a dènge mia dhu karehe, sèmi èdhi kahèi. de mage dhoka, rèngu ra'a hua aj'u dhu èci hari na, dhu hia mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: therefore the lord god sent him foorth from the garden of eden, to till ye earth, whence he was taken.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na babèga eele si nèti d'ara oka eden èèna, ho lasi asa era leo, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge sab'e oka-tedhe. lula dhèu j'aj'i nèti rai, de mamuri kahèi nèti rai.

source_text: thus he cast out man, and at the east side of the garden of eden he set the cherubims, and the blade of a sworde shaken, to keepe the way of the tree of life.
target_text: babège nare si, ka lamatua paredha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, dhu dènge èla, ho lasi j'aga oka èèna re ca bèka dhimu. rèngu dènge samala dhu heo ha'a-ha'a, dhu seru la'e-mai. lamatua pua si bèdho eele j'ara la'e sa d'ara, te nèngu d'èi boe dhèu puu rare hua aj'u dhu hia ra mamuri taa-taa èèna.

source_text: afterward the man knew heuah his wife, which conceiued and bare kain, and said, i haue obteined a man by the lord.
target_text: hèia adam j'unu dènge dhèu èmu na, hawa. ka bhèni ne dènge babia. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a abhu le ana mone ca dhèu, lula ama lamatua soru nare le ja'a. ka na pangare ana ne, kaen dhu sasoa na ‘abhu'.

source_text: and againe she brought foorth his brother habel, and habel was a keeper of sheepe, and kain was a tiller of the ground.
target_text: hèia hawa nara iisi hari ana mone èci. ka na pangare ne habel. dua ra kapai ka, habel j'aj'i dhèu madhenge badha. aa a'a na kaen, sab'a oka-tedhe.

source_text: and in processe of time it came to passe, that kain brought an oblation vnto the lord of the fruite of the ground.
target_text: ca lod'o, kaen nèti isi rai na cahag'e, ka hia lamatua.

source_text: and habel also him selfe brought of the first fruites of his sheepe, and of the fat of them, and the lord had respect vnto habel, and to his offering,
target_text: habel nèti ana-ana uuru kahib'i-kalèbho na. na roro kahib'i-kalèbho se, ka nèti sisi dhu be'a hia lamatua. d'ara ama lamatua karej'e ropa ladhe nèdhi korban nèti habel ne.

source_text: but vnto kain and to his offering he had no regarde: wherefore kain was exceeding wroth, and his countenance fell downe.
target_text: te ngaa na d'èi boe korban unu kaen. hèia kaen nasa bia, ka rèhu na mare boe.

source_text: then ye lord said vnto kain, why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance cast downe?
target_text: ka lamatua lii dènge kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! nga tao ka èu nasa sèmi èèna, ka rèhu èu mare boe?

source_text: if thou do well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sinne lieth at the doore: also vnto thee his desire shalbe subiect, and thou shalt rule ouer him.
target_text: ladhe tatao èu be'a, na ja'a sèmi èu dènge hua iia. de mu pangee uuru ku! ladhe èu tao bhelu, na bhabhelu èèna na'e hari èu, sama sèmi meo neo pacèli maraho. de sèmi èu neo tao bhabhelu, be'a risi core eele ka!

source_text: then kain spake to habel his brother. and when they were in the fielde, kain rose vp against habel his brother, and slewe him.
target_text: ca tèka, kaen gale habel, na peka na, mai lati ngad'o oka, we. ropa dua ra d'ai d'ara oka, kaen kalabhe pamadhe ari na.

source_text: then the lord said vnto kain, where is habel thy brother? who answered, i cannot tell. am i my brothers keeper?
target_text: ka lamatua karèi kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! ari mu ka mia? hèia kaen dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ke'a boe na ètu mia! èu ngee na, ja'a dhèu kèpe haga na, do?

source_text: againe he said, what hast thou done? the voyce of thy brothers blood cryeth vnto me from the earth.
target_text: ka lamatua b'ala, nga tao ka èu bhelu sèmi èèna? baku pangee na, èu pahuni more le raa ari èu ètu d'ara rai, te ja'a dhu kèdhi aa'i-aa'i le!

source_text: now therefore thou art cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receiue thy brothers blood from thine hand.
target_text: de lii dhoo lèke le mi dedha èu. lod'o èu pamadhe ari èu, rai sakid'o nare raa na. de limuri ne, rai bisa heka nèti mamuri mi èu.

source_text: when thou shalt till the grounde, it shall not henceforth yeelde vnto thee her strength: a vagabond and a runnagate shalt thou be in the earth.
target_text: de ladhe èu sab'a oka-tedhe, rai ne hia heka èu ngaa-ngaa. nèti deo ne'e, èu lu'u sa haa-sa dhimu, sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era paleo-palu'u.

source_text: then kain said to the lord, my punishment is greater, then i can beare.
target_text: te ngaa kaen b'ala lamatua, aku nèngu na, haii! ama lamatua, ee! lamatua dhoo ja'a bia titu kèna, de ja'a pasae mèke boe nga.

source_text: behold, thou hast cast me out this day from the earth, and from thy face shall i be hid, and shalbe a vagabond, and a runnagate in the earth, and whosoeuer findeth me, shall slay me.
target_text: lula lamatua bège eele ja'a nèti era ne'e, ja'a kaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. ja'a kako lole-laa asa mia-mia. de ladhe paraga dènge dhèu, èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: then the lord said vnto him, doubtlesse whosoeuer slayeth kain, he shalbe punished seue folde. and the lord set a marke vpon kain, lest any man finding him should kill him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, aad'o sèmi èèna! dhèu cee dhu pamadhe èu, èèna na ja'a huku ne, babia na pidhu hari risi nèti èu. hèia lamatua tao tadha mi kaen, sèna ka dhèu re'a ho baku pamadhe ne.

source_text: then kain went out from the presence of the lord, and dwelt in the land of nod towarde the eastside of eden.
target_text: hèia kaen tèke eele dènge era èèna. la'e pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, asa era èci, ètu bèka dhimu oka eden. era ne'e, ngara na nod dhu sasoa na, ‘lole-laa'. ka na pea ètu era èèna.

source_text: kain also knewe his wife, which conceiued and bare henoch: and he built a citie, and called the name of the citie by ye name of his sonne, henoch.
target_text: hèia kaen leo-èmu, ka dhèu èmu na dènge babia. ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na henok. hèia kaen patitu rae cue, ngara na henok, madhutu ngara ana na.

source_text: and to henoch was borne irad, and irad begate mehuiael, and mehuiael begate methushael, and methushael begate lamech.
target_text: ka henok matana irad. hèia irad matana mehuyael. mehuyael matana metusael. aa ana metusael, lamek.

source_text: and lamech tooke him two wiues: the name of the one was adah, and the name of the other zillah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek, dhèu dua. èci ngara na ada, aa ca dhèu hari, ngara na sila.

source_text: and adah bare iabal, who was the father of such as dwell in the tents, and of such as haue cattell.
target_text: ana ada, ngara na yabal. ana-èpu na, j'aj'i dhèu piara badha. mamuri ra ètu boe ca era, aa ra pea dhoka ètu d'ara paleo di.

source_text: and his brothers name was iubal, who was the father of all that play on the harpe and organes.
target_text: ari yabal, ngara na yubal. ana-èpu yubal, j'aj'i dhèu gai sasadhu, dènge tiu sakino.

source_text: and zillah also bare tubal-kain, who wrought cunningly euery craft of brasse and of yron: and the sister of tubal-kain was naamah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek èci hari, sila, nara iisi tubal kaen. ana-èpu na j'aj'i tuka bèsi, ka ra tuku mèdha ae-ae tao nèti bèsi, dènge tabaga. ana hèni tubal kaen, ngara na na'ama.

source_text: then lamech saide vnto his wiues adah and zillah, heare my voyce, ye wiues of lamech: hearken vnto my speach: for i would slay a man in my wound, and a yong man in mine hurt.
target_text: ca tèka, lamek padedha iisi na ètu madha dhèu èmu dua ra, peka na, mi nanene, ee! deo na, ana mone ngèru èci neo game ja'a. te ngaa ja'a dhadhedhe ne, toke madhe.

source_text: if kain shalbe auenged seuen folde, truely lamech, seuentie times seuen folde.
target_text: dhèu dhu pamadhe kaen, abhu huku pidhu hari. te ngaa cee ka dhu neo b'ala ho pamadhe ja'a, abhu huku pidhu nguru pidhu hari.

source_text: and adam knewe his wife againe, and she bare a sonne, and she called his name sheth: for god, saide she, hath appointed me another seede for habel, because kain slewe him.
target_text: ka hawa nara iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu. hèia ra pangare ne, set dhu sasoa na, ‘hia', lula aku hawa na, ama lamatua hia ja'a ana ne, sèna ka gati madha habel, dhu kaen pamadhe ne.

source_text: and to ye same sheth also there was borne a sonne, and he called his name enosh. then beganne men to call vpon the name of the lord.
target_text: pe d'ai nèbhu ku, set abhu ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na enos. tèu èèna, dhèu mulai manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the booke of the generations of adam. in the day that god created adam, in the likenes of god made he him, male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name adam in the day that they were created.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, na tao si sama sèmi rupa nèngu. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. ka na pangare si ‘dhèu rai-haha', aa na hia si berkat. dhèu dhu uru, ngara na adam. ana-èpu adam, nuka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: nowe adam liued an hundred and thirtie yeeres, and begate a childe in his owne likenes after his image, and called his name sheth.
target_text: lod'o adam d'ai ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, dhu rèhu na nare adam. ka pangare na, set.

source_text: and the dayes of adam, after he had begotten sheth, were eight hundreth yeeres, and he begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka adam mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèu, hèia na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes that adam liued, were nine hundreth and thirtie yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur adam ceo ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and sheth liued an hundreth and fiue yeeres, and begate enosh.
target_text: lod'o set d'ai ca ngasu lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na enos.

source_text: and sheth liued, after he begate enosh, eight hundreth and seuen yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka set mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of sheth were nine hundreth and twelue yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur set ceo ngasu canguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: also enosh liued ninetie yeeres, and begate kenan.
target_text: lod'o enos mamuri d'ai ceo nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na kenan.

source_text: and enosh liued, after he begate kenan, eight hundreth and fifteene yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka enos mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu canguru lèmi tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of enosh were nine hundreth and fiue yeeres: and he died
target_text: umur enos ceo ngasu lèmi tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: likewise kenan liued seuentie yeeres, and begate mahalaleel.
target_text: lod'o kenan d'ai pidhu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na mahalalel.

source_text: and kenan liued, after he begate mahalaleel, eight hundreth and fourtie yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka kenan mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu èpa nguru tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of kenan were nine hundreth and tenne yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur kenan ceo ngasu canguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: mahalaleel also liued sixtie and fiue yeres, and begate iered.
target_text: lod'o mahalalel d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na yared.

source_text: also mahalaleel liued, after he begate iered, eight hundreth and thirtie yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka mahalalel mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of mahalaleel were eight hundreth ninetie and fiue yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur mahalalel aru ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and iered liued an hundreth sixtie and two yeeres, and begate henoch.
target_text: lod'o yared d'ai cangasu èna nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na henok.

source_text: then iered liued, after he begate henoch, eight hundreth yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka yared mamuri d'ai aru ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of iered were nine hundreth sixtie and two yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur yared ceo ngasu èna nguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: also henoch liued sixtie and fiue yeeres, and begate methushelah.
target_text: ropa henok mamuri d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na metusalak.

source_text: and henoch walked with god, after he begate methushelah, three hundreth yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ele èèna, henok mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua d'ai tèlu ngasu tèu. ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of henoch were three hundreth sixtie and fiue yeeres. and henoch walked with god, and he was no more seene: for god tooke him away.
target_text: na mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. hèia lod'o na d'ai tèlu ngasu èna nguru lèmi tèu, ka na ele, lula ama lamatua paca'e ne sa dedha.

source_text: methushelah also liued an hundreth eightie and seuen yeeres, and begate lamech.
target_text: lod'o metusalak d'ai cangasu aru nguru pidhu tèu, na matana ana mone èci, ngara na lamek.

source_text: and methushelah liued, after he begate lamech, seuen hundreth eightie and two yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: èle èèna ka, metusalak mamuri hari d'ai pidhu ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so al the dayes of methushelah were nine hundreth sixtie and nine yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur metusalak ceo ngasu èna nguru ceo tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: then lamech liued an hundreth eightie and two yeeres, and begate a sonne,
target_text: lod'o lamek mamuri d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and called his name noah, saying, this same shall comfort vs concerning our worke and sorowe of our hands, as touching the earth, which the lord hath cursed.
target_text: lamek pangare ne noh dhu sasoa na ‘pakarej'e d'ara', lula na peka na, ana ne, èèna na pakarej'e d'ara èdhi nèti sasab'a dhu bia, ètu rai dhu ama lamatua dhoo le.

source_text: and lamech liued, after he begate noah, fiue hundreth ninetie and fiue yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka lamek mamuri taruu d'ai lèmi ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, aa na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so all the dayes of lamech were seuen hundreth seuentie and seuen yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur lamek pidhu ngasu pidhu nguru pidhu tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and noah was fiue hundreth yeere olde. and noah begate shem, ham and iapheth.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na matana ana mone dhèu tèlu, sem, yafet dènge ham.

source_text: so when men began to be multiplied vpon the earth, and there were daughters borne vnto them,
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu rai-haha, asa bèba-kacanga. ka ra papala-palème rai-haha. dhèu se matana kahèi ana-ana bhèni.

source_text: then the sonnes of god sawe the daughters of men that they were faire, and they tooke them wiues of all that they liked.
target_text: ana-ana mone nèti lamatua ladhe rèdhi ana bhèni nèti dhèu rai-haha se, bhèni iia hua. ka lasi todhe rare ana bhèni mia dhu ra d'èi.

source_text: therefore the lord saide, my spirit shall not alway striue with man, because he is but flesh, and his dayes shalbe an hundreth and twentie yeeres.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a roca le dènge tatao dhèu dhu lèke-lèke boe se. roh ja'a dhu pamamuri rèngu sa, d'èi heka hia ra mamuri manèro. hud'i rèngu madhe ku. de èèna na, mamuri rèngu se dhoka d'ai ca ngasu dua nguru tèu di.

source_text: there were gyants in the earth in those dayes: yea, and after that the sonnes of god came vnto the daughters of men, and they had borne them children, these were mightie men, which in olde time were men of renoume.
target_text: taa èèna, dènge taa-tebho dhu limuri nèti èèna hari, abhu le dhèu raksasa ètu rai-haha ne. ropa ana mone nèti lamatua leo rare ana bhèni dhèu rai-haha se, ka rara iisi dhèu kapai, nuka: kapala musu, dhèu re'a madhutu lii lolo uru-uru sèra.

source_text: when the lord sawe that the wickednesse of man was great in the earth, and all the imaginations of the thoughtes of his heart were onely euill continually,
target_text: taa èèna, lamatua ladhe nèdhi bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha dhu seli-kolane. d'ara rèngu pangee dhoka bhabhelu di.

source_text: then it repented ye lord, that he had made man in the earth, and he was sorie in his heart.
target_text: ka lamatua manyasa, lula na paj'aj'i le rèngu se ho pea ètu rai-haha ne. tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu papèd'a d'ara lamatua.

source_text: therefore ye lord said, i will destroy from the earth the man, whom i haue created, from man to beast, to the creeping thing, and to the foule of the heauen: for i repent that i haue made them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na peka na, dènge tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, ja'a huku pamadhe dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu paj'aj'i kore si le. manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, ja'a palaho aa'i si kahèi. te ja'a manyasa, nèti ja'a ka paj'aj'i si.

source_text: but noah found grace in the eyes of the lord.
target_text: te ngaa noh di dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: these are the generations of noah. noah was a iust and vpright man in his time: and noah walked with god. and noah begate three sonnes, shem, ham and iapheth.
target_text: lii lolo noh sèmi ne'e ka: ana mone na, dhèu tèlu, nuka sem, yafet dènge ham. noh mamuri dènge mola, koe-kapengo boe. taa èèna, nèngu di dhu mamuri mola. d'ara na dhodhoka ètu ama lamatua.

source_text: the earth also was corrupt before god: for the earth was filled with crueltie. then god looked vpon the earth, and beholde, it was corrupt: for all flesh had corrupt his way vpon the earth.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo se, ama lamatua ladhe ra bhelu aa'i mèu-mèu. ètu mia-mia èèna ka, j'ara mamuri dhèu se ele iie aa'i. ama lamatua nèdhi dhodhoka bhabhelu di, ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said vnto noah, an ende of all flesh is come before me: for the earth is filled with crueltie through them: and beholde, i wil destroy them with the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge noh, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi dhoka bhabhelu dhèu di, dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pama'ète kore le, sèna ka ja'a palaho aa'i rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: make thee an arke of pine trees: thou shalt make cabines in the arke, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, noh! èu tao kapa aae cue, dhu tao nèti aj'u adhu. re d'ara roa na, èu bagi mi kama-kama. aa re d'ara dènge li'u kapa, èu lame dènge èi dama.

source_text: and thus shalt thou make it: the length of the arke shalbe three hundreth cubites, the breadth of it fiftie cubites, and the height of it thirtie cubites.
target_text: mu sab'e kapa na, madhera na ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèlu meter; bhabhèla na dua nguru dua meter; dènge katitu na canguru tèlu meter.

source_text: a windowe shalt thou make in the arke, and in a cubite shalt thou finish it aboue, and the doore of the arke shalt thou set in the side thereof: thou shalt make it with the lowe, seconde and third roume.
target_text: èu tao èmu ètu dedha kapa na. te ngaa paconga ca laa ai nèti kadidhi re dedha. èu bagi kapa ne mi tèlu tad'a. aa re karasa na, tao babèdho èci.

source_text: and i, beholde, i will bring a flood of waters vpon the earth to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life vnder the heauen: all that is in the earth shall perish.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bèli-camèd'a, ja'a papuru èi aae lala, ho pacène eele rai-haha ne, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: but with thee will i establish my couenant, and thou shalt goe into the arke, thou, and thy sonnes, and thy wife, and thy sonnes wiues with thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. èèna na, èu maso d'ara kapa èèna, mèti dènge dhèu èmu èu, ana-ana èu, dènge dhèu èmu ana-ana èu.

source_text: and of euery liuing thing, of all flesh two of euery sort shalt thou cause to come into the arke, to keepe them aliue with thee: they shalbe male and female. of the foules, after their kinde, and of the cattell after their kind, of euery creeping thing of the earth after his kinde, two of euery sort shall come vnto thee, that thou mayest keepe them aliue.
target_text: badha aa'i-aa'i ra, èu hag'e more ca pasa-ca pasa, eo mèti asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri dènge èu kahèi. sèmi: badha ani, manu-bhui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: and take thou with thee of all meate that is eaten: and thou shalt gather it to thee, that it may be meate for thee and for them.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti dènge nganga'a-nganginu, pala miu dènge pala badha sèra hèi.

source_text: noah therefore did according vnto all, that god commanded him: euen so did he.
target_text: ka noh sab'e madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and the lord said vnto noah, enter thou and all thine house into the arke: for thee haue i seene righteous before me in this age.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka dènge noh, ja'a ladhe le palème, te ngaa abhu dhoka èu di dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge bhèni-ana niki èu, lami ka asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: of euery cleane beast thou shalt take to thee by seuens, the male and his female: but of vncleane beastes by couples, the male and his female. of the foules also of the heauen by seuens, male and female, to keepe seede aliue vpon the whole earth.
target_text: mèti dènge badha-badha dhu bisa mi'a, aa bisa hia ja'a kahèi, de mèti pidhu-pidhu pasa asa d'ara kapa. mèti kahèi rupa-rupa manu-bhui pidhu-pidhu pasa. te ngaa badha dhu leo, mèti dhoka ca pasa-ca pasa di. sèna ka badha dènge manu-bhui se, j'aj'i hini, ho baku ma'ète.

source_text: for seuen dayes hence i will cause it raine vpon the earth fourtie dayes and fourtie nightes, and all the substance that i haue made, will i destroy from off the earth.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie, oo! di pidhu lod'o ka, ja'a papuru èj'i aae mai dhu bhoka boe ca lod'o sa, toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. dènge sèmi ne'e, ja'a pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai, dhu ja'a paj'aj'i kore le.

source_text: noah therefore did according vnto all that the lord commanded him.
target_text: ka noh tao aa'i sèmi lii paredha lamatua.

source_text: and noah was sixe hundreth yeeres olde, when the flood of waters was vpon the earth.
target_text: lod'o èi aae lala, umur noh èna ngasu tèu.

source_text: so noah entred and his sonnes, and his wife, and his sonnes wiues with him into the arke, because of the waters of the flood.
target_text: noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana niki na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana ra di, lasi asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: of the cleane beastes, and of the vncleane beastes, and of the foules, and of all that creepeth vpon the earth, there came two and two vnto noah into the arke, male and female, as god had commanded noah.
target_text: madhutu lii paredha lamatua, ka noh pamaso manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, èci-èci ka dènge pasa na, nèti dhu bisa ra'a, dènge dhu bisa boe ra'a.

source_text: and so after seuen dayes the waters of the flood were vpon the earth.
target_text: ropa èle pidhu lod'o, cag'ag'a laa èi aae lala, ka rai-haha ne, mulai cène.

source_text: in the sixe hundreth yeere of noahs life in the second moneth, the seuetenth day of the moneth, in the same day were all the fountaines of the great deepe broken vp, and the windowes of heauen were opened,
target_text: lèke dènge umur noh èna ngasu tèu, risi dua hèru, canguru pidhu lod'o, ka mulai èi aae lala. lod'o èèna, sèmi babèdho liru dhu bhoke eele sa, ka èi na tao sabhori mai. aa èi madha-èi madha ètu rai-haha sabhoka, ka sèmi tao sabhuu sa dedha.

source_text: and the raine was vpon the earth fourtie dayes and fourtie nightes.
target_text: ka èj'i bhori mai loe boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda.

source_text: in the selfe same day entred noah with shem, and ham and iapheth, the sonnes of noah, and noahs wife, and the three wiues of his sonnes with them into the arke.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana mone na dhèu tèlu: sem, yafet dènge ham, dènge dhèu èmu ra, maso lasi asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: they and euery beast after his kinde, and all cattell after their kinde, and euery thing that creepeth and moueth vpon the earth after his kinde, and euery foule after his kinde, euen euery bird of euery fether.
target_text: lasi palere dènge badha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, manu-bhui, dènge badha-badha leo dhu dènge èla sèra.

source_text: for they came to noah into ye arke, two and two, of all flesh wherein is ye breath of life. and they entring in, came male and female of all flesh, as god had commanded him: and the lord shut him in.
target_text: ca pasa-ca pasa nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, lasi asa d'ara kapa palere dènge noh, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ropa aa'i-aa'i ra d'ai d'ara kapa, lamatua bèdho babèdho kapa èèna.

source_text: then ye flood was fourtie dayes vpon the earth, and the waters were increased, and bare vp the arke, which was lift vp aboue the earth. the waters also waxed strong, and were increased exceedingly vpon the earth, and the arke went vpon the waters. the waters preuailed so exceedingly vpon the earth, that all the high mountaines, that are vnder the whole heauen, were couered.
target_text: èj'i aae puru ma'ète boe d'ai èpa nguru lod'o. hèia kapa èèna taleb'o. èi ca'e loe boe toke hutu nare kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae.

source_text: fifteene cubites vpwarde did the waters preuaile, when the mountaines were couered.
target_text: èi ca'e taruu, ka marèma na seli èpa rèpa risi nèti kolo ledhe sèra.

source_text: then all flesh perished that moued vpon the earth, both foule and cattell and beast, and euery thing that creepeth and moueth vpon the earth, and euery man. euery thing in whose nostrels the spirit of life did breathe, whatsoeuer they were in the drie land, they died. so he destroyed euery thing that was vpon the earth, from man to beast, to ye creeping thing, and to the foule of the heauen: they were euen destroyed from the earth. and noah onely remained; and they that were with him in ye arke.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai sèra, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. nuka: dhèu, badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. ate dhoka noh dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa.

source_text: and the waters preuailed vpon the earth an hundreth and fiftie dayes.
target_text: èi na, kura boe toke ca ngasu lèmi nguru lod'o.

source_text: now god remembred noah and euery beast, and all the cattell that was with him in the arke: therefore god made a winde to passe vpon the earth, and the waters ceased.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe noh si dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa. hèia na hia ngèlu g'oro, ka èi na kura ka noo-noo.

source_text: the fountaines also of the deepe and the windowes of heauen were stopped and the raine from heauen was restrained,
target_text: na katange èi madha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa na taha èj'i kahèi.

source_text: and the waters returned from aboue the earth, going and returning: and after the ende of the hundreth and fiftieth day the waters abated.
target_text: ka èi kura noo-noo ka. d'ai cangasu lèmi nguru lod'o, èi marèma heka.

source_text: and in the seuenth moneth, in the seuenteenth day of the moneth, the arke rested vpon the mountaines of ararat.
target_text: lèke dènge hèru ka pidhu, risi canguru pidhu lod'o, kapa eta ètu kolo ledhe aae èci, ngara na ararat.

source_text: and the waters were going and decreasing vntill the tenth moneth: in the tenth moneth, and in the first day of the moneth were the toppes of the mountaines seene.
target_text: èi kura taruu toke lod'o ka èci, hèru ka canguru, ka kolo-kolo ledhe cèu noo-noo.

source_text: so after fourtie dayes, noah opened the windowe of the arke, which he had made,
target_text: risi nèti èpa nguru lod'o, hèia noh bhoke jendela èci.

source_text: and sent forth a rauen, which went out going forth and returning, vntill the waters were dried vp vpon the earth.
target_text: ka na patalale lakaa ci'u. manu-bhui ne lela la'e-mai, toke èi puru. ka na lèpa heka asa kapa.

source_text: againe he sent a doue from him, that he might see if the waters were diminished from off the earth.
target_text: hèia noh patabuli hari, koro j'aha ci'u, sèna ka neo ne'a èi na puru le, do dhae.

source_text: but the doue found no rest for the sole of her foote: therefore she returned vnto him into the arke for the waters were vpon the whole earth and he put forth his hand, and receiued her, and tooke her to him into the arke.
target_text: te ngaa, lula èi hutu nare dedha-rai era, ka koro ne abhu boe era tèka. ka lèpa hari asa kapa. hèia noh j'ole ai na, kèpe nare, ka na pamaso hari asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: and he abode yet other seuen dayes, and againe he sent forth the doue out of the arke.
target_text: ka noh tatae hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patabuli hari koro j'aha deo na.

source_text: and the doue came to him in ye euening, and loe, in her mouth was an oliue leafe that she had pluckt: whereby noah knewe that the waters were abated from off the earth.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia sa, koro ne lèpa hari la'e asa noh, tutu nèti dènge rèu saitun ca rèu dhu heka tutu nare kèna. nèti èèna ka, noh heka ne'a kèna, èi na dhu puru le tare'a di.

source_text: notwithstanding he wayted yet other seuen dayes, and sent forth the doue, which returned not againe vnto him any more.
target_text: ka na mate hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patalale hari koro j'aha ca hari ni. te ngaa ca tèka ne, koro ne lèpa heka.

source_text: and in the sixe hundreth and one yeere, in the first day of the first moneth the waters were dryed vp from off the earth: and noah remoued the couering of the arke and looked, and beholde, the vpper part of the ground was drie.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai èna ngasu ca tèu, lèke lod'o ka èci hèru èci, èi mèti aa'i le. hèia noh bhoke jendela, ka na ladhe palème, nèdhi rai dhu mango le.

source_text: and in the second moneth, in the seuen and twentieth day of the moneth was the earth drie.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka dua, lod'o ka dua nguru pidhu, dedha-rai ne dhu mango meto le.

source_text: then god spake to noah, saying,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge noh,

source_text: goe forth of the arke, thou and thy wife, and thy sonnes and thy sonnes wiues with thee.
target_text: noh! aa'i-aa'i mi puru ka nèti dedha kapa èèna.

source_text: bring forth with thee euery beast that is with thee, of all flesh, both foule and cattell, and euery thing that creepeth and moueth vpon the earth, that they may breede abundantly in ye earth, and bring forth fruite and increase vpon ye earth.
target_text: papuru aa'i badha-manu sèra! nuka: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. hud'i si, sèna ka ra bèba, papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so noah came forth, and his sonnes, and his wife, and his sonnes wiues with him. euery beast, euery creeping thing, and euery foule, all that moueth vpon the earth after their kindes went out of the arke.
target_text: èle èèna ka, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana-ana na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana na sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra puru nèti dedha kapa èèna. badha se, aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua ka madhutu anga ra èci-èci.

source_text: then noah built an altar to the lord and tooke of euery cleane beast, and of euery cleane foule, and offered burnt offerings vpon the altar.
target_text: hèia noh pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban hia lamatua. nèti badha-badha dhu bisa ra'a sèra, noh nare ci'u-ci'u, ka na roro, tunu ètu dedha mei deo na, ho j'aj'i mi tadha makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the lord smellled a sauour of rest, and the lord said in his heart, i will hencefoorth curse the ground no more for mans cause: for the imagination of mans heart is euill, euen from his youth: neither will i smite any more all things liuing, as i haue done.
target_text: ropa lamatua sangèd'u nare hèu gèmu korban deo na, d'ara na karej'e. ka na ngee na, nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a huku heka rai-haha ne, lula bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu. masi ka rèngu dhoka ngee bhabhelu di, ja'a pa'ele iie heka ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, sèmi dhu ja'a heka tao kore èèna.

source_text: hereafter seede time and haruest, and colde and heate, and sommer and winter, and day and night shall not cease, so long as ye earth remaineth.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha ne era, hèru dènge tèu, kako madhutu atora. sèmi: hèru sèla dènge hèru puu-g'ètu, hèru pacuhi dènge hèru sagoro, hèru hadhu dènge hèru èj'i lai, mèu dènge mèda.

source_text: and god blessed noah and his sonnes, and said to them, bring foorth fruite, and multiplie, and replenish the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pala-bagi berkat mi noh dènge ana-ana na, peka na, miu matana pa'ae-ae, sèna ka papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: also the feare of you, and the dread of you shalbe vpon euery beast of the earth, and vpon euery foule of the heauen, vpon all that moueth on the earth, and vpon all the fishes of the sea: into your hand are they deliuered.
target_text: ladhe èèna na, badha hui, manu-bhui dènge i'a aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge miu. miu ka dhu ator si.

source_text: euery thing that moueth and liueth, shall be meate for you: as the greene herbe, haue i giuen you all things.
target_text: sisi badha aa'i-aa'i, miu bisa mi'a, sèmi dhu mi'a hua-hela, dènge rèu ana aaj'u se. aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a hia miu.

source_text: but flesh with the life thereof, i meane, with the blood thereof, shall ye not eate.
target_text: dhoka sisi dhu dènge raa era, miu madha mèu mi'a, lula samanga badha ètu raa na.

source_text: for surely i will require your blood, wherein your liues are: at the hand of euery beast will i require it: and at the hand of man, euen at the hand of a mans brother will i require the life of man. who so sheadeth mans blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of god hath he made man.
target_text: ja'a paj'aj'i dhèu madhutu raropa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, baku pamadhe dhèu. ladhe abhu dhèu, do badha, dhu pamadhe dhèu, na, pamadhe ne kahèi. ne'e, lii paredha nèti ja'a.

source_text: but bring ye forth fruite and multiplie: grow plentifully in the earth, and increase therein.
target_text: miu se hud'i matana pa'ae-ae ku, sèna ka papènu hari rai-haha ne.

source_text: god spake also to noah and to his sonnes with him, saying,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na,

source_text: behold, i, euen i establish my couenant with you, and with your seede after you,
target_text: de ne'e ne, ja'a pajaji dènge miu, toke d'ai lai ana lai èpu.

source_text: and with euery liuing creature that is with you, with the foule, with the cattell, and with euery beast of the earth with you, from all that goe out of the arke, vnto euery beast of the earth.
target_text: lii pajaji ne, lèke kahèi mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, dènge manu-bhui. peka ka laa, lèke aa'i-aa'i dhu kalua palere-lere dènge miu nèti dedha kapa.

source_text: and my couenant will i establish with you, that from henceforth all flesh shall not be rooted out by ye waters of the flood, neither shall there be a flood to destroy the earth any more.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a hia heka èi aae lala, ho pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, aa dènge pa'ele iie rai-haha ne.

source_text: then god saide, this is the token of the couenant which i make betweene me and you, and betweene euery liuing thing, that is with you vnto perpetuall generations. i haue set my bowe in the cloude, and it shalbe for a signe of the couenant betweene me and the earth.
target_text: ja'a pasa saroo ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha pasanèd'e lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe dènge miu, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, aa dènge rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when i shall couer the earth with a cloud, and the bowe shall be seene in the cloude, then will i remember my couenant, which is betweene me and you, and betweene euery liuing thing in all flesh, and there shalbe no more waters of a flood to destroy all flesh. therefore the bowe shalbe in the cloude, that i may see it, and remember the euerlasting couenant betweene god, and euery liuing thing in all flesh that is vpon the earth. god said yet to noah, this is the signe of the couenant, which i haue established betweene me and all flesh that is vpon the earth.
target_text: ladhe abhu ra'i-liru, ho saroo cèu, èèna na pasanèd'e ja'a nèti lii pajaji èèna. na peka na, èi aae pa'ele iie heka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri. dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe, pa'èki tèke le dènge miu, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: nowe the sonnes of noah going foorth of the arke, were shem and ham and iapheth. and ham is the father of canaan.
target_text: ana-ana noh dhu puru nèti dedha kapa, sem, yafet dènge ham ham èèna, ama kana'an.

source_text: these are the three sonnes of noah, and of them was the whole earth ouerspred.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i nèti ana noh dhèu tèlu sèra.

source_text: noah also began to be an husband man and planted a vineyard.
target_text: noh èèna, dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. nèngu ka dhu uru j'ara tao oka anggor.

source_text: and he drunke of ye wine and was drunken, and was vncouered in the middes of his tent.
target_text: ca tèka, na ninu èi anggor, ka na mahu titu kèna. hèia na puru eele mèdha-papake nèti ua na. ka na j'unu lega-loli dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu d'ara paleo na.

source_text: and when ham the father of canaan sawe the nakednesse of his father, he tolde his two brethren without.
target_text: ropa ham ladhe nèdhi era makae ama na, ka rai li'u la'e, lolo dènge a'a na, sem dènge yafet.

source_text: then tooke shem and iapheth a garment, and put it vpon both their shoulders, and went backwarde, and couered the nakednesse of their father with their faces backwarde: so they sawe not their fathers nakednesse.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: then noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his yonger sonne had done vnto him,
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: and said, cursed be canaan: a seruant of seruants shall he be vnto his brethren.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: he said moreouer, blessed be the lord god of shem, and let canaan be his seruant.
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: god perswade iapheth, that he may dwell in the tentes of shem, and let canaan be his seruant.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: and noah liued after the flood three hundreth and fiftie yeeres.
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: so all the dayes of noah were nine hundreth and fiftie yeeres: and he died.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: now these are the generations of the sonnes of noah, shem, ham and iapheth: vnto whom sonnes were borne after the flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: the sonnes of iapheth were gomer and magog, and madai, and iauan, and tubal, and meshech, and tiras. and the sonnes of gomer, ashkenaz, and riphath, and togarmah. also the sonnes of iauan, elishah and tarshish, kittim, and dodanim. of these were the yles of the gentiles deuided in their landes, euery man after his tongue, and after their families in their nations.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: moreouer, ye sonnes of ham were cush, and mizraim, and put, and canaan.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: and the sonnes of cush, seba and hauilah, and sabtah, and raamah, and sabtecha: also the sonnes of raamah were sheba and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: and cush begate nimrod, who began to be mightie in the earth.
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: he was a mightie hunter before the lord. wherefore it is saide, as nimrod the mightie hunter before the lord.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: and the beginning of his kingdome was babel, and erech, and accad, and calneh, in the land of shinar.
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: out of that land came asshur, and builded niniueh, and the citie rehoboth, and calah:
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: resen also betweene niniueh and calah: this is a great citie.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: and mizraim begate ludim, and anamim, and lehabim, and naphtuhim.
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: pathrusim also, and casluhim out of whom came the philistims and caphtorims.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: also canaan begat zidon his first borne, and heth,
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: and iebusi, and emori, and girgashi,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: and hiui, and arki, and sini,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: and aruadi, and zemari, and hamathi: and afterwarde were the families of the canaanites spred abroade.
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: then the border of the canaanites was from zidon, as thou commest to gerar vntil azzah, and as thou goest vnto sodom, and gomorah, and admah, and zeboijm, euen vnto lasha.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: these are the sonnes of ham according to their families, according to their tongues in their countries and in their nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: vnto shem also the father of all the sonnes of eber, and elder brother of iapheth were children borne.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: the sonnes of shem were elam and asshur, and arpachshad, and lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: and the sonnes of aram, vz and hul, and gether and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: also arpachshad begate shelah, and shelah begate eber.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: vnto eber also were borne two sonnes: the name of the one was peleg: for in his dayes was the earth diuided: and his brothers name was ioktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: then ioktan begate almodad and sheleph, and hazarmaueth, and ierah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: and hadoram, and vzal, and dicklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: and obal, and abimael, and sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: and ophir, and hauilah, and iobab: all these were the sonnes of ioktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: and their dwelling was from mesha, as thou goest vnto sephar a mount of the east.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these are the sonnes of shem according to their families, according to their tongues, in their countreis and nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: these are the families of the sonnes of noah, after their generations among their people: and out of these were the nations diuided in the earth after the flood.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: then the whole earth was of one language and one speache.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: and as they went from the east, they found a plaine in the land of shinar, and there they abode.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and they said one to another, come, let vs make bricke, and burne it in the fire. so they had bricke for stone, and slime had they in steade of morter. also they said, goe to, let vs builde vs a citie and a towre, whose top may reache vnto the heauen, that we may get vs a name, lest we be scattered vpon the whole earth.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: but the lord came downe, to see the citie and towre, which the sonnes of men builded.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: and the lord said, beholde, the people is one, and they all haue one language, and this they begin to doe, neither can they now be stopped from whatsoeuer they haue imagined to do.
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: come on, let vs goe downe, and there confound their language, that euery one perceiue not anothers speache.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: so ye lord scattered them from thence vpon all the earth, and they left off to build the citie.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: therefore the name of it was called babel, because the lord did there confounde the language of all the earth: from thence then did the lord scatter them vpon all the earth.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: these are the generations of shem: shem was an hundreth yeere olde, and begate arpachshad two yeere after the flood.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: and shem liued, after he begate arpachshad, fiue hundreth yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: also arpachshad liued fiue and thirtie yeeres, and begate shelah.
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: and arpachshad liued, after he begate shelah, foure hundreth and three yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and shelah liued thirtie yeeres, and begat eber.
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: so shelah liued, after he begat eber, foure hundreth and three yeeres, and begat sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: likewise eber liued foure and thirtie yeres, and begate peleg.
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: so eber liued, after he begate peleg, foure hundreth and thirtie yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and peleg liued thirtie yeeres, and begate reu.
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: and peleg liued, after he begate reu, two hundreth and nine yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: also reu liued two and thirtie yeeres, and begate serug.
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: so reu liued, after he begate serug, two hundreth and seuen yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: moreouer serug liued thirtie yeeres, and begate nahor.
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: and serug liued, after he begate nahor, two hundreth yeeres, and begate sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and nahor liued nine and twentie yeeres, and begate terah.
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: so nahor liued, after he begate terah, an hundreth and nineteene yeeres, and begat sonnes and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: so terah liued seuentie yeeres, and begate abram, nahor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: nowe these are the generations of terah: terah begate abram, nahor, and haran: and haran begate lot.
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: then haran died before terah his father in the land of his natiuitie, in vr of the caldees.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: so abram and nahor tooke them wiues. the name of abrams wife was sarai, and the name of nahors wife milcah, the daughter of haran, the father of milcah, and the father of iscah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: but sarai was barren, and had no childe.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: then terah tooke abram his sonne, and lot the sonne of haran, his sonnes sonne, and sarai his daughter in lawe, his sonne abrams wife: and they departed together from vr of the caldees, to goe into the land of canaan, and they came to haran, and dwelt there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: so the dayes of terah were two hundreth and fiue yeeres, and terah died in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: for the lord had said vnto abram, get thee out of thy countrey, and from thy kindred, and from thy fathers house vnto the land that i will shewe thee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i will make of thee a great nation, and will blesse thee, and make thy name great, and thou shalt be a blessing.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: i will also blesse them that blesse thee, and curse them that curse thee, and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: so abram departed, euen as ye lord spake vnto him, and lot went with him. and abram was seuentie and fiue yeere olde, when he departed out of haran then abram tooke sarai his wife, and lot his brothers sonne, and all their substance that they possessed, and the soules that they had gotten in haran, and they departed, to goe to the land of canaan: and to the land of canaan they came.
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: so abram passed through the land vnto the place of shechem, and vnto the plaine of moreh and the canaanite was then in ye land
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: and the lord appeared vnto abram, and said, vnto thy seede will i giue this land. and there builded he an altar vnto the lord, which appeared vnto him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: afterward remouing thence vnto a moutaine eastward from beth-el, he pitched his tent hauing beth-el on the westside, and haai on the east: and there he built an altar vnto the lord, and called on the name of the lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: againe abram went forth going and iourneying toward the south.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: then there came a famine in the land: therefore abram went downe into egypt to soiourne there: for there was a great famine in the lande.
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.

source_text: and when he drewe neere to enter into egypt, he said to sarai his wife, beholde nowe, i know that thou art a faire woman to looke vpon:
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: therefore it will come to passe, that when the egyptians see thee, they will say, she is his wife: so will they kill me, but they will keepe thee aliue.
