source_text: therefore tel my father of al mine honour in egypt, and of all that ye haue seene, and make haste, and bring my father hither.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: then hee fell on his brother beniamins necke, and wept, and beniamin wept on his necke.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: moreouer, he kissed all his brethren, and wept vpon them: and afterwarde his brethren talked with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and the tidinges came vnto pharaohs house, so that they said, iosephs brethre are come: and it pleased pharaoh well, and his seruants.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: then pharaoh said vnto ioseph, say to thy brethren, this doe ye, lade your beastes and depart, go to the land of canaan,
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and take your father, and your houshoulds, and come to me, and i wil giue you the best of the land of egypt, and ye shall eate of the fat of the land.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: and i commaund thee, thus doe ye, take you charets out of the lande of egypt for your children, and for your wiues, and bring your father and come.
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: also regarde not your stuffe: for the best of all the land of egypt is yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and the children of israel did so: and ioseph gaue them charets according to the commandement of pharaoh: hee gaue them vitaile also for the iourney.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: he gaue them all, none except, change of raiment: but vnto beniamin he gaue three hundreth pieces of siluer, and fiue sutes of raiment.
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and vnto his father likewise hee sent ten hee asses laden with the best things of egypt, and ten shee asses laden with wheate, and bread and meate for his father by the way.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: so sent he his brethren away, and they departed: and he sayde vnto them, fall not out by the way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: then they went vp from egypt, and came vnto the land of canaan vnto iaakob their father,
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and tolde him, saying, ioseph is yet aliue, and he also is gouernour ouer all the lande of egypt, and iaakobs heart failed: for he beleeued them not.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: and they told him al the words of ioseph, which he had said vnto the: but when he saw the charets, which ioseph had sent to cary him, then the spirit of iaakob their father reuiued.
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and israel said, i haue inough: ioseph my sonne is yet aliue: i will go and see him yer i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: then israel tooke his iourney with all that he had, and came to beer-sheba, and offered sacrifice vnto the god of his father izhak.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: and god spake vnto israel in a vision by night, saying, iaakob, iaakob. who answered, i am here.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: then hee sayde, i am god, the god of thy father, feare not to goe downe into egypt: for i will there make of thee a great nation.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i wil go downe with thee into egypt, and i will also bring thee vp againe, and ioseph shall put his hand vpon thine eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: then iaakob rose vp from beer-sheba: and the sonnes of israel caried iaakob their father, and their children, and their wiues in the charets, which pharaoh had sent to cary him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and they tooke their cattell and their goods, which they had gotten in the lande of canaan, and came into egypt, both iaakob and all his seede with him, his sonnes and his sonnes sonnes with him, his daughters and his sonnes daughters, and al his seede brought he with him into egypt.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: and these are the names of the children of israel, which came into egypt, euen iaakob and his sonnes: reuben, iaakobs first borne.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: and the sonnes of reuben: hanoch, and phallu, and hezron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: and the sonnes of simeon: iemuel, and iamin, and ohad, and iachin, and zohar; and shaul the sonne of a canaanitish woman.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: also the sonnes of leui: gershon, kohath, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: also the sonnes of iudah: er, and onan, and shelah, and pharez, and zerah: but er and onan died in ye land of canaan and the sonnes of pharez were hezron and hamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: also the sonnes of issachar: tola, and phuuah, and iob, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: also the sonnes of zebulun: sered, and elon, and iahleel.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these bee the sonnes of leah, which shee bare vnto iaakob in padan aram, with his daughter dinah. all the soules of his sonnes and his daughters were thirtie and three.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: also the sonnes of gad: ziphion, and haggi, shuni, and ezbon, eri, and arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: also the sonnes of asher: iimnah, and ishuah, and isui, and beriah, and serah their sister. and the sonnes of beriah: heber, and malchiel.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these are the children of zilpah, whome laban gaue to leah his daughter: and these shee bare vnto iaakob, euen sixtene soules.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the sonnes of rahel iaakobs wife were ioseph and beniamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and vnto ioseph in the lande of egypt were borne manasseh, and ephraim, which asenath the daughter of poti-pherah prince of on bare vnto him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: also the sonnes of beniamin: belah, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and naaman, ehi, and rosh, muppim, and huppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these are the sonnes of rahel, which were borne vnto iaakob, fourteene soules in all.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: also the sonnes of dan: hushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: also the sonnes of naphtali: iahzeel, and guni, and iezer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these are the sonnes of bilhah, which laban gaue vnto rahel his daughter, and shee bare these to iaakob, in all, seuen soules.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: al the soules, that came with iaakob into egypt, which came out of his loynes beside iaakobs sonnes wiues were in the whole, three score and sixe soules.
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: also the sonnes of ioseph, which were borne him in egypt, were two soules: so that al the soules of the house of iaakob, which came into egypt, are seuentie.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: the he sent iudah before him vnto ioseph, to direct his way vnto goshen, and they came into the land of goshen.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: then ioseph made ready his charet and went vp to goshen to meete israel his father, and presented himselfe vnto him and fel on his necke, and wept vpon his necke a good while.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and israel sayde vnto ioseph, now let me die, since i haue seene thy face, and that thou art yet aliue.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: then ioseph said to his brethren, and to his fathers house, i wil go vp and shew pharaoh, and tell him, my brethren and my fathers house, which were in the land of canaan, are come vnto me,
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and the men are shepheardes, and because they are shepheardes, they haue brought their sheepe and their cattell, and all that they haue.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and if pharaoh call you, and aske you, what is your trade?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: then ye shall say, thy seruants are men occupied about cattell, from our childehood euen vnto this time, both we and our fathers: that yee may dwell in the lande of goshen: for euery sheepe keeper is an abomination vnto the egyptians.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: then came ioseph and tolde pharaoh, and sayde, my father, and my brethren, and their sheepe, and their cattell, and all that they haue, are come out of the land of canaan, and behold, they are in the land of goshen. and ioseph tooke part of his brethren, euen fiue men, and presented them vnto pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: then pharaoh said vnto his brethren, what is your trade? and they answered pharaoh, thy seruants are shepheards, both we and our fathers.
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: they sayde moreouer vnto pharaoh, for to soiourne in ye lande are we come: for thy seruants haue no pasture for their sheepe, so sore is ye famine in the lande of canaan. nowe therefore, we pray thee, let thy seruants dwel in the land of goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: then spake pharaoh to ioseph, saying, thy father and thy brethren are come vnto thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: the lande of egypt is before thee: in the best place of the land make thy father and thy brethren dwel: let the dwel in the land of goshen: and if thou knowest that there be men of actiuitie among them, make them rulers ouer my cattell.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: ioseph also brought iaakob his father, and set him before pharaoh. and iaakob saluted pharaoh.
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then pharaoh sayde vnto iaakob, howe olde art thou?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and iaakob sayd vnto pharaoh, the whole time of my pilgrimage is an hundreth and thirty yeeres: fewe and euill haue the dayes of my life bene, and i haue not attayned vnto the yeeres of the life of my fathers, in the dayes of their pilgrimages.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and iaakob tooke leaue of pharaoh, and departed from the presence of pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and ioseph placed his father, and his brethren, and gaue them possession in the lande of egypt, in the best of the land, euen in the lande of rameses, as pharaoh had commanded.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and ioseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his fathers houshold with bread, euen to the yong children.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: now there was no bread in all the land: for the famine was exceeding sore: so that the land of egypt, and the land of canaan were famished by reason of the famine.
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: and ioseph gathered all the money, that was found in the land of egypt, and in the land of canaan, for the corne which they bought, and ioseph layd vp the money in pharaohs house.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: so when money fayled in the lande of egypt, and in the lande of canaan, then all the egyptians came vnto ioseph, and sayde, giue vs bread: for why should we dye before thee? for our money is spent.
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: then saide ioseph, bring your cattell, and i will giue you for your cattell, if your money be spent.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: so they brought their cattell vnto ioseph, and ioseph gaue them bread for the horses, and for the flockes of sheepe, and for the heards of cattel, and for the asses: so he fed them with bread for all their cattell that yeere.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: but when the yeere was ended, they came vnto him the next yeere, and sayd vnto him, we will not hide from my lord, that since our money is spent, and my lord hath the heards of the cattel, there is nothing left in the sight of my lorde, but our bodies and our ground.
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: why shall we perish in thy sight, both we, and our land? bye vs and our land for bread, and we and our land will be bonde to pharaoh: therefore giue vs seede, that we may liue and not dye, and that the land go not to waste.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so ioseph bought all the lande of egypt for pharaoh: for the egyptians solde euery man his ground because the famine was sore vpon the: so the land became pharaohs.
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: and he remoued the people vnto the cities, from one side of egypt euen to the other.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: onely the lande of the priestes bought he not: for the priestes had an ordinarie of pharaoh, and they did eate their ordinarie, which pharaoh gaue them: wherefore they solde not their grounde.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: then ioseph sayd vnto the people, behold, i haue bought you this daye, and your lande for pharaoh: lo, here is seede for you: sowe therefore the grounde.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: and of the encrease ye shall giue the fifth part vnto pharaoh, and foure partes shalbe yours for the seede of the fielde, and for your meate, and for them of your housholdes, and for your children to eate.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: then they answered, thou hast saued our liues: let vs finde grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be pharaohs seruants.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: then ioseph made it a lawe ouer the land of egypt vnto this day, that pharaoh should haue the fift part, except the land of the priests only, which was not pharaohs.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: and israel dwelt in the lande of egypt, in the countrey of goshen: and they had their possessions therein, and grewe and multiplied exceedingly.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: moreouer, iaakob liued in the lande of egypt seuenteene yeeres, so that the whole age of iaakob was an hundreth fourtie and seuen yeere.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: now when the time drewe neere that israel must dye, he called his sonne ioseph, and sayde vnto him, if i haue nowe founde grace in thy sight, put thine hand nowe vnder my thigh, and deale mercifully and truely with me: burie me not, i pray thee, in egypt.
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but when i shall sleepe with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of egypt, and bury mee in their buryall. and he answered, i will doe as thou hast sayde.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: the he said, sweare vnto me. and he sware vnto him. and israel worshipped towardes the beds head.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: againe after this, one sayd to ioseph, loe, thy father is sicke: then hee tooke with him his two sonnes, manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: also one told iaakob, and said, behold, thy sonne ioseph is come to thee, and israel tooke his strength vnto him and sate vpon the bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: then iaakob sayde vnto ioseph, god almightie appeared vnto me at luz in the land of canaan, and blessed me.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and he sayde vnto me, behold, i wil make thee fruitefull, and will multiplie thee, and will make a great number of people of thee, and will giue this lande vnto thy seede after thee for an euerlasting possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: and now thy two sonnes, manasseh and ephraim, which are borne vnto thee in the lande of egypt, before i came to thee into egypt, shall be mine, as reuben and simeon are mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: but the linage, which thou hast begotten after them, shalbe thine: they shall be called after the names of their brethren in their inheritance.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: nowe when i came from padan, rahel died vpon mine hande in the lande of canaan, by the way when there was but halfe a dayes iourney of grounde to come to ephrath: and i buryed her there in the way to ephrath: the same is beth-lehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: then israel beheld iosephs sonnes and sayd, whose are these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: and ioseph sayd vnto his father, they are my sonnes, which god hath giuen mee here. then he sayd, i pray thee, bring them to me, that i may blesse them:
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: for the eyes of israel were dimme for age, so that hee coulde not well see then he caused them to come to him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and israel sayde vnto ioseph, i had not thought to haue seene thy face: yet lo, god hath shewed me also thy seede.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and ioseph tooke them away from his knees, and did reuerence downe to the ground.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: then tooke ioseph them both, ephraim in his right hand towarde israels left hand, and manasseh in his left hand toward israels right hand, so he brought them vnto him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: but israel stretched out his right hand, and layde it on ephraims head, which was the yonger, and his left hande vpon manassehs head directing his handes of purpose for manasseh was the elder.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: also he blessed ioseph and sayde, the god, before whom my fathers abraham and izhak did walke, the god, which hath fed me al my life long vnto this day, blesse thee.
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel, which hath deliuered me from all euill, blesse the children, and let my name be named vpon them, and the name of my fathers abraham and izhak, that they may growe as fish into a multitude in the middes of the earth.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: but when ioseph sawe that his father layde his right hande vpon the head of ephraim, it displeased him: and he stayed his fathers hand to remooue it from ephraims head to manassehs head.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: and ioseph sayde vnto his father, not so, my father, for this is the eldest: put thy right hand vpon his head.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: but his father refused, and sayd, i know well, my sonne, i know well: he shalbe also a people, and he shalbe great likewise: but his yonger brother shalbe greater then he, and his seede shall be full of nations.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: so he blessed them that day, and sayde, in thee israel shall blesse, and say, god make thee as ephraim and as manasseh. and he set ephraim before manasseh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. ' dènge j'ara ne'e, yakob ale uuru ngara efraim nèti ngara a'a na manase.

source_text: then israel said vnto ioseph, behold, i die, and god shall be with you, and bring you againe vnto the land of your fathers.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ana, ee! ja'a nèbhu heka madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua dènge miu, ho èèna na nèti hari miu asa era pea-palu'u bèi-baki miu.

source_text: moreouer, i haue giuen vnto thee one portion aboue thy brethren, which i gate out of the hand of the amorite by my sworde and by my bowe.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu risi eele nèti a'ari èu. aa ja'a hia tabha èu, ledhe ètu rai kana'an èèna, dhu uru na ja'a kore nèti dhèu amori, lod'o ja'a segi rèngu ètu d'ara pamusu.

source_text: then iaakob called his sonnes, and sayde, gather your selues together, that i may tell you what shall come to you in the last dayes.
target_text: hèia yakob pua ana na aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko. ropa ra kaboko aa'i, na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a aa'i-aa'i! mai padètu dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara mamuri mi èci-èci lod'o limuri.

source_text: gather your selues together, and heare, ye sonnes of iaakob, and hearken vnto israel your father.
target_text: ka na peka mema dènge ana-ana na si, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, ana-ana yakob! mai titu lingu mere ja'a. mi nanene, ama miu isra'el ne, neo padhai lii.

source_text: reuben mine eldest sonne, thou art my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellencie of dignitie, and the excellencie of power:
target_text: ruben! èu ne, ana ja'a dhu uru tèka! èu ne'e tatea ja'a, dènge ai g'ana ja'a. dhèu pakab'ua risi èu.

source_text: thou wast light as water: thou shalt not be excellent, because thou wentest vp to thy fathers bed: then diddest thou defile my bed, thy dignitie is gone.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara èu èra boe, sama sèmi rii dhasi dhu la'e-mai la'e-mai. cag'ag'a laa, èu lamu j'unu dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, ka pakaj'alu era j'unu ama èu. tatao èu èèna ka, pamanahu eele kolongara ca dhèu a'a.

source_text: simeon and leui, brethren in euill, the instruments of crueltie are in their habitations.
target_text: simeon dènge lewi! miu dua mi ca rupa. miu dua mi, malai titu kèna ded'e samala, ho paj'èra dhèu.

source_text: into their secret let not my soule come: my glory, be not thou ioyned with their assembly: for in their wrath they slew a man, and in their selfe will they digged downe a wall.
target_text: ladhe miu pare pama'ète kalua haga sapi, ho ra kapod'e reo-reo ètu era, na lèke dad'èi miu kèna. aa bhabhelu miu hari, ladhe miu kadhi ngutu, na mi pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pahae boe lii padhai lii miu. aa ja'a d'èi boe tao madha-dhilu mi lii langu miu.

source_text: cursed be their wrath, for it was fierce, and their rage, for it was cruell: i will deuide them in iaakob, and scatter them in israel.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo bhelu-katub'a miu ne, te seli-kolane nga! dènge nanasa miu dhu dènge boe sasue ciki sa hèi. ladhe èèna na, miu pasae unu mi, bhelu-katub'a miu sèra. ho èèna na, lamatua ceb'e ana-èpu miu, asa g'ana asa kariu. ka ra paceb'a asa mia-mia, ètu dedha rai isra'el.

source_text: thou iudah, thy brethre shall praise thee: thine hande shalbe in the necke of thine enemies: thy fathers sonnes shall bowe downe vnto thee.
target_text: yahuda! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘koa-kio'. a'ari èu èèna na ra koa èu, aa ra pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua èu. èu ne, j'èli musu èu, toke ra bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: iudah, as a lions whelpe shalt thou come vp from the spoyle, my sonne. he shall lye downe and couche as a lion, and as a lionesse: who shall stirre him vp?
target_text: èu ne, sama sèmi singa ngèru dhu èra, ho tenge nganga'a unu mu. aa èu ne, sama sèmi singa mone, dhu tèku iisi neo bhèj'i; èci sa bani boe pagagai dènge èu. èu kahèi sèmi singa rena, dhu madhenge ana; èci sa bani boe gagu. èci èèna ka dènge èu. dhèu èci sa bani boe padadisi, aa bani boe tao macam-macam mi dedha èu.

source_text: the scepter shall not depart from iudah, nor a lawegiuer from betweene his feete, vntill shiloh come, and the people shall be gathered vnto him.
target_text: èèna na èu mèd'u paredha. ana-èpu èu oo rèd'u paredha padhutu-dhutu, toke abhu èci dhu hak nèngu risi eele nèti cahag'e, ho nèd'u paredha na. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, pahaha iisi ho nanene lii paredha nèngu hèi.

source_text: he shall binde his asse foale vnto ye vine, and his asses colte vnto the best vine. hee shall wash his garment in wine, and his cloke in the blood of grapes.
target_text: èèna na, èu ne mamuri dènge karej'e-karae. èu neo ngaa, na abhu. èu neo tao ngaa, na j'aj'i! aa ladhe èèna na, badha-manu, dènge isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu, asa ae d'ai ceb'e lebhe eele hèi.

source_text: his eyes shalbe red with wine, and his teeth white with milke.
target_text: nganga'a-nginu èu, dhu be'a hua, aa dhu èle boe.

source_text: zebulun shall dwell by the sea side, and he shalbe an hauen for shippes: and his border shalbe vnto zidon.
target_text: sebolon! rai pusaka dhu èu unu, kapai seli, nèti nebhe dhasi toke d'ai too dènge kota sidon. kapa-kapa mai nèti mia-mia ho panahu dènge be'a ètu d'ara hèb'a-namo dhasi èu.

source_text: issachar shalbe a strong asse, couching downe betweene two burdens: and he shall see that rest is good, and that the land is pleasant, and he shall bow his shoulder to beare, and shalbe subiect vnto tribute.
target_text: isaskar! èu ne, sama sèmi keled'ei dhu èra, te ngaa èu kètu hadhu papake na aad'o. ladhe èu j'unu ètu talora j'ara, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pakèd'i èu ho kako taruu. te ngaa ladhe èu mèdhi rae ètu ca bèka nèi be'a, èci sa dhae pua mèka èèna ka, mu pasae mèti le mèdha-panyau èu ho lamu. tatu èu sama sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: dan shall iudge his people as one of the tribes of israel.
target_text: dan! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘dhèu pama'ète lii'. aa èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu, ladhe bèli-camèd'a pama'ète lii nèti dhèu èu isra'el sèra, dènge boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder by the path, byting the horse heeles, so that his rider shall fall backward.
target_text: aa èu ne, sama èci èèna ka dènge mege kaisao dhu j'unu ètu sebhe j'ara. dhèu ca'e jara ho èèna na, èu kadhi haga jara èèna nèti kabodho, toke dhèu manahu sa rai.

source_text: o lord, i haue waited for thy saluation.
target_text: o lamatua! ja'a ke'a na èu hia mamuri mi ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: gad, an hoste of men shall ouercome him, but he shall ouercome at the last.
target_text: gad! ngara èu, lii na oe èci èèna ka dènge, ‘age'. ladhe èèna na, dhèu parapo mai age èu, te ngaa èu kabèli hari age si, ka mu segi si.

source_text: concerning asher, his bread shalbe fat, and he shall giue pleasures for a king.
target_text: aser! ladhe èèna isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu be'a risi, d'ai èu tao koki dhu be'a bia, ka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai hèli ètu èu.

source_text: naphtali shalbe a hinde let goe, giuing goodly wordes.
target_text: naftali! èu ne sama sèmi rusa hui, dhu dhèu èci sa ator rare boe èu. ana-ana matana èu, bhèni iia dènge mone iia.

source_text: ioseph shalbe a fruitefull bough, euen a fruitful bough by the well side: the small boughs shall runne vpon the wall.
target_text: yusuf! èu ne, sama sèmi aj'u loro dhu dètu dènge madha èi. dadana na loro asa tembok dhu dedha aae.

source_text: and the archers grieued him, and shotte against him and hated him.
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu tèka d'ara dènge èu, sama èci èèna ka, dènge musu dhu neo kataki èu.

source_text: but his bowe abode strong, and the hands of his armes were strengthened, by the handes of the mighty god of iaakob, of whom was the feeder appointed, by the stone of israel,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ja'a mangaj'i na, bera-bera dènge èu. ho na pa'èra ai èu, ka èu kataki si hari, masi ka nèti kaj'èu èèna ka. èu segi si, lula ama lamatua dhu tolong èu. mema koasa na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i era sarai ja'a, lula nèngu na ka dhu madhenge ja'a.

source_text: euen by the god of thy father, who shall helpe thee, and by the almightie, who shall blesse thee with heauenly blessinges from aboue, with blessings of the deepe, that lyeth beneath, with blessings of the brestes, and of the wombe.
target_text: aa nèngu madhenge èu kahèi. dènge na pala-bagi hia èu mèngi-nale nèti dedha-liru, nèti rai-haha, dènge berkat ho matana ana ae-ae dhu ngi'u èra.

source_text: the blessings of thy father shalbe stronger then the blessings of mine elders: vnto the ende of the hilles of the worlde they shall be on the head of ioseph, and on the top of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
target_text: ledhe-ledhe ra ele boe. aa mamèngi-nale dhu ja'a peka mi èu ne, dedha risi nèti ledhe aa'i-aa'i ra. sèna ka hud'i laa berkat se aa'i-aa'i sabhori asa èu, lula èu ne risi nèti a'ari èu se aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: beniamin shall rauine as a wolfe: in the morning he shall deuoure the pray, and at night he shall deuide the spoyle.
target_text: benyamin! babani èu sama sèmi busa hui dhu manganga. mad'ae aae era, na kèd'i le èèna, ho bata-magèla badha hui, ho j'aj'i mi nganga'a na. aa, ladhe d'ai ka mèda, la'e papala dhu sisa hia mi ana-ana nèngu. babe'a ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: all these are the twelue tribes of israel, and thus their father spake vnto them, and blessed them: euery one of them blessed hee with a seuerall blessing.
target_text: sange ne'e ka, yakob peka dènge ana-ana na, tasa mera mia mamuri rèngu pala lod'o limuri, èci-èci ka dènge ana-èpu rèngu. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e ka, j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: and he charged them and sayd vnto them, i am ready to be gathered vnto my people: burie mee with my fathers in the caue, that is in the fielde of ephron the hittite, in the caue that is in the field of machpelah besides mamre in the land of canaan: which caue abraham bought with the fielde of ephron the hittite for a possession to burie in.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob manèngi sèna ka ana-ana na pajaji mema, peka na, nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe. ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, na miu hud'i padhane ku ja'a asa d'ara ro'a baki ku abraham. ro'a ne, ètu d'ara loe padètu dènge rae makpela, dènge mamre ètu rai kana'an. uru na baki abraham ka dhu hèli loe dènge oka na, ho j'aj'i mi era ro'a nèngu. na hèli pama'ète nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron.

source_text: there they buried abraham and sarah his wife: there they buryed izhak and rebekah his wife: and there i buried leah.
target_text: ètu era èèna, ra padhane baki èdhi abraham dènge bèi èdhi sara; ama ja'a isak dènge ina ku ribka ètu èèna kahèi. de èèna na, miu hud'i padhane ja'a mi era èèna, ètu sebhe ro'a dhèu èmu ja'a lea.

source_text: the purchase of the fielde and the caue that is therein, was bought of the children of heth.
target_text: de mage mi bhèlu, padhane ja'a ètu d'ara loe dhu baki abraham ku hèli nare èèna.

source_text: thus iaakob made an end of giuing charge to his sonnes, and plucked vp his feete into the bed and gaue vp the ghost, and was gathered to his people.
target_text: yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, na bhèj'i dènge ka ètu dedha koi na, hèia na madhe dènge ka.

source_text: then ioseph fell vpon his fathers face and wept vpon him, and kissed him.
target_text: hèia yusuf liku nare ama na, ka na tangi. na uu ama na pèri-pèri hari.

source_text: and ioseph commanded his seruantes the physicions, to enbaume his father, and the physicions enbaumed israel.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu dhu tuka urus dhèu madhe mai lalau ngi'u aae ama na dènge bubhu-bubhu, sèna ka baku ele iie.

source_text: so fourtie dayes were accomplished for so long did the dayes of them that were enbaumed last and the egyptians bewayled him seuentie dayes.
target_text: sasab'a tuka lalau ngi'u aae ama na, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, madhutu j'ara sasab'a rèngu. dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i madhutu tangi kahèi mamadhe yakob ne'e. ra beke pidhu nguru lod'o, tao sèmi dhèu kapai rèngu madhe.

source_text: and when the dayes of his mourning were past, ioseph spake to the house of pharaoh, saying, if i haue nowe found fauour in your eyes, speake, i pray you, in the eares of pharaoh, and say,
target_text: èle beke pidhu nguru lod'o, hèia yusuf peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, mi nanene! mèti ku lii ja'a ne asa dhèu aae, peka sèmi ne'e:

source_text: my father made me sweare, saying, loe, i die, bury me in my graue, which i haue made me in the land of canaan: now therefore let me go, i pray thee, and bury my father, and i wil come againe.
target_text: ‘lod'o ama ku oe madhe, na moa sèna ka ja'a laku padhane ne asa rai kana'an. de ja'a manèngi ho ama dhèu aae hia ja'a ijin laku padhane ama ku. ladhe èle na, ja'a lèpa hari mai. '

source_text: then pharaoh said, goe vp and bury thy father, as he made thee to sweare.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dhu moa le mi ama mu sèmi èèna na, lamu ho padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: so ioseph went vp to bury his father, and with him went all the seruants of pharaoh, both the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of egypt.
target_text: ka yusuf pakèd'i ka, la'e padhane ama na. dhèu ae madhutu lasi dènge ne kahèi. sèmi kapala urusan nèti dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i nèti masir.

source_text: likewise all the house of ioseph, and his brethren, and his fathers house: onely their children, and their sheepe, and their cattell left they in the land of goshen.
target_text: a'ari yusuf dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi padhane yakob. dhu ata ètu gosen dhoka dhèu èmu ra, ana iiki, dènge badha-manu ra di.

source_text: and there went vp with him both charets and horsemen: and they were an exceeding great company.
target_text: sordad'u ae madhutu kahèi. cahag'e ca'e kareta, aa cahag'e hari ca'e jara. taga dhèu dhu madhutu na, ae d'ai seli, nèti èèna ka, rombongan dhu rèti dhèu madhe ne, madhera titu kèna.

source_text: and they came to goren atad, which is beyond iorden, and there they made a great and exceeding sore lamentation: and he mourned for his father seuen dayes.
target_text: rèngu lasi, ka ra pège loko yarden ètu era èci, ngara na atad. era ne'e, dhèu biasa mai j'èli are. d'ai era ne'e, yusuf si tangi mamadhe ama na. aa ra beke hari pidhu mèda.

source_text: and when the canaanites the inhabitants of the lande sawe the mourning in goren atad, they sayde, this is a great mourning vnto the egyptians: wherefore the name thereof was called abel mizraim, which is beyond iorden.
target_text: ropa dhèu kana'an ètu sèra, ladhe na ra j'èra ae titu kèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! miu laladhe ku laa! babeke mamadhe dhèu masir se, ra susa bia nga! j'ara tatangi rèngu sèmi nèi ni ka. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare era èèna, ngara na abel-misraim. sasoa na, ‘sasusa dhèu masir'.

source_text: so his sonnes did vnto him, according as he had commanded them:
target_text: hèia ana-ana yakob se, tao madhutu sèmi lii moa rèngu uru na.

source_text: for his sonnes caried him into the lande of canaan, and buried him in the caue of the fielde of machpelah, which caue abraham bought with the fielde, to be a place to bury in, of ephron the hittite besides mamre.
target_text: ka nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yakob na, lasi padhane asa d'ara loe dhu padètu dènge rae makpela dènge mamre. abraham hèli nare era ne'e nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron, ho j'aj'i mi era udhu rui rèngu.

source_text: then ioseph returned into egypt, he and his brethren, and al that went vp with him to bury his father, after that he had buried his father.
target_text: yusuf padhane nare ama na, hèia nèngu dènge a'ari na lèpa hari asa masir. sama-sama dènge dhèu leo dhu madhutu sèra.

source_text: and when iosephs brethren saw that their father was dead, they sayde, it may be that ioseph will hate vs, and will pay vs againe all the euill, which we did vnto him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai masir, a'a yusuf se mulai madha'u. lula ama rèngu aad'o heka, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! ta pangee ku la! sèmi yusuf tèka d'ara dènge èdhi era, ho na b'ala tatao karehe èdhi mi nèngu uru èèna, na èdhi tasamia?

source_text: therefore they sent vnto ioseph, saying, thy father commanded before his death, saying,
target_text: hèia rare lii èci, ka ra hia lii la'e asa yusuf, peka na, ama wakil. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o ama èdhi mamuri era, na pua ji'i

source_text: thus shall ye say vnto ioseph, forgiue now, i pray thee, the trespasse of thy brethren, and their sinne: for they rewarded thee euil. and nowe, we pray thee, forgiue the trespasse of the seruants of thy fathers god. and ioseph wept, when they spake vnto him.
target_text: ho padhai lii dènge ama wakil, peka na, ‘yusuf hud'i bhabhèlu eele ka sasala a'a na si. lula uru na ra paj'èra ne. ' ji'i nge'a kahèi ama èdhi ne, karèi nèti uru ka mai, na mangaj'i dhoka mi ama lamatua di. ji'i kahèi j'aj'i ana pajuu lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai manèngi abho, lula uru na ji'i paj'èra le, ama wakil. ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia yusuf tangi.

source_text: also his brethren came vnto him, and fell downe before his face, and sayde, beholde, we be thy seruants.
target_text: èle èèna ka, a'a na si mai unu ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, hud'i laa ama tao ji'i j'aj'i ènu ama.

source_text: to whome ioseph sayde, feare not: for am not i vnder god?
target_text: te ngaa yusuf padhai lii dènge ra, miu se a'a ja'a! miu baku madha'u ia ka! dhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak hia huku mi dhèu. te ja'a ne, aad'o.

source_text: when ye thought euill against mee, god disposed it to good, that he might bring to passe, as it is this day, and saue much people aliue.
target_text: mema tare'a, uru na miu mere lii èci, ho neo paj'èra ja'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu ub'a eele tatao miu dhu karehe èèna, j'aj'i mi babe'a. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu ne'e, sèna ka dhèu ae abhu mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: feare not nowe therefore, i will nourish you, and your children: and hee comforted them, and spake kindly vnto them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! baku madha'u ia ka. ja'a pamoa dènge miu se, èèna na, ladhe-leru miu, dènge ana-èpu miu aa'i-aa'i ra. dènge lii padhai lii sèmi ne'e ne, yusuf pa'èra hari d'ara a'a na si.

source_text: so ioseph dwelt in egypt, he, and his fathers house: and ioseph liued an hundreth and tenne yeere.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pea taruu ètu rai masir, dènge a'ari na si, aa'i-aa'i ra. nèngu mamuri d'ai cangasu canguru tèu.

source_text: and ioseph saw ephraims children, euen vnto the third generation: also the sonnes of machir the sonne of manasseh were brought vp on iosephs knees.
target_text: nèngu d'ai hari nèdhi ana-èpu efraim kahèi. aa na leru èpu manase, nuka ana-ana nèti makir.

source_text: and ioseph sayd vnto his brethren, i am ready to dye, and god will surely visite you, and bring you out of this land, vnto ye land which hee sware vnto abraham, vnto izhak, and vnto iaakob.
target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: and ioseph tooke an othe of the children of israel, saying, god will surely visite you, and ye shall cary my bones hence.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: so ioseph died, when he was an hundreth and ten yere olde: and they enbaumed him and put him in a chest in egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.

source_text: the booke of the generation of jesus christ the sonne of dauid, the sonne of abraham. abraham begate isaac. and isaac begate iacob. and iacob begat iudas and his brethren.
target_text: sasuri ne, lole j'ara mamuri nèti yesus kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha mema ho neo pua mai. yesus ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud dènge abraham. karèi nèti abraham toke dhèu aae daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki. kabhia na sèmi ne'e: abraham matana isak, isak matana yakob, yakob matana yahuda dènge a'ari na,

source_text: and iudas begate phares, and zara of thamar. and phares begate esrom. and esrom begate aram.
target_text: yahuda matana peres dènge sera ina ra, ngara na tamar peres matana herson, herson matana ram,

source_text: and aram begate aminadab. and aminadab begate naasson. and naasson begat salmon.
target_text: ram matana aminadab, aminadab matana nahason, nahason matana salmon,

source_text: and salmon begate booz of rachab. and booz begat obed of ruth. and obed begat iesse.
target_text: salmon matana boas ina na, ngara na rahab boas matana obet ina na, ngara na rut, obet matana isai,

source_text: and iesse begate dauid the king. and dauid the king begate salomon of her that was the wife of vrias.
target_text: isai matana daud.

source_text: and salomon begate roboam. and roboam begate abia. and abia begate asa. and asa begate iosaphat. and iosaphat begate ioram. and ioram begate hozias. and hozias begat ioatham. and ioatham begate achaz. and achaz begate ezekias. and ezekias begate manasses. and manasses begate amon. and amon begate iosias. and iosias begate iakim. and iakim begate iechonias and his brethren about the time they were caried away to babylon.
target_text: nèti daud toke lod'o dhu ra babège suku isra'el asa babel, abhu hari canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: daud matana soleman ina na, uru èèna dhèu èmu uria. soleman matana rehabeam, rehabeam matana abia, abia matana asaf, asaf matana yosafat, yosafat matana yoram, yoram matana usia, usia matana yotam, yotam matana ahas, ahas matana heskia, heskia matana manase, manase matana amos, amos matana yosias, yosias matana yekonya dènge ari na, lod'o babège si asa babel.

source_text: and after they were caried away into babylon, iechonias begate salathiel. and salathiel begate zorobabel. and zorobabel begate abiud. and abiud begate eliacim. and eliacim begate azor. and azor begate sadoc. and sadoc begate achim. and achim begate eliud. and eliud begate eleazar. and eleazar begate matthan. and matthan begate iacob. and iacob begat ioseph ye husband of mary, of whom was borne jesus, that is called christ.
target_text: lod'o babège si asa babel, toke d'ai rara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: yekonya matana saltiel, saltiel matana serubabel, serubabel matana abihut, abihut matana elyakim, elyakim matana asor, asor matana sadok, sadok matana akim, akim matana eliut, eliut matana eliasar, eliasar matana matan, matan matana yakob, yakob matana yusuf, yusuf ne, dhèu èmu maria. maria ne ka dhu nara iisi yesus kristus.

source_text: so all the generations from abraham to dauid, are fourtene generations. and from dauid vntil they were caried away into babylon, fourtene generations: and after they were caried away into babylon vntill christ, fourteene generations.
target_text: de karèi nèti abraham toke daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; nèti daud toke lod'o ra babège si asa babel abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; aa nèti lod'o ra babège si asa babel d'ai maria nara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki.

source_text: nowe the birth of jesus christ was thus, when as his mother mary was betrothed to ioseph, before they came together, shee was found with childe of the holy ghost.
target_text: lii lolo maria nara iisi yesus sèmi ne'e ka: maria dhu tunanga le dènge yusuf. dua ra pa'èci rèdhi mèka sama sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali, te ngaa te'a boe na, maria dhu dènge le babia nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: then ioseph her husband being a iust man, and not willing to make her a publike example, was minded to put her away secretly.
target_text: ropa yusuf ne'a, ka na neo pama'ète lii rèngu dua ra. te ngaa na d'èi boe pamakae maria ètu madha dhèu ae, lula nèngu ne ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, na neo pamau eele lii rèngu ne.

source_text: but whiles he thought these things, behold, the angel of the lord appeared vnto him in a dreame, saying, ioseph, the sonne of dauid, feare not to take mary thy wife: for that which is conceiued in her, is of the holy ghost.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o dhu na pangee era, d'ara ca mèda sa, ka nèngu nii. ètu d'ara nii ne, ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yusuf! èu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. èu mage makae leo dènge maria. te ana dhu na kad'o èèna, j'aj'i nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: and she shall bring foorth a sonne, and thou shalt call his name jesus: for hee shall saue his people from their sinnes.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a maria nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. aa èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus, te nèngu ka dhu patabuli dhèu unu ama lamatua nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: and al this was done that it might be fulfilled, which is spoken of the lord by ye prophet, saying,
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua dhu peka mema nèti uru ka, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri, peka na,

source_text: behold, a virgine shalbe with childe, and shall beare a sonne, and they shall call his name emmanuel, which is by interpretation, god with vs.
target_text: mi nanene! bèli-camèd'a abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu dhu kalora iisi, te'a boe na, nèngu dhu dènge babia le. èèna na nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka ra pangare ne, imanuel. lii ibrani, ‘imanuel' sasoa na: ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi.

source_text: then ioseph, being raised from sleepe, did as the angel of the lord had inioyned him, and tooke his wife.
target_text: ropa nii èle, yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i na. ka na madhutu ka lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na tadèngi ètu d'ara nii deo na. ka nare maria j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: but he knew her not, til she had broght forth her first borne sonne, and he called his name jesus.
target_text: te ngaa na j'unu pa'èci boe dènge maria, toke maria nara iisi aa'i. nara iisi nare ka, yusuf pangare ana ne, yesus.

source_text: when jesus then was borne at bethleem in iudea, in the dayes of herod the king, beholde, there came wisemen from the east to hierusalem,
target_text: lod'o rara iisi yesus ètu rae betlehem, ètu propensi yudea, dhèu aae herodes dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri nèti era kaj'èu, mai nèti bèka dhimu asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se, dhu re'a mèu ladhe hua-hètu.

source_text: saying, where is that king of the iewes that is borne? for wee haue seene his starre in the east, and are come to worship him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai yerusalem dhèu se pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi, dhu heka rara iisi hiu èèna, era na buli mia, ee? ji'i ngèdhi hua-hètu cue ètu bèka dhimu, dhu j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rara iisi le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai neo pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: when king herod heard this, he was troubled, and all hierusalem with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia d'ara na susa. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem sèra, d'ara ra susa kahèi.

source_text: and gathering together all the chiefe priestes and scribes of the people, hee asked of them, where christ should be borne.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae herodes paroa nare kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, ka na karèi si, peka na, miu peka sèku dènge ja'a la! kristus, dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke èèna, rara iisi ne ètu mia?

source_text: and they saide vnto him, at beth-leem in iudea: for so it is written by the prophet,
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ètu rae betlehem, propensi yudea. te ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na mika, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na:

source_text: and thou beth-leem in the lande of iuda, art not the least among the princes of iuda: for out of thee shall come the gouernour that shall feede that my people israel.
target_text: ‘wee! miu dhèu betlehem ètu propensi yudea sèra. baku pangee na, rae miu ne, ca rae iiki dhu dhèu ige boe. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu kapai ca dhèu cèu mai nèti rae ne'e. èèna na nèngu j'aj'i dhèu madhenga mi dhèu ja'a, dhèu isra'el. '

source_text: then herod priuily called the wisemen, and diligently inquired of them the time of the starre that appeared,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae herodes paroa mau-mau dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra. ka na karèi, na, lod'o mia miu ladhe mèdhi hua-hètu ne cèu ètu dedha-liru? hèia ra peka dènge ne.

source_text: and sent them to beth-leem, saying, goe, and searche diligently for the babe: and when ye haue founde him, bring mee worde againe, that i may come also, and worship him.
target_text: èle ka, na hia si lasi asa betlehem. na moa dènge ra, peka na, lami ho tenge palème era, ètu mia ana ne. ladhe miu rage, na, lèpa hari mai sèna ka peka dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo laku pahaha iisi mi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: so when they had heard the king, they departed: and loe, the starre which they had seene in the east, went before them, till it came and stoode ouer the place where the babe was.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai dhèu aae, hèia lasi dènge ka. kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi hari hua-hètu dhu uru èèna rèdhi ètu bèka dhimu. hua-hètu ne cèu ètu madha rèngu, na kako uru nèti rèngu, hèia tèja ètu dedha era ana ne pea.

source_text: and when they sawe the starre, they reioyced with an exceeding great ioy,
target_text: ropa rèdhi, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: and went into the house, and founde the babe with mary his mother, and fell downe, and worshipped him, and opened their treasures, and presented vnto him giftes, euen golde, and frankincense, and myrrhe.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe rèdhi ana ne dènge ina na maria. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi ana ne. ka dhèu se bhoke mèdha dhu kab'ua rèti hia ana ne. ra hia hualaa, kemenyan dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi.

source_text: and after they were warned of god in a dreame, that they should not go againe to herod, they returned into their countrey another way.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka dhèu se abhu nii nèti ama lamatua, peka na, lami ia ka asa dhèu aae herodes. nèti èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa rai rèngu re j'ara leo.

source_text: after their departure, behold, the angel of the lord appeareth to ioseph in a dreame, saying, arise, and take the babe and his mother, and flee into egypt, and be there til i bring thee word: for herod will seeke the babe, to destroy him.
target_text: lod'o dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu se lèpa, hèia ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga, mai peka dènge yusuf ètu d'ara nii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! pakèd'i dènge ka d'ara lai-lai ne! mèti ana ne dènge ina na lami asa masir. pea ètu nèi, toke ja'a peka d'ai lod'o mia miu lèpa hari. te dhèu aae herodes tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ana ne!

source_text: so he arose and tooke the babe and his mother by night, and departed into egypt,
target_text: hèia yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka mèda èèna kahèi, nèti dhèu èmu na dènge ana ne, rai lasi asa masir.

source_text: and was there vnto the death of herod, that that might be fulfilled, which is spoken of the lord by the prophet, saying, out of egypt haue i called my sonne.
target_text: ra pea ètu nèi toke dhèu aae herodes madhe. j'ara èèna, nuka sèmi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na hosea, suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka, na, ja'a paroa hari ana ku, ho lèpa ka nèti masir.

source_text: then herod, seeing that he was mocked of the wisemen, was exceeding wroth, and sent foorth, and slew all the male children that were in beth-leem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two yeere old and vnder, according to the time which he had diligently searched out of the wisemen.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes ne'a nare, na, dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra leko-monya ne, hèia na nasa titu kèna. na paredha sordad'u na sèra, aku nèngu na, lami asa rae betlehem nèi, aa asa rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu èèna. pamadhe aa'i ana mone iiki dhu dua tèu asa haha mai. herodes hia paredha ne, lula na sanèd'e lii lolo nèti dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra. na ige karèi nèti rèngu rèdhi hiu-hiu hua-hètu cèu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: then was that fulfilled which is spoken by the prophet ieremias, saying,
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: in rhama was a voyce heard, mourning, and weeping, and great howling: rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they were not.
target_text: abhu lii tangi dènge lii roma iisi dhèu nèti kota rama. rahel tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ana-ana na madhe aa'i. na d'èi boe ca dhèu sa mai pamako ne, lula ana-ana na, aad'o heka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: and whe herod was dead, behold, an angel of the lord appeareth in a dreame to ioseph in egypt,
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu aae herodes madhe. lod'o èèna, yusuf si ètu masir era. hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu mai nèti sorga, pad'elo rèhu na mi nèngu ètu d'ara nii.

source_text: saying, arise, and take the babe and his mother, and goe into the land of israel: for they are dead which sought the babes life.
target_text: ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! kèd'i ka! mèti ka ana ne dènge ina na asa isra'el. te dhèu dhu neo pamadhe ana ne, madhe le.

source_text: then he arose vp and tooke the babe and his mother, and came into the land of israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yusuf kèd'i. èle ka nèti si asa rai isra'el.

source_text: but whe he heard that archelaus did reigne in iudea in stead of his father herod, he was afraide to go thither: yet after he was warned of god in a dreame, he turned aside into the parts of galile,
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf tadèngi na, arkalaus, ana dhèu aae herodes, dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae limuri ne ètu propensi yudea, ka na madha'u la'e asa yudea. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari dènge ne ètu d'ara nii, na, yusuf, èu baku pea ètu yudea. nèti èèna ka, lasi pea asa propensi galilea,

source_text: and went and dwelt in a citie called nazareth, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, which was, that hee should be called a nazarite.
target_text: ètu rae nasaret. dènge j'ara ne lii padhai ama lamatua lèke tare'a, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri tèke, na bèli-camèd'a dhèu paroa ne, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: and in those dayes, iohn the baptist came and preached in the wildernes of iudea,
target_text: lod'o yesus dhu kapai le, hèia yohanis tuka sarani mulai aj'a-nori dhèu ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: and said, repent: for the kingdome of heauen is at hand.
target_text: na aj'a peka na, a'ari pasue! miu hud'i mangaku aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu, ho lèpa asa ama lamatua. te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for this is he of whome it is spoken by the prophet esaias, saying, the voyce of him that crieth in the wildernes, prepare ye the way of the lord: make his pathes straight.
target_text: uru èèna, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri le lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu dhèu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra sèna ka tao pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mamai ama lamatua! tao pamola j'ara hia ne! '

source_text: and this iohn had his garment of camels heare, and a girdle of a skinne about his loynes: his meate was also locusts and wilde hony.
target_text: j'ara mamuri yohanis ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. mèdha-papake na tao nèti rèu badha onta. dhari hake na nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a na, kabara dènge dhua nasu oni.

source_text: then went out to him ierusalem and all iudea, and all the region rounde about iordan.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai neo paraga dènge yohanis. rèngu mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti kabarai propensi yudea aa'i-aa'i, dènge nèti rae-rae dhu dètu loko yarden.

source_text: and they were baptized of him in iordan, confessing their sinnes.
target_text: ra bhoka d'ara ra, aa mangaku sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i, èle ka yohanis sarani si ètu d'ara loko yarden.

source_text: now when he sawe many of the pharises, and of the sadduces come to his baptisme, he said vnto them, o generations of vipers, who hath forewarned you to flee from the anger to come?
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu partei agama saduki, lasi asa era èèna kahèi, manèngi yohanis sarani si. te ngaa ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi si, hèia na jèke si, peka na, heeh! miu se cakaraa mege dhu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua huku mi, lula tatao miu dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra. mage mi pangee na, miu bisa rai nèti hahuku na.

source_text: bring foorth therefore fruite worthy amendment of life.
target_text: de be'a risi miu lèpa sa ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala miu sèra. èle na, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sèmi aj'u dhu hua be'a.

source_text: and thinke not to say with your selues, we haue abraham to our father: for i say vnto you, that god is able euen of these stones to raise vp children vnto abraham.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, miu se abhu mamuri, lula j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. mi sanèd'e lii ja'a, ee! te ama lamatua bisa tao hadhu se j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham kahèi.

source_text: and now also is the axe put to the roote of the trees: therfore euery tree which bringeth not forth good fruit, is hewen downe, and cast into ye fire.
target_text: baku pamud'e! te abhu dhu kèpe mema kataka, pa'èra patue aa'i-aa'i aj'u dhu hua be'a boe, sèna ka core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: in deede i baptize you with water to amendment of life, but he that commeth after me, is mightier then i, whose shoes i am not worthie to beare: hee will baptize you with the holy ghost, and with fire.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a sarani miu pake èi, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu se tèke eele sasala-sasala miu. te ngaa pe abhu ca dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a, bèli-camèd'a mai. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi. èèna na, nèngu papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèngu tao miu j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, sama sèmi dhèu pake ai ho bhubhu maruru.

source_text: which hath his fanne in his hand, and wil make cleane his floore, and gather his wheate into his garner, but will burne vp the chaffe with vnquenchable fire.
target_text: te nèngu dhu nèd'u kokotai dènge laludhu ètu d'ara, ho neo tatai eele èto na. èle èèna, na bhori laludhu asa d'ara soka. te ngaa èto sèra, na dutu asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe boe.

source_text: then came iesus from galile to iordan vnto iohn, to be baptized of him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus puru mai nèti galilea, la'e asa loko yarden. na mai sèna ka manèngi yohanis sarani ne.

source_text: but iohn earnestly put him backe, saying, i haue neede to be baptized of thee, and commest thou to me?
target_text: te ngaa yohanis no'o boe. na pab'ala peka na, tasamia ka ja'a sarani èu? sale ne, sina ma? hud'i èu ku dhu sarani ja'a. te èèna ka dhu ja'a parluu!

source_text: then iesus answering, saide to him, let be nowe: for thus it becommeth vs to fulfill all righteousnes. so he suffered him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, pangee ia ka. te ngaa doe ne'e, hud'i laa èu di dhu sarani ja'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi nare, ka yohanis b'ala, aku nèngu na, sad'i aku èu hèia yohanis sarani yesus.

source_text: and iesus when hee was baptized, came straight out of the water. and lo, the heaues were opened vnto him, and iohn saw the spirit of god descending like a doue, and lighting vpon him.
target_text: ropa sarani èle, ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara loko. cag'ag'a laa, liru bhoke eele. hèia ladhe nèdhi roh ama lamatua puru mai, nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu mai tèka mi nèngu.

source_text: and loe, a voyce came from heauen, saying, this is my beloued sonne, in whome i am well pleased.
target_text: hèia ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, nèngu ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then was iesus led aside of the spirit into the wildernes, to be tempted of the deuil.
target_text: èle ka, roh ama lamatua nèti yesus asa d'ara mamoo, sèna ka dhèu aae nidhu sèku ne.

source_text: and when he had fasted fourtie dayes, and fourtie nights, he was afterward hungrie.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, yesus na'a-ninu boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. hèia na manganga titu kèna.

source_text: then came to him the tempter, and said, if thou be the sonne of god, commande that these stones be made bread.
target_text: ropa na manganga sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne, peka na, èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, do? ladhe tare'a, na, paredha hadhu se, ho j'aj'i nganga'a.

source_text: but he answering said, it is written, man shall not liue by bread onely, but by euery worde that proceedeth out of the mouth of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, na, dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na: ‘dhèu rai-haha mamuri mesa boe nèti nganga'a di. te ngaa rèngu hud'i nanene ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na kahèi. '

source_text: then the deuil tooke him vp into the holy citie, and set him on a pinacle of the temple,
target_text: ka dhèu aae nidhu nèti yesus asa kota yerusalem, kota lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna. èle ka, na nèti yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and said vnto him, if thou be the sonne of god, cast thy selfe downe: for it is written, that he wil giue his angels charge ouer thee, and with their hands they shall lift thee vp, lest at any time thou shouldest dash thy foote against a stone.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne, peka, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èu ridhu sèku asa haha nèi. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu nèti sorga, sèna ka j'aga èu. ' aa ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri kahèi, ‘pe ra kanata ai ra, ho sibhe èu, sèna ka ngi'u èu pèd'a boe, aa haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: iesus saide vnto him, it is written againe, thou shalt not tempt the lord thy god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, abhu kahèi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua èu. de èu baku pua ne pake koasa na, sèna ka pad'elo bukti, peka na, nèngu èèna, tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. '

source_text: againe the deuil tooke him vp into an exceeding hie mountaine, and shewed him all the kingdomes of the world, and the glory of them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu ne nèti hari yesus asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae. hèia na pad'elo aa'i saraga dènge babe'a negara aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and sayd to him, all these will i giue thee, if thou wilt fall downe, and worship me.
target_text: ropa na pad'elo nare, hèia dhèu aae nidhu ne peka, aku nèngu na, sad'i èu patitu kètu urutuu, sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ja'a, pe ja'a hia aa'i se'e se mi èu.

source_text: then sayd iesus vnto him, auoyde satan: for it is written, thou shalt worship the lord thy god, and him onely shalt thou serue.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, he, nidhu! pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e ne! te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri na, ‘èu hud'i pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, aa èu ne hud'i sab'a ku dhoka hia nèngu di. '

source_text: then the deuill left him: and beholde, the angels came, and ministred vnto him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae nidhu tadèngi lii ne, hèia na tèke eele yesus. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai uri ne.

source_text: and when iesus had heard that iohn was committed to prison, he returned into galile.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes pamaso yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ropa yesus tadèngi, hèia na lèpa asa galilea.

source_text: and leauing nazareth, went and dwelt in capernaum, which is neere the sea in the borders of zabulon and nephthalim,
target_text: la'e asa rae na nasaret, èle ka la'e taruu pea ètu rae kapernaum. rae èèna ètu sebhe dano galilea, ètu rai sebulon dènge naftali.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by esaias the propet, saying,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, na tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: the land of zabulon, and the land of nephthalim by the way of the sea, beyond iordan, galile of the gentiles:
target_text: rai sebulon dènge rai naftali dhu padètu dènge dano galilea ètu sebhe haa loko yarden. dhèu yahudi boe pea ètu era sèra kahèi.

source_text: the people which sate in darkenes, sawe great light: and to them which sate in the region, and shadowe of death, light is risen vp.
target_text: rèngu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa limuri ne, rèdhi le saraa. aa saraa ne heo le palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: from that time iesus began to preach, and to say, amende your liues: for the kingdome of heauen is at hand.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus mulai aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i soro kabodho aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, ho mamuri ka dènge mola-mèci! te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa le j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and iesus walking by the sea of galile, sawe two brethren, simon, which was called peter, and andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea for they were fishers.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea. na paraga dènge dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari. èci ngara na simon, dhu tema paroa ne, petrus. aa ari na, anderias. dua ra dhu pèku i'a ètu dano galilea, lula dua ra dhèu sab'a dhasi.

source_text: and he sayd vnto them, follow me, and i will make you fishers of men.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai ku madhutu ja'a! miu biasa tenge i'a, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo aj'a miu ho j'aj'i tuka tenge dhèu.

source_text: and they straightway leauing the nets, folowed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia dua ra tèke eele dènge ka pèku ra, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when he was gone forth from thence, he saw other two brethren, iames the sonne of zebedeus, and iohn his brother in a ship with zebedeus their father, mending their nets, and he called them.
target_text: èle ka, yesus kako hari ciki, hèia ladhe nèdhi ana sabadeus, dhèu dua. a'a, ngara na yakobis, aa ari na, yohanis. dua ra dhu lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha sama-sama dènge ama ra. hèia yesus paroa dua ra, sèna ka madhutu ne.

source_text: and they without tarying, leauing the ship, and their father, folowed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ra tèke eele ama dènge koha ra, lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: so iesus went about all galile, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdome, and healing euery sicknesse and euery disease among the people.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si kako palème propensi galilea, ho na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. na aj'a lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa na peka j'ara-j'ara tasamia, sèna ka dhèu bisa madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti rupa-rupa papèd'a-tarègu.
