target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but i say vnto you, that it shall be easier for them of the land of sodom in the day of iudgement, then for thee.
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: at that time iesus answered, and saide, i giue thee thankes, o father, lord of heauen and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and men of vnderstanding, and hast opened them vnto babes.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: it is so, o father, because thy good pleasure was such.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things are giuen vnto me of my father: and no man knoweth the sonne, but ye father: neither knoweth any man ye father, but the sonne, and he to whom ye sonne will reueile him.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come vnto me, all ye that are wearie and laden, and i will ease you.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: take my yoke on you, and learne of me that i am meeke and lowly in heart: and ye shall finde rest vnto your soules.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my yoke is easie, and my burden light.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: at that time iesus went on a sabbath day through ye corne, and his disciples were an hungred, and bega to plucke ye eares of corne and to eate.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: and when the pharises sawe it, they saide vnto him, beholde, thy disciples doe that which is not lawfull to doe vpon the sabbath.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: but he said vnto them, haue ye not read what dauid did when he was an hungred, and they that were with him? howe he entred into ye house of god, and did eate the shewe bread, which was not lawfull for him to eate, neither for them which were with him, but onely for the priestes?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: or haue ye not read in the lawe, how that on the sabbath dayes the priestes in the temple breake the sabbath, and are blameles?
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but i say vnto you, that here is one greater then the temple.
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: wherefore if ye knewe what this is, i will haue mercie, and not sacrifice, ye would not haue condemned the innocents.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for the sonne of man is lord, euen of the sabbath.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète, peka na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: and he departed thence, and went into their synagogue:
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: and beholde, there was a man which had his hand dried vp. and they asked him, saying, is it lawfull to heale vpon a sabbath day? that they might accuse him.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he said vnto the, what man shall there be among you, that hath a sheepe, and if it fal on a sabbath day into a pit, doth not take it and lift it out?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: how much more then is a man better then a sheepe? therefore, it is lawfull to doe well on a sabbath day.
target_text: de ama lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha, risi nèti dhèu unu kahib'i-kalèbho deo na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bisa tao j'ara dhu be'a lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then said he to the man, stretch forth thine hand. and he stretched it foorth, and it was made whole as the other.
target_text: ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai! hèia, na j'ole kacui-aai dhu madhe èèna, kaca'a la èle dènge ka, sama dènge kacui-aai dhu iia èèna.

source_text: then the pharises went out, and consulted against him, howe they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi se rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa titu kèna. èle ka ra kalua tèke eele èmu sabaj'a ne, hèia lasi pare'a, aku rèngu na, èdhi hud'i tenge ku j'ara, sèna ka pamadhe ne!

source_text: but whe iesus knew it, he departed thece, and great multitudes folowed him, and he healed the al,
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a ngangee rèngu dhu karehe ne, nèti èèna ka la'e asa era leo. dhèu ae madhutu ne, hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and charged them in threatning wise, that they should not make him knowen,
target_text: te ngaa na kai si, peka na, mage lami palolo kahèi dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled, which was spoken by esaias the prophet, saying,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna, madhutu sèmi lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka le mi dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke, na,

source_text: behold my seruant whom i haue chosen, my beloued in whom my soule deliteth: i wil put my spirit on him, and he shall shewe iudgement to the gentiles.
target_text: ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a, dhu ja'a hag'e kore le. ja'a sue ne, aa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu dènge ne. èèna na, ja'a pangèd'u ne roh ja'a, ho la'e aj'a-nori dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: he shall not striue, nor crie, neither shall any man heare his voyce in the streetes.
target_text: nèngu ne, ne'a boe tèb'a kakara. nèngu ne, ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: a bruised reede shall he not breake, and smoking flaxe shall he not quenche, till he bring forth iudgement vnto victorie.
target_text: d'ara na hua iia. dhu ne'a boe paj'èra dhèu. aj'u dhu oe padhe, na lèku eele boe. labhu dhu saruru, na tiu pamadhe boe. na loe boe aj'a-nori dhèu, toke dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and in his name shall the gentiles trust.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i èèna na parcaya ne, lula re'a na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: then was brought to him one, possessed with a deuill, both blind, and dumme, and he healed him, so that he which was blind and dumme, both spake and saw.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: and all the people were amased, and saide, is not this that sonne of dauid?
target_text: dhèu ae se, ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, nèngu ne'e, ele boe ana-èpu daud, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka! nèngu ne'e, tatu dhèu dhu èdhi mate tae-tae èèna!

source_text: but when the pharises heard it, they saide, this man casteth the deuils no otherwise out, but through beelzebub the prince of deuils.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi rare, hèia ra ro'o boe parcaya. ka ra papeka, na, wee! dhèu ne bisa babège nidhu, lula dhèu aae nidhu baalsebul ka dhu pangèd'u na koasa.

source_text: but iesus knew their thoughtes, and said to them, euery kingdome deuided against it selfe, is brought to nought: and euery citie or house, deuided against it selfe, shall not stand.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: so if satan cast out satan, he is deuided against himself: how shall then his kingdom endure?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu pamusu dènge nidhu, aa palab'a èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe!

source_text: also if i through beelzebub cast out deuils, by whom doe your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your iudges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu re'a kahèi babège eele nidhu. ra pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o! de miu baku padhai lii ore dhu peka na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu, ho babège eele nidhu. pe dhèu miu unu mi ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but if i cast out deuils by ye spirit of god, then is the kingdome of god come vnto you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a babège eele nidhu pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua, èèna pad'elo na, lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhu ètu le katanga madha miu.

source_text: els howe can a man enter into a strong mans house and spoyle his goods, except he first bind the strong man, and then spoile his house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo lasi mana'u èmu dhèu èci dhu èra, nèngu hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku dhèu lamatua èmu ne. heka na mana'u nèti mèdha-panyau na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me, is against me: and he that gathereth not with me, scattereth.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu pamusu dènge ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ja'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka pa'iu dhèu di.

source_text: wherefore i say vnto you, euery sinne and blasphemie shalbe forgiuen vnto men: but the blasphemie against the holy ghost shall not be forgiuen vnto men.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ama lamatua dhu sadia saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu leo, ama lamatua sadia abho ne era. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu bani padhai pakarehe roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na èèna.

source_text: and whosoeuer shall speake a word against the sonne of man, it shall be forgiuen him: but whosoeuer shall speake against the holy ghost, it shall not be forgiuen him, neither in this worlde, nor in the worlde to come.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pakarehe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala na. te ngaa cee ka dhu bani padhai lii pahahe roh ama lamatua, te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na, masi ka toke dai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: either make the tree good, and his fruite good: or els make the tree euill, and his fruite euil: for the tree is knowen by the fruite.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii taruu dènge dhèu parisi se, peka na, ngee paie-iie! aj'u dhu be'a, hia hua dhu be'a. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe, hia hua dhu karehe. nèti hua na, dhèu bisa tadhe aj'u ne, be'a do karehe.

source_text: o generations of vipers, howe can you speake good things, when ye are euill? for of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
target_text: te ngaa miu se ca ropa dènge mege, dhu ne'a dhoka kapod'e-kabèli di! miu me'a boe padhai lii dhu be'a. lula ngaa dhu tèke ètu d'ara, èèna ka dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara hèb'a na.

source_text: a good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth foorth good things: and an euill man out of an euill treasure, bringeth forth euill things.
target_text: dhèu be'a, tatu lii padhai na be'a, lula ètu d'ara na abhu j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu bhelu, tatu lii padhai na karehe, lula ètu d'ara na dhu pènu dènge bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but i say vnto you, that of euery idle word that men shall speake, they shall giue account thereof at the day of iudgement.
target_text: lèka la lii ja'a ne! te bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha, ama lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lod'o èèna, dhèu èci-èci ka hud'i dhaa lii-lii nèngu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for by thy wordes thou shalt be iustified, and by thy wordes thou shalt be condemned.
target_text: de mage-mage! te bèli-camèd'a èèna, ama lamatua dadoo lii-lii miu sèra, aa pama'ète peka na, miu lèke huku do, aad'o.

source_text: then answered certaine of ye scribes and of the pharises, saying, master, we would see a signe of thee.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, hèia pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi, peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i neo ngèdhi tadha malaa èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, koasa ama, tare'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he answered and said to them, an euill and adulterous generation seeketh a signe, but no signe shall be giuen vnto it, saue that signe of the prophet ionas.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke si, peka na, weh! miu dhèu taa limuri ne, mo'o boe madhutu ama lamatua! miu se me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a di! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a tao boe. lula uru èèna, lamatua hia le tadha malaa re yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai na. èèna d'ai le!

source_text: for as ionas was three daies and three nights in the whales belly: so shall the sonne of man be three daies and three nights in ye heart of the earth.
target_text: yunus pea tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda ètu d'ara kabake i'a aae ci'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ja'a kahèi ètu d'ara ro'a dhèu madhe, tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda.

source_text: the men of nineue shall rise in iudgement with this generation, and condemne it: for they repented at the preaching of ionas: and behold, a greater then ionas is here.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua j'aj'i hakim. aa dhèu niniwe se titu j'aj'i sakasii ho galaa miu, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i se, goa! ' uru èèna, ropa dhèu niniwe sèra tadèngi lii padhai yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, hèia ra tèke eele sasala ra. te ngaa miu sèmi boe èèna. masi ka limuri ne, abhu le dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti yunus, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu se pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: the queene of the south shall rise in iudgement with this generation, and shall condemne it: for she came from the vtmost partes of the earth to heare the wisdome of salomon: and beholde, a greater then salomon is here.
target_text: pe, ètu d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe lamatua j'aj'i hakim, bhèni aae syeba nèti balèu, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi. na paj'uj'u ai na mi miu, ho na galaa miu aa'i-aa'i dhu ana loo-limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi, goa! ' uru èèna, bhèni aae ne mai nèti rai kaj'èu ho neo nèdhi unu na mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: nowe when the vncleane spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh throughout drie places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
target_text: ladhe babège eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne la'e pea asa era dhu kaliu, ho j'aj'i mi era ae iisi na. te ngaa abhu boe era dhu mèci ho na pea kalili.

source_text: then he saith, i wil returne into mine house from whence i came: and when he is come, he findeth it emptie, swept and garnished.
target_text: hèia na pangee, peka na, ‘abhu boe era dhu be'a sèmi nèi, hua iia ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. ' ka la'e hari asa era nèngu uru èèna. na ladhe na, era ne mèu bia, aa dhu lalau rare pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then he goeth, and taketh vnto him seuen other spirites worse then himselfe, and they enter in, and dwell there: and the ende of that man is worse then the beginning. euen so shall it be with this wicked generation.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa nare angalai na dhèu pidhu dhu bhabhelu ra risi nèti nèngu. ka lasi pea ètu d'ara dhèu ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra kakeho ne. de limuri ne, mamuri dhèu ne asa ele iie-iie. sèmi èèna kahèi lèke mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a taa limuri ne.

source_text: while he yet spake to ye multitude, beholde, his mother, and his brethren stood without, desiring to speake with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na sèra, mai neo paraga dènge ne. rèngu titu ètu li'u, ka ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ne.

source_text: then one said vnto him, beholde, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speake with thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu mai peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ina dènge ari ama ètu li'u nèi. rèngu neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but he answered, and said to him that told him, who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, cee ka ina ku, aa cee ka a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a?

source_text: and he stretched foorth his hand toward his disciples, and said, beholde my mother and my brethren.
target_text: hèia na paj'uj'u asa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, rèngu se'e se ka, ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whosoeuer shall doe my fathers will which is in heauen, the same is my brother and sister and mother.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi ama ku ètu sorga, rèngu ka ina ku aa a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the same day went iesus out of the house, and sate by the sea side.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus kalua nèti èmu èèna, la'e madhèdi asa sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and great multitudes resorted vnto him, so that he went into a ship, and sate downe: and the whole multitude stoode on the shore.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae-ae mai lingu rare ne. ka la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue, dhu panahu ètu era èèna, ho aj'a dhèu sèra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dae sèra nanene ne.

source_text: then he spake many things to them in parables, saying, behold, a sower went forth to sowe.
target_text: hèia na aj'a madha j'ara ae-ae mi rèngu pake lii pakasame. na lole, peka na, abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the foules came and deuoured them vp.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini se, abhu dhu lèke ètu j'ara. hèia manu-bhui mai, ka tutu ra'e aa'i hini se.

source_text: and some fell vpon stony grounde, where they had not much earth, and anon they sprong vp, because they had no depth of earth.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai dhu dènge hadhu. hini se muri malai, lula abhu rai ciki di.

source_text: and when the sunne was vp, they were parched, and for lacke of rooting, withered away.
target_text: te ngaa ropa lod'o rea, hèia ana aaj'u se kamale, ka mango eele si. te amo ra marèma boe ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: and some fell among thornes, and the thornes sprong vp, and choked them.
target_text: abhu hini cahag'e dhu lèke ètu era j'u'u padhudhu. hèia j'u'u padhudhu se hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: some againe fel in good ground, and brought forth fruite, one corne an hundreth folde, some sixtie folde, and another thirtie folde.
target_text: te ngaa abhu hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai isi. hini se muri, ka ra kapai toke hua-hela. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu dhu èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: he that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
target_text: cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na nanene paie-iie!

source_text: then the disciples came, and said to him, why speakest thou to them in parables?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka ama aj'a dhèu ae pake lii pakasame?

source_text: and he answered, and said vnto them, because it is giuen vnto you, to know the secretes of the kingdome of heauen, but to the it is not giue.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, lula miu se neo me'a tare'a-re'a paredha ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka mema sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a aj'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: for whosoeuer hath, to him shalbe giuen, and he shall haue abundance: but whosoeuer hath not, from him shalbe taken away, euen that he hath.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua hia ne asa ne'a ae. te ngaa dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, pe lamatua tao ne asa tabha goa.

source_text: therefore speake i to them in parables, because they seeing, doe not see: and hearing, they heare not, neither vnderstand.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori si pake dhoka lii pakasame di, lula: ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ra pusi-pahae boe. '

source_text: so in them is fulfilled the prophecie of esaias, which prophecie saieth, by hearing, ye shall heare, and shall not vnderstand, and seeing, ye shall see, and shall not perceiue.
target_text: rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu yesaya suri mema le. yesaya èèna, nuka dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘miu èèna na tadèngi, te ngaa miu pakatele dhilu. miu èèna na ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa mo'o boe pame'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: for this peoples heart is waxed fat, and their eares are dull of hearing, and with their eyes they haue winked, lest they should see with their eyes, and heare with their eares, and should vnderstand with their hearts, and should returne, that i might heale them.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e adhu sèmi hadhu, ra pakatele dhilu ra, aa ra pabèdhu musi madha ra. de hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ro'a dhilu ra katele-katipa, aa soro tèke si, sèna ka musi madha ra bèdhu sèmi èèna. hud'i laa, ho ja'a puri-pa'èle ia ka si, lula rèngu pusi-pahae boe ja'a. '

source_text: but blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your eares, for they heare.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, oto! lula miu ladhe mèdhi dènge musi madha, aa tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu miu unu mi.

source_text: for verely i say vnto you, that many prophets, and righteous men haue desired to see those things which ye see, and haue not seene them, and to heare those things which ye heare, and haue not heard them.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola, d'ara ra neo rèdhi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa bisa boe. d'ara ra neo kahèi tadèngi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu tadèngi le, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: heare ye therefore ye parable of ye sower.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, de mi nanene ka sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: whensoeuer any man heareth the woorde of that kingdome, and vnderstandeth it not, that euil one commeth, and catcheth away that which was sowen in his heart: and this is he which hath receiued the seede by the way side.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, te ngaa nèngu ne'a iia boe. hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu ne.

source_text: and hee that receiued seede in the stonie grounde, is he which heareth the woorde, and incontinently with ioy receiueth it,
target_text: hini dhu ceb'e lèke ètu rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia na sèmi nare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: yet hath he no roote in himselfe, and dureth but a season: for assoone as tribulation or persecution commeth because of the woorde, by and by he is offended.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, amo na marèma boe. nèti èèna ka, nare boe nèbhu ètu d'ara dhèu ne. ropa dhèu leo paj'èra ne lula na sèmi nare lii holo-nori ne, ka dhèu ne kèpe pa'èra heka a'aj'a sèra.

source_text: and hee that receiued the seede among thornes, is hee that heareth the woorde: but the care of this worlde, and the deceitfulnesse of riches choke the word, and he is made vnfruitfull.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora aae j'u'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori. te ngaa nèngu bhute dènge rupa-rupa j'ara, ho pakarej'e mamuri na. hèia bhabhute se'e ka seti eele lii holo-nori ne nèti d'ara nèngu, toke dènge heka kab'ua.

source_text: but he that receiued the seede in the good ground, is he that heareth the worde, and vnderstandeth it, which also beareth fruite, and bringeth foorth, some an hundreth folde, some sixtie folde, and some thirtie folde.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu rai isi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa paie dhilu na, sèna ka sèmi nare lii holo-nori, aa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. hèia na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sama sèmi hini dhu muri toke kapai, ka na hua ae-ae. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu kahèi èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: another parable put hee foorth vnto them, saying, the kingdome of heauen is like vnto a man which sowed good seede in his fielde.
target_text: yesus lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua ne, nuka sèmi abhu ca dhèu la'e ceb'e hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: but while men slept, there came his enemie, and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his waie.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i bhèj'i luu, hèia dhèu bhelu mai, ka na ceb'e lamusi j'u'u ètu d'ara oka ne.

source_text: and when the blade was sprong vp, and brought forth fruite, then appeared the tares also.
target_text: ropa hini ètu d'ara oka ne d'ai hua-hela, hèia dhèu sab'a se, ladhe rèdhi j'u'u dhu muri palere-lere dènge hini se.

source_text: then came the seruaunts of the housholder, and sayd vnto him, master, sowedst not thou good seede in thy fielde? from whence then hath it tares?
target_text: ka lasi peka dènge lamatua oka ne, aku rèngu na, ‘ama! ca hari ni ji'i sèle hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka ama, si? nga tao ka muri mai pab'ali dènge j'u'u ae-ae? '

source_text: and hee said to them, some enuious man hath done this. then the seruants saide vnto him, wilt thou then that we go and gather them vp?
target_text: lamatua oka ne dhaa, peka na, ‘èèna tatao nèti dhèu bhelu. ' hèia dhèu sab'a se peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ama, ji'i la'a ko'o eele j'u'u sèi, do? '

source_text: but he saide, nay, lest while yee goe about to gather the tares, yee plucke vp also with them the wheat.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ala, peka na, ‘hud'i laa, te ladhe miu ko'o eele j'u'u se, ana nganga'a èdhi se lèke bete kahèi.

source_text: let both growe together vntill the haruest, and in time of haruest i will say to the reapers, gather yee first the tares, and binde them in sheaues to burne them: but gather the wheate into my barne.
target_text: hud'i rèngu sène ra muri palere-lere toke hèru puu-g'ètu. pe d'ai lod'o na, ja'a peka dènge dhèu sab'a se, na, miu pakaboko uru ku j'u'u sèra. hèia èki si ca èki-ca èki ho tunu eele si. èle ku, heka ta pakaboko isi oka kèna, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara babesi. '

source_text: another parable he put foorth vnto them, saying, the kingdome of heauen is like vnto a graine of mustard seede, which a man taketh and soweth in his fielde:
target_text: èle, ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pake hari lii pakasame èci, sèna ka miu me'a tasamia ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu ae-ae. dhèu unu na sèra, mulai nuka sèmi lamusi dhu ana iiki titu kèna, dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: which in deede is the least of all seedes: but when it is growen, it is the greatest among herbes, and it is a tree, so that the birdes of heauen come and builde in the branches thereof.
target_text: masi ka lamusi ne ana iiki d'ai seli, te ngaa ladhe na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae ètu d'ara oka ne. toke manu-bhui tao rèd'a ètu dadana-dadana na.

source_text: another parable spake hee to them, the kingdome of heauen is like vnto leauen, which a woman taketh and hideth in three pecks of meale, till all be leauened.
target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: all these thinges spake iesus vnto the multitude in parables, and without parables spake he not to them,
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled, which was spoken by the prophet, saying, i will open my mouth in parables, and will vtter the thinges which haue beene kept secrete from the foundation of the worlde.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: then sent iesus the multitude away, and went into the house. and his disciples came vnto him, saying, declare vnto vs the parable of the tares of that fielde.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: then answered he, and saide to them, he that soweth the good seede, is the sonne of man.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: and the field is the worlde, and the good seede are the children of the kingdome, and the tares are the children of that wicked one.
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: and the enemie that soweth them, is the deuill, and the haruest is the end of the worlde, and the reapers be the angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: as then the tares are gathered and burned in ye fire, so shall it be in the end of this world.
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: the sonne of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which doe iniquitie,
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: and shall cast them into a fornace of fire. there shalbe wailing and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: then shall the iust men shine as ye sunne in the kingdome of their father. hee that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: againe, the kingdom of heauen is like vnto a treasure hid in ye field, which when a man hath found, he hideth it, and for ioy thereof departeth and selleth all that he hath, and buieth that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: againe, the kingdome of heauen is like to a marchant man, that seeketh good pearles,
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: who hauing found a pearle of great price, went and solde all that he had, and bought it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: againe, the kingdom of heauen is like vnto a drawe net cast into the sea, that gathereth of all kindes of things.
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: which, when it is full, men draw to lande, and sit and gather the good into vessels, and cast the bad away.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: so shall it be at the end of the world. the angels shall goe foorth, and seuer the bad from among the iust,
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and shall cast them into a fornace of fire: there shalbe wailing, and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: iesus saide vnto them, vnderstand yee all these things? they saide vnto him, yea, lord.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: then sayd hee vnto them, therefore euery scribe which is taught vnto the kingdome of heauen, is like vnto an householder, which bringeth foorth out of his treasure things both newe and olde.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: and it came to passe, that when iesus had ended these parables, he departed thence,
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: and came into his owne countrey, and taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonied, and saide, whence commeth this wisdome and great woorkes vnto this man?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: is not this the carpenters sonne? is not his mother called marie, and his brethren iames and ioses, and simon and iudas?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: and are not his sisters all with vs? whence then hath he all these things?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and they were offended with him. then iesus said to them, a prophet is not without honour, saue in his owne countrey, and in his owne house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: and he did not many great woorkes there, for their vnbeliefes sake.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: at that time herod the tetrarche heard of the fame of iesus,
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and sayde vnto his seruaunts, this is that iohn baptist, hee is risen againe from the deade, and therefore great woorkes are wrought by him.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: for herod had taken iohn, and bounde him, and put him in prison for herodias sake, his brother philips wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: for iohn saide vnto him, it is not lawfull for thee to haue her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: and when hee woulde haue put him to death, hee feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but when herods birth day was kept, the daughter of herodias daunced before them, and pleased herod.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: wherefore he promised with an othe, that he would giue her whatsoeuer she would aske.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and shee being before instructed of her mother, sayde, giue mee here iohn baptists head in a platter.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: and the king was sorie: neuerthelesse because of the othe, and them that sate with him at the table, he commanded it to be giuen her,
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: and sent, and beheaded iohn in the prison.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and his head was brought in a platter, and giuen to the maide, and shee brought it vnto her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: and his disciples came, and tooke vp the bodie, and buried it, and went, and tolde iesus.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and when iesus heard it, hee departed thence by shippe into a desert place apart. and when the multitude had heard it, they followed him on foote out of the cities.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: and iesus went foorth and sawe a great multitude, and was mooued with compassion toward them, and he healed their sicke.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and when euen was come, his disciples came to him, saying, this is a desart place, and the time is alreadie past: let the multitude depart, that they may goe into the townes, and bye them vitailes.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but iesus saide to them, they haue no neede to goe away: giue yee them to eate.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: then saide they vnto him, wee haue here but fiue loaues, and two fishes.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: and he saide, bring them hither to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: and hee commanded the multitude to sit downe on the grasse, and tooke the fiue loaues and the two fishes, and looked vp to heauen and blessed, and brake, and gaue the loaues to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they did all eate, and were sufficed, and they tooke vp of the fragments that remained, twelue baskets full.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and they that had eaten, were about fiue thousande men, beside women and litle children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and straightway iesus compelled his disciples to enter into a shippe, and to goe ouer before him, while he sent the multitude away.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and assoone as hee had sent the multitude away, he went vp into a moutaine alone to pray: and when the euening was come, hee was there alone.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: and the shippe was nowe in the middes of the sea, and was tossed with waues: for it was a contrarie winde.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: and in the fourth watch of the night, iesus went vnto them, walking on the sea.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: and when his disciples sawe him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, it is a spirit, and cried out for feare.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: but straight way iesus spake vnto them, saying, be of good comfort, it is i: be not afraide.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: then peter answered him, and saide, master, if it be thou, bid me come vnto thee on the water.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: and he saide, come. and when peter was come downe out of the shippe, he walked on the water, to goe to iesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but when he sawe a mightie winde, he was afraide: and as he began to sinke, he cried, saying, master, saue me.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: so immediatly iesus stretched foorth his hande, and caught him, and saide to him, o thou of litle faith, wherefore diddest thou doubt?
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: and assoone as they were come into the ship, the winde ceased.
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: then they that were in the ship, came and worshipped him, saying, of a trueth thou art the sonne of god.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and when they were come ouer, they came into the land of gennezaret.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, hèia ra puru lasi asa dedha nebhe nèti rae genesaret.

source_text: and when the men of that place knewe him, they sent out into all that countrey rounde about, and brought vnto him all that were sicke,
target_text: lod'o ra puru èèna, dhèu ae dhu tadhe le. hèia dhèu pa'oo, peka na, wee! yesus mai le! ra rai lasi peka palème, hèia dhèu rèti dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and besought him, that they might touch the hemme of his garment onely: and as many as touched it, were made whole.
target_text: ra manèngi sèna ka ra goi lèke kodho yesus. te ra pangee na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a goi lèke suu kodho na, tatu dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i se goi kodho yesus, ka ra èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: then came to iesus the scribes and pharises, which were of hierusalem, saying,
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu parisi dènge mese agama ca nau mai nèti yerusalem, ho paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: why do thy disciples transgresse the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eate bread.
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi rèngu. lod'o rèngu tadèngi, na, ladhe ana madhutu yesus ra'a-rinu dhu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu ad'a ra, hèia ra nasa. ka rèngu mai ho pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe ai? èèna na, sisu le ad'a bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: but he answered and said vnto them, why doe yee also transgresse the commandement of god by your tradition?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu lab'a paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu ad'a tatao nèti bèi-baki miu di.

source_text: for god hath commanded, saying, honour thy father and mother: and he that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
target_text: te ama lamatua paredha, peka na, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa peka hari, na, ‘ladhe ca dhèu padhèd'a aapa ina do ama na, hud'i huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but ye say, whosoeuer shall say to father or mother, by the gift that is offered by me, thou maiest haue profite, though hee honour not his father, or his mother, shalbe free: thus haue ye made the commandement of god of no aucthoritie by your tradition.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ca dhèu parluu boe pake mèdha-panyau na, sèna ka soru-bara ina-ama na, masi ka rèngu ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ladhe na pamoa le neo hia mèdha ne asa lamatua' te ngaa dènge aj'a sèmi èèna, miu core eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho gati dènge atora unu miu.

source_text: o hypocrites, esaias prophecied well of you, saying,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a dhu peka le, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! èèna na, nuka sèmi yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: this people draweth neere vnto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with the lips, but their heart is farre off from me.
target_text: ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara.

source_text: but in vaine they worship me, teaching for doctrines, mens precepts.
target_text: masi ka rèngu tao sèmi èèna, te ngaa parcuma. ra pusi-pahae boe ja'a, te rèngu sèra pahae dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. '

source_text: then hee called the multitude vnto him, and said to them, heare and vnderstand.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ètu èèna, ka na aj'a si, peka na, pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu!

source_text: that which goeth into the mouth, defileth not the man, but that which commeth out of the mouth, that defileth the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara hèb'a, pakaj'alu boe dhèu. te ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: then came his disciples, and saide vnto him, perceiuest thou not, that the pharises are offended in hearing this saying?
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu na mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama me'a, do? dhèu parisi se d'ara pèd'a ropa tadèngi lii padhai ama.

source_text: but hee answered and saide, euery plant which mine heauenly father hath not planted, shalbe rooted vp.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga, èèna na core eele dhèu dhu aj'a madhutu boe dad'èi na. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu ko'o eele j'u'u dhu na d'èi boe.

source_text: let them alone, they be the blinde leaders of the blinde: and if the blinde leade ye blinde, both shall fall into the ditche.
target_text: de baku pusi-pahae dènge dhèu parisi sèi! te rèngu ca ropa dènge dhèu bèdhu dhu pakako dhèu bèdhu. èèna na ra manahu palere-lere asa d'ara ro'a lasi.

source_text: then answered peter, and said to him, declare vnto vs this parable.
target_text: ka petrus lii, peka na, ama, lole ku dènge ji'i la, sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na!

source_text: then said iesus, are ye yet without vnderstanding?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, miu me'a mèka kahèi?

source_text: perceiue ye not yet, that whatsoeuer entreth into the mouth, goeth into the bellie, and is cast out into the draught?
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e: ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara hèb'a, la'e taruu asa kabake, èle èèna kalua hari la'e asa d'ara kakus.

source_text: but those thinges which proceede out of the mouth, come from the heart, and they defile the man.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu, toke ama lamatua madenge dènge ne, aa d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for out of the heart come euil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false testimonies, slaunders.
target_text: te j'ara-j'ara karehe, ae ka dhu mai nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee dhu bhelu, pamadhe dhèu, bersina, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, mana'u, sakasii kapod'e-kabèli, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: these are the things, which defile the man: but to eat with vnwashen hands, defileth not ye man.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara se'e ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu dhoka ra'a j'amo boe ai madhutu ad'a, èèna sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and iesus went thence, and departed into the coastes of tyrus and sidon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tèke eele era ne'e, kako la'e asa kota tirus dènge kota sidon.

source_text: and beholde, a woman a cananite came out of the same coasts, and cried, saying vnto him, haue mercie on me, o lord, the sonne of dauid: my daughter is miserably vexed with a deuil.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu ina ca dhèu dhu j'aj'aj'i na nèti rai ne'e. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe. ropa na tadèngi nare yesus mai le asa ne'e, hèia la'e manèngi, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a, lèke nidhu tao. kasia ku ji'i la! te na j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: but hee answered her not a worde. then came to him his disciples, and besought him, saying, sende her away, for she crieth after vs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, aa dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa ciki sa. hèia ana madhutu na mai peka dènge ne, ama, ina ne pa'oo-parodha loe boe. be'a risi ama babège eele ne nèti ne'e!

source_text: but he answered, and said, i am not sent, but vnto the lost sheepe of the house of israel.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, ho soru-bara dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi, lula rèngu kako sala j'ara, nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu re'a heka j'ara. te na pua boe ja'a sèna ka soru-bara dhèu leo.

source_text: yet she came, and worshipped him, saying, lord, helpe me.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne mai padètu-dètu asa yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu dènge lii manèngi, ama! sue ku ja'a la!

source_text: and he answered, and said, it is not good to take the childrens bread, and to cast it to whelps.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, pantas boe tare nganga'a nèti ana-ana, ka hia mi busa. dènge lii dhu pacele, sasoa na, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu unu na, heka bisa ladhe-leru dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but she said, trueth, lord: yet in deede the whelpes eate of the crommes, which fall from their masters table.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, tare'a ama! te ngaa busa dhu mate mema ètu ro'a mei. rèngu ra'a kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe eele nèti d'ara pega ana sèra. sasoa na, ropa ana-ana ra'a, busa kahèi abhu ra'a. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i ladhe-leru dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: then iesus answered, and saide vnto her, o woman, great is thy faith: be it to thee, as thou desirest. and her daughter was made whole at that houre.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus peka na, ira ii! ina parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a! de lèpa ka, lula ngaa dhu ina manèngi èèna, j'aj'i le! èle èèna ka, na lèpa, ka na ladhe nèdhi ana na dhu èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: so iesus went away from thence, and came neere vnto the sea of galile, and went vp into a mountaine and sate downe there.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era ne'e, hèia ra kako madhutu re sebhe dano galilea. ka ra ca'e asa ledhe cue, hèia yesus madhèdi ho aj'a-nori si.

source_text: and great multitudes came vnto him, hauing with them, halt, blinde, dumme, maymed, and many other, and cast them downe at iesus feete, and he healed them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae-ae mai asa yesus. ra rèti dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dhèu lii aad'o, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pèd'a leo kahèi. ra pamadhèdi dhèu pèd'a se padètu-dètu dènge haga yesus. ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: in so much that the multitude wondered, to see the dumme speake, the maimed whole, the halt to goe, and the blinde to see: and they glorified the god of israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia dhèu ae se malaa. ra papeka na, ira ii! malaa titu kèna, nga! dhèu haga roe cabèka, bisa kako èra hari. dhèu bèdhu, bisa rèdhi. dhèu karuku, bisa kako. aa dhèu lii aad'o, bisa padhai lii! se'e se, tatu tatao ama lamatua. aa lamatua èèna ka, dhu uru-uru sèra bèi-baki èdhi pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: then iesus called his disciples vnto him, and said, i haue compassion on this multitude, because they haue continued with mee already three dayes, and haue nothing to eate: and i wil not let them depart fasting, least they faint in the way.
target_text: lalu eele pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae-ae se. abhu dhu mai nèti era kaj'èu, ra pakaboko ètu ne'e tèlu lod'o kèna, toke gee ra èle aa'i le. be'a risi baku hia si lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra bèbha ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples saide vnto him, whence should we get so much bread in the wildernes, as should suffice so great a multitude!
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama! era ne'e kaj'èu nèti rae. tatu, èdhi bisa boe panga'a tare dhèu ae-ae sèmi se'e.

source_text: and iesus said vnto them, how many loaues haue ye? and they said, seuen, and a few litle fishes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, roti miu pèri bua? ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, dhoka pidhu di, dènge i'a pèri ngi'u di!

source_text: then he commanded the multitude to sit downe on the ground,
target_text: ka yesus pua dhèu se'e madhèdi ètu rai.

source_text: and tooke the seuen loaues, and the fishes, and gaue thankes, and brake them, and gaue to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
target_text: hèia nare roti pidhu bua dènge i'a sèra, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti se, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they did all eate, and were sufficed: and they tooke vp of the fragments that remained, seuen baskets full.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu. ka ra kaboko rare nganga'a dhu ata, pènu pidhu soe hahake.

source_text: and they that had eaten, were foure thousand men, beside women, and litle children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone ele boe d'ai èpa riho dhèu sa. dhae ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki sèra.

source_text: then iesus sent away the multitude, and tooke ship, and came into the partes of magdala.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua dhèu ae-ae sèra lèpa. hèia na ca'e asa dedha koha, ho lasi asa rai magadan.

source_text: then came the pharises and sadduces, and did tempt him, desiring him to shew them a signe from heauen.
target_text: ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki, mai paraga dènge yesus. rèngu neo pakarèi dènge ne, sèna ka tenge j'ara neo pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi sèmi ne'e ka, ama! tao ku tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, dhu peka na, ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he answered, and said vnto them, when it is euening, ye say, faire wether: for ye skie is red.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, ladhe èdhi tèdhi liru mea ropa lod'o cèna, èdhi te'a, na, ‘bèli èj'i mai boe. '

source_text: and in the morning ye say, to day shall be a tempest: for the skie is red and lowring. o hypocrites, ye can discerne the face of the skie, and can ye not discerne the signes of the times?
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o rea, aa liru mèdhi, na èdhi te'a, na, ‘doe ne'e, oe èj'i. ' de ladhe miu bisa patadhe mere tadha ètu liru sèmi sèra, nga tao ka miu bisa boe patadhe mere sasoa nèti tadha-tadha jaman?

source_text: the wicked generation, and adulterous seeketh a signe, but there shall no signe be giuen it, but that signe of the prophet ionas: so hee left them, and departed.
target_text: miu dhèu lod'o limuri ne, me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di! miu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a dale boe tao. lula uru èèna, lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa re yunus, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. de èèna d'ai le! ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus tèke eele si.

source_text: and when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread with them.
target_text: ropa yesus si lasi asa ca bèka dano, hèia ana madhutu na, heka sanèd'e, na, rèngu rèti boe roti tao gee j'ara.

source_text: then iesus said vnto them, take heede and beware of the leauen of the pharises and sadduces.
target_text: tadèngi rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia na peka na, miu baku pamud'e dènge ragi dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: and they reasoned among themselues, saying, it is because we haue brought no bread.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana madhutu na bingu, ka ra peka, na peka ngaa nèi? ele boe ne'a na, èdhi tèti boe roti, sina ma?

source_text: but iesus knowing it, saide vnto them, o ye of litle faith, why reason you thus among your selues, because ye haue brought no bread?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, wee, miu seli-kolane, nga! nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu parcaya boe ja'a, do?

source_text: doe ye not yet perceiue, neither remember the fiue loaues, when there were fiue thousand men, and how many baskets tooke ye vp?
target_text: miu dhae me'a iia mèka koasa ja'a, do? te lod'o ja'a pamae lèmi bua roti ho panga'a lèmi riho dhèu sèra, dhu sisa, miu pakaboko mere pèri soe?

source_text: neither the seuen loaues when there were foure thousande men, and howe many baskets tooke ye vp?
target_text: aa tasamia hari dènge roti pidhu bua dhu ja'a panga'a èpa riho dhèu sèra? abhu pèri soe hahake dhu miu pakaboko nèti dhu ra'a risi sèra?

source_text: why perceiue ye not that i said not vnto you concerning bread, that ye shoulde beware of the leauen of the pharises and sadduces?
target_text: nga tao ka miu mo'o boe me'a dènge lii padhai ja'a deo na? ja'a padhue-padhai boe lula roti. te ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku pamud'e dènge tatao dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki. te lii aj'a-nori ra bisa ère rare dhèu ae, nuka sèmi ragi dhu tao roti j'aj'i kapai.

source_text: then vnderstood they that he had not said that they should beware of the leauen of bread, but of the doctrine of the pharises, and sadduces.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia heka rèngu re'a kèna, na nèngu peka boe roti. te ngaa na padhue-padhai nèti a'aj'a dhu sale nèti dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: nowe when iesus came into the coastes of cesarea philippi, hee asked his disciples, saying, whome doe men say that i, the sonne of man am?
target_text: èle, hèia yesus si lasi asa rai dhu padètu dènge kota kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, madhutu lii papeka dhèu, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they said, some say, iohn baptist: and some, elias: and others, ieremias, or one of the prophets.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, abhu dhu peka na, ama ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu mamuri hari. cahag'e peka na, ele boe ama ne, elia. cahag'e hari ale na, yermia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu leo nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra.

source_text: he said vnto them, but whome say ye that i am?
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari si, ladhe madhutu miu mesa mi, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: then simon peter answered, and said, thou art that christ, the sonne of the liuing god.
target_text: hèia simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo hia mai! aa ama ne, ana ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia!

source_text: and iesus answered, and saide to him, blessed art thou, simon, the sonne of ionas: for flesh and blood hath not reueiled it vnto thee, but my father which is in heauen.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii, peka na, simon, ana yunus! èu ne, oto kapai! te nèti boe dhèu rai-haha dhu peka lii ne'e dènge èu. te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga ka peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i say also vnto thee, that thou art peter, and vpon this rocke i will builde my church: and ye gates of hell shall not ouercome it.
target_text: nanene, ee! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a pangare èu, ‘petrus'. dhu sasoa na, hadhu. lula parcaya èu, èra sèmi hadhu, èèna na èu j'aj'i era padhèdi nèti dhèu-dhèu ja'a dhu parcaya. masi ka rèngu abhu j'aj'èra toke madhe, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu.

source_text: and i will giue vnto thee the keyes of the kingdome of heauen, and whatsoeuer thou shalt binde vpon earth, shalbe bound in heauen: and whatsoeuer thou shalt loose on earth, shall be loosed in heauen.
target_text: ja'a èèna na hia èu hak, sèna ka èu uri dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nuka sèmi èu mèd'u gagoe sorga. te, ngaa dhu èu kai ètu rai-haha, èèna na lamatua kai ètu sorga kahèi. dènge ngaa dhu èu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: then hee charged his disciples, that they should tell no man that he was iesus that christ.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka yesus kai si ho rèngu baku peka dènge dhèu, na, nèngu ne, kristus.

source_text: from that time foorth iesus beganne to shewe vnto his disciples, that he must goe vnto hierusalem, and suffer many thinges of the elders, and of the hie priestes, and scribes, and be slaine, and be raised againe the thirde day.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku ku asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: then peter tooke him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, master, pitie thy selfe: this shall not be vnto thee.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia petrus ère nare yesus asa karasa, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! tatu ama lamatua soro tèke boe j'ara ne j'aj'i!

source_text: then he turned backe, and said vnto peter, get thee behinde me, satan: thou art an offence vnto me, because thou vnderstandest not the thinges that are of god, but the thinges that are of men.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai petrus ne, madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus kabib'a, ka jèke ne, peka na, heh! pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! lii padhai èèna nèti dhèu aae nidhu! èu baku bhabhae ja'a! èu ne dhodhoka pangee madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: iesus then saide to his disciples, if any man will follow me, let him forsake himselfe: and take vp his crosse, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hèia yesus aj'a ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu ku bèli-bèli! nèngu hud'i pa'uru ku dad'èi ama lamatua, aa pabhèlu eele dad'èi nèngu unu na. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu, sama sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, la'e asa era mamadhe na.

source_text: for whosoeuer will saue his life, shall lose it: and whosoeuer shall lose his life for my sake, shall finde it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na di, èèna na mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara!

source_text: for what shall it profite a man though he should winne the whole worlde, if hee lose his owne soule? or what shall a man giue for recompence of his soule?
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ladhe lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ètu mia? masi ka èu pasae mèti aa'i isi rai-haha ne, èu bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu!

source_text: for the sonne of man shall come in the glory of his father with his angels, and then shall he giue to euery man according to his deedes.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai hari dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. lod'o èèna, pe ja'a b'ala mi ca dhèu-ca dhèu madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: verely i say vnto you, there bee some of them that stande here, which shall not taste of death, till they haue seene the sonne of man come in his kingdome.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! nèti miu aa'i-aa'i se, bèli-camèd'a abhu cahag'e dhu madhe boe, toke ra rèdhi ja'a, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha.

source_text: and after sixe dayes, iesus tooke peter, and iames and iohn his brother, and brought them vp into an hie mountaine apart,
target_text: èle èna lod'o, ka yesus paroa petrus, yakobis dènge ari na yohanis, sèna ka lasi asa ledhe dhu dedha èci, ho pea mesa ra ètu nèi.

source_text: and was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sunne, and his clothes were as white as the light.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra ladhe na, rupa yesus leko-leo. rèhu na kaha'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o, aa mèdha-papake na j'aj'i pudhi kale'e.

source_text: and beholde, there appeared vnto them moses, and elias, talking with him.
target_text: kaca'a la, rèngu ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge musa dènge elia.

source_text: then answered peter, and saide to iesus, master, it is good for vs to be here: if thou wilt, let vs make here three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elias.
target_text: hèia petrus bingu, ka na padhai lii leli, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i karej'e titu kèna ètu era ne'e ne! de be'a risi ji'i patitu paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: while he yet spake, behold, a bright cloude shadowed them: and beholde, there came a voyce out of the cloude, saying, this is that my beloued sonne, in whom i am well pleased: heare him.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna era, cag'ag'a laa, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare rèngu. hèia rèngu malaa-maloha tadèngi lii èci dhu kalua nèti d'ara ra'i-liru ne, peka na, nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a. nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and when the disciples heard that, they fell on their faces, and were sore afraide.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne, hèia ana madhutu na madha'u titu kèna, ka ra bèbha sagèb'a ètu rai.

source_text: then iesus came and touched them, and said, arise, and be not afraide.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mai gai si, ka na peka na, mi kèd'i ka, baku madha'u!

source_text: and when they lifted vp their eyes, they sawe no man, saue iesus onely.
target_text: ka ana madhutu se boti kètu ra, te ngaa ra ladhe rèdhi heka dhèu èci sa ètu era èèna, dhoka yesus di.

source_text: and as they came downe from the moutaine, iesus charged them, saying, shewe the vision to no man, vntil the sonne of man rise againe from the dead.
target_text: èle ka, ra puru nèti ledhe ne. hèia yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, ngaa dhu heka ladhe mèdhi deo na, mage peka dènge dhèu èci sa kahèi! te ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. èle èèna, ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, heka miu lole dènge dhèu kèna.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, saying, why then say the scribes that elias must first come?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama ne mema kristus, te ngaa elia ètu mia? te mese agama se aj'a, peka na, elia hud'i mai uuru ku, èle èèna, heka kristus mai kèna. te ngaa madhutu ama, tasamia?

source_text: and iesus answered, and saide vnto them, certeinely elias must first come, and restore all thinges.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema lèke. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus.

source_text: but i say vnto you that elias is come alreadie, and they knewe him not, but haue done vnto him whatsoeuer they would: likewise shall also the sonne of man suffer of them.
target_text: nanene paie! elia mai le, te ngaa dhèu tadhe boe ne. rèngu paj'èra ne, madhutu dad'èi ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a rèngu paj'èra ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: then the disciples perceiued that he spake vnto them of iohn baptist.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, ana madhutu na heka re'a, na, elia dhu yesus peka ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani.

source_text: and when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certaine man, and fell downe at his feete,
target_text: èle ka, ropa rèngu lèpa, paraga dènge dhèu ae dhu mate le. hèia ama ca dhèu mai patitu kètu urutuu, ka na manèngi yesus,

source_text: and saide, master, haue pitie on my sonne: for he is lunatike, and is sore vexed: for oft times he falleth into the fire, and oft times into the water.
target_text: na peka, ama! sue ku ana ja'a la! te nèngu dhu huj'u kahib'i, aa na j'èra titu kèna. ladhe èi papèd'a ne cèu, na bèbhe sa d'ara èi, do d'ara ai. ama sue ku la!

source_text: and i brought him to thy disciples, and they could not heale him.
target_text: ana ne, ja'a kèti le asa ana-ana madhutu ama ku, te ngaa ra tao rare boe ne.

source_text: then iesus answered, and said, o generation faithlesse, and crooked, how long now shall i be with you! howe long nowe shall i suffer you! bring him hither to me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus jèke ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, heh! miu se seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a le miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a mèu boe. aa miu parcaya boe ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ja'a hud'i mate hari ku miu, d'ai pèri lod'o? mèti ana èèna mai!

source_text: and iesus rebuked the deuill, and he went out of him: and the childe was healed at that houre.
target_text: hèia, rèti ana ne, ka yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana ne'e. ka nidhu rai tèke eele ne, hèia ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: then came the disciples to iesus apart, and said, why could not we cast him out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ropa yesus mesa na dènge ana madhutu sèra, ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège ngare nidhu deo na?

source_text: and iesus said vnto them, because of your vnbeliefe: for verely i say vnto you, if ye haue faith as much as is a graine of mustarde seede, ye shall say vnto this mountaine, remooue hence to yonder place, and it shall remoue: and nothing shalbe vnpossible vnto you.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, miu babège mere boe, lula miu parcaya boe dènge d'ara kateme. sanèd'e! ladhe miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka sama sèmi lamusi ana iiki-iiki èci, miu bisa paredha ledhe èci, peka na, ‘hee ledhe, hari sa nèi, lamu! ' tatu na hari kahèi. de miu bisa tao ngaa èèna ka, sad'i parcaya dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: howbeit this kinde goeth not out, but by prayer and fasting.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e! nidhu sèmi se'e se, mema bhelu titu kèna. ladhe miu sabaj'a boe aa puasa boe, ho manèngi mi ama lamatua, na, miu babège mere boe nidhu sèmi sèra.

source_text: and they being in galile, iesus said vnto them, the sonne of man shall be deliuered into the handes of men,
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhu pakaboko ètu propensi galilea. na peka dènge rèngu, na, nèbhu heka, te ra neo pahie ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: and they shall kill him, but the thirde day shall he rise againe: and they were very sorie.
target_text: hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a ja'a mamuri hari. ropa ana madhutu na sèra tadèngi lii deo na, hèia d'ara ra susa titu kèna.

source_text: and when they were come to capernaum, they that receiued polle money, came to peter, and sayd, doeth not your master pay polle money?
target_text: lod'o yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa rae kapernaum, hèia dhèu roro bea mai paraga dènge petrus, ka ra karèi ne, na, mese miu b'ae bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i do, aad'o?

source_text: he sayd, yes. and when he was come into the house, iesus preuented him, saying, what thinkest thou, simon? of whome doe the kings of the earth take tribute, or polle money? of their children, or of strangers?
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, na b'ae! ropa petrus lepa, ka yesus karèi dènge ka, aku nèngu na, simon, èu pangee ku la! dhèu aae-dhèu aae ètu rai-haha ne abhu bea nèti cee? nèti ana matana ra, do, nèti dhèu leo?

source_text: peter sayd vnto him, of strangers. then said iesus vnto him, then are the children free.
target_text: petrus dhaa, na, nèti dhèu leo! ka yesus tuhu lii padhai na, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ana dhèu aae di dhu b'ae boe, si?

source_text: neuerthelesse, lest we should offend them: goe to the sea, and cast in an angle, and take the first fish that commeth vp, and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt finde a piece of twentie pence: that take, and giue it vnto them for me and thee.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa hud'i laa, sèna ka dhèu roro bea se baku nasa dènge èdhi. de be'a risi lamu madulu i'a asa d'ara dano. i'a dhu èu abhu uuru èèna, èu bhoke hèb'a na. pe èu abhu doi iia cue. more, ho b'ae bea èdhi dua ti. te doi ne, d'ai le bea èdhi dua ti.

source_text: the same time the disciples came vnto iesus, saying, who is the greatest in the kingdome of heauen?
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus lasi karèi ne, peka na, ama! nèti dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, cee ka dhu kapai risi?

source_text: and iesus called a litle childe vnto him, and set him in the mids of them,
target_text: hèia yesus paroa nare ana iiki èci, mai patitu asa talora aae rèngu.

source_text: and sayd, verely i say vnto you, except ye be conuerted, and become as litle children, ye shall not enter into the kingdome of heauen.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, nanene paie-iie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, rèngu hud'i ub'a ngangee ra, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: whosoeuer therefore shall humble himselfe as this litle childe, the same is the greatest in the kingdome of heauen.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu ne'a pahaha iisi sama sèmi ana iiki ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu kapai risi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and whosoeuer shall receiue one such litle childe in my name, receiueth me.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu haha nuka sèmi ana iiki ne, lula na parcaya ja'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare le ja'a ne.

source_text: but whosoeuer shall offend one of these litle ones which beleeue in me, it were better for him, that a milstone were hanged about his necke, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
