target_text: te ne'e ne j'aj'i tadha dhu peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dètu ae le. ropa mèdhi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea, rai ka asa ledhe.

source_text: let him which is on the house top, not come downe to fetch any thing out of his house.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kalua nèti d'ara èmu le, na maso ia ka mere mèdha-panyau. te ngaa rai dènge ka, sèna ka baku lèke mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: and he that is in the fielde, let not him returne backe to fetch his clothes.
target_text: dhèu ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka mere mèdha-papake mi. te ngaa rai dènge ka!

source_text: and woe shalbe to them that are with childe, and to them that giue sucke in those dayes.
target_text: dhu j'èra risi ka, ina dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu pasusu ana dhu heka rara iisi hiu sèra. te rèngu se bisa boe rai pamèri.

source_text: but pray that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day.
target_text: de hua iia miu sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra èèna mage lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai, do, lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: for then shall be great tribulation, such as was not from the beginning of the worlde to this time, nor shalbe.
target_text: te lod'o èèna j'èra titu kèna! karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, dhèu dhae ladhe rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu kapai sèmi èèna na. aa èèna na, dhèu paraga heka dènge j'aj'èra dhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and except those dayes should be shortened, there should no flesh be saued: but for the elects sake those dayes shalbe shortened.
target_text: te ngaa miu oto kapai, te ama lamatua pab'ab'e lod'o èèna. ladhe aad'o, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa taha mamuri. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua sue dhèu unu na dhu hag'e nare sèra, nèti èèna ka na pab'ab'e lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: then if any shall say vnto you, loe, here is christ, or there, beleeue it not.
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai ka, miu tadèngi dhèu, peka na, ‘ladhe ku la! kristus ka ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘kristus ka nèi! ' te ngaa baku miu parcaya!

source_text: for there shall arise false christes, and false prophets, and shall shewe great signes and wonders, so that if it were possible, they should deceiue the very elect.
target_text: te èèna na, abhu dhèu mai tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa dhèu leo peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu kèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na rèngu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, pake koasa nidhu, sèna ka kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. dhèu se tenge j'ara ho dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: beholde, i haue tolde you before.
target_text: de miu hud'i j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu! lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se, dhae d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e mema le miu!

source_text: wherefore if they shall say vnto you, beholde, he is in the desert, goe not forth: beholde, he is in the secret places, beleeue it not.
target_text: ladhe dhèu peka dènge miu, na, ‘kristus ètu le d'ara tana lapa nèi! ', na baku lami kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhu peka na, ‘kristus nuka ètu d'ara èmu! ', na, baku miu parcaya kahèi.

source_text: for as the lightning commeth out of the east, and is seene into the west, so shall also the comming of the sonne of man be.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ladhe ja'a mai hari asa rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi bela kaha'a nèti dhimu asa haa.

source_text: for wheresoeuer a dead carkeis is, thither will the egles be gathered together.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, pe miu me'a ja'a ètu era mia. nuka sèmi dhèu re'a na, ladhe dhèu rèdhi manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na ra re'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and immediatly after ye tribulations of those dayes, shall the sunne be darkened, and the moone shall not giue her light, and the starres shall fal from heauen, and ye powers of heaue shalbe shake.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ho peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe oe èle ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, ‘èèna na, madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, hèru heo heka. hua hètu-hua hètu kabhui nèti dedha-liru, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru patogo èci dènge èci. '

source_text: and then shall appeare the signe of the sonne of man in heauen: and then shall all the kinreds of the earth mourne, and they shall see the sonne of man come in the cloudes of heauen with power and great glorie.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha ètu dedha-liru, dhu pad'elo, peka na, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari kèna. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne j'aj'i madha'u toke ra tangi. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge ra'i-liru, heka rèngu ladhe rèdhi koasa dènge dadedha ja'a kèna.

source_text: and he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect, from the foure windes, and from the one ende of the heauens vnto the other.
target_text: ka ja'a pake lii tèbhe dhu mèdhu ho pua ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, sèna ka pakaboko rare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a kabhili kore le, nèti suu-suu rai-haha, nèti haa toke dhimu, nèti badae toke balèu.

source_text: now learne the parable of the figge tree: when her bough is yet tender, and it putteth foorth leaues, ye knowe that sommer is neere.
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi aj'u ca kapua. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, tadha na, oe dètu hèru hadhu kèna.

source_text: so likewise ye, when ye see all these things, know that the kingdom of god is neere, eue at ye doores.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi ka d'ai lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka-padhai deo na, èèna tadha, na, mamai ja'a dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: verely i say vnto you, this generation shall not passe, till all these things be done.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri loo-limuri ne, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o j'aj'èra se dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: heauen and earth shall passe away: but my wordes shall not passe away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii padhai ja'a ne ca lamusi sa bisa boe ele.

source_text: but of that day and houre knoweth no man, no not the angels of heauen, but my father only.
target_text: ca dhèu sa re'a boe pèri lod'o ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe kahèi. dhodhoka ama ku mesa na dhu ne'a.

source_text: but as the dayes of noe were, so likewise shall the comming of the sonne of man be.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa ja'a mai hari, nuka sèmi taa uru sèra, lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: for as in the dayes before the flood, they did eate and drinke, marrie, and giue in mariage, vnto the day that noe entred into the arke,
target_text: èi aae dhae j'aj'i mèka lala, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu ra'a-rinu, aa paleo èmu sèmi biasa. dhèu sèra tao taruu sèmi èèna, toke noh maso asa d'ara kapa aae èèna.

source_text: and knewe nothing, till the flood came, and tooke them all away, so shall also the comming of the sonne of man be.
target_text: te ngaa ropa èi aae lala, hae nèti aa'i si, rèngu heka kabèdhi kèna, lula ngaa dhu j'aj'i sèra. èci èèna ka dènge mamai ja'a bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: then two shall be in the fieldes, the one shalbe receiued, and the other shalbe refused.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ladhe abhu dhèu dua ètu d'ara oka, cag'ag'a laa ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: two women shalbe grinding at ye mill: the one shalbe receiued, and the other shalbe refused.
target_text: ladhe dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, kaca'a la ama lamatua ded'e nèti ca dhèu, aa ca dhèu hari tèke eele.

source_text: watch therefore: for ye knowe not what houre your master will come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i bori pa'èra mema kahèi, te miu me'a boe pèri lod'o lamatua miu lèpa hari mai.

source_text: of this be sure, that if the good man of the house knewe at what watch the thiefe would come, he woulde surely watch, and not suffer his house to be digged through.
target_text: pangee paie-iie! ladhe lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema, na, mèda none dhèu mana'u mai, tatu na pasaruru boe musi madha na, sèna ka dhèu mana'u baku maso asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: therefore be ye also ready: for in the houre that ye thinke not, will the sonne of man come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra mema kahèi. te mamai hari ja'a èèna, dènge sahèka!

source_text: who then is a faithfull seruaunt and wise, whom his master hath made ruler ouer his household, to giue them meate in season?
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi lamatua na. te ladhe lamatua na neo la'e rai kaj'èu, na ded'e dhèu sab'a dhu sèmi èèna ku, ho uri nganga'a-nganginu hia isi èmu na.

source_text: blessed is that seruant, whom his master when he commeth, shall finde so doing.
target_text: ladhe lamatua na lèpa, ladhe nèdhi dhèu sab'a na dhu sab'e dènge be'a, tatu na karej'e.

source_text: verely i say vnto you, he shall make him ruler ouer all his goods.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua èmu hia dhèu sab'a ne koasa, sèna ka ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but if that euil seruant shall say in his heart, my master doth deferre his comming,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu sab'a ne, dhèu bhelu, tatu na ngee ètu d'ara na,

source_text: and begin to smite his fellowes, and to eate, and to drinke with the drunken,
target_text: ‘be'a kèna! lamatua ja'a la'e le, de cee ne'a na pèri lod'o lèpa hari mai! ' nèti ngangee sèmi ne'e ne, hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a leo sèra. aa nèngu madhèdi na'a-ninu mau-mau bera-bera dènge dhèu mahu sèra.

source_text: that seruaunts master will come in a day, when he looketh not for him, and in an houre that he is not ware of,
target_text: te ngaa dhu ne'a nare boe, na, cag'ag'a laa lamatua na lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and will cut him off, and giue him his portion with hypocrites: there shalbe weeping, and gnashing of teeth.
target_text: hèia lamatua na capa paj'èra ne, ka core ne asa li'u, sèna ka na pa'èci dènge dhèu padhai lii leo, tao leo sèra. ètu era ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ra j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: then the kingdome of heauen shalbe likened vnto tenne virgins, which tooke their lampes, and went foorth to meete the bridegrome.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus tuhu hari lii lula-nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho soru mamai ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne. sèmi ne'e: ca tèka dhèu bhèni dhèu canguru dhu kalua re mèda, lasi soru broit dhèu mone, rèti dènge labhu èi mènyi asa èmu angalai ra.

source_text: and fiue of them were wise, and fiue foolish.
target_text: te ngaa nèti rèngu canguru dhèu se, abhu lèmi dhu goa, aa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu.

source_text: the foolish tooke their lampes, but tooke none oyle with them.
target_text: lèmi dhu goa se, rèti boe èi mènyi dhu risi.

source_text: but the wise tooke oyle in their vessels with their lampes.
target_text: te ngaa lèmi dhu d'èlu-mèu se, rèti parisi.

source_text: nowe while the bridegrome taried long, all slumbred and slept.
target_text: d'ai èmu, broit dhèu mone dhae mai mèka. nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu bhèni se musi madha ra sakaa, hèia ra bhèj'i luu titu kèna.

source_text: and at midnight there was a crie made, behold, the bridegrome commeth: goe out to meete him.
target_text: re'a rare boe te, d'ai talora mèda sa, hèia tadèngi lii pa'oo, peka na, ‘wee! broit mai le! mai lati soru ne! '

source_text: then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lampes.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi, hèia dhèu bhèni se kèd'i ka. ka ra kèpe ka labhu ra èci-èci.

source_text: and the foolish said to the wise, giue vs of your oyle, for our lampes are out.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu goa se, peka dènge bhèni aanga ra, aku rèngu na, ‘angalai, ee! bagi hia ji'i èi mènyi miu ciki la, te labhu ji'i di ruru-ruru kèna! '

source_text: but the wise answered, saying, not so, lest there will not be ynough for vs and you: but goe ye rather to them that sell, and bye for your selues.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, ‘irii! baku nasa, te bisa boe. te èi mènyi ji'i d'ai boe èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti! de be'a risi lami hèli ètu era dhu pahia èi mènyi. '

source_text: and while they went to bye, the bridegrome came: and they that were readie, went in with him to the wedding, and the gate was shut.
target_text: hèia lasi ka hèli èi mènyi. te ngaa ropa rèngu lasi, broit dhu d'ai le. ka dhèu bhèni dhu d'èlu-mèu se, lasi ka asa d'ara pesta, palere-lere dènge broit dènge tamu aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa rèngu aa'i-aa'i d'ai d'ara, ka ra bèdho èmu.

source_text: afterwards came also the other virgins, saying, lord, lord, open to vs.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni dhèu lèmi dhu goa se, lèpa mai. ka ra paroa peka na, ‘ama! ama! conge ku èmu hia ji'i la! '

source_text: but he answered, and said, verely i say vnto you, i knowe you not.
target_text: te ngaa ama ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, bisa boe, te miu se cee, ja'a tadhe boe! '

source_text: watch therfore: for ye know neither the day, nor the houre, when the sonne of man will come.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, te miu me'a boe kahèi, lod'o do hake pèri ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: for the kingdome of heauen is as a man that going into a strange countrey, called his seruants, and deliuered to them his goods.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, ropa ja'a tèke eele miu, na, miu hud'i sab'a paie-iie hia ja'a, nuka sèmi lii pakasame ne: abhu lamatua ca dhèu neo pakèd'i la'e asa rai kaj'èu. ropa na pa'èra neo la'e, hèia na paroa nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ka na paredha si, aku nèngu na, ‘miu pake doi ne, tao mi poko. ladhe ja'a lèpa mai, miu pad'elo dènge ja'a, miu abhu leto ca ngaa. '

source_text: and vnto one he gaue fiue talents, and to an other two, and to another one, to euery man after his own ability, and straightway went from home.
target_text: ka na pabagi doi hualaa mi dhèu sab'a ka èci, lèmi saku, sèna ka pab'unge ne. dhèu sab'a ka dua abhu doi dua saku, aa ka tèlu abhu doi ca saku, madhutu a'èra rèngu èci-èci ra. ka lamatua ne pakèd'i la'e ka.

source_text: then he that had receiued the fiue talents, went and occupied with them, and gained other fiue talents.
target_text: ropa sèmi rare doi ne, hèia dhèu sab'a ka èci la'e dènge d'aga. nèbhu boe, na abhu leto doi lèmi saku hari.

source_text: likewise also, he that receiued two, he also gained other two.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sab'a ka dua. na abhu leto, doi dua saku hari.

source_text: but he that receiued that one, went and digged it in the earth, and hid his masters money.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ka tèlu dhu abhu doi ca saku deo na, la'e kèi ro'a ka na padhènu doi lamatua na asa d'ara.

source_text: but after a long season, the master of those seruants came, and reckoned with them.
target_text: nèbhu ae ku, heka lamatua rèngu lèpa. hèia na paroa dhèu sab'a na sèra, ho parisa doi na, dhu na hia si uri.

source_text: then came he that had receiued fiue talents, and brought other fiue talents, saying, master, thou deliueredst vnto me fiue talents: behold, i haue gained with them other fiue talents.
target_text: dhèu sab'a ka èci, la'e ka saraka doi canguru saku, ka na peka, ‘ama! doi ama ka ne'e. ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi lèmi saku. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a abhu leto lèmi saku kahèi. '

source_text: then his master saide vnto him, it is well done good seruant and faithfull, thou hast bene faithfull in litle, i will make thee ruler ouer much: enter into thy masters ioy.
target_text: ropa lamatua na tadèngi, hèia na karej'e. ka na peka, na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a. èu ne maj'èni, aa d'èi madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu ne bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu sèna ka uri j'ara dhu kapai aae hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: also he that had receiued two talents, came, and said, master, thou deliueredst vnto me two talents: behold, i haue gained two other talets more.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu sab'a ka dua, la'e saraka mi lamatua na, doi èpa saku, ka na peka na, ‘ama! ca hari ni, ama hia ja'a doi dua saku. te ngaa ladhe ku la, ja'a abhu leto dua saku kahèi. '

source_text: his master saide vnto him, it is well done good seruant, and faithfull, thou hast bene faithfull in litle, i will make thee ruler ouer much: enter into thy masters ioy.
target_text: ka lamatua ne karej'e kahèi, ka na peka na, ‘be'a! èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu be'a kahèi. èu ca dhèu dhu maj'èni, aa madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a, masi ka ja'a aad'o. lula èu bisa uri dhu ciki sèmi ne'e ne, de èèna na ja'a ded'e èu ho uri dhu kapai hari. pe ja'a tao pesta, sèna ka ta'a-tinu sama-sama. '

source_text: then he which had receiued the one talent, came, and said, master, i knewe that thou wast an hard man, which reapest where thou sowedst not, and gatherest where thou strawedst not:
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu sab'a ka tèlu, la'e peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ke'a na, ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara adhu. te ama more ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu more ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle.

source_text: i was therefore afraide, and went, and hid thy talent in the earth: behold, thou hast thine owne.
target_text: ka ja'a madha'u, mage doi se ele, hèia ama huku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a huni paie-iie ne. ka se'e, ama! de more hari ka, te doi ama se, kura boe ca ana ma sa! '

source_text: and his master answered, and said vnto him, thou euill seruant, and slouthfull, thou knewest that i reape where i sowed not, and gather where i strawed not.
target_text: ropa lamatua ne tadèngi nare, hèia na jèke dhèu sab'a ne, aku nèngu na, ‘wee, èu ne dhèu sab'a dhu bhelu aa bai-eed'a! èu dhu me'a, na, ja'a kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo tao, aa puu kore ngaa dhu dhèu leo sèle,

source_text: thou oughtest therefore to haue put my money to ye exchangers, and then at my comming should i haue receiued mine owne with vantage.
target_text: nga tao ka èu lamu boe tèke doi ne mi bank? sèna ka ropa ja'a lèpa, ja'a kore bunga na, masi ka ciki oo'e, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: take therefore the talent from him, and giue it vnto him which hath tenne talents.
target_text: ka lamatua ne pua dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, ‘mere doi nèti nèngu ne, ho hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto lèmi saku èèna.

source_text: for vnto euery man that hath, it shall be giuen, and he shall haue abundance, and from him that hath not, euen that he hath, shalbe taken away.
target_text: te dhèu dhu uri paie-iie ngaa dhu ètu adhe-aai na, èèna na, na abhu ae hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu ro'o boe uri ngaa dhu ètu d'ara adhe-aai na, èèna na rare aa'i nèti nèngu.

source_text: cast therefore that vnprofitable seruant into vtter darkenes: there shalbe weeping and gnasshing of teeth.
target_text: kèpe mere dhèu sab'a dhu guna boe ne. nuni pa'oro ne, pèci asa li'u nèi. soro tèke ne, sèna ka na tangi, aa dui nare j'aj'èra ètu era maroga aatu-aatu nèi! '

source_text: and when the sonne of man commeth in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit vpon the throne of his glorie,
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a puru mai dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. èle na ja'a madhèdi ètu kadera paredha dhu dedha risi, sèna ka parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and before him shalbe gathered all nations, and he shall seperate them one from another, as a shepheard separateth the sheepe from ye goates.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri rèdhi ètu rai-haha, mai asa madha ja'a. pe ja'a hag'e si, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha pacèri kahib'i-kalèbho nèti kahib'i-ka'ia, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dua kaboko.

source_text: and he shall set the sheepe on his right hand, and the goates on the left.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, ja'a hia si re g'ana ja'a. te ngaa dhu leo sèra, ja'a hia si re kariu ja'a.

source_text: then shall ye king say to them on his right hand, come ye blessed of my father: take the inheritance of the kingdome prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a kèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. èèna na dhèu-dhèu ètu g'ana ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se'e se, ka dhu abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama ku. mai lati asa d'ara èmu na, dhu na tao tèke hia miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for i was an hungred, and ye gaue me meate: i thirsted, and ye gaue me drinke: i was a stranger, and ye tooke me in vnto you.
target_text: ja'a nèru miu, lula uru èèna lod'o ja'a manganga, miu ka dhu panga'a ja'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu ka hia ja'a kinu. ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu hia ja'a manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu.

source_text: i was naked, and ye clothed me: i was sicke, and ye visited me: i was in prison, and ye came vnto me.
target_text: ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu ka dhu papake ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa miu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, aa miu ka dhu mai pa'asu-pareo dènge ja'a. '

source_text: then shall the righteous answere him, saying, lord, when sawe we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or a thirst, and gaue thee drinke?
target_text: ropa dhèu-dhèu ètu sebhe g'ana ja'a se tadèngi lii ja'a ne, ra dhaa peka na, ‘lamatua, ne'e ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, ka ji'i panga'a. lamatua koko kamango, ka ji'i hia minu.

source_text: and when sawe we thee a stranger, and tooke thee in vnto vs? or naked, and clothed thee?
target_text: lamatua sèmi dhèu leo kara, ka ji'i hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, ka ji'i papake lamatua.

source_text: or when sawe we thee sicke, or in prison, and came vnto thee?
target_text: lamatua pèd'a, ka ji'i lalau-lalo'o lamatua, lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, ka ji'i dhiu pa'asu-pareo. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, lod'o mia ka dhu ji'i tao mi lamatua? '

source_text: and the king shall answere, and say vnto them, verely i say vnto you, in as much as ye haue done it vnto one of the least of these my brethre, ye haue done it to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa si, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu tao j'ara se'e se mi dhèu unu ja'a, masi ka tao mi dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, sèra sa miu tao le mi dedha ja'a kahèi! '

source_text: then shall he say vnto them on ye left hand, depart from me ye cursed, into euerlasting fire, which is prepared for the deuill and his angels.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sebhe kariu ja'a, ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘hee, dhèu bhelu-katub'a! ama lamatua dhu dhoo le miu. pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! pe ja'a paredha dhèu mai kèpe miu, sèna ka pèci asa d'ara ai naraka dhu heo robhe-robhe. te ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le era j'aj'èra ne, hia mi nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra.

source_text: for i was an hungred, and ye gaue me no meate: i thirsted, and ye gaue me no drinke:
target_text: ja'a babège eele miu, lula lod'o ja'a manganga, miu hia boe ja'a ku'a. aa lod'o ja'a koko kamango, miu hia boe ja'a kinu.

source_text: i was a stranger, and ye tooke me not in vnto you: i was naked, and ye clothed me not: sicke, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
target_text: ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa miu soru boe ja'a asa d'ara èmu mi. ja'a dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa miu papake boe ja'a. lod'o ja'a pèd'a-tarègu, miu lalau-lalo'o boe ja'a. ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa miu pa'asu-pareo boe ja'a sa kahèi. '

source_text: then shall they also answere him, saying, lord, when sawe we thee an hungred, or a thirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sicke, or in prison, and did not minister vnto thee?
target_text: ropa dhèu bhelu-katub'a se tadèngi lii ja'a sèmi èèna, hèia ra b'ala, peka na, ‘lamatua ne tasamia kèna? lamatua peka na, lamatua manganga, te ngaa ji'i hia boe mu'a. lamatua koko kamango, te ngaa ji'i hia boe minu. lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu leo kara, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe hia manubha ètu d'ara èmu ji'i. lamatua dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ji'i papake boe. lamatua ètu d'ara papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa ji'i lalau-lalo'o boe. lamatua ètu d'ara bèdho, te ngaa ji'i pa'asu-pareo boe. te ngaa j'ara se'e se, ji'i tao mi lamatua lod'o mia? '

source_text: then shall he answere them, and say, verely i say vnto you, in as much as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
target_text: pe ja'a dhaa mi rèngu, peka na, ‘parcaya la ja'a! te lod'o miu soru-bara boe dhèu-dhèu dhu haha ae d'ai seli, èci èèna ka dènge miu soru-bara boe ja'a. '

source_text: and these shall goe into euerlasting paine, and the righteous into life eternall.
target_text: ka dhèu bhelu-katub'a abhu j'aj'èra, toke d'ai mia-mia. te ngaa dhèu-dhèu dhu d'ara mola, abhu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and it came to passe, when iesus had finished all these sayings, he saide vnto his disciples,
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, hèia na lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: ye know that after two dayes is ye passeouer, and the sonne of man shalbe deliuered to be crucified.
target_text: miu me'a le, na, di dua lod'o ka d'ai lod'o babe'a èdhi, nuka pesta paska. lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èle èèna, ra paku pamadhe ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then assembled together the chiefe priests, and the scribes, and the elders of ye people into the hall of the high priest called caiaphas:
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dhu pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu kayafas. kayafas ne, nuka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: and consulted together that they might take iesus by subtiltie, and kill him.
target_text: rèngu se tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they sayd, not on the feast day, least any vprore be among the people.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu rare lii èci, peka na, mata ku! mage èdhi kèpe ne ètu d'ara lai-lai ne, lula lod'o-lod'o be'a dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae dhu d'èi nèngu, tao maruru.

source_text: and when iesus was in bethania, in the house of simon the leper,
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. lod'o dhu d'ai mèka lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu simon.

source_text: there came vnto him a woman, which had a boxe of very costly oyntment, and powred it on his head, as he sate at the table.
target_text: ropa rèngu ra'a era, bhèni ca dhèu mai paraga dènge yesus. nèngu nèd'u boto cue dhu tao nèti hadhu dhu kab'ua. boto ne dhu isi na, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna. ka bhèni ne hake pamae katanga boto ne. hèia na pahae mau-mau èi hèu mèngi ne mi kètu yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and when his disciples sawe it, they had indignation, saying, what needed this waste?
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tatao bhèni ne, hèia ra nasa. ka ra paka'uu, aku rèngu na, heh! bhèni ne bhori eele iia d'ara, èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua aae ne. baku na tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: for this oyntment might haue bene solde for much, and bene giuen to the poore.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie! sèna ka kab'ua na bagi mi dhèu-dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and iesus knowing it, sayde vnto them, why trouble yee the woman? for shee hath wrought a good woorke vpon me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu, hèia na lii peka na, miu se baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e, lula na pahae le èi hèu mèngi ne mi ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: for yee haue the poore alwayes with you, but me shall yee not haue alwaies.
target_text: te dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa pa'èci taruu dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne mamuri nèbhu heka dènge miu.

source_text: for in that shee powred this oyntment on my bodie, shee did it to burie me.
target_text: aa bhèni dhu pahae èi hèu mèngi mi ngi'u ja'a ne, sèmi ngaa te, nèngu pahèu mèngi mema le ngi'u aae ja'a. te mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka.

source_text: verely i say vnto you, wheresoeuer this gospel shall bee preached throughout all the worlde, there shall also this that shee hath done, be spoken of for a memoriall of her.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! sad'i ètu mia èèna ka, ladhe dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua palème rai-haha ne, tatu rèngu papeka kahèi babe'a bhèni ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e ne.

source_text: then one of the twelue, called iudas iscariot, went vnto the chiefe priestes,
target_text: ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu yesus se, dhu ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o èèna kahèi, kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra, sèna ka neo pahie yesus mi rèngu.

source_text: and said, what will ye giue me, and i will deliuer him vnto you? and they appoynted vnto him thirtie pieces of siluer.
target_text: ropa yudas d'ai dhèu se'e, hèia na karèi, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe ja'a bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa kèpe yesus, miu hia ja'a ngaa? hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie ne dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae. ka ra ige rare tèlu nguru doi iia, aa ra j'ole asa yudas.

source_text: and from that time, he sought opportunitie to betraie him.
target_text: èle, ka yudas li'u ka la'e, hèia na tenge j'ara ho saraka yesus asa d'ara adhe-aai rèngu.

source_text: nowe on the first day of the feast of vnleauened bread the disciples came to iesus, saying vnto him, where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eate the passeouer?
target_text: d'ara tèu mai-tèu mai, abhu lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi dhu nanèbhu na pidhu lod'o. ra pangare lod'o babe'a se, na, ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. ropa pesta èèna neo mulai, ana madhutu yesus se mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! mèda ne'e, èdhi bhoke lod'o babe'a èdhi. de ama neo sèna ka ji'i la'a roro kahib'i-kalèbho, aa lalau era pesta paska ètu mia?

source_text: and he said, goe yee into the citie to such a man, and say to him, the master saieth, my time is at hande: i will keepe the passeouer at thine house with my disciples.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, lami asa d'ara kota, pe mi paraga dènge ama ca dhèu. miu peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e, ‘ama! ama mese rasa lod'o mamadhe na nèbhu heka. hèia na manèngi era èci ètu d'ara èmu ama, sèna ka na tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. '

source_text: and the disciples did as iesus had giuen them charge, and made readie the passeouer.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ana-ana madhutu na, tao sèmi dhu na peka. ka ra lalau nganga'a kalela paska ètu era èèna.

source_text: so when the euen was come, hee sate downe with the twelue.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda, hèia yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, madhèdi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and as they did eate, he sayde, verely i say vnto you, that one of you shall betraie me.
target_text: ropa dhu ra'a era, hèia na lii, peka na, mi nanene! ca dhèu nèti miu se, èèna na pahie ja'a asa adhe-aai dhèu leo kara.

source_text: and they were exceeding sorowfull, and began euery one of them to say vnto him, is it i, master?
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara rèngu roe-bhilu. ka rèngu èci-èci karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: and hee answered and sayde, hee that dippeth his hande with me in the dish, hee shall betraie me.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti na palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahie ja'a.

source_text: surely the sonne of man goeth his way, as it is written of him: but woe be to that man, by whom the sonne of man is betrayed: it had bene good for that man, if hee had neuer bene borne.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa mate unu na! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, bèli-camèd'a pasae nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: then iudas which betraied him, answered and sayde, is it i, master? he sayde vnto him, thou hast sayd it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yudas karèi kahèi, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma? hèia yesus b'ala ne, mema tare'a èu unu mu ka dhu peka lii èèna. de cee hari?

source_text: and as they did eate, iesus tooke the bread, and when he had blessed, he brake it, and gaue it to the disciples, and sayd, take, eate: this is my bodie.
target_text: rèngu dhu ra'a era, hèia yesus ded'e nare roti cue, aa na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a. mere ho mi'e ka!

source_text: also he tooke the cuppe, and when he had giuen thankes, he gaue it them, saying, drinke ye all of it.
target_text: èle ka, yesus nare galaa dhu pènu dènge èi anggor, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. hèia na j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na lii, peka na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, mere ho minu.

source_text: for this is my blood of the newe testament, that is shedde for many, for the remission of sinnes.
target_text: te èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna. èèna na ja'a madhe, te ngaa raa ja'a suti, sèna ka sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. raa ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua pajaji èèna, mema limuri ne j'aj'i le. de mere ho minu ka!

source_text: i say vnto you, that i will not drinke henceforth of this fruit of the vine vntil that day, when i shall drinke it new with you in my fathers kingdome.
target_text: te ngaa nanene paie-iie! mulai nèti mèda ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. pe ja'a dènge ama ku madhèdi ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka ja'a kinu hari kèna dènge miu.

source_text: and when they had sung a psalme, they went out into the mount of oliues.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia rèngu sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho koa-kio ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, rèngu lasi dènge ka asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: then saide iesus vnto them, all yee shall be offended by me this night: for it is written, i wil smite the shepheard, and the sheepe of the flocke shalbe scattered.
target_text: ropa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, ciki hari ètu d'ara mèda ne'e kahèi, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na, ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala. '

source_text: but after i am risen againe, i will go before you into galile.
target_text: ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, laku mate miu ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: but peter aunswered, and sayde vnto him, though that al men should be offended by thee, yet will i neuer be offended.
target_text: te ngaa petrus d'èi boe nanene lii na, ka na peka, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai tèke eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: iesus sayde vnto him, verely i say vnto thee, that this night, before the cocke crow, thou shalt denie me thrise.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala aku nèngu na, petrus! sèmi èèna, do? lèka la lii ja'a ne! ètu d'ara mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: peter saide vnto him, though i should die with thee, i will in no case denie thee. likewise also sayd all the disciples.
target_text: te ngaa petrus no'o boe sèmi. ka na peka, aad'o, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe kahèi. te ja'a rai boe, tèke eele ama! angalai petrus se, peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then went iesus with them into a place which is called gethsemane, and said vnto his disciples, sit ye here, while i goe, and pray yonder.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu asa ledhe saitun, d'ai d'ara oka cue, ngara na getsemani. ètu era ne'e yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, miu madhèdi uuru ku mi ne'e, te ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: and hee tooke vnto him peter, and the two sonnes of zebedeus, and began to waxe sorowfull, and grieuously troubled.
target_text: te ngaa na paroa nare petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis, ho lasi palere-lere dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, d'ara na ma'ète laho mae-mae, aa roe-bhilu.

source_text: then sayde iesus vnto them, my soule is very heauie, euen vnto the death: tarie yee here, and watch with me.
target_text: rèngu kako kaj'èu mèka, te na peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna! ja'a nuka sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi, mate ja'a mi ne'e.

source_text: so hee went a litle further, and fell on his face, and praied, saying, o my father, if it be possible, let this cup passe from me: neuerthelesse, not as i will, but as thou wilt.
target_text: ka la'e ako kaj'èu ciki, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ho sabaj'a, aku nèngu na, ama pasue! ladhe ama d'èi na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e. te ngaa baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: after, hee came vnto the disciples, and founde them a sleepe, and sayde to peter, what? coulde yee not watch with me one houre?
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia lèpa la'e asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i luu. ka yesus parèi si, hèia na lii dènge petrus, peka na, hee, petrus! nga tao ka miu se bhèj'i? ja'a ètu nèi nèbhu boe, te ngaa miu lake mere boe beke ciki sa mate ja'a!

source_text: watch, and praie, that yee enter not into tentation: the spirit in deede is readie, but the flesh is weake.
target_text: ruri pamako musi madha miu. kèd'i ho beke dènge ja'a. te d'ara miu mema d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa ngi'u miu èra boe. de hua iia miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe lèke dadugu-rariu miu bisa taha.

source_text: againe he went away the second time, and praied, saying, o my father, if this cuppe can not passe away from mee, but that i must drinke it, thy will be done.
target_text: ka yesus la'e hari sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ladhe ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra ne'e, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: and he came, and founde them a sleepe againe, for their eyes were heauie.
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia na mai hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu se. te ngaa dhu ra bhèj'i hari, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna.

source_text: so he left them and went away againe, and praied the third time, saying the same woordes.
target_text: ka na tèke eele si, la'e hari manèngi-mangaj'i catèka. na manèngi-mangaj'i hari mi ama, sèna ka baku soro tèke nèngu pasae j'aj'èra èèna, te ngaa hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then came he to his disciples, and said vnto them, sleepe henceforth, and take your rest: behold, the houre is at hand, and the sonne of man is giuen into the hands of sinners.
target_text: sabaj'a nare ka, na lèpa hari, la'e parèi ana madhutu na, peka na, miu se bhèj'i taruu, do? kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dètu le. dhèu se mai ho kèpe ja'a kèna, ho saraka asa adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: rise, let vs goe: beholde, hee is at hande that betraieth me.
target_text: wee, kèd'i ka! bhoke musi madha miu, ladhe ku asa nèi. te dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, nuka mai nèi.

source_text: and while hee yet spake, loe iudas, one of the twelue, came, and with him a great multitude with swordes and staues, from the high priests and elders of the people.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas dhu nare le era èèna dènge dhèu ae-ae. dhèu se mai rèti hela dènge aj'u cèki ho neo kèpe ne. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, lula madhutu paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now he that betraied him, had giuen them a token, saying, whomesoeuer i shall kisse, that is he, laie holde on him.
target_text: yudas dhu peka mema le mi dhèu se'e, na, miu ladhe paie-iie! dhèu dhu ja'a uu, nèngu ka dhu miu kèpe! te nèngu ka dhu miu tenge!

source_text: and forthwith he came to iesus, and sayd, god saue thee, master, and kissed him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai madha yesus, hèia yudas lii dènge ka, saloom, ama mese! hèia yudas uu yesus.

source_text: then iesus sayde vnto him, friende, wherefore art thou come? then came they, and laide hands on iesus, and tooke him.
target_text: èle ka, yesus peka dènge ne, hee, yudas! tao ka laa, madhutu dad'èi èu. ka dhèu ae sèra ara lasi neo kèpe ne.

source_text: and behold, one of them which were with iesus, stretched out his hand, and drewe his sworde, and strooke a seruaunt of the high priest, and smote off his eare.
target_text: te ngaa dhu re'a boe, na, dhèu unu yesus ca dhèu dhu bete hela na, ka seru pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, nuka ca dhèu ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: then sayde iesus vnto him, put vp thy sworde into his place: for all that take the sworde, shall perish with the sworde.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pasaluu hela èu èèna asa d'ara sope na. te dhèu dhu pake rèka ho neo uri pamere lii langu, èèna na nèngu madhe dènge rèka kahèi.

source_text: either thinkest thou, that i can not now pray to my father, and he will giue me moe then twelue legions of angels?
target_text: èu me'a boe, do? ja'a bisa manèngi ama ku, ho na hia ana pajuu na d'ai nguru riho mai nèti sorga, sèna ka soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: howe then shoulde the scriptures bee fulfilled, which say, that it must be so?
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa, ra kèpe ja'a. te aa'i-aa'i dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ja'a ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: the same houre sayde iesus to the multitude, ye be come out as it were against a thiefe, with swordes and staues to take mee: i sate daily teaching in the temple among you, and yee tooke me not.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu miu, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? nga tao ka miu mai kèpe ja'a ne, mèti dènge hela dènge aj'u cèki? bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu èci sa tao boe ngaa-ngaa mi ja'a.

source_text: but all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. then all the disciples forsooke him, and fled.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa! mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne'e ne, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. ropa ana madhutu yesus rèdhi sèmi èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele ne mesa-mesa.

source_text: and they tooke iesus, and led him to caiaphas the hie priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu dhu kèpe yesus, rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dhu ngara na, kayafas, lula dhèu kapai sèra dhu pakaboko le ètu era èèna. dhèu se nuka, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, aa dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: and peter followed him a farre off vnto the hie priestes hall, and went in, and sate with the seruants to see the ende.
target_text: ropa ra rèti yesus, petrus madhutu nèti limuri, toke d'ai èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna. petrus la'e kahèi asa madha èmu, ho madhèdi dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sèra. te neo ne'a, ngaa ka dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: nowe the chiefe priestes and the elders, and all the whole councill sought false witnesse against iesus, to put him to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne, kètu agama yahudi sèra dhu padhue-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi uri lii langu agama. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they founde none, and though many false witnesses came, yet founde they none: but at the last came two false witnesses,
target_text: masi ka rèngu hia sakasii monya ae kahèi, te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala èci sa dhu rèngu bisa pake. nèbhu boe ka, rèngu abhu sakasii dhèu dua.

source_text: and saide, this man saide, i can destroie the temple of god, and build it in three daies.
target_text: dhèu dua se, peka na, ji'i tadèngi le kahèi, dhèu ne peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, ja'a patitu kore hari. '

source_text: then the chiefe priest arose, and sayde to him, answerest thou nothing? what is the matter that these men witnesse against thee?
target_text: ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era èèna. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu tadèngi le lii galaa dhèu se'e dhu ra galaa èu. nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa?

source_text: but iesus helde his peace. then the chiefe priest answered, and saide to him, i charge thee sweare vnto vs by the liuing god, to tell vs, if thou be that christ the sonne of god, or no.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa. hèia kètu kapai ne karèi hari, na, ja'a neo karèi! te ngaa èu hud'i dhaa tare'a-re'a ku, nuka sèmi èu dhaa mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri ètu sorga. abhu dhèu dhu peka na, èu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa tèke karèi nèti uru ka. tare'a sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: iesus saide to him, thou hast saide it: neuerthelesse i say vnto you, hereafter shall ye see the sonne of man, sitting at the right hande of the power of god, and come in the cloudes of the heauen.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, tare'a, nuka sèmi lii ama èèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. pe ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne, dhu koasa na kapai risi eele èèna. èle na, ja'a puru mai hari ètu dedha ra'i-liru.

source_text: then the hie priest rent his clothes, saying, hee hath blasphemed, what haue wee any more neede of witnesses? beholde: nowe yee haue heard his blasphemie.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare yesus peka sèmi èèna, hèia kètu kapai ne nasa bia, toke na ciu pamae kodho madhera na. hèia na pa'oo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu sakasii tao ngaa hari era! miu unu mi tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, lii padhai na. nèngu tao iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne pahaha ama lamatua! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le, na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua, na, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku!

source_text: what thinke yee? they answered, and said, he is guiltie of death.
target_text: de miu neo pama'ète sèmi mia hari? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra parodha, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne mema sala tare'a! de hud'i huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: then spet they in his face, and buffeted him, and other smote him with roddes,
target_text: ka dhèu pèri-pèri lasi sabhuu ilu mi yesus. hèia ra hake-paru, aa tèb'e pa'oke ne.

source_text: saying, prophecie to vs, o christ, who is he that smote thee?
target_text: èle ka, ra lalangu ne, peka na, wee! èu ne'e ka kristus, si? èu peka sèku! dhèu cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: peter sate without in the hall, and a maide came to him, saying, thou also wast with iesus of galile:
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu. ka ènu bhèni ca dhèu mai lii dènge ne, peka na, deo na, èu kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but hee denied before them all, saying, i wote not what thou saiest.
target_text: te ngaa na pasili ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe ne.

source_text: and when hee went out into the porche, another maide sawe him, and sayde vnto them that were there, this man was also with iesus of nazareth.
target_text: ka petrus kalua la'e titu ètu hèb'a oka. hèia bhèni leo hari èci ladhe nèdhi ne ètu èèna. ka bhèni ne peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a kèdhi dhèu ne'e ne palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna.

source_text: and againe he denied with an othe, saying, i knowe not the man.
target_text: hèia petrus jèke ne, peka na, èu ne tao-tao huj'u! ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: so after a while, came vnto him they that stoode by, and sayde vnto peter, surely thou art also one of them: for euen thy speache bewraieth thee.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo ètu sèra sa peka dènge ne, hee! èu ne baku kapod'e-kabèli d'ara lii, dhu peka na, èu kako palere boe dènge dhèu ne! te nèti lii padhai èu, èci èèna ka dènge laloe lii dhèu galilea!

source_text: then began hee to curse himselfe, and to sweare, saying, i knowe not the man. and immediately the cocke crewe.
target_text: te ngaa na padhèd'a, ka b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e ne! ropa na peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: then peter remembred the wordes of iesus, which had sayde vnto him, before the cocke crowe thou shalt denie me thrise. so he went out, and wept bitterly.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii kokotoo manu, hèia petrus ngee nèdhi lii yesus, dhu peka na, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a. sanèd'e nare lii ne'e, hèia la'e asa li'u ka tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: when the morning was come, all the chiefe priests, and the elders of the people tooke counsell against iesus, to put him to death,
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri lii langu agama sèra, rare lii èci sèna ka neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and led him away bounde, and deliuered him vnto pontius pilate the gouernour.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra èki ne rèti asa madha gubernur pilatus. te rèngu d'èi sèna ka gubernur huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: then when iudas which betraied him, sawe that hee was condemned, hee repented himselfe, and brought againe the thirtie pieces of siluer to the chiefe priestes, and elders,
target_text: ropa yudas tadèngi na, yesus abhu hahuku madhe, hèia na manyasa, lula nèngu ka dhu pahie yesus. ka la'e hari asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, ho neo hia hari la'a doi iia tèlu nguru bua sèra.

source_text: saying, i haue sinned, betraying the innocent bloud. but they sayde, what is that to vs? see thou to it.
target_text: na peka na, ja'a tao le sasala-sasigo, lula ja'a pahie le dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. te ngaa dhèu se b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! ji'i se pusi-pahae heka èu ne! èu mesa mu ka dhu d'ui more sasala èèna.

source_text: and when hee had cast downe the siluer pieces in the temple, hee departed, and went, and hanged himselfe.
target_text: ka yudas ceb'e eele doi sèra asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia la'e kadhoe iisi na, toke na madhe aapa.

source_text: and the chiefe priestes tooke the siluer pieces, and sayde, it is not lawfull for vs to put them into the treasure, because it is the price of bloud.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra kaboko rare doi dhu na ceb'e eele sèra. ra padhue, aku rèngu na, doi se'e mage èdhi tao asa d'ara boaraka doi, lula doi se doi kaj'alu.

source_text: and they tooke counsell, and bought with them a potters fielde, for the buriall of strangers.
target_text: de be'a risi èdhi hèli tare rai ca kasib'i nèti dhèu tao èru rai sèi. ladhe dhèu mai nèti rai leo, do, dhèu dhu èdhi tadhe boe madhe, èdhi padhane si ètu era ne'e ne.

source_text: wherefore that field is called, the field of bloud, vntill this day.
target_text: ka ra hèli rai ne, kab'ua na nèti doi deo sa. nèti èèna ka, rai ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu pangare na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: then was fulfilled that which was spoken by ieremias the prophet, saying, and they tooke thirtie siluer pieces, ye price of him that was valued, whom they of ye children of israel valued.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu madhutu lii nèti ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, dhu suri tèke na, rèngu pake doi iia tèlu nguru bua ho hèli rai. rèngu pake doi se, lula doi se kab'ua nèti hèli dhèu, madhutu sèmi dhu dhèu isra'el pama'ète rare le.

source_text: and they gaue them for the potters fielde, as the lord appointed me.
target_text: rai ne, rèngu hèli nèti dhèu tao èru rai, madhutu lii paredha dhu ama lamatua hia mi ja'a.

source_text: and iesus stood before ye gouernour, and the gouernour asked him, saying, art thou that king of the iewes? iesus said vnto him, thou sayest it.
target_text: ropa dhèu se rèti yesus d'ai gubernur, hèia na karèi yesus, tasamia? èu ne, tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? na dhaa, peka na, tare'a. ama peka lèke kèna.

source_text: and when he was accused of the chiefe priestes, and elders, he answered nothing.
target_text: te ngaa ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra galaa ne dènge lii langu ae-ae, na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi.

source_text: then saide pilate vnto him, hearest thou not howe many things they lay against thee?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari ne, peka na, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai lii rèngu, do? dhèu se hia sasala ae-ae mi dedha èu. te ngaa tasamia ka èu b'ala boe si hèi? !

source_text: but he answered him not to one worde, in so much that the gouernour marueiled greatly.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi, toke gubernur malaa.

source_text: nowe at the feast, the gouernour was wont to deliuer vnto the people a prisoner whom they would.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai ka lod'o kalela paska, dhèu yahudi hag'e rare ana bèdho ca dhèu, sèna ka gubernur patabuli ne.

source_text: and they had then a notable prisoner, called barabbas.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu bèdho ca dhèu, ngara na barabas. dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe le nèngu ne, lula nèngu ca dhèu bhelu-katub'a titu kèna.

source_text: when they were then gathered together, pilate said vnto the, whether will ye that i let loose vnto you barabbas, or iesus which is called christ?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu ae lasi asa gubernur pilatus ho manèngi, sèna ka patabuli dhèu bèdho èci, sèmi biasa. hèia pilatus karèi si, aku nèngu na, be'a. de ja'a patabuli cee? ètu ne'e barabas, aa abhu kahèi yesus, dhu dhèu paroa ne, kristus. mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? miu ka dhu pama'ète.

source_text: for he knewe well, that for enuie they had deliuered him.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, te ne'a na kètu agama yahudi rèti yesus asa nèngu, lula rèngu se tèka d'ara dènge yesus.

source_text: also when he was set downe vpon the iudgement seate, his wife sent to him, saying, haue thou nothing to do with that iust man: for i haue suffered many things this day in a dreame by reason of him.
target_text: gubernur ètu d'ara uri lii langu ne era, dhèu èmu na moa lii, peka na, ama! mage-mage, oo! te yesus ne dhu dènge boe sasala. lula nèngu ne'e ka, mèda deo na, ja'a nii aapa. toke d'ai sange ne'e, d'ara ja'a dhae tèka mèka.

source_text: but the chiefe priestes and the elders had persuaded the people that they shoulde aske barabbas, and should destroy iesus.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dadugu dhèu ae ètu èèna, ho ra manèngi gubernur patabuli barabas, aa huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: then the gouernour answered, and said vnto them, whether of the twaine will ye that i let loose vnto you? and they said, barabbas.
target_text: ka na karèi hari si, aku nèngu na, nèti dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, peka na, barabas! patabuli barabas di!

source_text: pilate said vnto them, what shall i do then with iesus, which is called christ? they all said to him, let him be crucified.
target_text: èle ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tao tasa mera mia mi yesus, dhu ra peka na kristus ne? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha peka na, paku pamadhe ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: then saide the gouernour, but what euill hath he done? then they cryed the more, saying, let him be crucified.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur karèi hari, peka na, te sala na, ngaa? ja'a parisa le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa! te ngaa ra asa pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: when pilate saw that he auailed nothing, but that more tumult was made, he tooke water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, i am innocent of the blood of this iust man: looke you to it.
target_text: nèbhu boe, na ne'a heka tao tasamia hari, lula dhèu se'e asa ka ra hino neo patao. nèti èèna ka, nare èi ho j'amo ai ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, aa na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a tago boe mamadhe dhèu ne'e ne! miu aa'i-aa'i mi ka dhu hud'i pasae mere mamadhe na!

source_text: then answered all the people, and saide, his bloud be on vs, and on our children.
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e dhaa dènge lii pa'oo-parodha peka na, oo, hud'i laa! hud'i laa ji'i dènge ana-èpu ji'i tago ngare raa na!

source_text: thus let he barabbas loose vnto them, and scourged iesus, and deliuered him to be crucified.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia na peka, la'a, sina ma. hèia na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi ra. èle èèna ka, na pua dhèu j'aga, lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare, ka sordad'u rèti yesus, sèna ka neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the souldiers of the gouernour tooke iesus into the common hall, and gathered about him the whole band,
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u ère rèti yesus asa tana lapa ètu d'ara benteng rèngu. d'ai nèi, rèngu paroa rare angalai ra ca batalion.

source_text: and they stripped him, and put about him a skarlet robe,
target_text: hèia ra papake ne kodho madhera èci dhu mea aae.

source_text: and platted a crowne of thornes, and put it vpon his head, and a reede in his right hand, and bowed their knees before him, and mocked him, saying, god saue thee king of the iewes,
target_text: ka rare loro aj'u padhudhu ra ènyu tao sèmi solo. hèia ra ènyi solo ne mi kètu yesus, ho ra sasei ne, tao nuka sèmi rèngu ded'e dhèu aae hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. èle èèna ka, ra j'ole hia ne aj'u ca'èta asa ai g'ana na, nuka sèmi tatea paredha. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ra, patangara dènge yesus, aa ra pamakae ne, peka na, pakab'ua dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and spitted vpon him, and tooke a reede, and smote him on the head.
target_text: hèia ra sabhuu ne ilu, aa rare aj'u ca'èta dhu na kèpe deo na, ka ra d'eu kètu na.

source_text: thus when they had mocked him, they tooke the robe from him, and put his owne rayment on him, and led him away to crucifie him.
target_text: ropa ra sasei rare ne, hèia ra bhoke eele kodho madhera. èle èèna ka, ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. ka rèti ne asa li'u kota yerusalem, ho neo paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and as they came out, they found a man of cyrene, named simon: him they compelled to beare his crosse.
target_text: ropa ra ère rèti yesus, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci dhu neo la'e asa d'ara kota. ngara na, simon. dhèu se laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha gati yesus.

source_text: and when they came vnto the place called golgotha, that is to say, the place of dead mens skulles
target_text: ka ra d'ai era èci, ngara na golgota. ètu d'ara lii aram, sasoa na, era rui kètu.

source_text: they gaue him vineger to drinke, mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drinke.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu se'e hia yesus ninu èi anggor dhu pab'ali rare le dènge èi na'i dhu pèd'u, sèna ka bisa taha rarii. ka yesus camuci, hèia juku eele.

source_text: and when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, and did cast lottes, that it might be fulfilled, which was spoken by the prophet, they deuided my garments among them, and vpon my vesture did cast lottes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e paku yesus asa aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka nèti rèngu, cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and they sate, and watched him there.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi madhenge yesus ètu era ne'e.

source_text: they set vp also ouer his head his cause written, this is iesvs the king of the ievves.
target_text: ra suri kahèi ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne yesus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a nga tao ka rèngu huku ne.

source_text: and there were two theeues crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra paku pamadhe parapo dhèu dua kahèi. ca dhèu re bèka g'ana yesus, aa èci hari re bèka kariu na.

source_text: and they that passed by, reuiled him, wagging their heades,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re sèra, laladhe ne. hèia ra pakapengo hèb'a ra, ho lalangu ne.

source_text: and saying, thou that destroyest ye temple, and buildest it in three dayes, saue thy selfe: if thou be ye sonne of god, come downe from ye crosse.
target_text: dhèu se'e rodhe ne, peka na, eeh! èu peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ho èèna na patitu hari ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, si? ladhe èu tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, na, papuru ngi'u mu nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: likewise also the hie priests mocking him, with the scribes, and elders, and pharises, said,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra. ra pahahe yesus, aku rèngu na,

source_text: he saued others, but he cannot saue him selfe: if he be ye king of israel, let him now come downe from ye crosse, and we will beleeue in him.
target_text: nèngu ne pamamuri le dhèu leo, te ngaa na bisa boe patabuli eele ngi'u nèngu unu na. nèngu mesa na peka na, nèngu dhèu aae isra'el! ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi na puru ka nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. ladhe ji'i ngèdhi ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna, ji'i heka parcaya nèngu kèna.

source_text: he trusted in god, let him deliuer him nowe, if he will haue him: for he saide, i am the sonne of god.
target_text: ladhe nèngu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, hud'i laa, ‘na maena mi ama lamatua. de ladhe lamatua d'èi ne, hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu pamamuri ne. '

source_text: the selfe same thing also ye theeues which were crucified with him, cast in his teeth.
target_text: dhèu parapo dhèu dua se, pahahe ne sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: now from ye sixt houre was there darkenesse ouer all the land, vnto the ninth houre.
target_text: èle èèna ka, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare era ne'e, karèi nèti lod'o titu mera toke d'ai hake tèlu nihia.

source_text: and about ye ninth houre iesus cryed with a loud voyce, saying, eli, eli, lamasabachthani? that is, my god, my god, why hast thou forsaken me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, na, eli! eli! lema sabaktani? sasoa na, ama lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka ama soro kabodho ho tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: and some of them that stoode there, when they heard it, said, this man calleth elias.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu dètu ètu sèra, tadèngi lii na sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, mi nanene ku laa. na paroa elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra!

source_text: and straightway one of them ran, and tooke a spondge, and filled it with vineger, and put it on a reede, and gaue him to drinke.
target_text: ka ca dhèu rai la'e nare ula, cèb'u asa d'ara èi anggor manyilu. hèia na èki mi suu tatea èci, ka j'ole asa hèb'a yesus sèna ka na camuci.

source_text: other said, let be: let vs see, if elias wil come and saue him.
target_text: te ngaa cahag'e hari peka na, èdhi ladhe sèku, teko-teko elia mai pamamuri ne, do aad'o?

source_text: then iesus cryed againe with a loude voyce, and yeelded vp the ghost.
target_text: ka yesus pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, hèia na madhe.

source_text: and behold, the vayle of the temple was rent in twaine, from the top to the bottome, and the earth did quake, and the stones were cloue.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. lèke dènge yesus ma'ète a'ae èèna, bèla dhu bhèla aae ne mae, cèri mi dua, nèti dedha toke haha. hèia rai opo, toke hadhu aae-hadhu aae mae sèg'i bagi mi dua.

source_text: and the graues did open themselues, and many bodies of the saintes, which slept, arose,
target_text: ro'a-ro'a dhèu madhe bhoke kahèi. aa dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu madhe le, abhu dhu na pamamuri hari.

source_text: and came out of the graues after his resurrection, and went into the holy citie, and appeared vnto many.
target_text: ropa yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, hèia dhèu madhe sèra bhodho mai nèti d'ara ro'a, ka lasi asa yerusalem. ètu era ne'e dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: when the centurion, and they that were with him watching iesus, saw the earthquake, and the thinges that were done, they feared greatly, saying, truely this was the sonne of god.
target_text: ètu golgota, abhu komedhaa dènge sordad'u na dhu j'aga ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus èèna. ropa ladhe rèdhi rai opo, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se'e, rèngu madha'u titu kèna. ka ra papeka, na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a ana lamatua!

source_text: and many women were there, beholding him a farre off, which had folowed iesus from galile, ministring vnto him.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu bhèni pèri-pèri dhèu dhu laladhe mamadhe yesus nèti kaj'èu. rèngu se'e ka dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea, te rèngu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ne karèi nèti uru.

source_text: among whom was marie magdalene, and marie the mother of iames, and ioses, and the mother of zebedeus sonnes.
target_text: dhèu bhèni se'e, nuka maria nèti rae magdala, maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yusuf, aa dènge dhèu èmu sabadeus nuka ina nèti yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and when the euen was come, there came a riche man of arimathea, named ioseph, who had also himselfe bene iesus disciple.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu kaja èci nèti rae arimatea, ngara na yusuf. nèngu ne dhu nèbhu le madhutu a'aj'a yesus. lod'o mamadhe yesus lèke hari jumat. asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yusuf tenge j'ara ho neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: he went to pilate, and asked ye body of iesus. then pilate commanded ye body to be deliuered.
target_text: hèia la'e asa gubernur pilatus, sèna ka manèngi papuru ngi'u aae yesus. ka gubernur paredha, sèna ka ngi'u aae yesus saraka mi yusuf.

source_text: so ioseph tooke the body, and wrapped it in a cleane linnen cloth,
target_text: ka yusuf la'e asa golgota, hèia na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia na hutu pabe'a-be'a ngi'u aae ne dènge bèla hiu dhu kab'ua.

source_text: and put it in his new tombe, which he had hewen out in a rocke, and rolled a great stone to the doore of the sepulchre, and departed.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu ledhe hadhu, sèna ka tao tèke ro'a hia yusuf dènge a'ari na, ladhe d'ai lod'o rèngu madhe. de yusuf si nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus ne, lasi paj'unu asa ro'a deo na. ka ètu hèb'a ro'a ne, ra saguru dènge hadhu kabela aae cue, ho ra bèdho pabe'a-be'a hèb'a ro'a ne. èle èèna ka yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: and there was marie magdalene, and the other marie sitting ouer against the sepulchre.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. ra madhèdi patangara dènge ro'a ne.

source_text: nowe the next day that followed the preparation of the sabbath, the hie priestes and pharises assembled to pilate,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. hèia kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi lasi paraga dènge gubernur.

source_text: and said, syr, we remember that that deceiuer saide, while he was yet aliue, within three dayes i will rise.
target_text: ra peka, ama. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o dhèu kapod'e-kabèli èèna mamuri era, na peka, na, ‘ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o, ja'a mamuri hari. '

source_text: command therefore, that the sepulchre be made sure vntill the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steale him away, and say vnto the people, he is risen from the dead: so shall the last errour be worse then the first.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama paredha ku sordad'u sèra, ho ra j'aga paie-iie ro'a èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana madhutu na bani boe mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na, sèna ka ra monya peka na, nèngu mamuri hari. te ladhe rèngu kapod'e-kabèli sèmi èèna, risi eele nèti mamonya rèngu uru sèra, lod'o dhu ra peka na, nèngu ne nuka kristus.

source_text: then pilate saide vnto them, ye haue a watch: goe, and make it sure as ye knowe.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa miu dènge dhèu madhenga kahèi. be'a risi miu pua si, ho lasi j'aga paie-iie ro'a nèi.

source_text: and they went, and made the sepulchre sure with the watch, and sealed the stone.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa era èèna, rèti dènge dhèu madhenga ra. d'ai era ne'e, ra segel madhe babèdho ro'a ne. hèia ra pua dhèu sèra madhenga, sèna ka dhèu leo baku mai rare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: now in the end of the sabbath, when the first day of ye weeke began to dawne, marie magdalene, and the other marie came to see the sepulchre,
target_text: ka ètu d'ara hari migu mad'ae aae era, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci, lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: and behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the lord descended from heauen, and came and rolled backe the stone from the doore, and sate vpon it.
target_text: kaca'a la rai opo kapai titu kèna. ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu puru mai nèti sorga, hèia na loli eele hadhu aae dhu saguru ro'a. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha hadhu ne.

source_text: and his countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snowe.
target_text: rèhu ana pajuu ne kale'e sèmi kaha'a bela, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi mèu.

source_text: and for feare of him, the keepers were astonied, and became as dead men.
target_text: dhèu madhenga se, madha'u bia toke ra karèbha, ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto, nuka sèmi dhèu madhe sa.

source_text: but the angel answered, and said to the women, feare ye not: for i know that ye seeke iesus which was crucified:
target_text: hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, lii dènge dhèu bhèni se'e, aku nèngu na, miu baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a miu se mai tenge yesus, dhèu dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: he is not here, for he is risen; as he saide: come, see the place where the lord was laid,
target_text: te ngaa nèngu aad'o heka ètu era ne'e. te na mamuri hari le, sama sèmi dhu na peka le uru èèna. maso mai, sèna ka mèdhi unu mi era dhu ra paj'unu ngi'u aae na. era ne ngaa-ngaa aad'o heka!

source_text: and go quickly, and tel his disciples that he is risen from ye dead: and behold, he goeth before you into galile: there ye shall see him: loe, i haue told you.
target_text: de pamèri lèpa ka! lami lolo dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le. la'e uuru le asa galilea. rèngu hud'i lasi paraga uuru ku dènge ne ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna, na moa mema mi rèngu. parcaya la. lèpa ka, lami lole ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne!

source_text: so they departed quickly from the sepulchre, with feare and great ioye, and did runne to bring his disciples worde.
target_text: hèia bhèni se rai li'u lasi, tèke eele era ne'e. ra madha'u, te ngaa ra karej'e-karae kahèi. ka ra pamèri-mèri lèpa, lasi peka j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra mi ana madhutu yesus.

source_text: and as they wet to tel his disciples, behold, iesus also met the, saying, god saue you. and they came, and tooke him by the feete, and worshipped him.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, kabèdhi la yesus mai paraga dènge ra. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom! ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia lasi padètu-dètu, liku rare haga na, dènge pahaha iisi ra mi yesus.

source_text: then said iesus vnto them, be not afraide. goe, and tell my brethren, that they goe into galile, and there shall they see me.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, peka na, baku madha'u! lami peka dènge ana madhutu ja'a, sèna ka ra lasi mate ja'a ètu galilea nèi.

source_text: nowe when they were gone, beholde, some of the watch came into the citie, and shewed vnto the hie priestes all ye things that were done.
target_text: lod'o dhèu bhèni se ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu madhenga se lèpa le asa kota. rèngu lasi lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i se mi kètu agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and they gathered them together with the elders, and tooke counsell, and gaue large money vnto the souldiers,
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi rare lii èci dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, sèna ka b'ae doi ae-ae mi dhèu j'aga ho ra hutu hèb'a.

source_text: saying, say, his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
target_text: kètu agama yahudi sèra peka, na, ladhe dhèu karèi miu, dhaa sèmi ne'e: d'ara mèda, ropa ji'i bhèj'i luu, nge'a boe, na, ana madhutu na mai mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na.

source_text: and if this matter come before the gouernour to be heard, we will perswade him, and so vse the matter that you shall not neede to care.
target_text: aa ladhe gubernur tadèngi, mage miu madha'u, te ji'i ka dhu ator dènge ne.

source_text: so they tooke the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is noysed among the iewes vnto this day.
target_text: hèia dhèu madhenga se rare doi. aa ra tao madhutu dad'èi kètu agama se'e. nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e dhèu-dhèu yahudi parcaya era lii lolo kapod'e-kabèli ne.

source_text: then ye eleuen disciples wet into galile, into a mountaine, where iesus had appointed the.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii lolo nèti dhèu bhèni se'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci, lasi paraga dènge yesus asa propensi galilea, ètu ledhe èci, madhutu lii moa na.

source_text: and when they sawe him, they worshipped him: but some douted.
target_text: ropa ra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu d'ara ra kajari era.

source_text: and iesus came, and spake vnto them, saying, all power is giuen vnto me, in heauen, and in earth.
target_text: hèia na ara mai padètu-dètu dènge ra, ka na lii, ama lamatua pangèd'u le koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: go therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the father, and the sonne, and the holy ghost,
target_text: de miu lami asa mia-mia, miu hud'i peka-padhai ku dènge dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra, lii lolo be'a ja'a ne. aa miu hud'i aj'a si paie-iie, ho sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a. aa miu hud'i sarani si ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, rèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama, dènge ana, aa dènge roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: teaching them to obserue all things, whatsoeuer i haue commanded you: and lo, i am with you alway, vntill the ende of the worlde, amen.
target_text: aa nori si sèna ka ra tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka tèke le dènge miu. sanèd'e, ee! ja'a bera-bera dènge miu toke èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: the beginning of the gospel of iesus christ, the sonne of god:
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo be'a lula-nèti ana ama lamatua. ngara na yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai. lii lolo na mulai sèmi ne'e:

source_text: as it is written in the prophets, behold, i send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
target_text: lod'o yesus sab'a mèka sasab'a na, ama lamatua pua uru dhèu èci, ngara na yohanis, la'e tao tèke j'ara hia yesus dhu mai bèli-camèd'a. lula uru èèna, ama lamatua peka le dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya. na suri tèke, peka na, nanene! ja'a pua le dhèu èci, ho bhoke j'ara hia èu.

source_text: the voyce of him that cryeth in the wildernesse is, prepare the way of the lord: make his paths straight.
target_text: dhèu èèna la'e asa d'ara mamoo, ho na rodhe, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi tao pabe'a ku j'ara, sèna ka sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru mamai na. '

source_text: iohn did baptize in the wildernesse, and preach the baptisme of amendment of life, for remission of sinnes. and al ye countrey of iudea, and they of hierusalem went out vnto him, and were all baptized of him in the riuer iordan, confessing their sinnes. nowe iohn was clothed with camels heare, and with a girdle of a skinne about his loynes: and he did eate locusts and wilde hony,
target_text: ra pangare dhèu ne'e, yohanis, tuka sarani dhèu. era pea nèngu ètu d'ara mamoo. kodho na tao nèti rèu badha onta, dhara hake na, tao nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a nèngu kabara dènge dhua nasu oni. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti kota yerusalem dènge propensi yudea, mai paraga dènge yohanis ètu era pea na. dhèu se mai neo rèdhi yohanis, aa nanene lii holo-nori na. na peka, hua iia miu ele-ho'a nèti tatao karehe, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna miu sarani uuru ku j'aj'i mi tadha, na, miu be'a le dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e bhoka sasala rèngu, ka yohanis sarani si ètu loko yarden.

source_text: and preached, saying, a stronger then i commeth after me, whose shoes latchet i am not worthy to stoupe downe, and vnloose.
target_text: ka na peka hari, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. lula ja'a ne haha d'ai seli, neo j'aj'i ana pua-paleha èèna ka, lèke boe sa hèi.

source_text: trueth it is, i haue baptized you with water: but he will baptize you with the holy ghost.
target_text: ja'a ne dhodhoka sarani miu dènge èi di, te ngaa nèngu tao risi eele nèti ja'a. te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and it came to passe in those dayes, that iesus came from nazareth, a citie of galile, and was baptized of iohn in iordan.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus la'e nèti rae nasaret ètu rai galilea, ka na paraga dènge yohanis. èle èèna ka yohanis sarani ne ètu loko yarden.

source_text: and assoone as he was come out of the water, iohn saw the heauens clouen in twaine, and the holy ghost descending vpon him like a doue.
target_text: ropa yesus bhodho nèti d'ara èi mai, na ladhe, na, liru bhoke eele, ka roh ama lamatua puru mai sama sèmi koro j'aha ci'u, puru mai asa yesus.

source_text: then there was a voyce from heauen, saying, thou art my beloued sonne, in whome i am well pleased.
target_text: kaca'a la, ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a, èu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and immediatly the spirite driueth him into the wildernesse.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, roh ama lamatua jajuku yesus asa d'ara mamoo la'e.

source_text: and he was there in the wildernesse fourtie daies, and was tempted of satan: hee was also with the wilde beastes, and the angels ministred vnto him.
target_text: na pea dènge badha hui ètu èèna, èpa nguru lod'o. ka dhèu aae nidhu mai dadugu tenge j'ara sèna ka yesus madhutu nèngu, te ngaa tao nare boe. èle èèna ka, ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua puru mai lalau-lalo'o ne.

source_text: now after that iohn was committed to prison, iesus came into galile, preaching the gospel of the kingdome of god,
target_text: lod'o dhu kèpe rare yohanis tuka sarani pamaso asa d'ara bèdho, nèbhu boe ka yesus pakèd'i la'e propensi galilea. la'e lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: and saying, the time is fulfilled, and the kingdome of god is at hand: repent and beleeue the gospel.
target_text: ka na peka, mi nanene! lod'o ama lamatua d'ai kèna! limuri ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ama lamatua nèd'u le paredha karèi nèti uru ka. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i tèke eele ka tatao karehe sèra, ho lèpa madhutu ama lamatua. hèia parcaya ka lii holo-nori nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and as he walked by the sea of galile, he saw simon, and andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishers.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea, ka nèdhi dhèu dua, ngara ra simon dènge ari na anderias. sasab'a rèngu bèli-bèli èèna, j'ala i'a.

source_text: then iesus said vnto them, folow me, and i will make you to be fishers of men.
target_text: ka yesus paroa nare dua ra, peka na, we! mai madhutu ja'a! miu tema tenge i'a, te ngaa ja'a neo aj'a miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu tenge samanga.

source_text: and straightway they forsooke their nets, and folowed him.
target_text: ropa ra nanene rare, hèia ra tèke eele j'ala rèngu, ka lasi dènge madhutu ne.
