target_text: na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! lula miu se d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka paled'a, ho miu me'a tasamia lamatua neo paredha dhèu unu na. te ngaa dhèu leo ro'o boe pare'a dènge dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a-nori si pake lii pakasame di. te dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘rèngu se rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi. '

source_text: the parable is this, the seede is the worde of god.
target_text: hèia yesus peka sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne, aku nèngu na, hini se, nuka lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and they that are beside the way, are they that heare: afterward commeth the deuill, and taketh away the worde out of their hearts, least they should beleeue, and be saued.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare nèti d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu parcaya boe lamatua, aa abhu boe mamuri.

source_text: but they that are on the stones, are they which when they haue heard, receiue ye word with ioy: but they haue no rootes: which for a while beleeue, but in the time of tentation goe away.
target_text: hini dhu lèke dedha hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge d'ara karej'e. te ngaa amo na marèma boe. rèngu parcaya, te ngaa ropa paraga dènge j'aj'èra, rèngu manahu.

source_text: and that which fell among thornes, are they which haue heard, and after their departure are choked with cares and with riches, and voluptuous liuing, and bring forth no fruite.
target_text: hini dhu lèke era aj'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu tadèngi, ka ra sèmi rare lii lolo be'a. te ngaa nare nèbhu boe, ka rèngu bhèlu eele lii lolo be'a, lula rèngu bhute dènge laladhe sasab'a-la'a rèngu, mèdha-panyau rèngu, aa dènge neo mamuri karej'e di. nèti èèna ka, parcaya rèngu dènge boe kab'ua ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but that which fell in good ground, are they which with an honest and good heart heare the worde, and keepe it, and bring forth fruite with patience.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka dhèu dhu mamuri mola dènge d'ara hua iia. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, rèngu sèle asa d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu parcaya taa-taa, aa ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: no man when he hath lighted a candle, couereth it vnder a vessell, neither putteth it vnder the bed, but setteth it on a candlesticke, that they that enter in, may see the light.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, abhu ètu mia, dhèu paheo rare labhu iiki, ho èèna na saguru dènge èru rai. aa abhu ètu mia, dhèu tao labhu ètu ro'a koi. te ladhe tao sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe rèdhi heo na. labhu dhu guna, nuka padhèdi ètu era dedha, sèna ka heo na bisa pasaraa dhèu dhu maso mai.

source_text: for nothing is secret, that shall not be euident: neither any thing hid, that shall not be knowen, and come to light.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a pasabhoka. aa madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu dhèu re'a boe limuri ne, èèna na dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: take heede therefore how ye heare: for whosoeuer hath, to him shall be giuen: and whosoeuer hath not, from him shalbe taken euen that which it seemeth that he hath.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee paie-iie ku j'ara se'e. dhèu dhu neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa rèngu dhu pusi pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, rèngu asa goa.

source_text: then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come neere to him for the preasse.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus bhute dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na mai neo paraga dènge ne. te ngaa ra bisa boe lasi padètu, lula dhèu se, ae titu kèna.

source_text: and it was tolde him by certaine which said, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, and would see thee.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ina dènge ari ama, ètu li'u sèi. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: but he answered, and sayd vnto them, my mother and my brethren are these which heare the worde of god, and doe it.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! te ngaa sèmi ne'e. ina dènge a'ari ja'a, nuka rèngu dhu tare'a-re'a d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu.

source_text: and it came to passe on a certaine day, that he went into a ship with his disciples, and he sayd vnto them, let vs goe ouer vnto the other side of the lake. and they lanched forth.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus gale dhèu pajuu-paleha na, aku nèngu na, mai lati ka asa cabèka dano. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia pakèd'i lasi.

source_text: and as they sayled, he fell a sleepe, and there came downe a storme of winde on the lake, and they were filled with water, and were in ieopardie.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano, yesus bhèj'i. nèbhu boe cag'ag'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha tèb'e koha, hèia èi maso sa d'ara, ka oe molo.

source_text: then they went to him, and awoke him, saying, master, master, we perish. and he arose, and rebuked the winde, and the waues of water: and they ceased, and it was calme.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se parèi ne, peka na, ama! ama! kèd'i ho tolong ku laa! te èdhi madhe aa'i kèna! ka yesus kèd'i. hèia na kai ngèlu dènge naha, peka na, mau ka! kaca'a laa, ngèlu dènge naha mau dènge ka.

source_text: then he sayde vnto them, where is your fayth? and they feared, and wondered among them selues, saying, who is this that commandeth both the windes and water, and they obey him!
target_text: hèia na pasanèd'e ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu parcaya mèka ja'a? rèngu madha'u dènge malaa, ka ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, cee ka yesus ne? tasamia ka nèngu bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka ra madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: so they sailed vnto the region of the gadarenes, which is ouer against galile.
target_text: nèbhu boe rèngu d'ai rai garasa, ètu sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and as he went out to land, there met him a certaine man out of the citie, which had deuils long time, and he ware no garment, neither abode in house, but in the graues. and when he sawe iesus, he cryed out and fell downe before him, and with a loude voyce sayd, what haue i to doe with thee, iesus the sonne of god the most high? i beseech thee torment me not. for he commanded ye foule spirit to come out of the man: for oft times he had caught him: therefore he was bound with chaines, and kept in fetters: but he brake the bands, and was caried of the deuill into wildernesses.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu èci dhu nèbhu ae le, nidhu ae pahuj'u ne. dhèu ne dènge boe èmu, ka na pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. bèli-bèli èèna kako la'e-mai, dhu pake boe mèdha-papake. te nidhu sèra loe boe paredha ne. dhèu dhu èki le pèri-pèri hari dènge rate aa pakanau ne dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na lèku èta si. ka nidhu se laka-seti ne ho la'e asa era dhu kaliu. ropa yesus si puru nèti dedha koha, ka dhèu huj'u ne mai asa yesus. hèia na pa'oo-parodha. ka na pabèbhe iisi, aa na patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga yesus. hèia yesus paredha nidhu sèra, aku nèngu na, ee, nidhu! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e! hèia dhèu huj'u ne pa'oo, peka na, baku gagu ja'a! te ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele! èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: then iesus asked him, saying, what is thy name? and he sayd, legion, because many deuils were entred into him.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? hèia nidhu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, legion, te ji'i se ae, sèmi sordad'u riho-riho. na lii sèmi èèna, lula nidhu se ae-ae dhu maso ètu d'ara ngi'u dhèu èèna.

source_text: and they besought him, that he would not commaund them to goe out into the deepe.
target_text: nidhu se loe boe pamako yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu lasi asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra, nuka era taha koasa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and there was there by, an hearde of many swine, feeding on an hill: and the deuils besought him, that he would suffer them to enter into them. so he suffered them.
target_text: te ngaa dhu padètu ètu èèna, hahi canau kateme dhu nyuu rai ètu sebhe ledhe. ka nidhu se manèngi yesus, peka na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi! hèia yesus d'èi kahèi.

source_text: then went the deuils out of the man, and entred into the swine: and the hearde was caried with violence from a steepe downe place into the lake, and was choked.
target_text: ka nidhu se kalua ka nèti d'ara dhèu mone ne, lasi maso asa hahi. hahi se aa'i-aa'i ra huj'u, ka ra rai paj'ala puru nèti sebhe ledhe ne, hèia caroco asa d'ara dano. aa cène, ka madhe aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: when the heardmen sawe what was done, they fled: and when they were departed, they tolde it in the citie and in the countrey.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenge hahi se, rai lasi palème rae-rae ètu sèra, lolo aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: then they came out to see what was done, and came to iesus, and found the man, out of whom the deuils were departed, sitting at the feete of iesus, clothed, and in his right minde: and they were afrayd.
target_text: ropa dhèu ètu rae se tadèngi lii lolo se, ka lasi ae-ae sèna ka neo rèdhi unu ra tatao dhu j'aj'i le. d'ai era èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi mau-mau padètu ètu haga yesus. nèngu pake le mèdha-papake, aa na huj'u heka. ladhe rèdhi sèmi ne'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i madha'u.

source_text: they also which saw it, tolde them by what meanes he that was possessed with the deuill, was healed.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, ra palolo dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu heka mai sèra, tasamia ka dhèu huj'u ne èle nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: then the whole multitude of the countrey about the gadarenes, besought him that he would depart from them: for they were taken with a great feare: and he went into the ship, and returned.
target_text: ka dhèu garasa aa'i-aa'i ra manèngi yesus ho tèke eele rai rèngu, te rèngu madha'u titu kèna. hèia yesus si ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, sèna ka lèpa hari asa cabèka dano galilea.

source_text: then the man, out of whome the deuils were departed, besought him that hee might be with him: but iesus sent him away, saying,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu deo na dhu nidhu tao, loe boe pamako yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! hud'i laa ja'a madhutu ama kahèi! te ngaa yesus dhaa ne, peka na,

source_text: returne into thine owne house, and shewe what great things god hath done to thee. so hee went his way, and preached throughout all the citie, what great things iesus had done vnto him.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ku laa! be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa a'ari èu. lamu lolo aa'i dènge ra, na, ama lamatua tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èu. hèia dhèu ne kako palème d'ara kota ne, na palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, yesus ka dhu pa'èle nèngu.

source_text: and it came to passe, when iesus was come againe, that the people receiued him: for they all waited for him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano galilea. lod'o rèngu puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae dhu mate mema le yesus. dhèu se mai ae-ae ho soru ne.

source_text: and beholde, there came a man named iairus, and he was the ruler of the synagogue, who fell downe at iesus feete, and besought him that he would come into his house. for he had but a daughter onely, about twelue yeeres of age, and she lay a dying and as he went, the people thronged him.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu ca dhèu, ngara na yairus. nèngu kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. ana na dhoka ca dhèu di; ana bhèni, umur na canguru dua tèu. ana bhèni ne dhu pèd'a aae, oe madhe. ropa yairus nèdhi yesus mai, hèia la'e patitu kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus. na manèngi ho yesus dhuli èmu na, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ana na. dhaa nare ka, yesus madhutu dènge ne asa èmu na. aa dhèu ae madhutu rèngu. ka rèngu paseti èci dènge èci.

source_text: and a woman hauing an yssue of blood, twelue yeeres long, which had spent all her substance vpon physicians, and could not be healed of any:
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kako dènge rèngu. bhèni ne dhu lèke papèd'a dhèu bhèni dhu loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna. doi-dhari dènge mèdha-panyau na èle aa'i le, ho b'ae dote-matarii. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa puri-pa'èle ne. papèd'a na asa na hoe.

source_text: when she came behind him, she touched the hemme of his garment, and immediatly her yssue of blood stanched.
target_text: ka na ara padètu-dètu asa yesus nèti kabodho. hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus. ropa na gai lèke kodho yesus ne, hèia papèd'a na èle dènge ka.

source_text: then iesus sayd, who is it that hath touched me? when euery man denied, peter sayd and they that were with him, master, the multitude thrust thee, and tread on thee, and sayest thou, who hath touched me?
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, yesus titu taha. hèia na karèi, peka na, cee ka dhu goi lèke ja'a? te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mangaku. ka petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! dhèu ae-ae ka dhu tao paseti aa patule-pajuku nèti kabodho. sèmi ne'e ne, te'a na cee ka dhu goi lèke ama!

source_text: and iesus sayde, some one hath touched me: for i perceiue that vertue is gone out of me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, aad'o! deo na ja'a rasa abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti ngi'u ja'a. de ja'a ke'a, na, ca dhèu dhu sangaja gai ja'a.

source_text: when the woman sawe that she was not hid, she came trembling, and fell downe before him, and tolde him before all the people, for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediatly.
target_text: ropa bhèni ne ne'a, na, nèngu bisa boe pasili, hèia na madha'u titu kèna. isi na rèbha-rèbha, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na lolo mi dhèu ae sèra, nga tao ka nèngu gai yesus. aa na lolo kahèi, na, ropa nèngu gai lèke yesus, nèngu èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and he said vnto her, daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath saued thee: go in peace.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, ana hèni! èu èle nèti papèd'a, lula èu parcaya ja'a. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: while he yet spake, there came one from the ruler of the synagogues house, which sayde to him, thy daughter is dead: disease not the master.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge bhèni ne, ca dhèu nèti yairus mai peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ana ama aad'o heka. na madhe le, de paj'èra ia ka ama mese.

source_text: when iesus heard it, he answered him, saying, feare not: beleeue onely, and she shall be saued.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii peka dhèu èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge yairus, mau-mau! baku madha'u! parcaya mi ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia mamuri mi ana èu.

source_text: and when he went into the house, he suffered no man to goe in with him, saue peter, and iames, and iohn, and the father and mother of the maide. and all wept, and sorowed for her: but he sayd, weepe not: for she is not dead, but sleepeth. and they laught him to scorne, knowing that she was dead.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai èmu yairus, dhèu ae le. ra tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ae eele ka tangi laa! ana ne madhe boe. dhoka na bhèj'i di! te ngaa dhèu se pahae boe, ra mari pakapengo hèb'a, te rèngu rèdhi unu ra ana ne ma'ète a'ae. hèia yesus manèngi sèna ka ina-ama nèti ana bhèni ne, petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis maso lasi palere-lere dènge ne. dhèu leo sèra, na hia si mate ètu li'u.

source_text: so he thrust them all out, and tooke her by the hand, and cryed, saying, maide, arise.
target_text: rare d'ara, ka yesus kèpe ai ana ne, hèia na paroa peka na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and her spirite came againe, and she rose straightway: and he comanded to giue her meate.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana ne mamuri hari, ka na kèd'i titu. hèia yesus lii dènge ina ana bhèni ne, na, hia ana ne na'a!

source_text: then her parents were astonied: but hee commanded them that they should tell no man what was done.
target_text: ina-ama ana ne malaa-maloha. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, baku palolo dènge dhèu, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: then called hee his twelue disciples together, and gaue them power and authoritie ouer all deuils, and to heale diseases.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus pakaboko nare ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra. ka na hia si koasa, ho babège eele nidhu, aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a.

source_text: and hee sent them foorth to preach the kingdome of god, and to cure the sicke.
target_text: na pua si lasi lole j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua, aa puri-pa'èle papèd'a dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and he sayd to them, take nothing to your iourney, neither staues, nor scrip, neither bread, nor siluer, neither haue two coates apiece.
target_text: te ngaa na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie-iie! baku mèti kahèi ngaa-ngaa ètu j'ara. kako dhoka dènge kodho ètu ua di. baku mèti kodho silu. baku mèti kahèi tatea, tas, gee j'ara, do doi-dhari!

source_text: and whatsoeuer house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka d'ara rae èci, abhu dhèu dhu soru miu, na lami pea dènge ne. mage mi hag'e-hag'e èmu kahèi. pea taruu ètu d'ara èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i, tèke eele rae èèna.

source_text: and howe many so euer will not receiue you, when ye goe out of that citie, shake off the very dust from your feete for a testimonie against them.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, hèia dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra ro'o boe sèmi miu, aa ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, na, pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. lod'o miu tèke eele rae èèna, tao madhutu ad'a ho caro eele ahu nèti haga miu. aa mi peka dènge ra, ‘miu se ladhe mo'o boe nanene lii ji'i, pe miu sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and they went out, and went through euery towne preaching the gospel, and healing euery where.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu se lasi ka asa rae-rae. ra lole dènge dhèu-dhèu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. aa puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a ètu mia-mia.

source_text: nowe herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he douted, because that it was sayd of some, that iohn was risen againe from the dead:
target_text: ca tèka, rupa-rupa lii lolo lula-nèti yesus ne d'ai le dhèu aae herodes antipas. ropa na tadèngi lii lolo se, hèia na bingu, lula dhèu cahag'e peka na, yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu mamuri hari le.

source_text: and of some, that elias had appeared: and of some, that one of the olde prophets was risen againe.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari peka na, nèngu ne, baki elia dhu mamuri hari. abhu dhu leo hari, peka na, nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu uru-uru sèra.

source_text: then herod sayd, iohn haue i beheaded: who then is this of whome i heare such things? and he desired to see him.
target_text: te ngaa herodes sanèd'e era, peka na, ca hari ni, ja'a pua le poro pama'ète kètu yohanis. de na mamuri hari, do? aa ca dhèu ne, cee hari? ka na tenge j'ara, sèna ka patoo madha dènge yesus.

source_text: and when the apostles returned, they tolde him what great things they had done. then he tooke them to him, and went aside into a solitarie place, neere to the citie called bethsaida.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu dhu yesus pua sèra, lèpa mai pa'èci hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge ne aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu tao. ka yesus si kako mesa-mesa ra asa era èci, dhu padètu dènge rae betsaida, ho ra ae ètu èèna.

source_text: but when the people knewe it, they followed him: and he receiued them, and spake vnto them of the kingdome of god, and healed them that had neede to be healed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu re'a rare, na, yesus si neo lasi sa mia, ka ra paki'u re limuri. yesus sèmi si, hèia na pa'èle dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i, aa na peka-padhai dènge ra, j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua nèd'u paredha.

source_text: and when the day began to weare away, the twelue came, and sayd vnto him, sende the people away, that they may goe into the townes and villages round about, and lodge, and get meate: for we are here in a desart place.
target_text: ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, ka canguru dua ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka dènge ne, be'a risi ama pua dhèu se'e lasi asa rae-rae dhu padètu dènge era ne'e, sèna ka ra tenge nganga'a unu ra. aa hud'i laa ra lasi tenge era ho j'unu taha. te era dhu kaj'èu nèti rae sèmi ne'e, tasamia ka rèngu bisa abhu ra'a-rinu?

source_text: but he sayd vnto them, giue ye them to eate. and they sayd, we haue no more but fiue loaues and two fishes, except we should go and buy meate for all this people. for they were about fiue thousand men. then he sayde to his disciples, cause them to sit downe by fifties in a company.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, sèmi ne'e! miu ka dhu panga'a si! hèia ana madhutu se dhaa, peka na, ira ii! ama, ee! tasamia bisa sèmi èèna? dhèu se risi nèti lèmi riho dhèu! èèna dhèu mone di, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana niki! ètu d'ara adhe-aai ji'i, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di. ladhe ama neo sèna ka ji'i panga'e dhèu se'e, tasa mera mia ho ji'i hèli nganga'a ae-ae hia ra? ! ka yesus dhaa, pakaboko si madhèdi lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru dhèu, ca kaboko.

source_text: and they did so, and caused all to sit downe.
target_text: hèia lasi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: then he tooke the fiue loaues, and the two fishes, and looked vp to heauen, and blessed them, and brake, and gaue to the disciples, to set before the people.
target_text: ropa dhèu se madhèdi, ka yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. ka na tangara sa dedha, ho na manèngi makasi. èle ka yesus pamae roti dènge i'a sèra. hèia na j'ole sa ana-ana madhutu na, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu sèra.

source_text: so they did all eate, and were satisfied: and there was taken vp of that remained to them, twelue baskets full of broken meate.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a toke bècu. ka nganga'a dhu risi sèra, kaboko rare pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and it came to passe, as hee was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, whom say the people that i am?
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e mesa na ho sabaj'a ètu era èci. hèia ana madhutu na mai ka pa'èci dènge ne. sabaj'a nare, ka yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu tadèngi-tadèngi dhèu palolo na ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: they answered, and sayd, iohn baptist: and others say, elias: and some say, that one of the olde prophets is risen againe.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, cahag'e peka na, yohanis tuka sarani. aa cahag'e peka na, baki elia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra dhu mamuri hari.

source_text: and he sayd vnto them, but whom say ye that i am? peter answered, and sayd, that christ of god.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari si, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, ja'a ne, cee? ka petrus dhaa, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: and he warned and commanded them, that they should tell that to no man,
target_text: èle ka yesus kai si, sèna ka baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa, peka na, nèngu na, kristus.

source_text: saying, the sonne of man must suffer many things and be reproued of the elders, and of the hie priests and scribes, and be slaine, and the third day rise againe.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i pasae ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra dhu bia. bèli-camèd'a dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra, ro'o boe sèmi, ladhe peka, na, ja'a ne kristus. aa èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a. mema tare'a-re'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari!

source_text: and he sayd to them all, if any man will come after me, let him denie himselfe, and take vp his crosse dayly, and follow me.
target_text: èle ka na peka dènge dhèu ae se, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu dènge d'ara kateme ètu lod'o bèli-lod'o bèli. nèngu hud'i core eele ku dad'èi d'ara na. nèngu hud'i madhutu taruu, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whosoeuer will saue his life, shall lose it: and whosoeuer shall lose his life for my sake, the same shall saue it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu unu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pakaj'èu-j'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for what auantageth it a man, if he win the whole worlde, and destroy himselfe, or lose himselfe?
target_text: ladhe dhèu unu aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua tule eele ne, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for whosoeuer shall be ashamed of me, and of my wordes, of him shall the sonne of man be ashamed, when hee shall come in his glorie, and in the glorie of the father, and of the holy angels.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. de dhèu dhu makae madhutu ja'a, aa makae sèmi lii aj'a ja'a, ja'a kahèi makae mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua, lod'o ja'a lèpa mai nèti sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana-ana pajuu na nèti sorga.

source_text: and i tell you of a suretie, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they haue seene the kingdome of god.
target_text: ja'a peka patare'a dènge miu. abhu pèri-pèri nèti miu ètu se'e se, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi unu ra lamatua nèd'u paredha, heka ra madhe kèna.

source_text: and it came to passe about an eyght dayes after those wordes, that he tooke peter and iohn, and iames, and went vp into a mountaine to pray.
target_text: èle aru lod'o, ka yesus nèti petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi ca'e asa ledhe èci, ho neo sabaj'a.

source_text: and as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was changed, and his garment was white and glistered.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a era, rèhu na j'aj'i leko-leo, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and beholde, two men talked with him, which were moses and elias:
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua cèu mai. dhèu se, nuka baki musa dènge baki elia. ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: which appeared in glory, and tolde of his departing, which he shoulde accomplish at hierusalem.
target_text: dua ra ladhe na le'e-le'e hèti-hèti. tèlu ra padhue-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe yesus bèli-camèd'a ètu yerusalem.

source_text: but peter and they that were with him, were heauie with sleepe, and when they awoke, they saw his glorie, and the two men standing with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus dènge angalai na dhèu dua sèra musi madha sakaa titu kèna, ka ra bhèj'i luu. ropa ra kabèdhi, hèia rèdhi yesus titu dènge dhèu dua. aa rèdhi yesus dhu kaha'a kahèi.

source_text: and it came to passe, as they departed from him, peter said vnto iesus, master, it is good for vs to be here: let vs therefore make three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for moses, and one for elias, and wist not what he said.
target_text: ropa musa dènge elia neo lèpa, petrus bingu, ne'a heka tao tasamia. ka na padhai lii leli, na peka na, ama! ji'i ètu ne'e, be'a d'ai seli! de hua iia ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia baki musa, aa cue hari hia baki elia.

source_text: whiles he thus spake, there came a cloude and ouershadowed them, and they feared when they were entring into the cloude.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus padhai lii era, ra'i-liru puru mai, ka saguru rare rèngu. hèia petrus si madha'u bia.

source_text: and there came a voyce out of the cloud, saying, this is that my beloued sonne, heare him.
target_text: ka ra tadèngi lii nèti d'ara ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, ne'e ne, ana ja'a dhu ja'a hag'e kore le! ladhe na padhai lii, nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and when the voyce was past, iesus was found alone: and they kept it close, and tolde no man in those dayes any of those things which they had seene.
target_text: ropa lii na èle, petrus si ladhe rèdhi dhoka yesus mesa-mesa na. rèngu tèlu ra, peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa, ngaa dhu rèngu rèdhi le. d'ai nèbhu ku, heka ra palolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and it came to passe on the next day, as they came downe from the mountaine, much people met him.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lod'o yesus dènge petrus si puru mai nèti ledhe, dhèu ae mai paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and beholde, a man of the companie cried out, saying, master, i beseech thee, beholde my sonne: for he is all that i haue.
target_text: ka dhèu èci rodhe ne, peka na, ama mese! ladhe ku ana mone ja'a ca dhèu ne laa!

source_text: and loe, a spirit taketh him, and suddenly he crieth, and he teareth him, that he fometh, and hardly departeth from him, when he hath bruised him.
target_text: te abhu nidhu dhu loe boe kèpe ne, ka na pakèce sahèka, aa nyanyoko ne, toke hèb'a na horo karaka. nidhu ne loe boe dhadhedhe ana ne, aa d'èi boe hia ana ne ae nare ciki sa.

source_text: nowe i haue besought thy disciples to cast him out, but they could not.
target_text: ja'a manèngi le kahèi ana madhutu ama se ho ra babège eele nidhu ne, te ngaa tao rare boe!

source_text: then iesus answered, and said, o generation faithlesse, and crooked, howe long now shall i be with you, and suffer you? bring thy sonne hither.
target_text: ka yesus jèke si, peka na, eeh! miu se parcaya boe, na, lamatua bisa pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a ra. miu mema dhèu dhu me'a boe mamuri madhutu j'ara mola! de ja'a hud'i tatae hari miu toke pèri lod'o? hèia na peka dènge ama ana ne, mèti ana mu sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and whiles he was yet comming, the deuill rent him, and tare him: and iesus rebuked the vncleane spirite, and healed the childe, and deliuered him to his father.
target_text: ropa pakako rèti ana ne asa yesus, hèia nidhu hake pabèbhe, aa rarumu ne. te ngaa yesus paredha nidhu ho kalua tèke eele ana ne, hèia na èle dènge. ka yesus hia ana ne asa ama na la'e.

source_text: and they were all amased at the mightie power of god: and while they all wondered at al things, which iesus did, he said vnto his disciples,
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra dhu ladhe rèdhi koasa yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. ropa dhèu se padhue era tadha malaa dhu yesus tao, nèngu lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: marke these wordes diligently: for it shall come to passe, that the sonne of man shalbe deliuered into the handes of men.
target_text: miu patadhe paie lii padhai ja'a ne! nèbhu boe dhèu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu leo.

source_text: but they vnderstood not that word: for it was hid from them, so that they could not perceiue it: and they feared to aske him of that worde.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na se bingu. masi ka rèngu dhane rare boe sasoa na, te ngaa ra madha'u karèi ne, sasoa na ngaa.

source_text: then there arose a disputation among them, which of them should be the greatest.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu yesus pasisu lula-nèti rèngu se, cee ka dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu re madha.

source_text: when iesus sawe the thoughtes of their heartes, he tooke a litle childe, and set him by him,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu rèngu pasisu. ka na paroa nare ana iiki ca dhèu, hèia na patitu ètu karasa na.

source_text: and said vnto them, whosoeuer receiueth this litle childe in my name, receiueth me: and whosoeuer shall receiue me, receiueth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, he shall be great.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, nanene paie! dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na ladhe-leru dhèu haha, dhu sama sèmi ana iiki ne, sasoa na nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi. aa na ladhe-leru kahèi ama ku ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu dhèu ae dhu pusi-pahae boe dhèu sèmi se'e se. dhèu se'e, nuka: dhu unu aad'o, dhu susa, dhu laku-laku boe, dhu kalua aapa, aa dènge dhèu haha. de dhèu dhu d'èi lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi se'e se, madhutu ama lamatua, nèngu ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and iohn answered and saide, master, we sawe one casting out deuils in thy name, and we forbad him, because he followeth thee not with vs.
target_text: hèia yohanis peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! ca lod'o ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu babège eele nidhu, dènge ale kolongara ama. ka ji'i kai ne, sèna ka na ale ia ka ngara ama, lula nèngu ne dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: then iesus saide vnto him, forbid ye him not: for he that is not against vs, is with vs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, baku! te dhèu dhu lab'a boe èdhi, nèngu èèna angalai èdhi.

source_text: and it came to passe, when the dayes were accomplished, that he should be receiued vp, he setled himselfe fully to goe to hierusalem,
target_text: yesus ne'a le lod'o na ca'e asa sorga dètu le. ka na pama'ète nare, ho la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and sent messengers before him: and they went and entred into a towne of the samaritans, to prepare him lodging.
target_text: na pua dhèu lasi uuru, sèna ka ra lalau nganga'a-nganginu. ka dhèu lasi uuru se, maso lasi asa d'ara rae cue ètu propensi samaria, ho lalau mema era rèngu manubha.

source_text: but they woulde not receiue him, because his behauiour was, as though he would go to hierusalem.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ètu samaria se, ro'o boe sèmi rare yesus si, lula nèngu neo la'e sogo-tagu ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and when his disciples, iames and iohn sawe it, they saide, lord, wilt thou that we commaund, that fire come downe from heauen, and consume them, euen as elias did?
target_text: ropa yakobis dènge yohanis tadèngi lii ne'e, ka ra pamako yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! tasamia na ti manèngi ama lamatua papuru ai mai nèti dedha-liru, ho tunu pakèpu si?

source_text: but iesus turned about, and rebuked them, and said, ye knowe not of what spirit ye are.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe asa dua ra, hèia na kai si, peka na, baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: for the sonne of man is not come to destroy mens liues, but to saue them. then they went to another towne.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lasi hari asa rae leo.

source_text: and it came to passe that as they went in the way, a certaine man said vnto him, i will follow thee, lord, whithersoeuer thou goest.
target_text: ropa rèngu kako era, dhèu èci lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama! ama neo asa mia èèna ka, ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu!

source_text: and iesus saide vnto him, the foxes haue holes, and the birdes of the heauen nestes, but the sonne of man hath not whereon to lay his head.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa pangee ku laa. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dènge era pea-palu'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge badha-manu. busa hui lèpa la'e asa d'ara ro'a na. manu-bhui lasi asa d'ara rèd'a ra. te ngaa ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, dènge boe era pea-palu'u ho pasoru iisi ja'a ne. era lalaka kètu, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: but he said vnto another, followe me. and the same said, lord, suffer me first to goe and burie my father.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ca dhèu, ka na peka, mai madhutu ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi, do! te ngaa sèmi ne'e, ama. hud'i ja'a lèpa ku ladhe-leru ina-ama ja'a. ladhe padhane kore ama ku, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: and iesus said vnto him, let the dead burie their dead: but go thou, and preache the kingdome of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, uri dhèu rèngu dhu madhe. te ngaa miu dhu lèka lamatua, sasab'a miu lami peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: then another saide, i will follow thee, lord: but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at mine house.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo dhu peka na, be'a kahèi. ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu. te ngaa hud'i ja'a laku palangu ku lii dènge a'ari ja'a, heka ja'a mai madhutu ama.

source_text: and iesus saide vnto him, no man that putteth his hand to the plough, and looketh backe, is apt to the kingdome of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. ladhe dhèu neo pare rai, te ngaa tao hari ngaa-ngaa dhu leo, toke bhèlu sèle, tatu oka na j'aj'i boe. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu pama'ète nare le neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa pangee taruu mamuri na lod'o dhu uru sèra. dhèu sèmi èèna gaguna na aad'o j'aj'i dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: after these thinges, the lord appointed other seuentie also, and sent them, two and two before him into euery citie and place, whither he himselfe should come.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus hag'e nare ana madhutu na dhu leo, pidhu nguru dua dhèu. ka na hag'e si, dua-dua dhèu, sèna ka lasi uuru asa era-era dhu nèngu neo la'e.

source_text: and he said vnto them, the haruest is great, but the labourers are fewe: pray therefore the lord of the haruest to sende foorth labourers into his haruest.
target_text: hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, abhu dhèu ae dhu nuka sèmi are dhu karara le. ka lamatua oka pua dhèu sab'a na lasi g'ètu are se. de miu hud'i sabaj'a, sèna ka ama lamatua hia tabha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ho oru rare dhèu-dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. lula dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, ae. te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: goe your wayes: beholde, i send you foorth as lambes among wolues.
target_text: de lami ka! ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu ae. te ngaa sanèd'e sèmi ne'e. miu èci èèna ka dènge ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu lami asa talora aae busa hui dhu bhelu.

source_text: beare no bagge, neither scrippe, nor shoes, and salute no man by the way.
target_text: miu baku mèti doi-dhari, tas tao mèdha-papake, do salapa dhu risi ètu d'ara kakako miu. mage core eele ai lod'o dènge padhai lii iia d'ara dènge dhèu ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: and into whatsoeuer house ye enter, first say, peace be to this house. and if the sonne of peace be there, your peace shall rest vpon him: if not, it shall turne to you againe. and in that house tary still, eating and drinking such things as by them shall be set before you: for the labourer is worthy of his wages. goe not from house to house. but into whatsoeuer citie ye shall enter, if they receiue you, eate such things as are set before you,
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, miu baku pidha-pidha era pea. ladhe dhèu sèmi rare miu dènge be'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, pea dhoka ètu èèna toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, miu hud'i manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu isi èmu èèna. ladhe lamatua èmu ètu sèra sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, tatu lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi isi èmu èèna. te ngaa ladhe ro'o boe sèmi miu, na, hud'i laa lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu mesa mi. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, do, asa rae èci, ra hia miu nganga'a, mi'a-minu laa dènge karej'e. te ra hia èèna pamèci dènge èi kabhèsu miu dhu hae.

source_text: and heale the sicke that are there, and say vnto them, the kingdome of god is come neere vnto you.
target_text: puri-pa'èle dhèu rèngu dhu pèd'a. aa peka-padhai dènge dhèu sèra, na, ‘paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le! '

source_text: but into whatsoeuer citie ye shall enter, if they will not receiue you, goe your wayes out into the streetes of the same, and say,
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi rae dhu dhèu ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu. ladhe ra tao miu sèmi èèna, na, lami titu asa j'ara-j'ara ètu d'ara rae èèna, mi lii dènge ra, peka na,

source_text: euen the very dust, which cleaueth on vs of your citie, we wipe off against you: notwithstanding knowe this, that the kingdome of god was come neere vnto you.
target_text: ‘nanene paie! miu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara rae ne. ji'i mai le ngèti lii lolo be'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe. de ji'i caro eele ahu rae ne'e nèti haga ji'i, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, pe bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie! paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. '

source_text: for i say to you, that it shall be easier in that day for them of sodom, then for that citie.
target_text: miu me'a, sina ma, bhabhelu dhèu kota sodom? ja'a pasanèd'e miu! bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, bia risi nèti dhèu sodom!

source_text: woe be to thee, chorazin: woe be to thee, beth-saida: for if the miracles had bene done in tyrus and sidon, which haue bene done in you, they had a great while agone repented, sitting in sackecloth and ashes.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mate unu miu dhu pea ètu rae korasin dènge miu ètu rae betsaida! miu dui mere j'aj'èra! ja'a tao tadha-tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya lamatua. ngaa hari miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe ne. ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa se, dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu, lèke ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e dhèu sèra ele-ho'a le, aa ra tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, ho mai madhutu lamatua. aa rèngu tatu pake le mèdha sasusa, dènge tao ahu ètu kètu ra j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra, dhèu yahudi boe. de ra peka boe, na, rèngu dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua.

source_text: therefore it shall be easier for tyrus, and sidon, at the iudgement, then for you.
target_text: tare'a! miu ladhe ku laa! bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku nèti lamatua mi dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and thou, capernaum, which art exalted to heauen, shalt be thrust downe to hell.
target_text: mata unu miu, kabarai kapernaum! miu baku pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua nedhe miu pamaso asa d'ara sorga. aad'o! mola-mèu èi! èèna na lamatua pèci miu asa d'ara naraka lami!

source_text: he that heareth you, heareth me: and he that despiseth you, despiseth me: and he that despiseth me, despiseth him that sent me.
target_text: sanèd'e pabe'a-be'a. dhèu dhu nanene lii miu, nuka sèmi rèngu nanene ja'a. aa dhèu dhu pusi boe nanene miu, èci èèna ka ra pahae boe ja'a. aa dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene ja'a, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and the seuentie turned againe with ioy, saying, lord, euen the deuils are subdued to vs through thy name.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu pidhu nguru dua sèra lèpa hari mai, d'ara ra karej'e bia. ka ra lole dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ira ii! kakako ji'i ne, be'a bia! ropa ji'i pake kolongara ama ho babège eele nidhu, na, nidhu sèra nanene lii ji'i, hèia ra rai bhalèta.

source_text: and he said vnto them, i sawe satan, like lightening, fall downe from heauen.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, mema tare'a! lod'o miu tao sèra sa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ama lamatua pèci eele nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra nèti dedha-liru nèi, nuka sèmi bela dhu kaha'a nèti haa, nèti dhimu!

source_text: beholde, i giue vnto you power to treade on serpents, and scorpions, and ouer all the power of the enemie, and nothing shall hurt you.
target_text: sanèd'e! dhèu aae nidhu èèna, musu èdhi. aa nèngu dènge koasa kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pangèd'u le miu koasa, ho palaho koasa na. ladhe miu j'èli lèke kaisao, do karaka rai, miu ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ngaa èci sa bisa boe paj'èra miu.

source_text: neuerthelesse, in this reioyce not, that the spirits are subdued vnto you: but rather reioyce, because your names are written in heauen.
target_text: miu karej'e lula nidhu nanene miu. be'a kahèi, te ngaa sèra sa ana iiki era! dhu be'a risi, d'ara miu karej'e, lula lamatua suri nare le ngara miu, j'aj'i ana kabarai na ètu sorga.

source_text: that same houre reioyced iesus in the spirit, and said, i confesse vnto thee, father, lord of heauen and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and vnderstanding, and hast reueiled them to babes: euen so, father, because it so pleased thee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci tao d'ara yesus karej'e-karae. hèia na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pa'abhe j'ara-j'ara se'e nèti dhèu dhu tao iisi d'èlu-mèu dènge dhèu lela dedha. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele aa'i-aa'i se hia mi ana iiki-ana iiki dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi. tare'a ama! lula èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things are giuen me of my father: and no man knoweth who the sonne is, but the father: neither who the father is, saue the sonne, and he to whom the sonne will reueile him.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene paie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le koasa mi ja'a. dhu tadhe mèu, ja'a ne cee, dhoka ama di. aa dhu tadhe mèu, ama èèna cee, dhoka ana nèti ama di, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka nori si, ho ra tadhe mèu nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and he turned to his disciples, and said secretly, blessed are the eyes, which see that ye see.
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na peka dènge rèngu mesa ra, aku nèngu na, miu se oto titu kèna, lula mèdhi le koasa lamatua.

source_text: for i tell you that many prophets and kings haue desired to see those things, which ye see, and haue not seene them: and to heare those things which ye heare, and haue not heard them.
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra, d'èi titu kèna neo rèdhi ngaa dhu miu limuri ne mèdhi, te ngaa rèdhi boe. rèngu d'èi kahèi neo tadèngi ngaa dhu miu nanene ne, te ngaa ra tadèngi rèdhi boe.

source_text: then beholde, a certaine lawyer stoode vp, and tempted him, saying, master, what shall i doe, to inherite eternall life?
target_text: ca tèka, ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi, titu ho neo sèku pamanahu yesus. na karèi peka na, ama mese! mu peka ku laa! ja'a ad'u j'ara sèmi ngaa, sèna ka ja'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga?

source_text: and he saide vnto him, what is written in the lawe? howe readest thou?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, aku nèngu na, musa suri tasamia lula-nèti j'ara ne'e ne? aa madhutu mame'a èu, tasamia?

source_text: and he answered, and saide, thou shalt loue thy lord god with all thine heart, and with all thy soule, and with all thy strength, and with all thy thought, and thy neighbour as thy selfe.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa peka na, na suri sèmi ne'e ka: ‘èu hud'i sue ku ama lamatua, risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu hud'i d'èi nèngu titu kèna, sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa tadhe mèu ne. ' dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: then he said vnto him, thou hast answered right: this doe, and thou shalt liue.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, dhu lèke kèna! ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi sèra, na, èu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but he willing to iustifie himselfe, said vnto iesus, who is then my neighbour?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ne, tao iisi na sèmi dhèu mola sa. ka na karèi hari yesus, aku nèngu na, te ngaa, ‘dhèu ja'a' èèna, ka cee?

source_text: and iesus answered, and saide, a certaine man went downe from hierusalem to iericho, and fell among theeues, and they robbed him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leauing him halfe dead.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo lolo dènge èu lii pakasame èci. pe èu mesa mu ka dhu peka, na, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu èu'. lii pakasame ne, sèmi ne'e ka: ca lod'o, abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu pakèd'i nèti kota yerusalem, puru la'e asa kota jeriko. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa parapo mai game paroe ne. ra game, aa parame rare aa'i doi-dhari dènge mèdha-papake dhèu ne. ka parapo se core ne asa sebhe j'ara la'e, aa ra rai tèke eele ne. dhèu ne, oe madhe.

source_text: nowe so it fell out, that there came downe a certaine priest that same way, and when he sawe him, he passed by on the other side.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe, ka ama agama yahudi ca dhèu puru mai re j'ara èèna. te ngaa ropa na ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne dhu diu raa, aa dhu tarenga ètu sebhe j'ara, ama agama ne titu boe sa hèi, ho uri dhèu ne. na kako paseli eele dhèu ne'e, la'e asa cabèka j'ara, ka na taruu.

source_text: and likewise also a leuite, when he was come neere to the place, went and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo hari èci kako re èèna. nèngu ne nèti suku lewi dhu tema sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ropa nèdhi dhèu ne dhu baa-baa ètu sebhe j'ara, hèia la'e padètu-dètu ho ladhe, te ngaa na bara boe ne kahèi. na sigo eele j'ara, ka la'e taruu.

source_text: then a certaine samaritane, as he iourneyed, came neere vnto him, and when he sawe him, he had compassion on him, and went to him, and bound vp his wounds, and powred in oyle and wine, and put him on his owne beast, and brought him to an inne, and made prouision for him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci nèti rai samaria mai re j'ara èèna dènge badha keled'ei na. dhèu yahudi pahae boe dhèu samaria. te ngaa ropa dhèu samaria ne nèdhi dhèu dhu lèke rapo èèna, ka d'ara na mèke boe. na mai padètu-dètu ho neo sarad'e ne. ka pamèu nu'a dhèu ne dènge èi anggor, hèia na pana'i dènge èi mènyi. aa na parbaan nu'a na, èle ka na paca'e asa keled'ei na. hèia nèti ne la'e asa d'ara kota. na pamaso ne asa d'ara losmen, aa lalau pabe'a-be'a ne.

source_text: and on the morowe when he departed, he tooke out two pence, and gaue them to the hoste, and said vnto him, take care of him, and whatsoeuer thou spendest more, when i come againe, i will recompense thee.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu ne la'e b'ae uuru kètu, doi iia dua bua mi lamatua losmen ne, ka na peka, ‘pake uuru doi ne ho lalau dhèu ne toke èle. ladhe d'ai boe, pake uuru doi èu. pe ja'a lèpa, pula hari doi sèra. '

source_text: which nowe of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour vnto him that fell among the theeues?
target_text: lii pakasame yesus ne d'ai sange ne'e ka. hèia yesus karèi mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu èu, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu nèngu, ' mi dhèu dhu lèke rapo ne?

source_text: and he saide, he that shewed mercie on him. then said iesus vnto him, goe, and do thou likewise.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu lalau ne toke èle. hèia yesus lii, peka na, tare'a! de lamu ka, tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: nowe it came to passe, as they went, that he entred into a certaine towne, and a certaine woman named martha, receiued him into her house. and she had a sister called marie, which also sate at iesus feete, and heard his preaching. but martha was combred about much seruing, and came to him, and saide, master, doest thou not care that my sister hath left me to serue alone? bid her therefore, that she helpe me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi taruu asa yerusalem. hèia ra dhuli ètu rae èci. ètu era ne'e, dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari, ngara ra, marta dènge maria. marta manèngi ho yesus si manubha ètu èmu rèngu. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna. ropa yesus madhèdi ho aj'a si, marta bhute dènge pananasu. te ngaa ari na maria, madhèdi padètu-dètu haga yesus, ho nanene lii padhai na. nèbhu boe ka marta mai ka'ugu ètu madha yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! tasamia, ee? ja'a d'ai madhe lalau nganga'a-nganginu mesa-mesa ku, te ngaa ari ja'a madhèdi mau-mau. peka ku dènge ne laa, sèna ka mai bara ja'a ètu dapu ne.

source_text: and iesus answered, and said vnto her, martha, martha, thou carest, and art troubled about many things:
target_text: te ngaa lamatua yesus dhaa, na, marta. èu ne bhute dènge ngangee rupa-rupa.

source_text: but one thing is needefull, marie hath chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
target_text: be'a kahèi do, te ngaa j'ara èci dhu be'a risi. maria pili nare dhu be'a risi le, nuka madhèdi ho nanene lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dhèu bisa boe parame rare nèti nèngu lii lolo be'a ne.

source_text: and so it was, that as he was praying in a certaine place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said vnto him, lord, teache vs to pray, as iohn also taught his disciples.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia ana madhutu na ca dhèu mai, ka na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama! yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a ana madhutu na ka re'a sabaj'a. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama aj'a ji'i sabaj'a kahèi.

source_text: and he said vnto them, when ye pray, say, our father, which art in heauen, halowed be thy name: thy kingdome come: let thy will be done, euen in earth, as it is in heauen:
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, be'a! sabaj'a pake conto sèmi ne'e: ama! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai na. hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: our dayly bread giue vs for the day:
target_text: ama hia laa ji'i bèli-bèli, nganga'a dhu d'ai.

source_text: and forgiue vs our sinnes: for euen we forgiue euery man that is indetted to vs: and leade vs not into temptation: but deliuer vs from euill.
target_text: ji'i manèngi ama pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala-sasala dhèu dhu tao mi dedha ji'i. ama magee ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: moreouer he said vnto them, which of you shall haue a friende, and shall goe to him at midnight, and say vnto him, friende, lende mee three loaues? for a friende of mine is come out of the way to me, and i haue nothing to set before him:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nori hari si, j'ara-j'ara sabaj'a. na pake upama, peka na, sèmi d'ai talora mèda, angalai èu mai nèti kaj'èu, ho manubha ètu èmu èu. te ngaa èu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, sèna ka hia ne na'a. ka èu lamu asa èmu angalai dhu leo, ho pamako nèti li'u, peka na, ‘lai aae na, ee! hia taha ku ja'a roti d'ai tèlu bua sa! te ji'i abhu tamu ètu èmu, te ngaa ji'i dhu mola-mèu èi! de lai aae na, ee! dhoka tèlu bua di. pe ja'a g'ati hari! '

source_text: and hee within shoulde answere, and say, trouble mee not: the doore is nowe shut, and my children are with mee in bed: i can not rise and giue them to thee.
target_text: ladhe sèmi angalai èu dhaa, peka na, ‘te a'a, ee! dhèu bhèj'i luu, na, èu mai parèi! babèdho dhu patèke le! ana iiki se dhu bhèj'i aa'i le. de mage mu nasa kahèi! pe lod'o leo hari ku laa! '

source_text: i say vnto you, though he would not arise and giue him, because he is his friende, yet doubtlesse because of his importunitie, hee woulde rise, and giue him as many as he needed.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngee paie-iie. masi ka dhèu ne kèd'i boe lula èu angalai nèngu, te ngaa ladhe èu loe boe pamako, tatu na kèd'i, ho hia èu roti sèra.

source_text: and i say vnto you, aske, and it shall be giuen you: seeke, and yee shall finde: knocke, and it shalbe opened vnto you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi taruu mi lamatua; pe na hia. tenge taruu; pe na paj'uj'u j'ara. paroa taruu; pe na bhoke hèb'a èmu.

source_text: for euery one that asketh, receiueth: and he that seeketh, findeth: and to him that knocketh, it shalbe opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi taruu mi ama lamatua, èèna na rèngu sèmi. dhu loe boe tenge, èèna na abhu. dhu ma'ète boe paroa, pe na bhoke babèdho.

source_text: if a sonne shall aske bread of any of you that is a father, will he giue him a stone? or if hee aske a fish, will he for a fish giue him a serpent?
target_text: miu pangee ku laa. abhu ètu mia ladhe ama, dhu ana na manèngi i'a, na hia mege?

source_text: or if hee aske an egge, will hee giue him a scorpion?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi kanadhu manu, na hia karaka rai? tatu aad'o, si?

source_text: if yee then which are euill, can giue good giftes vnto your children, howe much more shall your heauenly father giue the holy ghost to them, that desire him?
target_text: dhèu rai-haha ne, mema bhelu. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga, nèngu ne mema be'a. de ladhe miu dhèu dhu bhelu, d'èi hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana-ana miu, ngaa hari ama! nèngu ne hia, mesa boe ngaa dhu miu parluu, te ngaa risi nèti èèna. na pala-bagi roh na dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu manèngi mi nèngu.

source_text: then hee cast out a deuill which was domme: and when the deuill was gone out, the domme spake, and the people wondered.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus magèle eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu dhu lii aad'o. ka dhèu ne bisa padhai lii hari. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra malaa.

source_text: but some of them said, he casteth out deuils through beelzebub the chiefe of ye deuils.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, mema, nèngu bisa magèle eele nidhu, lula nèngu abhu koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, nuka baalsebul.

source_text: and others tempted him, seeking of him a signe from heauen.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo neo sèku yesus. ka ra manèngi ho yesus tao tadha malaa èci hari, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, koasa na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but he knew their thoughts, and said vnto them, euery kingdom deuided against it self, shall be desolate, and an house deuided against an house, falleth.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a nare le kahadhu kaj'alu rèngu sèra. ka na lii, peka na, ladhe ètu rai cue, kabarai na pamusu, tatu rai ne laho mae-mae. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe ètu d'ara èmu cue, isi èmu loe boe patao-palaha, tatu èmu ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci!

source_text: so if satan also bee deuided against himselfe, howe shall his kingdome stande, because yee say that i cast out deuils through beelzebub?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu se pamusu aa pabata èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra bisa boe rèd'u paredha dènge nèbhu. de maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, ladhe miu peka, na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu ho bata eele hari nidhu.

source_text: if i through beelzebub cast out deuils, by whome doe your children cast them out? therefore shall they be your iudges.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu kahèi dhu re'a magèle eele nidhu. rèngu pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o, si! de miu baku sad'i padhai lii di, dhu peka na, ja'a ne pake koasa nidhu sèna ka bata eele si. pe dhèu miu ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe.

source_text: but if i by ye finger of god cast out deuils, doutles the kingdome of god is come vnto you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a bata nidhu pake koasa ama lamatua, èèna dhu peka na, paredha lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. paredha ne abhu le, te ngaa miu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa.

source_text: when a strong man armed keepeth his palace, the thinges that hee possesseth, are in peace.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èra èci dènge rèka, dhu bori tèke ètu keja g'ana-kariu madhenge èmu na, tatu mèdha-panyau na, dhèu bani boe lasi mana'u.

source_text: but when a stronger then hee, commeth vpon him, and ouercommeth him: hee taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and deuideth his spoiles.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu èra risi nèti nèngu mai segi ne, aa parame nèti rèka na. hèia na parame nèti mèdha-panyau na kahèi, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu na. nèbhu nare sange ne'e lamatua èmu èèna maena dhoka mi rèka na. te ngaa limuri ne, na maena heka rèka na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me, is against me: and he that gathereth not with me, scattereth.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu musu ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ètu d'ara sasab'a ja'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka ad'u-ue j'ara maruru di.

source_text: when the vncleane spirite is gone out of a man, he walketh through drie places, seeking rest: and when he findeth none he saieth, i wil returne vnto mine house whence i came out.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe èdhi bata eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne rai la'e asa era kaliu, ho tenge era ae iisi. lula na abhu boe era dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi na, hèia na pangee na, ‘aah! abhu boe era ae iisi, be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. '

source_text: and when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
target_text: ropa na lèpa, rage hari era uru èèna, dhu mèu le, aa dhu lalau pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then goeth hee, and taketh to him seuen other spirites worse then himselfe: and they enter in, and dwel there: so the last state of that man is worse then the first.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa angalai na pidhu dhu bhelu risi nèti nèngu. ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi pea ètu dhèu èèna, ka ra madahu ne. de lèpa limuri, mamuri dhèu ne asa aae ka ele iie.

source_text: and it came to passe as he sayde these thinges, a certaine woman of the companie lifted vp her voyce, and sayde vnto him, blessed is the wombe that bare thee, and the pappes which thou hast sucked.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhèu bhèni èci ètu èèna pa'oo, peka na, ina mu oto kapai, lula nara iisi èu, aa pasusu èu!

source_text: but hee saide, yea, rather blessed are they that heare the woorde of god, and keepe it.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, tare'a ina! te ngaa dhu oto risi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa tao madhutu!

source_text: and when the people were gathered thicke together, he began to say, this is a wicked generation: they seeke a signe, and there shall no signe be giuen them, but the signe of ionas the prophet.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era, dhèu oke rare ne, hèia na peka, dhèu limuri ne re'a dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. rèngu loe boe manèngi ho ja'a tao tadha malaa hia rèngu, sèna ka re'a, na, ja'a ne tare'a-re'a dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa uru èèna, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, nuka yunus. èèna na d'ai le!

source_text: for as ionas was a signe to the niniuites: so shall also the sonne of man bee to this generation.
target_text: ngaa dhu lèke mi dedha yunus èèna, j'aj'i tadha hia dhèu ètu kota niniwe, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu paleha ne mai. èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ngaa dhu lèke mi ja'a, èèna na j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu limuri ne, dhu peka na, mema ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: the queene of the south shall rise in iudgement, with the men of this generation, and shall condemne them: for shee came from the vtmost partes of the earth to heare the wisedome of salomon, and beholde, a greater then salomon is here.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua j'aj'i ka hakim, pe bhèni aae nèti balèu mamuri hari ho na j'aj'i sakasii. na paj'uj'u ho galaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri taa limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' te uru èèna, bhèni aae mai nèti j'ara kaj'èu, ho nèdhi dènge madha na, mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa miu pusi boe ne!

source_text: the men of niniue shall rise in iudgement with this generation, and shall condemne it: for they repented at the preaching of ionas: and beholde, a greater then ionas is here.
target_text: mesa boe nèngu di! èèna na dhèu-dhèu nèti niniwe kèd'i titu ho paj'uj'u ai asa miu dhu mamuri limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' ra peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ropa yunus la'e peka dad'èi lamatua dènge rèngu, hèia ra ele-ho'a dènge. masi ka dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti yunus ètu talora aae miu, te ngaa mo'o boe ele-ho'a sa hèi.

source_text: no man when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a priuie place, neither vnder a bushell: but on a candlesticke, that they which come in, may see the light.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, dhèu suru labhu, na padhèdi ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka pasaraa d'ara kama hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu maso asa era èèna. abhu ètu mia dhèu suru labhu, ho saguru ne dènge soe, sèna ka pahuni ne! èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: the light of the bodie is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, then is thy whole bodie light: but if thine eye be euill, then thy bodie is darke.
target_text: musi madha miu èci èèna ka dènge labhu. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa d'ara miu. ladhe musi madha maroga, dhèu ladhe ngaa aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara dhu maroga. te ngaa ladhe musi madha mèu, dhèu rèdhi dènge d'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: take heede therefore, that the light which is in thee, be not darkenesse.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka saraa ètu d'ara miu, j'aj'i mèu aae sèmi saraa madha lod'o. saraa ètu d'ara miu, mage sèmi heo hèru, dhu pad'elo dhoka mamaho di.

source_text: if therefore thy whole body shall be light, hauing no part darke, then shall all be light, euen as when a candle doth light thee with the brightnesse.
target_text: ladhe d'ara miu saraa, abhu boe sasanga èci sa dhu maroga, tatu mamuri miu j'aj'i mèu, nuka sèmi labhu aae dhu d'elo mamuri miu.

source_text: and as hee spake, a certaine pharise besought him to dine with him: and hee went in, and sate downe at table.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu èci nèti partei agama parisi nèru ne, lasi ra'a asa èmu na. d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, ka yesus madhèdi ètu mei ra'a.

source_text: and when the pharise saw it, he marueiled that he had not first washed before dinner.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua èmu ne malaa ladhe yesus madhèdi na'a, dhu j'amo uru boe ai, madhutu atora dhèu parisi.

source_text: and the lord saide to him, in deede yee pharises make cleane the outside of the cuppe, and of the platter: but the inwarde part is full of rauening and wickednesse.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, eeh! miu dhèu parisi se seli-kolane! miu kèpe pa'èra atora agama miu! miu bhèlu boe rase pega dènge galaa re li'u toke kale'e, te ngaa sanèd'e boe ho pamèu d'ara miu dhu kaj'alu, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: ye fooles, did not he that made that which is without, make that which is within also?
target_text: goa, ee! baku bhèlu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i re li'u, aa tao re d'ara kahèi.

source_text: therefore, giue almes of those thinges which you haue, and beholde, all thinges shall be cleane to you.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, miu pala-bagi dhèu dènge boe unu sèra, nèti ngaa dhu miu unu, sèna ka miu mola ètu katanga madha lamatua.

source_text: but wo be to you, pharises: for ye tithe the mynt and the rewe, and all maner herbs, and passe ouer iudgement and the loue of god: these ought yee to haue done, and not to haue left the other vndone.
target_text: miu dhèu parisi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! ca pala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia mi lamatua, miu pa'iga taruu nèti dhu ana iiki toke kapai. toke bubhu-lara dhu ana iiki-iiki d'ara oka, miu pa'iga hèi! te ngaa miu pusi boe dènge j'ara dhu kapai risi. j'ara-j'ara sasue mi ama lamatua, aa dènge boe bia cabèka, miu pabhèlu eele! mema tare'a, èdhi hud'i hia ku pala lamatua, te ngaa baku bhèlu kahèi dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi sèra.

source_text: wo be to you, pharises: for ye loue the vppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu d'èi dhoka tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, aa d'èi dhèu pakab'ua miu ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: wo be to you, scribes and pharises, hypocrites: for ye are as graues which appeare not, and the men that walke ouer them, perceiue not.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu nuka sèmi ro'a dhèu madhe dhu pamera le dènge rai. dhèu kako re dedha, te ngaa re'a boe, na, ètu èèna na abhu ro'a dhèu madhe, lula ro'a èèna ètu dedha na tèdhi na mèu, te ngaa d'ara na laho kao-kao. masi ka madhutu ad'a èdhi, ladhe dhèu j'èli lèke ro'a dhèu madhe, pakaj'alu ngi'u na, de nèngu nia boe maso asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. miu dhèu parisi se, ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe èèna! re li'u, miu mèu titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara miu pènu dènge kaj'alu. dhèu dhu padètu dènge miu, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu kahèi.

source_text: then answered one of the lawyers, and saide vnto him, master, thus saying thou puttest vs to rebuke also.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi. ropa na tadèngi lii yesus, ka b'ala dènge, aku nèngu na, lii padhai ama deo na, lèke mi dedha ji'i!

source_text: and he sayde, wo be to you also, yee lawyers: for yee lade men with burdens grieuous to be borne, and yee your selues touche not the burdens with one of your fingers.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala lii na, peka na, tare'a! miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu agama yahudi, hud'i dui mamadhe-mamopo kahèi! miu soru boe dhèu ho pasamaa si, te ngaa miu asa pasusa si dènge j'ara pabia atora agama miu. ka miu pua dhèu sèra pasae rupa-rupa babia nèti atora miu sèra. te ngaa miu mesa mi, mo'o boe pasae babia ne dènge kacui-aai miu ca laa sa hèi!

source_text: wo be to you: for ye builde the sepulchres of the prophetes, and your fathers killed them.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu bhute dhoka pudhi hadhu tao tugu hia dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra, sèna ka pakab'ua si. te ngaa bèi-baki miu se'e ka dhu pamadhe si!

source_text: truely ye beare witnesse, and allowe the deedes of your fathers: for they killed them, and yee build their sepulchres.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi dènge bèi-baki miu sèra. rèngu tule eele dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, ka ra pamadhe si. hèia miu dame hadhu ro'a ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu se mo'o kahèi dènge tatao bèi-baki miu.

source_text: therefore said the wisedome of god, i wil sende them prophets and apostles, and of them they shall slaie, and persecute away,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i, peka nèdhi le, na, ‘pe ja'a pua dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo, sèna ka lasi asa dhèu sèra. hèia dhèu sèra kalabhe paj'èra cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari ra pamadhe si. '

source_text: that the blood of all the prophets, shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation, from the blood of abel vnto the blood of zacharias, which was slaine betweene the altar and the temple: verely i say vnto you, it shall be required of this generation.
target_text: dhèu taa limuri ne, hud'i tago rare tatao nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. sèra sa, mulai ige nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, karèi nèti mamadhe habel, toke d'ai dhèu dhu limuri tèka, nuka sakaria. nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe ne ètu talora aae mei korban dènge kama mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. miu se kahèi pasae mere hahuku ra!

source_text: wo be to you, lawyers: for ye haue taken away the key of knowledge: ye entred not in your selues, and them that came in, ye forbade.
target_text: miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu dhu mèd'u gagoe ho bisa bhoke babèdho, sèna ka dhèu re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mesa mi maso boe asa d'ara. dhu karehe risi hari, miu pahèb'e dhèu, ho baku ra lasi asa èèna!

source_text: and as he sayde these things vnto them, the scribes and pharises began to vrge him sore, and to prouoke him to speake of many things, laying wait for him, and seeking to catche some thing of his mouth, whereby they might accuse him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra jèke ne. karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, rèngu karèi rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka neo pamanahu ne. ra loe boe tenge j'ara ho pabèbhe ne.

source_text: in the meane time, there gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, so that they trode one another: and he began to say vnto his disciples first, take heede to your selues of the leauen of the pharises, which is hypocrisie.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu pèri-pèri riho dhu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus. dhèu se mai pasuki, lingu rare ne. ka na peka uru dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, j'aga ngi'u ho baku madhutu j'ara mamuri dhèu parisi. te rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo.

source_text: for there is nothing couered, that shall not bee reueiled: neither hidde, that shall not be knowen.
target_text: rèngu sangaja be'a, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu hui. te aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni ne, bèli-camèd'a sabhoka.

source_text: wherefore whatsoeuer yee haue spoken in darkenesse, it shall be heard in the light: and that which ye haue spoken in the eare, in secret places, shall be preached on the houses.
target_text: ngaa dhu deo ne'e miu padhai pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadèngi dènge mèu. ngaa dhu miu paholo ètu d'ara kama, èèna na dhèu peka paled'a ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: and i say vnto you, my friendes, be not afraide of them that kill the bodie, and after that are not able to doe any more.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ana-ana, ee! mage miu madha'u, ladhe dhèu neo pamadhe miu. te rèngu pamadhe dhoka ngi'u aae di, te ngaa ra bisa boe tao ngaa mi samanga miu.

source_text: but i wil forewarne you, who ye shall feare: feare him which after hee hath killed, hath power to cast into hell: yea, i say vnto you, him feare.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka, na, miu hud'i madha'u mi cee ku. miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu bisa pamadhe miu, aa pèci asa d'ara ai naraka. de miu hud'i madha'u tare'a-re'a mi nèngu.

source_text: are not fiue sparowes bought for two farthings, and yet not one of them is forgotten before god?
target_text: miu pangee sèku, ana mangungu kab'ua ca ngaa? mura titu kèna! lèmi ngi'u, dua doi, si? masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua bhèlu boe ci'u sa hèi.

source_text: yea, and all the heares of your head are nombred: feare not therefore: yee are more of value then many sparowes.
target_text: aa sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi miu. lamatua ne'a mèu, abhu rèu kètu pèri loa ètu kaba kètu miu. de miu baku madha'u, te lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu ae-ae sèra.

source_text: also i say vnto you, whosoeuer shall confesse mee before men, him shall the sonne of man confesse also before the angels of god.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pasa dhilu miu paie-iie! ladhe dhèu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a mangaku nèngu kahèi ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: but hee that shall denie mee before men, shall be denied before the angels of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, peka na, nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, ja'a tadhe boe nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and whosoeuer shall speake a woorde against the sonne of man, it shall be forgiuen him: but vnto him, that shall blaspheme ye holy ghost, it shall not be forgiuen.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu padhai pakarehe kolongara ja'a, ama lamatua sadia ho pabhèlu eele sasala na era. te ngaa ladhe na padhai pakarehe kolongara roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe sasala na.

source_text: and when they shall bring you vnto the synagogues, and vnto the rulers and princes, take no thought howe, or what thing ye shall answere, or what yee shall speake.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ère rèti miu asa era uri lii langu agama, do, rèti miu asa dhèu paredha, lula miu parcaya ja'a, mage miu pangee, na, tasamia miu bisa siri iisi.

source_text: for the holy ghost shall teache you in the same houre, what yee ought to say.
target_text: te ètu d'ara lai-lai èèna kahèi, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, peka dènge miu lii dhu pamèci ho b'ala dhèu sèra.

source_text: and one of the companie said vnto him, master, bidde my brother deuide the inheritance with me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ca dhèu nèti dhèu ae sèra, karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! peka ku dènge a'a ku, ho pabagi dènge ja'a pusaka ama ji'i.

source_text: and he said vnto him, man, who made me a iudge, or a deuider ouer you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, waa! dhèu cee ka dhu ded'e ja'a j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu miu sèmi èèna?

source_text: wherefore he said vnto them, take heede, and beware of couetousnesse: for though a man haue abundance, yet his life standeth not in his riches.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! miu baku j'aj'i dhèu manga'a. te kakaja-sasu'i bisa boe nèti mamuri dhu mera-milu.

source_text: and he put foorth a parable vnto them, saying, the grounde of a certaine riche man brought foorth fruites plenteously.
target_text: èle ka, na padhai lii pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu, isi oka na ae titu kèna.

source_text: therefore he thought with himselfe, saying, what shall i doe, because i haue no roume, where i may lay vp my fruites?
target_text: ka èmu-èmu dhu tèka nganga'a na pènu tao cacèci, aa risi eele hèi, ka ne'a heka tao tasamia.

source_text: and he said, this wil i do, i wil pul downe my barnes, and builde greater, and therein will i gather all my fruites, and my goods.
target_text: ka na pama'ète, peka na, ‘ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e ka! èmu era tèka nganga'a dhu dhui se, ja'a sag'e eele ho patitu hari dhu kapai risi, sèna ka tèke nganga'a nèti d'ara oka dènge mèdha-panyau ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i wil say to my soule, soule, thou hast much goods laide vp for many yeeres: liue at ease, eate, drinke and take thy pastime.
target_text: ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, ja'a pama'ète kore, na, gud'a pènu le! nganga'a tesa le, ku'a d'ai tèu-tèu. de ku'a-kinu pakarej'e iisi dènge pacapa haga! '

source_text: but god said vnto him, o foole, this night wil they fetch away thy soule from thee: then whose shall those things be which thou hast prouided?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge ne, na, ‘heeh! dhèu goa! mèda ne'e kahèi, èu madhe. aa cee ka dhu abhu aa'i isi gud'a èu sèra? '

source_text: so is he that gathereth riches to himselfe, and is not riche in god.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e! bisa kahèi, dhèu pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne hia ngi'u na, te ngaa ètu d'ara ngangee ama lamatua, nèngu ne, dhèu unu aad'o, lula pabe'a boe dènge lamatua.

source_text: and he spake vnto his disciples, therefore i say vnto you, take no thought for your life, what yee shall eate: neither for your body, what yee shall put on.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a tabha hari ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, miu mage dhoka pangee mamuri miu bèli-bèli, nèti nganga'a-nganginu, do mèdha-papake.

source_text: the life is more then meate: and the body more then the raiment.
target_text: te mamuri èdhi ne risi nèti ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, aa ngaa dhu èdhi pake.

source_text: consider the rauens: for they neither sowe nor reape: which neither haue storehouse nor barne, and yet god feedeth them: how much more are yee better then foules?
target_text: ladhe sèku lakaa! rèngu sèra sèla boe, puu-g'ètu boe, dènge boe gud'a ho tèke nganga'a, te ngaa ama lamatua kab'oi si. ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu piara miu kahèi. lula na pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and which of you with taking thought, can adde to his stature one cubite?
target_text: sèmi dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho lalau iisi na, nèngu bisa pamadhera mamuri na, do? aad'o, sina ma!

source_text: if yee then bee not able to doe the least thing, why take yee thought for the remnant?
target_text: de ladhe bhute dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu ana iiki sèra, dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, tasamia hari ka miu bhute dènge madha j'ara dhu kapai? a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: consider the lilies howe they growe: they labour not, neither spin they: yet i say vnto you, that salomon himselfe in all his royaltie was not clothed like one of these.
target_text: ladhe sèku bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami. rèngu sab'a boe oka-tedhe, aa ra manènu boe sig'i-rabhi. te ngaa mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua aae, saraga risi boe hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami sèra.

source_text: if then god so clothe the grasse which is to day in the field, and to morowe is cast into the ouen, howe much more will he clothe you, o yee of litle faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua piara j'u'u dhu ana iiki-iiki dhu kab'ua aad'o, dhu dhoka mamuri deo ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, nèngu bisa kab'oi miu dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti j'u'u sèra. de tasamia ka parcaya miu èra boe mi lamatua?

source_text: therefore aske not what yee shall eate, or what ye shall drinke, neither hag you in suspense.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku bhute dènge nganga'a-nganginu. te èèna na, lamatua uri hia miu.
