target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se mulai ka'uu-kamuki, lula yesus peka na, roti dhu mai nèti lamatua èèna, nuka ja'a dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and they said, is not this iesus that sonne of ioseph, whose father and mother wee knowe? howe then sayth he, i came downe from heauen?
target_text: ra padhai lii, peka na, tasamia ka sèmi ne'e? dhèu ne'e ne, yesus ana yusuf, si? ji'i tadhe ina-ama na. de tasamia ka nèngu ne peka na, ‘ja'a mai nèti sorga? ' abhu ètu mia?

source_text: iesus then answered, and saide vnto them, murmure not among your selues.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, eee! loe eele ku ka'uu-kamuki!

source_text: no man can come to mee, except the father, which hath sent mee, drawe him: and i will raise him vp at the last day.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa mai asa ja'a, ladhe ama ku lere boe ne mai. aa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: it is written in the prophetes, and they shalbe al taught of god. euery man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the father, commeth vnto me:
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra suri rèdhi le, peka na, ‘ama lamatua neo aj'a-nori dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ' de dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene ama ètu sorga, aa rèngu abhu aj'a-nori nèti nèngu, rèngu mai sa ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: not that any man hath seene the father, saue hee which is of god, hee hath seene the father.
target_text: ja'a ne ka dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua. de dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku kèdhi ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu patoo madha dènge ama ètu sorga.

source_text: verely, verely i say vnto you, hee that beleeueth in me, hath euerlasting life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i am that bread of life.
target_text: te ja'a ne, nuka roti dhu nèti mamuri èèna.

source_text: your fathers did eate manna in the wildernesse, and are dead.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna lod'o ra kako rai-reo d'ara mamoo. masi ka ra'a le roti èèna, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu madhe kahèi.

source_text: this is that breade, which commeth downe from heauen, that hee which eateth of it, shoulde not die.
target_text: te ngaa roti dhu limuri ne puru mai nèti sorga, leko-leo. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ra'a. sasoa na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, rèngu cèri eele heka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: i am that liuing breade, which came downe from heauen: if any man eate of this breade, hee shall liue for euer: and the bread that i will giue, is my flesh, which i will giue for the life of the world.
target_text: lula ja'a ne, roti dhu nèti mamuri, dhu mai nèti sorga. pe ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, ho ra bisa mamuri. aa dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: then the iewes stroue among themselues, saying, howe can this man giue vs his flesh to eate?
target_text: ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia ra pab'ala èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, na padhai lii sèmi ngaa ka nèi? tasamia ka dhèu ne bisa hia ngi'u na, èdhi ta'e?

source_text: then iesus saide vnto them, verely, verely i say vnto you, except yee eate the flesh of the sonne of man, and drinke his blood, yee haue no life in you.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a padhai lii dhu mola-mola dènge miu kèna. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. dhèu dhu neo mamuri lèke, hud'i pa'èki ku dènge ja'a. de ladhe miu mi'a boe ngi'u ja'a, aa minu boe raa ja'a, na, miu abhu boe mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: whosoeuer eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternall life, and i will raise him vp at the last day.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ra'e ngi'u ja'a, aa rinu raa ja'a, rèngu abhu le mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: for my flesh is meat in deede, and my blood is drinke in deede.
target_text: te nganga'a dhu lèke, nuka ngi'u ja'a. aa nganginu dhu lèke, nuka raa ja'a.

source_text: hee that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and i in him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu ra'a ngi'u ja'a, dènge rinu raa ja'a, mamuri ra dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu.

source_text: as that liuing father hath sent me, so liue i by the father, and he that eateth me, euen he shall liue by me.
target_text: ama ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a, nèngu mamuri tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti nèngu kahèi. nèti èèna ka dhèu dhu na'e ngi'u ja'a, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: this is that bread which came downe from heauen: not as your fathers haue eaten manna, and are deade. hee that eateth of this bread, shall liue for euer.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna nèti dedha-liru. masi ka rèngu ra'a, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu rèngu madhe kahèi. te ngaa roti dhu mai nèti sorga ne, leko-leo. te dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: these things spake he in the synagogue, as he taught in capernaum.
target_text: yesus aj'a j'ara se'e ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi cue ètu kota kapernaum.

source_text: many therefore of his disciples when they heard this sayde, this is an hard saying: who can heare it?
target_text: dhèu ae dhu madhutu yesus. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii padhai na sèmi èèna, hèia abhu dhu peka na, a'aj'a na, bia! cee ka dhu bisa sèmi rare a'aj'a èèna?

source_text: but iesus knowing in himselfe, that his disciples murmured at this, saide vnto them, doeth this offend you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a le lii padhai rèngu se, hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, a'aj'a ne tao miu susa, do?

source_text: what then if yee should see that sonne of man ascend vp where he was before?
target_text: tasamia hari, ladhe miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ca'e hari asa era pea ja'a uru èèna?

source_text: it is the spirite that quickeneth: the flesh profiteth nothing: the woordes that i speake vnto you, are spirite and life.
target_text: roh lamatua ka dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke. mamuri dhu lèke mai boe nèti ngi'u dhèu. te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a kapua na nèti roh ama lamatua. de lii holo-nori ne'e bisa hia mamuri dhu lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: but there are some of you that beleeue not: for iesus knewe from the beginning, which they were that beleeued not, and who shoulde betray him.
target_text: te ngaa abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu lèka boe ja'a. yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèngu dhu ne'a le karèi nèti uru j'ara, cee dhu parcaya boe, aa cee ka dhu èèna na pahie eele nèngu.

source_text: and hee saide, therefore saide i vnto you, that no man can come vnto mee, except it be giuen vnto him of my father.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema le dènge miu, na, ama ku ètu sorga hud'i bhoke uuru ku j'ara hia dhèu, heka dhèu ne bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kèna.

source_text: from that time, many of his disciples went backe, and walked no more with him.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ana madhutu na ae ka dhu tèke eele ne, lula rèngu ro'o heka madhutu nèngu.

source_text: then sayde iesus to the twelue, will yee also goe away?
target_text: ka yesus karèi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, aku nèngu na, aa miu tasamia? neo tèke eele ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: then simon peter answered him, master, to whome shall we goe? thou hast the wordes of eternall life:
target_text: te ngaa simon petrus dhaa, peka na, ama! ji'i patai-patapa mi cee hari? abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa lole dènge ji'i, j'ara tasamia ji'i bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dhoka èu mesa mu di!

source_text: and we beleeue and knowe that thou art that christ that sonne of the liuing god.
target_text: aa ji'i lèka ama. lula ji'i dhu nge'a le, na, èu ne, nuka dhèu mola-mèci nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: iesus answered them, haue not i chosen you twelue, and one of you is a deuill?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hag'e kore le miu dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa sanèd'e! nèti miu se'e, abhu ca dhèu nuka sèmi nidhu!

source_text: now he spake it of iudas iscariot the sonne of simon: for hee it was that shoulde betraie him, though he was one of the twelue.
target_text: dhu na peka ne, nuka yudas, ana simon iskariot. yudas ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: after these things, iesus walked in galile, and woulde not walke in iudea: for the iewes sought to kill him.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus si kako palème propensi galilea. nèngu neo boe kako palème propensi yudea, lula abhu ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: nowe the iewes feast of the tabernacles was at hande.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela puu-g'ètu dhu ra peka na, kalela paleo.

source_text: his brethren therefore sayde vnto him, depart hence, and goe into iudea, that thy disciples may see thy woorkes that thou doest.
target_text: ka ari yesus sèra peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, be'a risi, èu pakeso nèti ne'e, lamu asa yudea. sèna ka dhèu dhu madhutu èu ètu nèi, bisa ladhe rèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu èu tao.

source_text: for there is no man that doeth any thing secretely, and hee himselfe seeketh to be famous. if thou doest these things, shewe thy selfe to the worlde.
target_text: te ladhe cee dhu neo sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi kolo-karisi nèngu, na, nèngu baku tao pahuni-pahuni. lula èu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, be'a risi hari, ladhe dhèu ae-ae bisa ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu èu tao sèra!

source_text: for as yet his brethren beleeued not in him.
target_text: ari na sèra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhu lèka nèngu èra iia boe.

source_text: then iesus saide vnto them, my time is not yet come: but your time is alway readie.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka. te ngaa ladhe miu neo lami, sad'i lake mere.

source_text: the world can not hate you: but me it hateth, because i testifie of it, that the workes thereof are euill.
target_text: dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tèka boe d'ara dènge miu. te ngaa rèngu tèka d'ara dènge ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele aa'i tatao rèngu. te d'ara ra bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: go ye vp vnto this feast: i wil not go vp yet vnto this feast: for my time is not yet fulfilled.
target_text: lod'o kalela agama èdhi dètu le. de miu ka laa lami asa yerusalem. ja'a neo mèka laku, te dhae d'ai mèka lod'o.

source_text: these things he sayde vnto them, and abode still in galile.
target_text: na peka nare, hèia na pea ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: but assoone as his brethren were gone vp, then went hee also vp vnto the feast, not openly, but as it were priuilie.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ari na si lasi madhutu kalela agama dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem, yesus madhutu kahèi. te ngaa la'e pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi ne.

source_text: then the iewes sought him at the feast, and saide, where is hee?
target_text: ètu yerusalem, lod'o kalela agama dhèu yahudi, ama-ama dhèu yahudi patangi-tenge yesus. ra pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia?

source_text: and much murmuring was there of him among the people. some said, he is a good man: other sayd, nay: but he deceiueth the people.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu paka'uu lula-nèti nèngu. cahag'e peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu be'a. cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne dhu kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: howbeit no man spake openly of him for feare of the iewes.
target_text: te ngaa abhu boe dhu pacèu lii padhai lula-nèti yesus, te rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama se.

source_text: nowe when halfe the feast was done, iesus went vp into the temple and taught.
target_text: pas ètu talora kalela ne, yesus maso la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na aj'a dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the iewes marueiled, saving, howe knoweth this man the scriptures, seeing that hee neuer learned!
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi malaa, ka ra peka na, dhèu ne sakola nèdhi boe sèmi èdhi. te ngaa tasamia ka ne'a aa'i mèu j'ara se'e?

source_text: iesus answered them, and saide, my doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, nanene. j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a lole, kapua boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèti nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: if any man will doe his will, he shall knowe of the doctrine, whether it be of god, or whether i speake of my selfe.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, nèngu èèna na ne'a mèu, a'aj'a ja'a ne, tare'a-re'a mai nèti ama lamatua, do nèti dhoka ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: hee that speaketh of himselfe, seeketh his owne glorie: but hee that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no vnrighteousnes is in him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padhai lii pake mamèu unu na, nèngu tenge dhoka kolongara di. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo ded'e kolongara nèti dhèu dhu pua-paleha na, tatu lii padhai lèke mola-mola. aa lii padhai nèngu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: did not moses giue you a law, and yet none of you keepeth the lawe? why goe ye about to kill me?
target_text: musa pangèd'u le miu atora ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mo'o boe tao madhutu. de tasamia ka miu tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the people answered, and said, thou hast a deuil: who goeth about to kill thee?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae se karèi, peka na, èu peka ngaa, ne? ele boe nidhu tao èu, do? cee ka dhu tenge j'ara neo pamadhe èu?

source_text: iesus answered, and saide to them, i haue done one worke, and ye all maruaile.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a heka tao tadha malaa èci ètu lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi kacèki le.

source_text: moses therefore gaue vnto you circumcision, not because it is of moses, but of the fathers and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka-tèka, miu sab'a kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, nuka sèmi: musa hia le atora suna, dhu peka na, ladhe dhèu rara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, na, ètu d'ara lod'o ka aru, miu hud'i suna ku ana ne. masi ka lod'o ne, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu hud'i suna ku nèngu. te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, atora ne uru tèka nèti musa. te ama lamatua dhu hia uru le atora ne mi abraham.

source_text: if a man on the sabbath receiue circumcision, that the lawe of moses should not be broken, be ye angrie with me, because i haue made a man euery whit whole on the sabbath day?
target_text: de ladhe suna ana iiki èci lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a sisu boe atora musa, nga tao ka miu nasa dènge ja'a, lula ja'a puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a? maso boe d'ara ngangee, sina ma! ?

source_text: iudge not according to the appearance, but iudge righteous iudgement.
target_text: baku pasale dhèu lula j'ara-j'ara dhu miu mèdhi dènge musi madha di. dadoo uuru ku dènge d'ara be'a, heka pama'ète dhu lèke.

source_text: then saide some of them of hierusalem, is not this he, whom they goe about to kill?
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu nèti kota yerusalem pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ra patangi-tenge ho neo pamadhe ne, do?

source_text: and beholde, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing to him: doe the rulers know in deede that this is in deede that christ?
target_text: ladhe ku laa! na padhai lii pahuni boe ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa abhu boe dhu kai ne ho hutu hèb'a na. madhutu miu, tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa sèra re'a le, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, nuka kristus, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo pua mai èèna, si?

source_text: howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when that christ commeth, no man shall knowe whence he is.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'i mi lii langu, sèmi ne'e: ladhe lamatua pua ka kristus mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a nèngu nèti mia. te ngaa èdhi te'a le dhèu ne nèti mia.

source_text: then cried iesus in the temple as hee taught, saying, ye both knowe mee, and knowe whence i am: yet am i not come of my selfe, but he that sent me, is true, whome ye knowe not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus aj'a dhèu era ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa tadèngi dhèu se peka sèmi èèna, hèia na karèi si dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu pangee, na, miu se tadhe ja'a, aa me'a mèu ja'a mai nèti mia, do? ja'a ne, mai boe asa ne'e madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te dhu pua ja'a èèna, abhu tare'a-re'a. aa miu tadhe boe nèngu.

source_text: but i knowe him: for i am of him, and he hath sent me.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a tadhe ne, lula ja'a mai nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: then they sought to take him, but no man layde handes on him, because his houre was not yet come.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e neo kèpe ne. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa kèpe ne, te d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: now many of the people beleeued in him, and said, when that christ commeth, will he doe moe miracles then this man hath done?
target_text: nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu ètu èèna, abhu ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne. dhèu se padhai lii, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne tao tadha malaa ae le. pe bèli-camèd'a, ladhe kristus mai, tatu boe na tao tadha malaa risi nèti dhèu ne'e, si?

source_text: the pharises heard that the people murmured these thinges of him, and the pharises, and high priestes sent officers to take him.
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu ae se, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi kahèi. rèngu tadèngi dhèu ae se pakanucu j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus. hèia, dhèu se, dènge kètu agama yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: then saide iesus vnto them, yet am i a little while with you, and then goe i vnto him that sent mee.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, lod'o ja'a pa'èci dènge miu di ciki oo'e ka, nare heka nèbhu. te nèbhu heka, ja'a laku hari asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: ye shall seeke me, and shall not finde me, and where i am, can ye not come.
target_text: pe èèna na, miu tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe ja'a. te ja'a neo laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu.

source_text: then saide the iewes amongs themselues, whither will he goe, that we shall not finde him? will he goe vnto them that are dispersed among the grecians, and teache the grecians?
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne neo la'e mia? la'e asa era mia, dhu èdhi bisa boe paraga dènge ne? nèngu la'e lu'u asa dhèu yahudi dhu bali ètu rai kaj'èu, do? neo la'e aj'a-nori dhèu-dhèu dhu pake lii yunani ètu nèi, do? do, tasamia?

source_text: what saying is this that hee saide, ye shall seeke mee, and shall not finde mee? and where i am, cannot ye come?
target_text: a'abhu na tasamia, ka na peka, na, ‘miu neo tenge ja'a, te ngaa paraga boe. ' aa, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu. '?

source_text: nowe in the last and great day of the feast, iesus stoode and cried, saying, if any man thirst, let him come vnto me, and drinke.
target_text: d'ai lod'o oe èle kalela, dhu j'aj'i lod'o kapai risi èèna, hèia yesus kèd'i titu, ka na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! cee ka dhu koko-kamango, na, hud'i laa na mai asa ja'a ho ninu!

source_text: hee that beleeueth in mee, as saith the scripture, out of his bellie shall flowe riuers of water of life.
target_text: cee dhu parcaya ja'a, na, mai sèna ka minu! te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘èi dhu nèti mamuri, èèna na hae mai nèti d'ara dhèu-dhèu parcaya. ' ka rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: this spake hee of the spirite which they that beleeued in him, should receiue: for the holy ghost was not yet giuen, because that iesus was not yet glorified.
target_text: yesus padhai lii lula-nèti roh ama lamatua, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus abhu roh èèna. te ngaa lod'o yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, rèngu dhae sèmi rare mèka roh èèna, lula ama lamatua dhae hia mèka. ama lamatua mema hia mèka, lula na ded'e mèka padedha-dedha yesus.

source_text: so many of the people, when they heard this saying, said, of a trueth this is that prophet.
target_text: dhèu ae-ae ètu sèra nanene lii padhai yesus ne. hèia abhu dhu peka, na, tatu dhèu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu na padhadha mema karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: other saide, this is that christ: and some said, but shall that christ come out of galile?
target_text: abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai! te ngaa cahag'e hari pab'ala, peka na, bisa boe! te kristus èèna, dhèu galilea boe. tare'a, si?

source_text: saith not the scripture that that christ shall come of the seede of dauid, and out of the towne of beth-leem, where dauid was?
target_text: te sasuri ama lamatua suri, na, kristus èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ètu d'ara sasuri leo kahèi dhu suri, peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu betlehem, rae dhèu aae daud. sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: so was there dissension among the people for him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mulai pahag'a lula yesus.

source_text: and some of them would haue taken him, but no man layde handes on him.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu neo kèpe ne, te ngaa ca dhèu sa goi boe ne.

source_text: then came the officers to the hie priests and pharises, and they said vnto them, why haue ye not brought him?
target_text: èle ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu mai neo kèpe yesus, lèpa asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi sèra. hèia dhèu kapai se karèi, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka miu mèti boe ne mai?

source_text: the officers answered, neuer man spake like this man.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, na, ira ii! ji'i dhae paraga ngèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa dhu padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu nèi!

source_text: then answered them the pharises, are yee also deceiued?
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi, aku rèngu na, heh! miu se lèke le tipu, si?

source_text: doeth any of the rulers, or of the pharises beleeue in him?
target_text: sanèd'e! te nèti ji'i dhèu-dhèu parisi, do, ama-ama abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu lèka ne. tare'a, si? ladhe dhèu kapai parcaya boe, na, tasamia ka miu se lèka nèngu?

source_text: but this people, which know not the law, are cursed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu neo parcaya ne, re'a boe atora ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu dui rare huku dhu bia nèti ama lamatua!

source_text: nicodemus said vnto them, he that came to iesus by night, and was one of them.
target_text: te ngaa ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu la'e asa yesus re mèda, ho padhai lii dènge ne. ka na karèi dhèu se'e, peka na,

source_text: doth our law iudge a man before it heare him, and knowe what he hath done?
target_text: tasamia? madhutu atora agama, èdhi pama'ète uru ku lii langu dhèu, do? do, èdhi hud'i nanene uuru ku lii lolo na, sèna ka te'a mèu dhèu ne tao ngaa, heka pama'ète lii langu na kèna?

source_text: they answered, and said vnto him, art thou also of galile? searche and looke: for out of galile ariseth no prophet.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu ne, dhèu galilea èci èèna ka dènge nèngu, do? parisa paie-iie uuru ku sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! baca paie-iie sèna ka me'a mèu, na, abhu boe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti galilea!

source_text: and euery man wet vnto his owne house.
target_text: ka ra pacèri, èci-èci lèpa asa èmu ra.

source_text: and iesus went vnto the mount of oliues,
target_text: te ngaa yesus la'e asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: and early in the morning came againe into the temple, and all the people came vnto him, and he sate downe, and taught them.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, nèngu la'e asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dhèu ae mai pakaboko ètu madha nèngu. ka na madhèdi aj'a-nori si.

source_text: then the scribes, and the pharises brought vnto him a woman, taken in adulterie, and set her in the middes,
target_text: lod'o èèna, kèpe rare bhèni ca dhèu dhu talora na ad'u-ue j'ara makae. ka pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi ère rèti bhèni ne asa yesus. hèia ra laka-seti bhèni ne titu ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and said vnto him, master, we foud this woman committing adulterie, euen in the very acte.
target_text: ka ra peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese. kèpe ngare bhèni ne dhu talora nèngu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae.

source_text: now moses in our law commanded, that such should be stoned: what sayest thou therefore?
target_text: ètu d'ara atora musa, abhu paredha èci dhu peka na, ‘dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu na boe, hud'i abhu hahuku pèci toke madhe. ' de madhutu ama mese, na, tasamia?

source_text: and this they saide to tempt him, that they might haue, whereof to accuse him. but iesus stouped downe, and with his finger wrote on the groud.
target_text: dhèu se sèku ne, sèna ka abhu j'ara ho pèci sasala asa yesus ho pamanahu ne. yesus lii boe, te ngaa madhèdi pasaboti suri rai, pake suu kolo ai na.

source_text: and while they continued asking him, hee lift himselfe vp, and sayde vnto them, let him that is among you without sinne, cast the first stone at her.
target_text: dhèu se loe boe karèi nèngu. hèia na titu, ka padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu tao mèdhi mèka sasala, na, nèngu ka dhu bisa pèci uuru ku, sèna ka huku bhèni ne'e.

source_text: and againe hee stouped downe, and wrote on the ground.
target_text: ka na madhèdi pasaboti hari, hèia suri hari rai.

source_text: and when they heard it, being accused by their owne conscience, they went out one by one, beginning at ye eldest euen to the last: so iesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the mids.
target_text: ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai na, rèngu j'aj'i makae. lula rèngu re'a ètu d'ara ra, rèngu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi. ka lasi ka èci-èci, mulai nèti dhèu heka toke d'ai ana ngèru, tèke eele dhodhoka yesus dènge bhèni ne ètu era èèna.

source_text: when iesus had lift vp himselfe againe, and sawe no man, but the woman, hee saide vnto her, woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
target_text: hèia yesus titu hari, ka na karèi, eea! mia lasi? abhu heka ca dhèu sa ètu ne'e ho pèci sasala mi èu, do?

source_text: she said, no man, lord. and iesus said, neither do i condemne thee: go and sinne no more.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama. ka yesus lii dènge dhèu ne, peka na, ja'a neo boe huku èu kahèi. lèpa ka, te ngaa sanèd'e. tao ia ka sasala!

source_text: then spake iesus againe vnto them, saying, i am that light of the worlde: hee that followeth mee, shall not walke in darkenes, but shall haue that light of life.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ja'a ne, nuka sèmi saraa hia dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa na pea ètu d'ara saraa dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: the pharises therefore saide vnto him, thou bearest recorde of thy selfe: thy recorde is not true.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu pab'ala, peka na, weh! èu mesa mu neo j'aj'i sakasii nèti ngi'u èu unu mu, do? bisa boe sèmi èèna! te madhutu atora èdhi, hud'i dhèu leo ku dhu j'aj'i sakasii hia dhèu èci, bisa boe nèngu unu na. de ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi, aa ngo'o boe parcaya.

source_text: iesus answered, and sayde vnto them, though i beare recorde of my selfe, yet my recorde is true: for i know whence i came, and whither i go: but ye cannot tell whence i come, and whither i goe.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa ja'a j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, te lii padhai ja'a ne, lèke. lula ja'a mesa ku ke'a mola-mola ja'a ne mai nèti mia, aa neo laku asa mia. miu me'a boe ja'a mai nèti mia, aa me'a boe neo laku asa mia kahèi.

source_text: ye iudge after the flesh: i iudge no man.
target_text: miu nile dhèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a madhutu boe a'abhu dhèu rai-haha ho nile dhèu èci sa.

source_text: and if i also iudge, my iudgement is true: for i am not alone, but i, and the father, that sent mee.
target_text: ladhe ja'a nile dhèu, a'uku dhu ja'a pake, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a mesa ku boe dhu nile dhèu, te ngaa ja'a tao aa'i-aa'i sama-sama dènge ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: and it is also written in your lawe, that the testimonie of two men is true.
target_text: baku bhèlu. te dhu suri tèke ètu atora agama miu, peka na, ‘ladhe abhu dhèu dua j'aj'i sakasii dhu padhue j'ara dhu sama, èèna lèke tare'a. '

source_text: i am one that beare witnes of my selfe, and the father that sent me, beareth witnes of me.
target_text: de ja'a mesa ku boe dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a unu ku. te ama ku dhu pua ja'a, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: then saide they vnto him, where is that father of thine? iesus answered, ye neither know me, nor that father of mine. if ye had knowen me, ye should haue knowen that father of mine also.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, te ama èu èèna, ètu mia? ka yesus b'ala, peka na, miu se tadhe iie boe ja'a. miu tadhe boe kahèi ama ku. te ladhe miu tadhe iie ja'a, tatu miu tadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: these wordes spake iesus in the treasurie, as hee taught in the temple, and no man layde handes on him: for his houre was not yet come.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, yesus peka-padhai lod'o nèngu aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, padètu dènge era rèngu kaboko doi kolete. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kèpe ne, lula d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: then saide iesus againe vnto them, i goe my way, and ye shall seeke me, and shall die in your sinnes, whither i goe, can ye not come.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tèke eele miu, ho laku asa era leo. miu èèna na patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe, te miu dhu dènge boe hak sèna ka lami asa era èèna. aa ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: then said the iewes, will he kill himselfe, because he saith, whither i goe, can ye not come?
target_text: hèia ama dhèu yahudi sèra pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, peka na, na padhai lii ngaa, nèi? neo pamadhe iisi na, do? te na peka, na, ‘miu bisa boe lami asa era èèna. '

source_text: and hee saide vnto them, ye are from beneath, i am from aboue: ye are of this world, i am not of this worlde.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu nèti rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. miu dhèu nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa ja'a nèti boe rai-haha ne.

source_text: i said therefore vnto you, that ye shall die in your sinnes: for except ye beleeue, that i am he, ye shall die in your sinnes.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka dènge miu, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala-sasigo miu era. de ladhe miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai, ladhe miu madhe, tatu miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: then saide they vnto him, who art thou? and iesus saide vnto them, euen the same thing that i said vnto you from the beginning.
target_text: ka ra karèi, peka na, weeh! te èu ne, cee? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: i haue many things to say, and to iudge of you: but he that sent me, is true, and the things that i haue heard of him, those speake i to the world.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu ja'a bisa peka lula-nèti miu. sasala miu ae kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pad'elo boe j'ara sèra. te dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, ladhe na padhai lii, ne'a dhoka peka dhu mola di. aa ja'a peka dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti nèngu di.

source_text: they vnderstoode not that hee spake to them of the father.
target_text: dhu nèngu padhue-padhai, nuka ama na ètu sorga. te ngaa dhèu se re'a rare boe sasoa lii padhai na.

source_text: then said iesus vnto them, when ye haue lift vp the sonne of man, then shall ye know that i am he, and that i doe nothing of my selfe, but as my father hath taught me, so i speake these things.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, pe ladhe miu ded'e ka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, heka miu me'a kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus. aa ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a aj'a-nori dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ama ètu sorga aj'a-nori le ja'a.

source_text: for he that sent me, is with me: the father hath not left me alone, because i do alwayes those things that please him.
target_text: dhu pua-paleha ja'a bera-bera dènge ja'a taruu. nèngu tèke eele nèdhi boe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, lula ja'a loe boe sab'a madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: as hee spake these thinges, many beleeued in him.
target_text: ropa yesus peka j'ara se'e, dhèu ae parcaya nèngu.

source_text: then saide iesus to the iewes which beleeued in him, if ye continue in my worde, ye are verely my disciples,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ladhe miu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge lii holo-nori ja'a, aa aj'a taruu nèti ja'a, na, miu bisa j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a dhu lèke.

source_text: and shall know the trueth, and the trueth shall make you free.
target_text: miu bisa me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèra ka dhu patabuli miu, sèna ka miu j'aj'i ia ka ènu.

source_text: they answered him, wee be abrahams seede, and were neuer bonde to any man: why sayest thou then, ye shalbe made free?
target_text: ka dhèu se pab'ala, aku rèngu na, hee! ji'i se, j'aj'i boe ènu dhèu! te ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! de, nga tao ka èu peka, na, èèna na ji'i bebas?

source_text: iesus answered them, verely, verely i say vnto you, that whosoeuer committeth sinne, is the seruant of sinne.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, j'aj'i sama sèmi ènu dhu dhoka madhutu dad'èi sasala di.

source_text: and the seruant abideth not in the house for euer: but the sonne abideth for euer.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tema, sèmi ne'e: ènu se abhu boe pala nèti lamatua èmu na. te dhoka ana lamatua èmu di dhu abhu pala taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: if that sonne therefore shall make you free, ye shalbe free in deede.
target_text: de ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne, ladhe saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, na, miu bebas, aa j'aj'i heka ènu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. dènge j'ara ne, miu madhutu heka dad'èi sasala, aa tare'a-re'a bebas!

source_text: i know that ye are abrahams seede, but yee seeke to kill mee, because my worde hath no place in you.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le miu se, ana-èpu abraham. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu loe boe patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ja'a, lula mo'o boe sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a. te ètu d'ara miu, abhu heka era tatèka lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: i speake that which i haue seene with my father: and ye doe that which ye haue seene with your father.
target_text: ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a kèdhi le, dhu ama ku paj'uj'u le dènge ja'a. aa miu tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu miu tadèngi le nèti ama-ama miu.

source_text: they answered, and saide vnto him, abraham is our father. iesus said vnto them, if ye were abrahams children, ye woulde doe the workes of abraham.
target_text: dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu j'aj'i tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham, miu hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri nèngu.

source_text: but nowe ye goe about to kill mee, a man that haue told you the trueth, which i haue heard of god: this did not abraham.
target_text: te ngaa abraham tao boe bhabhelu sama sèmi dhu miu tao! te miu loe boe tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a. aa te ngaa ja'a ne, dhu peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: ye do the workes of your father. then said they to him, we are not borne of fornication: we haue one father, which is god.
target_text: tatao miu se mema beda boe nèti tatao ama miu. te ngaa rèngu pab'ala, aku rèngu na, heh! ji'i se, ana d'èlu! baku peka na ji'i se, ana ama aad'o! te ama ji'i, èci di, nuka ama lamatua!

source_text: therefore iesus sayde vnto them, if god were your father, then woulde ye loue mee: for i proceeded foorth, and came from god, neither came i of my selfe, but he sent me.
target_text: hèia, aku yesus na, ladhe ama lamatua tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ama miu, tatu miu sue ja'a. te ja'a mai nèti nèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a ka ne'e ne. ja'a mai ne madhutu boe dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a mai, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: why doe ye not vnderstande my talke? because ye cannot heare my worde.
target_text: nga tao ka miu dhane mere boe lii padhai ja'a? ele boe, lula miu mema mo'o boe nanene!

source_text: ye are of your father the deuill, and the lustes of your father ye will doe: hee hath bene a murtherer from the beginning, and abode not in the trueth, because there is no trueth in him. when hee speaketh a lie, then speaketh hee of his owne: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
target_text: miu se, ca ropa dènge dhèu aae nidhu. te miu d'èi madhutu dad'èi na! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, nèngu d'èi dhoka pamadhe dhèu. nèngu lab'a j'ara dhu lèke, lula na tule eele j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke! ladhe na kapod'e-kabèli, mema sasab'a na kèna. te nèngu ne, tuka kapod'e-kabèli, aa baki nèti leko-monya!

source_text: and because i tell you the trueth, yee beleeue me not.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu lole j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ja'a.

source_text: which of you can rebuke me of sinne? and if i say the trueth, why do ye not beleeue me?
target_text: pangee sèku! nèti miu se, cee ka dhu bisa pad'elo bukti, peka na, ja'a ne ad'u-ue sasala? malaa, nga! ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a?

source_text: he that is of god, heareth gods wordes: yee therefore heare them not, because ye are not of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i nèti ama lamatua nanene lii holo-nori na. te ngaa miu se j'aj'i boe nèti ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mo'o boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: then answered the iewes, and said vnto him, say we not well that thou art a samaritane, and hast a deuil?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi b'ala, peka na, lii padhai ji'i lèke tare'a-re'a. te ji'i dhu peka le, na, èu ne, dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa dhèu samaria. èu ne nidhu tao!

source_text: iesus answered, i haue not a deuil, but i honour my father, and ye haue dishonoured me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a nidhu tao boe. ja'a pakab'ua ama ku ètu sorga, te ngaa miu mo'o boe pakab'ua ja'a.

source_text: and i seeke not mine owne praise: but there is one that seeketh it, and iudgeth.
target_text: ja'a padedha boe iisi ho pad'elo kolo-karisi ja'a. te ngaa abhu èci dhu neo pad'elo dadedha ja'a. hud'i laa nèngu ka dhu pama'ète, na, lii padhai ja'a ne lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: verely, verely i say vnto you, if a man keepe my word, he shall neuer see death.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a, lèke tare'a. de dhèu dhu nanene aa tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe.

source_text: then said the iewes to him, now know we that thou hast a deuill. abraham is dead, and the prophets: and thou sayest, if a man keepe my worde, he shall neuer taste of death.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii ne, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, limuri ne ji'i nge'a le èu dhèu huj'u, lula nidhu tao le èu. te abraham, madhe. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, madhe le kahèi. te ngaa aku èu, na, ‘dhèu dhu nanene dènge madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe. ' mema èu ne tare'a-re'a huj'u le!

source_text: art thou greater then our father abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whome makest thou thy selfe?
target_text: do, èu ne pangee, na, èu ne kapai risi nèti abraham dhu madhe le? do, èu kapai risi nèti dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu madhe sèra? èu ngee, na, èu ne, cee?

source_text: iesus answered, if i honour my selfe, mine honour is nothing worth: it is my father that honoureth me, whome ye say, that hee is your god.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe ja'a ka dhu padedha iisi, dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare. madhutu iia-iia, na, ja'a boe ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha iisi, te ngaa dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha nuka ama ku. nèngu ne'e ka dhu miu mangaku, na, nèngu j'aj'i ama lamatua miu.

source_text: yet ye haue not knowen him: but i knowe him, and if i should say i know him not, i should be a liar like vnto you: but i knowe him, and keepe his worde.
target_text: te ngaa miu tadhe boe ne. dhu tadhe mèu ka ja'a ne. ladhe ja'a peka na ja'a tadhe boe ne, ja'a leko-monya, sama sèmi miu. te ngaa ja'a tadhe mèu ne, aa ja'a tao madhutu lii holo-nori na kahèi.

source_text: your father abraham reioyced to see my day, and he sawe it, and was glad.
target_text: d'ara baki miu abraham karej'e titu kèna, lod'o na tatae neo nèdhi mamai ja'a. nèngu mema nèdhi le, ka na karej'e-karae.

source_text: then sayd ye iewes vnto him, thou art not yet fiftie yeere olde, and hast thou seene abraham?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi se b'ala ne, aku rèngu na, umur èu dhae d'ai mèka lèmi nguru tèu sa hèi! te ngaa èu peka na, mèdhi le abraham. tare'a, do?

source_text: iesus sayd vnto them, verely, verely i say vnto you, before abraham was, i am.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te dhae rara iisi mèka abraham, ja'a dhu mema-mema le.

source_text: then tooke they vp stones, to cast at him, but iesus hid himselfe, and went out of the temple: and hee passed through the middes of them, and so went his way.
target_text: ka dhèu se rare hadhu ho neo pèci ne, lula na tao iisi sama sèmi ama lamatua. te ngaa yesus kako mau-mau kalua nèti madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and as iesus passed by, he sawe a man which was blinde from his birth.
target_text: hèia yesus si kako taruu. ka na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu, dhu bèdhu karèi nèti ina na nara iisi nèngu.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, saying, master, who did sinne, this man, or his parents, that he was borne blinde?
target_text: hèia ana-ana madhutu na karèi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! cee ka tao sasala, ka dhèu ne bèdhu? nèti nèngu mesa na, do, nèti ina-ama na?

source_text: iesus answered, neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents, but that the workes of god should be shewed on him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu bèdhu ne tao boe sala. aa ina-ama na aad'o kahèi. rara iisi na sèmi ne'e, ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi tatao ama lamatua dhu be'a mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: i must worke the workes of him that sent me, while it is day: the night commeth when no man can worke.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a. de èdhi hud'i tenge j'ara, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na, lod'o saraa era. te ladhe maroga mai, dhèu bisa heka sab'a.

source_text: as long as i am in the world, i am the light of the world.
target_text: ropa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era, ja'a nuka sèmi saraa dhu d'elo hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: assoone as he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spettle, and anointed the eyes of the blinde with the clay,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka na paru'e ilu mi rai. hèia na madhèdi pasaboti, ho pakihu rai ne j'aj'i kabheca. ka na lame musi madha dhèu ne dènge kabheca deo na.

source_text: and sayd vnto him, go wash in the poole of siloam which is by interpretation, sent. he went his way therefore, and washed, and came againe seeing.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, lamu asa kolam siloam, sèna ka riu rèhu èu. ètu d'ara lii ibrani, siloam, sasoa na, ‘nèti mai'. ka dhèu bèdhu ne la'e, ka riu rèhu na. ropa na lèpa hari mai, nèngu bisa nèdhi le!

source_text: nowe the neighbours and they that had seene him before, when he was blinde, sayd, is not this he that sate and begged?
target_text: hèia rae lesa dènge dhèu dhu rèdhi ne, dhu tema manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu bèdhu dhu tema madhèdi ho kanata ai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, sina ma?

source_text: some said, this is he: and other sayd, he is like him: but he himselfe sayd, i am he.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e dhaa, peka na, oo! nèngu ka! dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, rèhu na oe sèmi dhèu èèna! te ngaa dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! ja'a èèna ka, ne'e ne! dhu uru èèna bèdhu!

source_text: therefore they sayd vnto him, howe were thine eyes opened?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi?

source_text: he answered, and sayd, the man that is called iesus, made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and sayde vnto me, goe to the poole of siloam and wash. so i went and washed, and receiued sight.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu dhu ngara yesus èèna, pakihu kabheca ka lame mi musi madha ja'a. ka na pua ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘lamu asa kolam siloam, ho riu rèhu èu ètu nèi. ' hèia ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa ladhe kèdhi le!

source_text: then they sayd vnto him, where is he? he sayd, i can not tell.
target_text: èle ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia? ka na dhaa, ke'a boe, mia la'e!

source_text: they brought to the pharises him that was once blinde. and it was the sabbath day, when iesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa yesus pakihu rai j'aj'i kabheca, ka puri-pa'èle dhèu bèdhu ho bisa ladhe nèdhi èèna, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka lere rèti dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, asa madha dhèu-dhèu partei agama parisi.

source_text: then againe the pharises also asked him, how he had receiued sight. and hee sayd vnto them, he layd clay vpon mine eyes, and i washed, and doe see.
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi ne, èu lolo ku laa! tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi? dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu èèna tao kabheca mi musi madha ja'a. ka laku riu rèhu. hèia limuri ne, ja'a bisa kèdhi le.

source_text: then said some of the pharises, this man is not of god, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. others sayd, howe can a man that is a sinner, doe such miracles? and there was a dissension among them.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu parisi cahag'e, peka na, dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle èu èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. ji'i nge'a, lula nèngu sisu atora nèti lod'o a'ae sasab'a. aa abhu cahag'e hari, peka na, tasamia ka dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa sèmi sèra? ka rèngu patao-palaha èci dènge èci toke ra pahag'a.

source_text: then spake they vnto the blinde againe, what sayest thou of him, because he hath opened thine eyes? and he sayd, he is a prophet.
target_text: hèia ra karèi hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, aku rèngu na, madhutu a'abhu èu, dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a musi madha èu ne, dhèu sèmi ngaa sa? dhèu ne b'ala, peka na, madhutu a'abhu ja'a, dhèu èèna ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: then the iewes did not beleeue him that he had bene blinde, and receiued his sight vntill they had called the parents of him that had receiued sight.
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe lèka, na, dhèu ne uru èèna bèdhu, ka limuri ne bisa nèdhi le. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ina-ama na mai.

source_text: and they asked them, saying, is this your sonne, whom ye say was borne blinde? how doeth he nowe see then?
target_text: ropa ina-ama na mai d'ai madha si, hèia ama-ama se karèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, ana miu, do? tare'a, do aad'o, nèngu ne dhu bèdhu mema karèi nèti mera iisi ne? tasamia ka limuri ne nèngu bisa ladhe nèdhi?

source_text: his parents answered them, and sayd, we know that this is our sonne, and that he was borne blinde:
target_text: ka ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu ne, mema ana ji'i. aa na bèdhu karèi nèti ngara iisi ne.

source_text: but by what meanes hee nowe seeth, we know not: or who hath opened his eyes, can we not tell: he is olde ynough: aske him: hee shall answere for himselfe.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe, na pake ngaa ka musi madha na bisa nèdhi sèmi ne'e. cee ka dhu puri-pa'èle musi madha na, ji'i nge'a boe kahèi. nèngu kapai le, de karèi ne, te nèngu bisa lolo unu na!

source_text: these wordes spake his parents, because they feared the iewes: for the iewes had ordeined already, that if any man did confesse that he was christ, he should be excommunicate out of the synagogue.
target_text: dua ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. lula re'a, na, ama-ama dhèu yahudi se dhu rare le lii èci, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu mangaku, na, yesus ne, nuka kristus, na, babège eele dhèu sèra nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: therefore sayde his parents, hee is olde ynough: aske him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu kapai le. de karèi ne.

source_text: then againe called they the man that had bene blinde, and sayd vnto him, giue glory vnto god: we know that this man is a sinner.
target_text: hèia ra paroa hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu. ka ra karèi ne, sèmi ne'e! èu hud'i peka ku mola-mola ètu madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aga paie kolongara na. te ji'i nge'a, na, yesus ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: then he answered, and sayd, whether hee be a sinner or no, i can not tell: one thing i know, that i was blinde, and nowe i see.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ama si baku nasa! te ja'a ke'a boe, na, nèngu èèna, dhèu bhelu, do aad'o. dhu ja'a ke'a mola-mola, nuka, uru èèna ja'a bèdhu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: then sayd they to him againe, what did he to thee? howe opened he thine eyes?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, te na tao èu tasamia? tasamia na bhoke musi madha èu?

source_text: hee answered them, i haue tolde you already, and yee haue not heard it: wherefore would yee heare it againe? will yee also be his disciples?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, eee! te deo na ja'a lole le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe nanene. tasamia ka miu neo ja'a lolo hari? ele boe ama si neo j'aj'i ana madhutu na, do?

source_text: then reuiled they him, and sayd, be thou his disciple: we be moses disciples.
target_text: ka ra padhai pa-aape ne, hèia ra peka, hud'i laa èu ka j'aj'i ana madhutu na! te ji'i se, ana madhutu musa.

source_text: we know that god spake with moses: but this man we know not from whence he is.
target_text: ji'i nge'a ama lamatua ka dhu padhai lii dènge musa. te ngaa nge'a boe dhèu èèna bhodho nèti ro'a mia.

source_text: the man answered, and sayde vnto them, doutlesse, this is a marueilous thing, that ye know not whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu na, dhaa, ja'a malaa, nga! miu me'a boe nèngu mai nèti mia. aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu bhoke pamèu musi madha ja'a, ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: now we know that god heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of god, and doeth his will, him heareth he.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, na, ama lamatua parluu boe nanene lii dhèu bhelu, si? te ngaa ama lamatua nanene dhèu d'ara mola, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: since the world began, was it not heard, that any man opened the eyes of one that was borne blinde.
target_text: karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e, abhu mèka lii lolo èci sa hèi, lula-nèti dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a dhèu bèdhu karèi rara iisi ne, ho nèngu bisa nèdhi.

source_text: if this man were not of god, hee could haue done nothing.
target_text: de ladhe yesus mai boe nèti ama lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, sina ma?

source_text: they answered, and sayd vnto him, thou art altogether borne in sinnes, and doest thou teach vs? so they cast him out.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! èu ne, dhèu bhelu karèi ina mu nara iisi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa aj'a hari ji'i, do? ka ra babège eele dhèu ne nèti èmu sabaj'a rèngu.

source_text: iesus heard that they had cast him out: and when he had found him, he sayd vnto him, doest thou beleeue in the sonne of god?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi rèngu babège eele dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu nèti èmu sabaj'a ra, hèia na la'e tenge dhèu ne, toke abhu. ka na peka, tasamia! èu parcaya dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, do?

source_text: he answered, and sayd, who is he, lord, that i might beleeue in him?
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari ne, aku nèngu na, ama, te nèngu èèna cee? peka ku laa, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne.

source_text: and iesus sayd vnto him, both thou hast seene him, and he it is that talketh with thee.
target_text: hèia yesus peka, na, èu paraga le dènge ne. nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a ne, dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: then he sayd, lord, i beleeue, and worshipped him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a parcaya! hèia na patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi mi yesus.

source_text: and iesus sayd, i am come vnto iudgement into this world, that they which see not, might see: and that they which see, might be made blinde.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka pad'elo sasala-sasigo dhèu, ho dhèu bèdhu bisa ladhe rèdhi, aa dhèu dhu rèdhi bisa j'aj'i bèdhu.

source_text: and some of the pharises which were with him, heard these things, and sayd vnto him, are we blinde also?
target_text: ètu era èèna abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, tasamia! ji'i se bèdhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: iesus sayd vnto them, if ye were blinde, ye should not haue sinne: but nowe ye say, we see: therefore your sinne remaineth.
target_text: yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe musi madha miu bèdhu, abhu boe dhu pasala miu. te ngaa lula miu peka, na, miu bisa mèdhi, nèti èèna ka miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: verely, verely i say vnto you, hee that entreth not in by the doore into the sheepefolde, but climeth vp another way, he is a theefe and a robber.
target_text: yesus padhai lii pake lii pakasame, peka na, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. abhu kahib'i-kalèbho dènge oka ra. ladhe dhèu maso boe re hèb'a oka, te ngaa ca'e re kolo oka, na, te'a le, nèngu ne, dhèu mana'u.

source_text: but he that goeth in by the doore, is the shepheard of the sheepe.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe maso re hèb'a oka, nuka dhèu madhenga dhu piara kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: to him the porter openeth, and the sheepe heare his voyce, and he calleth his owne sheepe by name, and leadeth them out.
target_text: dhèu j'aga hèb'a oka, tadhe dhèu madhenga kahib'i-kalèbho, hèia na bhoke babèdho hia nèngu. kahib'i-kalèbho se tadhe lii dhèu madhenga badha kahèi. ka ropa dhèu madhenga ne paroa ngara ra èci-èci, kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne asa li'u.

source_text: and when hee hath sent foorth his owne sheepe, he goeth before them, and the sheepe follow him: for they know his voyce.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhenga ne neo nèti si asa mia, nèngu kako uuru. kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne re limuri, lula ra tadhe lii na.

source_text: and they will not follow a stranger, but they flee from him: for they know not the voyce of strangers.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kahib'i-kalèbho tadhe boe, na, rèngu madhutu boe ne. te ngaa ra rai pakaj'èu, lula rèngu tadhe boe lii dhèu leo.

source_text: this parable spake iesus vnto them: but they vnderstoode not what things they were which he spake vnto them.
target_text: masi ka yesus lole lii pakasame ne hia dhèu se'e, te ngaa re'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: then sayd iesus vnto them againe, verely, verely i say vnto you, i am that doore of the sheepe.
target_text: ka yesus peka tabha hari dènge dhèu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a lole dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ja'a ne nuka sèmi hèb'a oka kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: all, that euer came before me, are theeues and robbers: but the sheepe did not heare them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai uuru nèti ja'a, rèngu sama sèmi dhèu mana'u. masi ka rèngu loe boe paroa, te ngaa kahib'i-kalèbho se nanene boe lii rèngu.

source_text: i am that doore: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saued, and shall go in, and go out, and finde pasture.
target_text: aa ja'a ne èci èèna ka dènge hèb'a oka èèna. ladhe abhu dhèu neo maso re ja'a, ama lamatua neo patabuli ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. èèna sama sèmi nèngu la'e asa era ama lamatua, maso re ja'a dhu j'aj'i hèb'a oka. aa dhèu dhu maso re ja'a, nèngu neo asa mia èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, dènge abhu na'a-ninu dhu be'a.

source_text: the theefe commeth not, but for to steale, and to kill, and to destroy: i am come that they might haue life, and haue it in abundance.
target_text: dhèu mana'u re'a dhoka tao maruru di, te rèngu mai ho mana'u, pamadhe dhèu, aa pa'ele iie mamuri dhèu. te ngaa ja'a kèti mamuri dhu hua iia titu kèna, te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mera-milu, aa unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: i am that good shepheard: that good shepheard giueth his life for his sheepe.
target_text: ja'a kahèi nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. te dhèu madhenga dhu be'a, sadia saraka ngi'u na toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho na bisa mamuri.

source_text: but an hireling, and hee which is not the shepheard, neither the sheepe are his owne, seeth the wolfe comming, and hee leaueth the sheepe, and fleeth, and the wolfe catcheth them, and scattreth the sheepe.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu lamatua boe nèti kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, ropa nèdhi busa hui mai, na rai pakaj'èu, tèke eele kahib'i-kalèbho se. hèia busa hui ne kadhi nare kahib'i-kalèbho, ka rèngu cahag'e rai paceb'a.

source_text: so the hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheepe.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èèna rai, lula nèngu dhoka sab'a tenge doi di. na pusi-pahae boe j'aga paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: i am that good shepheard, and knowe mine, and am knowen of mine.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ja'a ne nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. ja'a tadhe hua iia kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a sèra. aa rèngu tadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: as the father knoweth me, so know i the father: and i lay downe my life for my sheepe.
target_text: èèna, èci èèna ka dènge ama ku ètu sorga tadhe ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe nèngu kahèi. ja'a sadia kore le ho soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a bisa mamuri.

source_text: other sheepe i haue also, which are not of this folde: them also must i bring, and they shall heare my voyce: and there shalbe one sheepefolde, and one shepheard.
target_text: abhu kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu leo era, dhu dhae kaboko kore mèka sèna ka pa'èci dènge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu se'e se. ja'a hud'i eo pa'oru kore si mi ca era kahèi. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii ja'a, rèngu tadhe dènge. hèia ra mai pa'èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ca kaboko dhu dènge dhèu madhenga èci.

source_text: therefore doeth my father loue me, because i lay downe my life, that i might take it againe.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a. te ja'a dhu sadia le soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: no man taketh it from me, but i lay it downe of my selfe: i haue power to lay it downe, and haue power to take it againe: this commandement haue i receiued of my father.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu laka-seti ja'a ho madhe, te ngaa ja'a mesa ku soro iisi la'a toke madhe. ja'a dènge hak ho soro ngi'u ja'a, aa dènge hak kahèi sèna ka kore hari. paredha ne, dhu ja'a sèmi kore le nèti ama ku ètu sorga.

source_text: then there was a dissension againe among the iewes for these sayings,
target_text: lula dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi se pab'ala hari isi-aanga ra.

source_text: and many of them sayd, he hath a deuill, and is mad: why heare ye him?
target_text: abhu dhèu ae nèti rèngu dhu peka na, dhèu ne, huj'u! aa nidhu tao ne! nga tao ka miu d'èi nanene ne?

source_text: other sayd, these are not the wordes of him that hath a deuill: can the deuill open the eyes of the blinde?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e peka na, ne'e ne nèti boe lii padhai dhèu huj'u, sina ma? lii padhai sèmi se'e se, kalua boe nèti d'ara hèb'a nidhu! aa nidhu sèra bisa boe kahèi puri-pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu, si?

source_text: and it was at hierusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi neo tao kalela agama rèngu. lod'o be'a ne, lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. pesta ne, pasanèd'e dhèu yahudi lod'o dhu dhèu leo mai pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra pamèu ne sèna ka ringi hari ca tèka.

source_text: and iesus walked in the temple, in salomons porche.
target_text: yesus kako palème ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, ètu era dhu ra pangare na, ‘paleo dhèu aae soleman'.

source_text: then came the iewes round about him, and sayd vnto him, howe long doest thou make vs dout? if thou be that christ, tell vs plainely.
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: iesus answered them, i tolde you, and ye beleeue not: the workes that i doe in my fathers name, they beare witnes of me.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: but ye beleeue not: for ye are not of my sheepe, as i sayd vnto you.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: my sheepe heare my voyce, and i knowe them, and they follow me,
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and i giue vnto them eternall life, and they shall neuer perish, neither shall any plucke them out of mine hand.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: my father which gaue them me, is greater then all, and none is able to take them out of my fathers hand.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: i and my father are one.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: then ye iewes againe tooke vp stones, to stone him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: iesus answered them, many good workes haue i shewed you from my father: for which of these workes doe ye stone me?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the iewes answered him, saying, for the good worke we stone thee not, but for blasphemie, and that thou being a man, makest thy selfe god.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: iesus answered them, is it not written in your lawe, i sayd, ye are gods?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: if hee called them gods, vnto whome the worde of god was giuen, and the scripture cannot be broken,
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: say ye of him, whome the father hath sanctified, and sent into the worlde, thou blasphemest, because i said, i am the sonne of god?
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i doe not the workes of my father, beleeue me not.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but if i doe, then though ye beleeue not mee, yet beleeue the workes, that ye may knowe and beleeue, that the father is in me, and i in him.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: againe they went about to take him: but he escaped out of their handes,
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: and went againe beyonde iordan, into the place where iohn first baptized, and there abode.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: and many resorted vnto him, and saide, iohn did no miracle: but all thinges that iohn spake of this man, were true.
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and many beleeued in him there.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: and a certaine man was sicke, named lazarus of bethania, the towne of marie, and her sister martha. and it was that mary which anointed the lord with oyntment, and wiped his feete with her heare, whose brother lazarus was sicke.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: therefore his sisters sent vnto him, saying, lord, beholde, he whome thou louest, is sicke.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: when iesus heard it, he saide, this sickenes is not vnto death, but for the glorie of god, that the sonne of god might be glorified thereby.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: nowe iesus loued martha and her sister, and lazarus.
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: and after he had heard that he was sicke, yet abode hee two dayes still in the same place where he was.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: then after that, said he to his disciples, let vs goe into iudea againe.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: the disciples saide vnto him, master, the iewes lately sought to stone thee, and doest thou goe thither againe?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: iesus answered, are there not twelue houres in the day? if a man walke in the day, hee stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: but if a man walke in the night, hee stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: these things spake he, and after, he said vnto them, our friend lazarus sleepeth: but i goe to wake him vp.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: then said his disciples, lord, if he sleepe, he shalbe safe.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: howbeit, iesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of the naturall sleepe.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: then saide iesus vnto them plainely, lazarus is dead.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: and i am glad for your sakes, that i was not there, that ye may beleeue: but let vs go vnto him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: then saide thomas which is called didymus vnto his felow disciples, let vs also goe, that we may die with him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: then came iesus, and found that he had lien in the graue foure dayes alreadie. nowe bethania was neere vnto hierusalem, about fifteene furlongs off. and many of ye iewes were come to martha and marie to comfort them for their brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: then martha, when shee heard that iesus was comming, went to meete him: but mary sate still in the house.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: then said martha vnto iesus, lord, if thou hadst bene here, my brother had not bene dead.
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: but now i know also, that whatsoeuer thou askest of god, god will giue it thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: iesus said vnto her, thy brother shall rise againe.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: martha said vnto him, i know that he shall rise againe in the resurrection at the last day.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: iesus saide vnto her, i am the resurrection and the life: he that beleeueth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he liue.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: and whosoeuer liueth, and beleeueth in me, shall neuer die: beleeuest thou this?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: she said vnto him, yea, lord, i beleeue that thou art that christ that sonne of god, which should come into the world.
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when she had so saide, she went her way, and called mary her sister secretly, saying, the master is come, and calleth for thee.
target_text: ropa marta padhai lii nare, hèia na lèpa asa èmu na. ka na paroa ari na maria, sèna ka dua ra mesa-mesa ra. ka na peka, na, ama mese mai le. nèngu neo paraga dènge èu.

source_text: and when she heard it, shee arose quickly, and came vnto him. for iesus was not yet come into the towne, but was in the place where martha met him. the iewes then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they sawe marie, that she rose vp hastily, and went out, folowed her, saying, she goeth vnto the graue, to weepe there.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia maria la'e dènge ka tenge yesus. ropa dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria ètu d'ara èmu, rèdhi nèngu kèd'i sahèka, ka rai li'u la'e, hèia lasi madhutu ne re limuri. te rèngu pangee, na, maria la'e tangi asa ro'a lasarus. lod'o èèna, yesus si d'ai mèka d'ara rae. nèngu ètu era dhu marta paraga dènge ne.

source_text: then when mary was come where iesus was, and sawe him, she fell downe at his feete, saying vnto him, lord, if thou haddest bene here, my brother had not bene dead.
target_text: ropa maria la'e d'ai era èèna, ka ladhe nèdhi yesus. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sèmi ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: when iesus therefore saw her weepe, and the iewes also weepe which came with her, hee groned in the spirit, and was troubled in himselfe,
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi maria tangi, aa dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu ne tangi kahèi, ka yesus nasa aa d'ara na susa.

source_text: and saide, where haue ye layde him? they said vnto him, lord, come and see.
target_text: hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu padhane ne ètu mia? ra dhaa, peka na, mai, ama! sèna ka mèdhi unu mu.

source_text: and iesus wept.
target_text: hèia yesus tangi.

source_text: then saide the iewes, beholde, how he loued him.
target_text: ka dhèu yahudi se papeka, aku rèngu na, ladhe ku laa. na sue lasarus titu kèna!

source_text: and some of them saide, coulde not he, which opened the eyes of the blinde, haue made also, that this man should not haue died?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e dhu papeka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu hia dhèu bèdhu bisa nèdhi. nga tao ka nèngu bisa boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka lasarus baku madhe?

source_text: iesus therefore againe groned in himselfe, and came to the graue. and it was a caue, and a stone was layde vpon it.
target_text: ka d'ara yesus susa. hèia la'e padètu-dètu asa ro'a dhu ra padhane lasarus. ro'a ne dhu ra katange le dènge hadhu aae cue.

source_text: iesus saide, take ye away the stone. martha the sister of him that was dead, said vnto him, lord, he stinketh alreadie: for he hath bene dead foure dayes.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, loli eele ku hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne! te ngaa marta, ana hèni dhèu madhe ne, peka, aku nèngu na, irii, ama! na madhe èpa lod'o kèna! tatu hèu le.

source_text: iesus saide vnto her, saide i not vnto thee, that if thou diddest beleeue, thou shouldest see the glorie of god?
target_text: ka yesus pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e lii ja'a deo na, si? ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, ladhe èu tare'a-re'a parcaya ja'a, pe mèdhi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: then they tooke away the stone from the place where the dead was layde. and iesus lift vp his eyes, and saide, father, i thanke thee, because thou hast heard me.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: i knowe that thou hearest me alwayes, but because of the people that stand by, i said it, that they may beleeue, that thou hast sent me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: as hee had spoken these things, hee cried with a loude voyce, lazarus, come foorth.
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: then he that was dead, came forth, bound hande and foote with bandes, and his face was bound with a napkin. iesus said vnto them, loose him, and let him goe.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: then many of the iewes, which came to mary, and had seene the thinges, which iesus did, beleeued in him.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of them went their way to the pharises, and told them what things iesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: then gathered the hie priests, and the pharises a councill, and said, what shall we doe? for this man doeth many miracles.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we let him thus alone, all men will beleeue in him, and the romanes will come and take away both our place, and the nation.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: then one of them named caiaphas, which was the hie priest that same yere, said vnto them, ye perceiue nothing at all,
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: nor yet doe you consider that it is expedient for vs, that one man die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: this spake hee not of himselfe: but being hie priest that same yere, he prophecied that iesus should die for that nation:
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and not for that nation onely, but that he shoulde gather together in one the children of god, which were scattered.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: then from that day foorth they consulted together, to put him to death.
target_text: lula lii padhai kayafas ne'e ka, karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ama-ama dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: iesus therefore walked no more openly among the iewes, but went thence vnto a countrey neere to the wildernes, into a citie called ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e heka asa madha dhèu ae ètu talora ama-ama dhèu yahudi. nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na lasi asa d'ara kota èci, ngara na efraim, padètu dènge d'ara mamoo. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna.

source_text: and the iewes passeouer was at hande, and many went out of the countrey vp to hierusalem before the passeouer, to purifie themselues.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela paska agama yahudi. dhu tema le, d'ai lod'o sèmi èèna, dhèu ae nèti rae-rae mai pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. dhèu se d'ai uru, ho pamèu iisi madhutu atora agama.

source_text: then sought they for iesus, and spake among themselues, as they stoode in the temple, what thinke ye, that he cometh not to the feast?
