target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when pilate then heard that woorde, he was the more afraide,
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: and went againe into the common hall, and saide vnto iesus, whence art thou? but iesus gaue him none answere.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: then saide pilate vnto him, speakest thou not vnto me? knowest thou not that i haue power to crucifie thee, and haue power to loose thee?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: iesus answered, thou couldest haue no power at all against me, except it were giuen thee from aboue: therefore he that deliuered me vnto thee, hath the greater sinne.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: from thence foorth pilate sought to loose him, but the iewes cried, saying, if thou deliuer him, thou art not cesars friende: for whosoeuer maketh himselfe a king, speaketh against cesar.
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate heard this woorde, hee brought iesus foorth, and sate downe in the iudgement seate in a place called the pauement, and in hebrewe, gabbatha.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: and it was the preparation of the passeouer, and about the sixt houre: and hee sayde vnto the iewes, beholde your king.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: but they cried, away with him, away with him, crucifie him. pilate sayde vnto them, shall i crucifie your king? the high priestes answered, we haue no king but cesar.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: then deliuered he him vnto them, to be crucified. and they tooke iesus, and led him away.
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: and he bare his owne crosse, and came into a place named of dead mens skulles, which is called in hebrewe, golgotha:
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and iesus in the middes.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and pilate wrote also a title, and put it on the crosse, and it was written, jesus of nazareth the king of the jewes.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: this title then read many of the iewes: for the place where iesus was crucified, was neere to the citie: and it was written in hebrewe, greeke and latine.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: then saide the hie priests of the iewes to pilate, write not, the king of the iewes, but that he sayd, i am king of the iewes.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: pilate answered, what i haue written, i haue written.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: then the souldiers, when they had crucified iesus, tooke his garments and made foure partes, to euery souldier a part and his coat: and the coat was without seame wouen from the toppe throughout.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: therefore they sayde one to another, let vs not deuide it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be. this was that the scripture might be fulfilled, which sayth, they parted my garments among them, and on my coate did cast lots. so the souldiers did these things in deede.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: then stoode by the crosse of iesus his mother, and his mothers sister, marie the wife of cleopas, and marie magdalene.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: and when iesus sawe his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loued, he said vnto his mother, woman, beholde thy sonne.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: then saide he to the disciple, beholde thy mother: and from that houre, the disciple tooke her home vnto him.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: after, when iesus knew that all things were performed, that the scripture might be fulfilled, he said, i thirst.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.

source_text: and there was set a vessell full of vineger: and they filled a spondge with vineger: and put it about an hyssope stalke, and put it to his mouth.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu èi anggor manyilu ètu d'ara g'ala iiki cue. ka sordad'u sèra rare ula ho cèb'u asa èi anggor, hèia èki mi suu aj'u ca laa, ka j'ole asa hèb'a na.

source_text: nowe when iesus had receiued of the vineger, he saide, it is finished, and bowed his head, and gaue vp the ghost.
target_text: ropa yesus camuci nare, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èle kèna. hèia kètu na loe, ka ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: the iewes then because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remaine vpon the crosse on the sabbath day: for that sabbath was an hie day besought pilate that their legges might be broken, and that they might be taken downe.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke hari jumat. madhutu atora agama, dhèu yahudi hud'i sadia mema d'ara lod'o èèna, sèna ka bèli èèna rèngu soru lod'o sabaj'a ra. nèti èèna ka, ro'o boe tèke eele ngi'u aae dhèu madhe, kadhoe tèke ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. te lod'o sabaj'a èèna, lod'o be'a. de ama-ama dhèu yahudi manèngi gubernur, sèna ka pua dhèu lasi hake papadhe haga dhèu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, rèngu madhe malai, ho dhèu bisa papuru ngi'u aae ra nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ako lod'o aae era.

source_text: then came the souldiers and brake the legges of the first, and of the other, which was crucified with iesus.
target_text: hèia sordad'u se lasi asa era èèna. ka ra hake papadhe uru haga dhèu dua sèra, dhu paku sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: but when they came to iesus, and saw that he was dead alreadie, they brake not his legges.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ra d'ai yesus, rèdhi, na, yesus dhu madhe le. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hake papadhe boe haga na.

source_text: but one of the souldiers with a speare pearced his side, and foorthwith came there out blood and water.
target_text: te ngaa sordad'u ca dhèu nare kapoke na, hèia kèj'i d'ara karasa yesus. ka raa kalua, aa èi kalua kahèi.

source_text: and he that sawe it, bare recorde, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might beleeue it.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu ladhe kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. ja'a kèdhi aa'i, aa dhu ja'a suri ne lèke tare'a-re'a. te ja'a ke'a mèu ngaa dhu ja'a lolo ne lèke mola-mola, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: for these things were done, that the scripture shoulde be fulfilled, not a bone of him shalbe broken.
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, na, rui na ca laa sa, padhe boe.

source_text: and againe an other scripture saith, they shall see him whom they haue thrust through.
target_text: ètu era leo d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ne, suri kahèi, peka na, èèna rèngu ladhe rèdhi dhèu dhu ra kèj'i ne.

source_text: and after these things, ioseph of arimathea who was a disciple of iesus, but secretly for feare of the iewes besought pilate that he might take downe the bodie of iesus. and pilate gaue him licence. he came then and tooke iesus body.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci ngara na yusuf, nèti rae arimatea. nèngu ana madhutu yesus kahèi. te ngaa na madhutu pahuni-pahuni, lula madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. yusuf la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi ijin sèna ka bisa nèti ngi'u aae yesus. gubernur d'èi kahèi. ka yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus, hèia ded'e nèti.

source_text: and there came also nicodemus which first came to iesus by night and brought of myrrhe and aloes mingled together about an hundreth pound.
target_text: nikodemus la'e sama-sama dènge yusuf kahèi. nikodemus ne'e ka dhu uru èèna la'e paraga dènge yesus re mèda. na hèli rampe ae titu kèna, pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèlu kilo sa, sèna ka tao mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then tooke they the body of iesus, and wrapped it in linnen clothes with the odours, as the maner of the iewes is to burie.
target_text: hèia ra hèlu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla halus. ladhe hèlu ca tèka, ra tao rampe la'a. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi ladhe padhane dhèu madhe.

source_text: and in that place where iesus was crucified, was a garden, and in the garden a newe sepulchre, wherein was neuer man yet laid.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era yesus madhe ne, abhu oka bunga cue. ètu d'ara oka ne, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a dhèu madhe kèna. ra padhane rèdhi mèka dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara ro'a èèna.

source_text: there then laide they iesus, because of the iewes preparation day, for the sepulchre was neere.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lod'o sadia dhèu yahudi ho soru lod'o sabaj'a ra, oe èle kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se tèke ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, te era èèna kaj'èu boe.

source_text: nowe the first day of the weeke came marie magdalene, early when it was yet darke, vnto the sepulchre, and sawe the stone taken away from the tombe.
target_text: hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. mad'ae aae era, maria nèti rae magdala la'e asa ro'a yesus. d'ai era èèna, ladhe nèdhi hadhu aae dhu pake katange ro'a, hari eele nèti era na.

source_text: then she ranne, and came to simon peter, and to the other disciple whom iesus loued, and saide vnto them, they haue taken away the lord out of the sepulchre, and we knowe not where they haue laid him.
target_text: hèia na rai lèpa hari la'e paraga dènge simon petrus aa dènge ja'a, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue, ka na peka, dhèu mana'u rèti le lamatua èdhi nèti ro'a na! te'a boe rèngu tèke ne ètu mia!

source_text: peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and they came vnto the sepulchre.
target_text: ka ja'a dènge petrus rai la'a asa era ro'a èèna.

source_text: so they ranne both together, but the other disciple did outrunne peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
target_text: ji'i rai palere-lere, te ngaa ja'a malai risi, ka d'ai uuru ro'a èèna.

source_text: and he stouped downe, and sawe the linnen clothes lying: yet went he not in.
target_text: te ngaa laku boe asa d'ara ro'a, dhoka patigi nèti li'u di. ètu d'ara ro'a, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bèla halus dhu ra pake hèlu mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then came simon peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and sawe the linnen clothes lye,
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus d'ai, la'e dènge asa d'ara. nèdhi bèla halus dhu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the kerchiefe that was vpon his head, not lying with the linnen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by it selfe.
target_text: nèdhi kahèi lesu dhu ra pahutu kètu yesus. te ngaa lesu ne dhu lèpe ètu era leo nèti bèla halus ne.

source_text: then went in also the other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he sawe it, and beleeued.
target_text: hèia ja'a, dhu d'ai uuru ro'a, maso madhutu kahèi asa d'ara. ropa ladhe kèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, ka ja'a parcaya lii padhadha dhu uru èèna yesus peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: for as yet they knewe not the scripture, that he must rise againe from the dead.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ji'i dhu j'aj'i ana madhutu na, dhae nge'a mèka sasoa nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri mema, peka na, kristus hud'i mamuri hari ku nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: and the disciples went away againe vnto their owne home.
target_text: èle ka, ji'i dua mi lèpa.

source_text: but marie stoode without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she bowed her selfe into the sepulchre,
target_text: te ngaa maria titu era ètu li'u ro'a èèna. nèngu tangi taruu. ka na patigi asa d'ara ro'a ne, aa na tangi era.

source_text: and sawe two angels in white, sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feete, where the body of iesus had laien.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhèu dua. ana pajuu se, pake mèdha-papake pudhi. dua ra madhèdi ètu era dhu ca lod'o ni dhèu paj'unu ngi'u aae yesus. ca dhèu madhèdi re era kètu, aa èci hari dhu madhèdi re era haga.

source_text: and they said vnto her, woman, why weepest thou? she said vnto them, they haue taken away my lord, and i know not where they haue laide him.
target_text: ana pajuu se karèi maria, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka èu tangi? hèia maria dhaa, peka na, ja'a tangi, lula dhèu ded'e rèti ngi'u aae lamatua ja'a. te ngaa ke'a boe ra tèke ne ètu mia.

source_text: when she had thus said, she turned her selfe backe, and sawe iesus standing, and knewe not that it was iesus.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, nèngu kabib'a asa li'u. ka ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, te ngaa ne'a boe, na, dhèu ne, nuka yesus.

source_text: iesus saith vnto her, woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? she supposing that he had bene the gardener, said vnto him, sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and i will take him away.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tangi? te èu tenge cee? maria pangee, na, nèngu ne dhèu madhenga oka. ka maria pamako dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ama ka ded'e mèti ngi'u aae na, peka ku laa, ama tèke ne ètu mia. hud'i laa laku ded'e kèti ne asa era leo, sèna ka padhane ne pabe'a-be'a. sue laa, ama!

source_text: iesus saith vnto her, marie. she turned her selfe, and said vnto him, rabboni, which is to say, master.
target_text: ka yesus paroa ne, peka na, maria. hèia na kabèli ladhe asa yesus, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, raboni! lii aram, sasoa na, mese ja'a!

source_text: iesus saith vnto her, touch me not: for i am not yet ascended to my father: but goe to my brethren, and say vnto them, i ascend vnto my father, and to your father, and to my god, and your god.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ne, baku g'ag'e ku ja'a, te ja'a dhae ca'e mèka laku asa ama ku ètu sorga. te ngaa lamu uuru ku peka dènge angalai ja'a sèra, na, ‘ja'a neo ca'e laku asa ama ku. nèngu èèna, ama miu kahèi. nèngu èèna, ama lamatua ja'a. de nèngu, ama lamatua miu kahèi. '

source_text: marie magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seene the lord, and that he had spoken these things vnto her.
target_text: èle ka, maria, dhèu magdala èèna, la'e lolo dènge ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka na, ja'a paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, yesus! ka na peka dènge rèngu lii moa yesus.

source_text: the same day then at night, which was the first day of the weeke, and when the doores were shut where the disciples were assembled for feare of the iewes, came iesus and stoode in the middes, and saide to them, peace be vnto you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. lod'o heka cèna kèna, ka ana madhutu yesus pakaboko. rèngu patèke babèdho èmu ne pa'èra-èra, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. re'a rare boe, na, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom!

source_text: and when he had so saide, he shewed vnto them his handes, and his side. then were the disciples glad when they had seene the lord.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, hèia na pad'elo nu'a dhu ètu kacui-aai dènge karasa na. ana madhutu na karej'e titu kèna, ropa ladhe rèdhi lamatua rèngu.

source_text: then saide iesus to them againe, peace be vnto you: as my father sent me, so sende i you.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, hud'i laa miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. sanèd'e, te ama ku pua-paleha ja'a tasamia, na, ja'a pua-paleha miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and when he had saide that, he breathed on them, and saide vnto them, receiue the holy ghost.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na ara padètu la'e asa rèngu, hèia na tiu a'ae na mi rèngu èci-èci. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ja'a pangèd'u miu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. sèmi mere ne.

source_text: whosoeuers sinnes ye remit, they are remitted vnto them: and whosoeuers sinnes ye reteine, they are reteined.
target_text: de, ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, sasala ne ele le, te ama lamatua saku eele sasala èèna kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, lamatua saku eele boe sasala sèra kahèi.

source_text: but thomas one of the twelue, called didymus, was not with them when iesus came.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus canguru dua sèra, ngara na tomas. ra pangare na, ‘ana kembar' kahèi. ropa yesus pad'elo iisi na dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, tomas aad'o.

source_text: the other disciples therefore saide vnto him, we haue seene the lord: but he said vnto them, except i see in his handes the print of the nailes, and put my finger into the print of the nailes, and put mine hand into his side, i will not beleeue it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa angalai na sèra peka dènge ne, ji'i paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, hèia tomas dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a hud'i ladhe kèdhi ku nu'a era paku sèra ètu kacui-aai na, aa pamaso ai ja'a asa nu'a ètu d'ara karasa na. ladhe ja'a tao mèka sèmi èèna, ja'a bisa mèka parcaya, na, nèngu mamuri hari le.

source_text: and eight dayes after, againe his disciples were within, and thomas with them. then came iesus, when the doores were shut, and stood in the middes, and said, peace be vnto you.
target_text: ca migu hari, ka ana madhutu yesus sama-sama dènge tomas ètu d'ara èmu cue. masi ka babèdho dhu patèke, te ngaa yesus maso asa d'ara, titu ètu talora aae rèngu. ka na hia lii maho'o dènge ra, peka na, saloom!

source_text: after saide he to thomas, put thy finger here, and see mine hands, and put forth thine hand, and put it into my side, and be not faithlesse, but faithfull.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge tomas, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai, ho g'ag'e kacui-aai ja'a ne. aa mai g'ag'e nu'a ètu d'ara karasa ja'a ne. parcaya ka, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le! core eele ka d'ara parcaya boe èu èèna.

source_text: then thomas answered, and said vnto him, thou art my lord, and my god.
target_text: tomas dhaa, peka na, ira ii, ama, ee! ja'a heka lèka tare'a-re'a kèna! ama ne, kètu ja'a, aa ama lamatua ja'a kahèi!

source_text: iesus said vnto him, thomas, because thou hast seene me, thou beleeuest: blessed are they that haue not seene, and haue beleeued.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ne, tomas! èu parcaya, na, ja'a mamuri hari le, lula èu mèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha èu unu mu. te ngaa dhu oto risi ka, nuka dhèu dhu rèdhi boe ja'a, te ngaa ra parcaya.

source_text: and many other signes also did iesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this booke.
target_text: yesus tao tadha malaa dhu leo ae-ae kahèi, dhu ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne. ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa se'e dènge musi madha rèngu unu ra.

source_text: but these things are written, that ye might beleeue, that iesus is that christ that sonne of god, and that in beleeuing ye might haue life through his name.
target_text: te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, sèna ka miu parcaya, na, yesus ne, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke hia mai. yesus ne, ana ama lamatua kahèi. aa ropa miu parcaya ne, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu.

source_text: after these things, iesus shewed himselfe againe to his disciples at the sea of tiberias: and thus shewed he himselfe:
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, ka yesus pad'elo hari iisi na ètu sebhe dano tiberias. lii lolo na, sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: there were together simon peter, and thomas, which is called didymus, and nathanael of cana in galile, and the sonnes of zebedeus, and two other of his disciples.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus, dhèu pidhu dhu pakaboko. rèngu se, nuka: simon petrus, tomas, dhu ra pangare ne, ‘ana kembar', natanel, nèti rae kana ètu propensi galilea, ana dhèu dua nèti sabadeus, dènge ana madhutu yesus dhu leo dhèu dua.

source_text: simon peter said vnto them, i go a fishing. they said vnto him, we also will goe with thee. they went their way and entred into a ship straightway, and that night caught they nothing.
target_text: simon petrus peka dènge angalai na se'e, ja'a neo laku pèku i'a. hèia angalai na se'e dhaa, aku rèngu na, oo! ji'i la'a kahèi. ka lasi asa sebhe dano. hèia ca'e koha lasi tenge i'a. te ngaa mèda èèna rèngu rara boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but when the morning was nowe come, iesus stoode on the shore: neuerthelesse the disciples knewe not that it was iesus.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, yesus titu ètu sebhe dano ne. te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra re'a boe, na, nèngu ne, yesus.

source_text: iesus then said vnto them, syrs, haue ye any meate? they answered him, no.
target_text: ka na pa'oo, peka na, mera i'a, do? hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mola-mèu lao! ci'u sa, aad'o hèi.

source_text: then he said vnto them, cast out the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall finde. so they cast out, and they were not able at all to draw it, for the multitude of fishes.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, lolo sèku pèku miu asa cabèka koha èèna. pe miu abhu. ka rèngu tao madhutu kahèi. ka ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna, toke rèngu bisa boe ère rare pèku ne asa dedha koha.

source_text: therefore said the disciple whom iesus loued, vnto peter, it is the lord. when simon peter heard that it was the lord, he girded his coate to him for he was naked and cast himselfe into the sea.
target_text: aa ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. ja'a ne, ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ka ja'a peka dènge petrus, na, ira ii! nèngu nèi, lamatua èdhi! ropa tadèngi nare lii ja'a deo na, hèia simon petrus pake hari kodho na, ka ridhu asa d'ara dano, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: but the other disciples came by shippe for they were not farre from land, but about two hundreth cubites and they drewe the net with fishes.
target_text: te koha ne kaj'èu nèti dae pe d'ai cangasu meter sa. hèia angalai na kao koha asa dae, todhe dènge pèku dhu pènu dènge i'a deo sa.

source_text: assoone then as they were come to land, they sawe hoate coales, and fish laide thereon, and bread.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai dae, hèia rèdhi ai karoo, dènge i'a dhu ra paga. aa abhu roti kahèi.

source_text: iesus saide vnto them, bring of the fishes, which ye haue nowe caught.
target_text: yesus lii dènge ra, mèti ku i'a osa miu d'ai ciki sa, dhu miu heka pèku mere deo na.

source_text: simon peter stepped foorth and drewe the net to land, full of great fishes, an hundreth, fiftie and three: and albeit there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
target_text: ka simon petrus ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ho ère pa'eta pèku ne asa dae. pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a aae, cangasu lèmi nguru tèlu ngi'u. masi ka i'a ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa pèku ne mae boe ciki sa hèi.

source_text: iesus saide vnto them, come, and dine. and none of the disciples durst aske him, who art thou? seeing they knewe that he was the lord.
target_text: ka yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai mi'a ka! rèngu dhu re'a le, na, nèngu ne lamatua rèngu, ka ra bani boe karèi ne, na, ama ne, cee?

source_text: iesus then came and tooke bread, and gaue them, and fish likewise.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti dènge i'a, nèti hia si.

source_text: this is now the third time that iesus shewed himselfe to his disciples, after that he was risen againe from the dead.
target_text: ne'e ne, ka tèlu hari kèna yesus pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na sèra, ropa na mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so when they had dined, iesus said to simon peter, simon the sonne of iona, louest thou me more then these? he said vnto him, yea lord, thou knowest that i loue thee. he said vnto him, feede my lambes.
target_text: ropa ra'a-rinu rare, yesus karèi simon petrus, aku nèngu na, hee, simon ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a risi nèti angalai se sue ja'a, do? ka petrus dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. hèia yesus peka, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, madhenga paie ana kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: he said to him againe the second time, simon the sonne of iona, louest thou me? he said vnto him, yea lord, thou knowest that i loue thee. he said vnto him, feede my sheepe.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari, aku nèngu na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. ka yesus peka hari dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a.

source_text: he said vnto him the third time, simon the sonne of iona, louest thou me? peter was sorie because he said to him the third time, louest thou me? and said vnto him, lord, thou knowest all things: thou knowest that i loue thee. iesus saide vnto him, feede my sheepe.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi hari petrus, peka na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu ne, angalai ja'a, do? hèia d'ara petrus susa titu kèna, lula yesus karèi ne d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhu me'a aa'i j'ara. de ama dhu me'a le, na, ja'a ne angalai ama. hèia yesus peka dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a se, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: verely, verely i say vnto thee, when thou wast yong, thou girdedst thy selfe, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be olde, thou shalt stretch foorth thine hands, and another shall gird thee, and lead thee whither thou wouldest not.
target_text: èu dhane more le naneo ja'a, do? ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: uru èèna lod'o èu ngèru era, èu tema pake unu mu kodho dènge dhara hake, ho lamu asa mia-mia madhutu dad'èi èu. te ngaa ètu d'ara heka, èu j'ole kacui-aai ho dhèu èki, pake dhara hake èu unu mu. hèia ra ère rèti èu asa era dhu èu d'èi boe.

source_text: and this spake he signifying by what death he shoulde glorifie god. and when he had said this, he said to him, folowe me.
target_text: lii padhai yesus ne, peka mi petrus, lula-nèti ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a mi dedha nèngu. te èèna na mamadhe petrus pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. hèia yesus lii dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: then peter turned about, and sawe the disciple whom jesus loued, folowing, which had also leaned on his breast at supper, and had saide, lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus kabib'a asa kabodho. ka ladhe nèdhi ja'a dhu re limuri madhutu rèngu dua ra. ja'a ne, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus, lod'o ji'i nga'a kalela paska. ja'a ne ka dhu karèi yesus, peka na, ama! cee ka dhu neo pahie ama?

source_text: when peter therefore sawe him, he saide to iesus, lord, what shall this man doe?
target_text: ropa petrus ladhe nèdhi ja'a, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! deo na ama peka-padhai le lula-nèti ja'a ne. te ngaa tasamia dènge nèngu hari?

source_text: iesus said vnto him, if i will that he tarie till i come, what is it to thee? follow thou me.
target_text: yesus b'ala lii petrus, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa? dhu lèke ka èu hud'i sanèd'e ku lii moa dhu ja'a peka deo na, nuka: mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a.

source_text: then went this worde abroade among the brethren, that this disciple shoulde not die. yet iesus saide not to him, he shall not die: but if i will that he tarie till i come, what is it to thee?
target_text: lula yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na dhu leo sèra papeka, na, yohanis ne, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe. aa te ngaa yesus padhai lii boe sèmi èèna. dhu na peka, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa?

source_text: this is that disciple, which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things, and we know that his testimonie is true.
target_text: ana madhutu dhu yesus peka èèna, nuka ja'a ne, yohanis. ja'a ka lole se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. ja'a ka dhu kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ja'a ka suri aa'i-aa'i se. ka èdhi te'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a lole hia miu se, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: nowe there are also many other things which iesus did, the which if they should be written euery one, i suppose the world coulde not conteine the bookes that shoulde be written, amen.
target_text: abhu j'ara leo ae era dhu yesus tao. ladhe dhèu neo suri aa'i mèu-mèu, karèi nèti yesus pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke èle, ja'a ngee na buku se pènu risi rai-haha ne. d'ai sange ne'e ka, yohanis

source_text: i have made the former treatise, o theophilus, of al that jesus began to doe and teach, vntill the day that hee was taken vp, after that hee through the holy ghost, had giuen commandements vnto the apostles, whome hee had chosen: to whome also he presented himselfe aliue after that he had suffered, by many infallible tokens, being seene of them by the space of fourtie daies, and speaking of those thinges which appertaine to the kingdome of god.
target_text: ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, lukas. ètu d'ara sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ja'a suri aa'i mèu-mèu lula-nèti mamuri lamatua yesus. nuka, ngaa dhu na tao, dènge ngaa dhu na aj'a-nori, karèi nèti uru tèka. na hag'e nare dhèu pajuu-paleha na. masi ka dhèu paj'èra ne, aa ra pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ropa na kèd'i nèti mamadhe, na pad'elo iisi mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ra rèdhi ne padhutu-dhutu toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, ka ra re'a, na mamuri hari tare'a. nèngu peka dènge rèngu, na, ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae dhu nèd'u paredha. ka na pua rèngu kahèi pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. lii dhu ja'a suri ne, lole ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao nèti uru, toke d'ai na ca'e hari asa sorga. se'e se ka dhu ja'a suri kèdhi le.

source_text: and when he had gathered them together, he commanded them, that they should not depart from hierusalem, but to waite for the promise of the father, which sayde hee, yee haue heard of me. for iohn in deede baptized with water, but ye shall be baptized with the holy ghost within these fewe daies.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ropa yesus pa'èci dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na ètu dedha ledhe saitun, na hia si paredha peka na, sanèd'e! uru èèna, yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua tao ngaa dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. lula na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. de baku tèke eele kota yerusalem kahèi. te ngaa miu mate mi ne'e, toke d'ai ama ku papuru roh na mi dedha miu, sèmi dhu na moa le uru èèna. aa miu tadèngi le nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: when they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, lord, wilt thou at this time restore the kingdome to israel?
target_text: ropa yesus pakaboko dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na era, ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i neo karèi: ama sanèd'e era, sina ma, dhu uru èèna, kabarai èdhi isra'el paredha unu na? de ama neo patabuli èdhi nèti dhèu leo deo ne'e, do, mate hari lod'o leo?

source_text: and hee saide vnto them, it is not for you to know the times, or the seasons, which the father hath put in his owne power,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu pakarèi ia ka lod'o èèna! dhoka ama ku di, dhu pama'ète j'aj'aj'i lod'o èèna na.

source_text: but yee shall receiue power of the holy ghost, when he shall come on you: and ye shalbe witnesses vnto me both in hierusalem and in all iudea, and in samaria, and vnto the vttermost part of the earth.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci mai maso asa d'ara miu, heka miu abhu koasa kèna. hèia miu hud'i lami palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lula-nèti ja'a. miu peka dènge dhèu ètu kota yerusalem, ètu rae aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria, taruu toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when he had spoken these things, while they behelde, he was taken vp: for a cloude tooke him vp out of their sight.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa dedha-liru la'e ètu katanga madha rèngu. ra ladhe taruu, toke d'ai ra'i-liru hutu nare ne, ka rèngu rèdhi heka.

source_text: and while they looked stedfastly towarde heauen, as hee went, beholde, two men stoode by them in white apparell,
target_text: ropa rèngu ladhe asa dedha-liru era, cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua titu ètu karasa rèngu, dhu pake mèdha-papake pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: which also sayde, yee men of galile, why stande yee gasing into heauen? this iesus which is taken vp from you into heauen, shall so come, as yee haue seene him goe into heauen.
target_text: dhèu dua sèra peka dènge rèngu, na, wee! miu dhèu galilea! nga tao ka miu tangare taruu asa dedha-liru? deo na miu mèdhi le yesus ca'e toke d'ai ra'i-liru hutu nare ne. miu mèdhi unu mi dènge musi madha miu, na ca'e la'e deo na. sèmi mia dhu miu ladhe mèdhi na ca'e la'e èèna, sèmi èèna kahèi èèna na nèngu mai hari.

source_text: then returned they vnto hierusalem from the mount that is called the mount of oliues, which is neere to hierusalem, being from it a sabbath daies iourney.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra puru nèti ledhe saitun lèpa lasi asa kota yerusalem. ledhe saitun èèna, ele boe kaj'èu nèngu d'ai ca kilo di nèti d'ara kota.

source_text: and when they were come in, they went vp into an vpper chamber, where abode both peter and iames, and iohn, and andrew, philip, and thomas, bartlemew, and matthewe, iames the sonne of alpheus, and simon zelotes, and iudas iames brother.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ka ra lasi asa d'ara èmu dhu rèngu pea. ka ra ca'e asa kama èci ètu èmu dedha. ngara dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra, nuka: petrus, yohanis, yakobis, anderias, pelipus, tomas, bertolomeos, mateos, yakobis ana alpius, simon dhu madhutu partei selot, dènge yudas ana yakobis.

source_text: these all continued with one accorde in prayer and supplication with the women, and marie the mother of iesus, and with his brethren.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tema pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i dènge d'ara èci. maria, ina yesus, aa dhèu bhèni-dhèu bhèni leo, dènge a'ari yesus sèra pakaboko dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and in those dayes peter stoode vp in the middes of the disciples, and sayde nowe the nomber of names that were in one place were about an hundreth and twentie.
target_text: ca tèka hari, rèngu pakaboko, ele boe dhèu d'ai cangasu dua nguru dhèu sa. ka petrus kèd'i titu, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na,

source_text: yee men and brethren, this scripture must needes haue beene fulfilled, which the holy ghost by the mouth of dauid spake before of iudas, which was guide to them that tooke iesus.
target_text: ina-ama, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èle boe miu sanèd'e yudas era, dhu uru èèna nèti anga na canau, ho lasi kèpe yesus. ngaa dhu yudas tao, mema hud'i j'aj'i sèmi èèna ku. te nèti uru ka, roh ama lamatua peka le, dènge dhèu aae daud, ho suri tatao yudas.

source_text: for hee was nombred with vs, and had obteined fellowship in this ministration.
target_text: te yudas èèna, dhèu èdhi dhu sab'a pa'èci dènge èdhi.

source_text: he therefore hath purchased a field with the reward of iniquitie: and when he had throwen downe himselfe headlong, hee brast asunder in the middes, and all his bowels gushed out.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yudas pahie eele yesus, ka rare doi papana èèna, lasi hèli rare rai cue. rai èèna ka dhu j'aj'i era mamadhe nèngu. na bèbhe sagèb'a ètu era èèna, ka masèke eele kabake na, hèia tanèi na talala.

source_text: and it is knowen vnto all the inhabitants of hierusalem, in so much, that that field is called in their owne language, aceldama, that is, the field of blood.
target_text: ka dhèu palolo lème, toke d'ai isi kabarai kota yerusalem re'a aa'i mèu-mèu mamadhe yudas èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare rai èèna madhutu lii aram, ngara na ‘akeldama', sasoa na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: for it is written in the booke of psalmes, let his habitation be void, and let no man dwel therein: also, let another take his charge.
target_text: petrus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, uru-uru sèra, dhèu aae daud suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio, peka na, ‘hud'i sène era pea nèngu, j'aj'i mi era dhu pa'ela eele; bisa heka dhèu èci sa pea ètu èèna. ' aa na suri kahèi, aku nèngu na, ‘hud'i sène, sasab'a nèngu ra hia asa dhèu leo la'e. '

source_text: wherefore of these men which haue companied with vs, all the time that the lord iesus was conuersant among vs, beginning from the baptisme of iohn vnto the day that hee was taken vp from vs, must one of them bee made a witnesse with vs of his resurrection.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i tenge dhèu èci ho gati yudas. èdhi tenge dhèu dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi nèti uru ka mai. dhèu èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu nèbhu le madhutu yesus la'e-mai, mulai nèti yohanis sarani yesus. aa nèngu èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu nèdhi dènge musi madha, na, yesus kèd'i hari nèti mamadhe na, toke d'ai lod'o yesus ca'e hari asa dedha-liru ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: and they presented two, ioseph called barsabas, whose surname was iustus, and matthias.
target_text: ropa petrus peka nare sèmi èèna, ka dhèu dhu pakaboko sèra, pamaso ngara dhèu dua. èci ngara na matias, aa èci hari ngara na yusuf dhu tema le ra paroa na barsabas; ngara na leo èci hari, na, yustus.

source_text: and they praied, saying, thou lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shewe whether of these two thou hast chosen, that he may take the roume of this ministration and apostleship, from which iudas hath gone astray, to goe to his owne place.
target_text: hèia ra sabaj'a, aku rèngu na, ama ètu dedha-liru! ama dhu me'a iie d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. yudas madhe le, tèke eele sasab'a na. de ama paj'uj'u hia ji'i dhèu èci nèti rèngu dua se, mia dhu ama d'èi, ho ji'i ded'e ne j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus.

source_text: then they gaue foorth their lottes: and the lotte fell on matthias, and hee was by a common consent counted with the eleuen apostles.
target_text: ka ra ère lot, pake ngara dhèu dua sèra. hèia dhu lèke ka matias. ka ra ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus, ho na pa'èci dènge rèngu dhèu canguru èci sèra.

source_text: and when the day of pentecost was come, they were al with one accord in one place. and suddenly there came a sounde from heauen, as of a russhing and mightie winde, and it filled all the house where they sate.
target_text: lèke lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi, dhu ra pangare na ‘lod'o pantekosta', dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu lamatua yesus pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu cue. cag'ag'a laa, ra tadèngi lii dhu mai nèti dedha-liru, sama sèmi bohe. lii èèna mèdhu titu kèna, ka rèngu bisa boe tadèngi lii dhèu leo dhu ètu sèra.

source_text: and there appeared vnto them clouen tongues, like fire, and it sate vpon eche of them.
target_text: hèia rèngu ladhe rèdhi sèmi heo ai sa, dhu puru mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: and they were all filled with the holy ghost, and began to speake with other tongues, as the spirit gaue them vtterance.
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu roh ama lamatua. ka ra padhai lii, pake lii dhèu rai-rai leo, madhutu ngaa dhu roh hia si peka-padhai.

source_text: and there were dwelling at hierusalem iewes, men that feared god, of euery nation vnder heauen.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi ae titu kèna dhu mai nèti lème rai ètu rai-haha ne, pakaboko ètu yerusalem. d'ara rèngu neo madhutu ama lamatua.

source_text: nowe when this was noised, the multitude came together and were astonied, because that euery man heard them speake his owne language.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii èèna, ka ra mai lingu rare era èèna. ka rèngu ca dhèu-dhèu ka, tadèngi lii dhu ana madhutu lamatua yesus sèra padhai, èci èèna ka dènge lii rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra malaa-maloha.

source_text: and they wondered al, and marueiled, saying among themselues, beholde, are not all these which speake, of galile?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hèb'a nganga-nganga sène, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! te dhèu se, dhèu galilea, sina ma?

source_text: how then heare we euery man our owne language, wherein we were borne?
target_text: tasamia ka, rèngu bisa padhai lii, tao lii èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti?

source_text: parthians, and medes, and elamites, and the inhabitants of mesopotamia, and of iudea, and of cappadocia, of pontus, and asia,
target_text: èdhi se'e, mai nèti propensi partia, media, elam, mesopotamia, yudea, kapadokia, pontus, asia,

source_text: and of phrygia, and pamphylia, of egypt, and of the partes of libya, which is beside cyrene, and strangers of rome, and iewes, and proselytes, creetes, and arabians: wee hearde them speake in our owne tongues the wonderful works of god.
target_text: frigia, pamfilia, masir, nèti libia dhu dètu dènge kota kirene, aa èdhi cahag'e mai nèti kota roma. aa cahag'e kahèi mai nèti pulu kreta, dènge nèti rai arab. èdhi cahag'e dhèu yahudi, cahag'e dhèu rai leo dhu maso agama yahudi. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi rèngu padhai lii, pake lii èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara kapai titu kèna, dhu ama lamatua tao. te aa'i-aa'i se pamalaa èdhi, nga!

source_text: they were all then amased, and douted, saying one to another, what may this be?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hèb'a nganga-nganga sène, ka ra pakarèi isi aanga ra, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi ne'e? sasoa na, ngaa ka ne?

source_text: and others mocked, and saide, they are full of newe wine.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu mari si, peka na, weeh! baku pusi dènge dhèu sèi! te ra mahu nèi!

source_text: but peter standing with ye eleuen, lift vp his voice, and said vnto them, ye men of iudea, and ye all that inhabite hierusalem, be this knowen vnto you, and hearken vnto my woordes.
target_text: ètu era èèna, petrus dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhèu canguru èci leo sèra. ka nèngu kako la'e asa madha, hèia na mulai padhai lii mi dhèu ae dhu lingu ètu èèna. na padhai lii mèdhu bia, peka na, ina-ama, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! miu dhèu yahudi, dènge miu dhu mai nèti mia-mia pea ètu kota yerusalem! pasa dhilu paie, ho mi nanene lii padhai lii ja'a ne, te ja'a neo peka j'ara hua iia mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for these are not drunken, as yee suppose, since it is but the third houre of the day.
target_text: mage mi pangee, na, dhèu se mahu. sèmi boe èèna! mad'ae aae era, dhèu mahu boe. ngaa hari, heka hake ceo kèna.

source_text: but this is that, which was spoken by the prophet ioel,
target_text: deo na miu tadèngi, na, dhèu se padhai lii pake lii miu aa'i-aa'i mi. dhu lèke, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, ama lamatua moa tèke le j'ara ne'e re dhèu nèti lii padhai lii nèngu, ngara na yoel, peka na:

source_text: and it shalbe in the last daies, saith god, i wil powre out of my spirite vpon al flesh, and your sonnes, and your daughters shall prophecie, and your yong men shall see visions, and your old men shall dreame dreames.
target_text: ‘ama lamatua peka na, ladhe lod'o rai-haha oe èle, ja'a neo hia roh ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ana ngèru miu sèra, bhèni-mone, ja'a ded'e si, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a. ana ngèru miu sèra, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu ja'a neo pad'elo mi rèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu heka miu sèra, bèli-camèd'a ra abhu nii, ngaa dhu ja'a neo pad'elo hia ra rèdhi.

source_text: and on my seruauntes, and on mine handmaides i will powre out of my spirite in those daies, and they shall prophecie.
target_text: ladhe lod'o rai-haha oe èle, ja'a hia roh ja'a mi ana pua-paleha ja'a sèra. hia dhèu mone, aa dhèu bhèni kahèi. sèna ka ra peka-padhai ngaa dhu ja'a peka le dènge rèngu.

source_text: and i wil shew wonders in heauen aboue, and tokens in the earth beneath, blood, and fire, and the vapour of smoke. the sunne shalbe turned into darkenesse, and the moone into blood, before that great and notable day of the lord come. and it shalbe, that whosoeuer shall call on the name of the lord, shalbe saued.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o lamatua. masi ka lod'o èèna dhae d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a tao uru tadha-tadha malaa ètu dedha-liru. tadha malaa sèmi madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga kiu-kiu, dènge hèru mea sèmi raa sa kahèi. ja'a neo tao j'ara-j'ara kapai seli eele kahèi, ètu dedha-rai. j'ara sèra sa, sama sèmi raa, ai, dènge sèb'u poka-poka ca'e la'e asa dedha. ladhe d'ai lod'o lamatua dhu kapai seli èèna, dhèu cee dhu manèngi ama lamatua soru-bara ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu abhu mamuri. ' sèmi èèna ka, dhu uru èèna, yoel suri le.

source_text: yee men of israel, heare these woordes, jesus of nazareth, a man approued of god among you with great workes, and wonders, and signes, which god did by him in the middes of you, as yee your selues also knowe:
target_text: a'ari dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i ti! mai pasa dhilu miu, ho nanene paie ngaa dhu ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu. ama lamatua paj'uj'u nare le yesus, dhèu nasaret. ji'i nge'a le j'ara èèna j'aj'i tare'a, lula ji'i ka dhu ladhe ngèdhi unu mi, na, ama lamatua pake yesus ho tao tadha malaa dènge tatao kapai seli eele. miu me'a le j'ara ne'e kahèi, lula yesus tao le tadha malaa sèra ètu talora miu.

source_text: him, i say, being deliuered by the determinate counsell, and foreknowledge of god, after you had taken, with wicked handes you haue crucified and slaine.
target_text: te ngaa miu pamadhe ne, dènge j'ara miu dadugu-rariu dhèu bhelu-katub'a, ho paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. aa te ngaa, sèra sa pamèci dènge naneo ama lamatua nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: whome god hath raised vp, and loosed the sorrowes of death, because it was vnpossible that he should be holden of it.
target_text: lula tatao miu, ka nèngu madhe tare'a. te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe ho yesus madhe taruu. nèti èèna ka, lamatua patalale eele nèngu nèti koasa mamadhe, ka pamamuri hari ne. te koasa mamadhe bisa boe segi ne.

source_text: for dauid sayeth concerning him, i beheld the lord alwaies before me: for hee is at my right hand, that i should not be shaken.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu aae daud suri tèke le lula-nèti yesus ne, peka na: ‘ja'a ke'a, na, lamatua sama-sama taruu dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ngaa èci sa bisa boe pamanahu ja'a, lula ama lamatua ètu baboa ja'a taruu.

source_text: therefore did mine heart reioyce, and my tongue was glad, and moreouer also my flesh shall rest in hope,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a karej'e, ka ja'a koa-kio ne taruu, aa ja'a mate lamatua dènge d'ara mera-milu.

source_text: because thou wilt not leaue my soule in graue, neither wilt suffer thine holy one to see corruption.
target_text: te nèngu soro tèke boe samanga ja'a pea taruu ètu era dhèu madhe sèra. aa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ngi'u aae dhèu nèngu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ele iie ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: thou hast shewed me the waies of life, and shalt make me full of ioy with thy countenance.
target_text: lamatua pad'elo le ja'a j'ara mamuri dhu mola. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e d'ai seli, lula lamatua bera-bera dènge ja'a. ' ne'e ne ka dhu dhèu aae daud suri tèke nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: men and brethren, i may boldly speake vnto you of the patriarke dauid, that hee is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre remaineth with vs vnto this day.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu mata ku ho ja'a lole paie ku dènge miu lula-nèti dhèu aae daud. na peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa na lole boe ngi'u nèngu. èdhi te'a, lula nèngu madhe le, aa ra padhane ne. ro'a na abhu ètu talora èdhi toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: therefore, seeing hee was a prophet, and knewe that god had sworne with an othe to him, that of the fruite of his loynes hee woulde raise vp christ concerning the flesh, to set him vpon his throne,
target_text: dhèu aae daud ne j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa na ne'a, na, ama lamatua dhu moa le pake lii subha, ho limuri mai èci nèti ana-èpu daud nèd'u paredha. nèngu èèna ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: hee knowing this before, spake of the resurrection of christ, that his soule shoulde not bee left in graue, neither his flesh shoulde see corruption.
target_text: lod'o èèna, daud pangee madhera. aa na peka uuru lula-nèti dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u tèke le. èena na dhèu èèna madhe, te ngaa mamuri hari kahèi. aa daud peka kahèi, na, dhèu èèna pea taruu boe ètu era dhèu madhe, aa ngi'u na ele iie boe kahèi.

source_text: this iesus hath god raised vp, whereof we all are witnesses.
target_text: dhèu dhu daud peka-padhai ne, nuka yesus! ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne nèti mamadhe na. ka ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i!

source_text: since then that he by the right hande of god hath bene exalted, and hath receiued of his father the promise of the holy ghost, hee hath shed foorth this which yee nowe see and heare.
target_text: ka limuri ne, ama lamatua ded'e le yesus, ho nèd'u paredha dhu dedha risi eele. aa na madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu lamatua sadia tèke le. aa ama na hia le roh na dhu mola-mèci, sama sèmi dhu na moa tèke nèti uru ka. aa na moa neo hia roh mola-mèci na mi èdhi kahèi. èèna ka dhu miu tadèngi dènge laladhe mèdhi deo na, nuka ama lamatua hia roh na.

source_text: for dauid is not ascended into heauen, but he sayth, the lord sayd to my lord, sit at my right hande,
target_text: daud mesa na ca'e boe la'e asa sorga, te ngaa na suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, madhèdi mi sebhe g'ana ja'a, ètu era dhu ja'a sadia mema,

source_text: vntill i make thine enemies thy footestoole.
target_text: toke ja'a tao musu èu sèra, pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: therefore, let all the house of israel know for a suretie, that god hath made him both lord, and christ, this iesus, i say, whome yee haue crucified.
target_text: nèti èèna ka dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i re'a ku tare'a-re'a, lula-nèti yesus dhu miu paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. nèngu, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le. aa nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i kètu èdhi.

source_text: now when they heard it, they were pricked in their heartes, and said vnto peter and the other apostles, men and brethren, what shall we doe?
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii petrus ne, d'ara dhèu sèra roe. ka ra karèi petrus dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha leo sèra, peka na, a'ari! ji'i hud'i tao tasamia ku?

source_text: then peter said vnto them, amend your liues, and bee baptized euery one of you in the name of iesus christ for the remission of sinnes: and ye shall receiue the gift of the holy ghost.
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, peka na, miu èci-èci hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i mi, ho miu lèpa hari madhutu lamatua. hèia soro iisi mi ho sarani, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu lèpa hari le madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. aa èèna j'aj'i tadha kahèi, peka na, lamatua saku eele le sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna, miu sèmi mere roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for the promise is made vnto you, and to your children, and to all that are a farre off, euen as many as the lord our god shall call.
target_text: te ama lamatua moa le hia roh na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na. dènge j'ara ne'e, lii mamoa lula-nèti roh na, j'aj'i hia miu dènge ana-èpu miu kahèi. na moa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and with many other words he besought and exhorted them, saying, saue your selues from this froward generation.
target_text: aa petrus padhai lii ae hari mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, dhèu ae sero le nèti j'ara mamuri dhu mola. de miu mage-mage, sèna ka miu baku madhutu tatao dhèu bhelu sèra. te ngaa miu hud'i madhutu dhoka j'ara mola nèti ama lamatua di. dènge j'ara èèna, miu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: then they that gladly receiued his word, were baptized: and the same day there were added to the church about three thousand soules.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae sèra sèmi rare lii padhai lii petrus èèna dènge d'ara kateme. ka ra madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus, hèia ra soro iisi ra sèna ka abhu sarani. lod'o èèna, pe d'ai tèlu riho dhèu mai pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu yesus sèra.

source_text: and they continued in the apostles doctrine, and fellowship, and breaking of bread, and prayers.
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu yesus. aa rèngu mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu maj'èni nanene lii holo-nori nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus. rèngu d'èi manèngi-mangaj'i sama-sama kahèi. aa rèngu d'èi ra'a-rinu mei èci.

source_text: and feare came vpon euery soule: and many wonders and signes were done by ye apostles.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra tao tadha malaa ae-ae, ka dhèu dhu ètu sèra sa malaa dènge madha'u.

source_text: and all that beleeued, were in one place, and had all things common.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ka ngaa dhu unu dhèu èci, j'aj'i unu rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: and they sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all me, as euery one had need.
target_text: abhu cahag'e pahia mèdha-panyau ra, ho ra pala-bagi doi kab'ua na mi dhèu parcaya sèra, madhutu èci-èci dhu parluu.

source_text: and they continued dayly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, did eate their meate together with gladnesse and singlenesse of heart,
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu ra'a-rinu boko-boko mue-mue dènge d'ara karej'e-karae, nèti èmu èci asa èmu èci, dènge boe ka'uu-kamuki. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri èci tulu èci, dènge boe kire-kome.

source_text: praysing god, and had fauour with all the people: and the lord added to the church from day to day, such as should be saued.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ma'ète boe koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu leo sèra d'èi rèngu titu kèna. nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o ama lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu sèra, ho ra pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka rèngu asa ka ae.

source_text: nowe peter and iohn went vp together into the temple, at the ninth houre of prayer.
target_text: ca lod'o, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho neo sabaj'a dènge dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: and a certaine man which was a creeple from his mothers wombe, was caried, whom they layde dayly at the gate of the temple called beautifull, to aske almes of them that entred into ye temple.
target_text: rèngu neo maso re hèb'a oka, dhu ngara na ‘hèb'a saraga'. ètu èèna, rèngu rèdhi dhèu mone karuku èci, dhu karuku nèti ina na nara iisi ne. bèli-bèli mai, na, dhèu nedhe rèti ne asa era èèna, ho na kanata kacui-aai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu cee dhu neo maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i re èèna.

source_text: who seeing peter and iohn, that they would enter into the temple, desired to receiue an almes.
target_text: ropa na ladhe nèdhi petrus dènge yohanis oe maso asa d'ara, ka na kanata kacui-aai, manèngi, peka na, ama-ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. hia ku ja'a ngaa, do?

source_text: and peter earnestly beholding him with iohn, said, looke on vs.
target_text: ka dua ra ladhe kaloo ka dhèu ne'e, hèia petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku mai!

source_text: and hee gaue heede vnto them, trusting to receiue some thing of them.
target_text: hèia nèngu boti kètu na, ladhe asa rèngu dua ra, ka na pangee, na, waa! ele boe dua ra neo hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa ne.

source_text: then said peter, siluer and gold haue i none, but such as i haue, that giue i thee: in the name of iesus christ of nazareth, rise vp and walke.
target_text: te ngaa petrus peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a dènge boe doi hualaa ho hia mi èu! te, ngaa dhu ja'a unu, èèna ka dhu ja'a neo hia mi èu. de nanene paie-iie! dènge koasa yesus kristus, dhèu nasaret, ja'a pua èu kèd'i titu, ho kako!

source_text: and hee tooke him by the right hand, and lift him vp, and immediately his feete and ankle bones receiued strength.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe ai g'ana dhèu karuku èèna, ka na pakèd'i patitu ne. kaca'a laa, haga dhèu ne'e be'a dènge ka, ètu d'ara ciki ood'e èèna kahèi.

source_text: and he leaped vp, stoode, and walked, and entred with them into the temple, walking and leaping, and praysing god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, na pasoka titu, hèia na kako la'e-mai neo ne'a, haga nèngu be'a le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, na la'e palere dènge rèngu dua ra asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. na kako pasoa-pasoka dènge koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: and all the people sawe him walke, and praysing god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ladhe rèdhi dhèu ne'e kako la'e-mai, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and they knewe him, that it was he which sate for the almes at the beautifull gate of the temple: and they were amased, and sore astonied at that, which was come vnto him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra tadhe ne, ka ra malaa, hèia peka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne'e ka dhèu karuku dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a saraga, ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa èèna, sina ma? tasamia ka na j'aj'i sèmi ne'e?

source_text: and as the creeple which was healed, held peter and iohn, all the people ranne amased vnto them in the porch which is called salomons.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, madhutu petrus dènge yohanis. ka tèlu ra lasi d'ai èmu taleo cue, ngara na ‘èmu taleo dhèu aae soleman'. ètu èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai lingu rare rèngu malaa titu kèna.

source_text: so when peter saw it, he answered vnto the people, ye me of israel, why marueile ye at this? or why looke ye so stedfastly on vs, as though by our owne power or godlines, we had made this man go?
target_text: ropa petrus nèdhi rèngu, ka na padhai lii, peka na, dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! nga tao ka miu malaa, lula j'ara ne'e ne? nga tao ka miu ladhe kaloo ji'i? miu ngee, na, dhèu ne kako lula ji'i pake na'i, do, lula ji'i maj'èni madhutu ama lamatua? do, tasamia?

source_text: the god of abraham, and isaac, and iacob, the god of our fathers hath glorified his sonne iesus, whom ye betrayed, and denied in the presence of pilate, when he had iudged him to be deliuered.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. lamatua èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha dhèu nèngu dhu na pili nare, nuka yesus. yesus èèna ka dhu miu tule eele ne, ka saraka ne asa gubernur pilatus. ka gubernur neo patabuli ne, te ngaa miu ka dhu palab'a, sèna ka na baku patabuli eele yesus.

source_text: but ye denied the holy one and the iust, and desired a murtherer to be giuen you,
target_text: te ngaa yesus, dhèu dhu sala boe. d'ara nèngu be'a. gubernur neo patabuli eele dhèu dhu sala boe ne, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi lab'a ne. aa dhu bhelu risi hari ka, miu dadugu-rariu ne, sèna ka na patabuli hia miu dhèu bhelu-katub'a èci dhu pamadhe nèdhi dhèu.

source_text: and killed the lord of life, whome god hath raised from the dead, whereof we are witnesses.
target_text: miu ka dhu pamadhe yesus! aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu hia èdhi mamuri. mema tare'a nèngu madhe le, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèngu ka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i.

source_text: and his name hath made this man sound, whom ye see, and know, through faith in his name: and the faith which is by him, hath giuen to him this perfite health of his whole body in the presence of you all.
target_text: miu tadhe dhèu karuku ne. nèngu èra le, te ngaa ji'i boe ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne. ji'i se dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa. koasa èèna mai nèti yesus. dhèu ne'e ne èra, lula nèngu parcaya lamatua yesus. yesus ka dhu pa'èle ne, ètu katanga madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: and now brethren, i know that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your gouernours.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! limuri ne, ja'a ke'a le, miu dènge dhèu aae-dhèu kapai miu, tao bhelu mi dedha yesus, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i lèpa limuri.

source_text: but those thinges which god before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that christ should suffer, he hath thus fulfilled.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka mema nèti uru ka mai, pake dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, peka na, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu na hag'e nare èèna, hud'i d'ui ku j'aj'èra. ka j'aj'i le, sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: amend your liues therefore, and turne, that your sinnes may be put away, whe the time of refreshing shall come from the presence of the lord.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i ele-ho'a, tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia lèpa asa ama lamatua, ho na saku eele aa baku ngee ia ka sasala miu sèra.

source_text: and he shall sende iesus christ, which before was preached vnto you,
target_text: pe ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu. ka na neo pua kristus dhu na hag'e nare èèna, mai hari asa miu. kristus èèna, nuka yesus, dhu na pua le mai asa miu.

source_text: whome the heauen must containe vntill the time that all thinges be restored, which god had spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, lamatua padhai lii re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, ama lamatua pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka j'aj'i hiu. ' yesus hud'i mate ku ètu era mola-mèci toke d'ai lod'o nèngu mai hari, ho na pahiu ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for moses said vnto the fathers, the lord your god shall raise vp vnto you a prophet, euen of your brethren, like vnto me: ye shall heare him in all things, whatsoeuer he shall say vnto you.
target_text: uru èèna, baki musa peka le dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘lamatua miu, nuka ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na pua dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sama sèmi na pake ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu kèti lii padhai na. de miu hud'i pasa dhilu, sèna ka mi nanene paie, ngaa-ngaa dhu na neo peka mi miu.

source_text: for it shalbe that euery person which shall not heare that prophet, shall be destroyed out of the people.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe nanene paie, lii padhai lii dhèu èèna, èèna na cèri eele nèti dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dènge heka hak ètu talora rèngu. '

source_text: also all the prophets from samuel, and thencefoorth as many as haue spoken, haue likewise foretolde of these dayes.
target_text: mesa boe baki musa di dhu peka sèmi èèna. te lamatua pake dhèu leo kahèi, j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na. rèngu peka sèmi èèna kahèi. sama sèmi uru èèna, lamatua pake baki samuel, ho lolo j'ara-j'ara dhu limuri ne èdhi tèdhi dènge musi madha èdhi.

source_text: ye are the children of the prophets, and of the couenant, which god hath made vnto our fathers, saying to abraham, euen in thy seede shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
target_text: ama lamatua moa tèke le, mi baki abraham, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, re ana-èpu èu èci, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi dedha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ' lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka le mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, limuri ne, j'aj'i le mi dedha miu, nuka a'ari ja'a dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: first vnto you hath god raysed vp his sonne iesus, and him hee hath sent to blesse you, in turning euery one of you from your iniquities.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ana na dhu na hag'e nare èèna, ho paj'uj'u j'ara, sèna ka miu tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu. lamatua pua uuru ana na mai asa miu, èle èèna, heka na pua ne asa suku leo sèra. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti.

source_text: and as they spake vnto the people, the priestes and the captaine of the temple, and the sadduces came vpon them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa petrus dènge yohanis padhai lii era dènge dhèu ètu sèra, dhèu kapai canau mai. rèngu sèra, kètu agama yahudi, dhèu nèti partei saduki, dènge komedhaa j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu mai neo patao dènge petrus dènge yohanis.

source_text: taking it grieuously that they taught the people, and preached in iesus name the resurrection from the dead.
target_text: dhèu sèra nasa, lula rèngu dua ra d'èi peka dènge dhèu ae, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. dènge j'ara èèna, nèngu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu madhe sèna ka bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: and they layde handes on them, and put them in holde, vntill the next day: for it was now euentide.
target_text: ka ra paredha dhèu rèngu lasi kèpe dua ra. te ngaa, lula lod'o oe cèna kèna, ka ra pamaso taha si asa d'ara bèdho. ho bèli èèna, heka ra neo parisa si kèna.

source_text: howbeit, many of them which heard the word, beleeued, and the number of the men was about fiue thousand.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora dhèu dhu d'èi nanene dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, ae ka dhu mangaku, na, lii aj'a-nori rèngu sèra lèke tare'a. nèti èèna ka dhèu parcaya asa tabha ae, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: and it came to passe on the morow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes, were gathered together at hierusalem,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu kapai yahudi sèra pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem, nuka dhèu paredha, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and annas the chiefe priest, and caiaphas, and iohn, and alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the hie priestes.
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dhu ngara na hanas, ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu kapai leo, sèmi kayafas, yohanis, aleksander, dènge a'ari leo sèra nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and whe they had set them before them, they asked, by what power, or in what name haue ye done this?
target_text: ropa ra tesa aa'i, ka ra paredha dhèu lasi rare petrus dènge yohanis, ho rèti mai asa madha ama-ama dhèu kapai se'e. ropa rèngu mai, ka ra karèi si, peka na, tasamia ka miu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku? miu pake koasa nèti cee? aa cee ka dhu pua miu ka miu bani tao j'ara èèna?

source_text: then peter ful of the holy ghost, said vnto them, ye rulers of the people, and elders of israel,
target_text: hèia roh ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara petrus, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! miu ka dhèu kapai, dènge dhèu heka kabarai isra'el! baku nasa ladhe ji'i ako malaa ciki.

source_text: for as much as we this day are examined of the good deede done to the impotent man, to wit, by what meanes he is made whole,
target_text: ji'i ladhe, na, ama-ama si neo tao lii langu, lula ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èci. aa miu neo me'a ji'i pake koasa nèti cee?

source_text: be it knowen vnto you all, and to all the people of israel, that by the name of jesus christ of nazareth, whom ye haue crucified, whome god raised againe from the dead, euen by him doth this man stand here before you, whole.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: tatu ama si sanèd'e era dhèu nasaret, dhu ngara na yesus. nèngu èèna, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai. te ngaa miu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ja'a d'èi sèna ka ama si dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èèna, pake dhodhoka koasa yesus.

source_text: this is the stone cast aside of you builders which is become the head of the corner.
target_text: yesus ne'e ka dhu ra suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka core eele; te ngaa limuri mai, hadhu èèna j'aj'i hadhu padhèdi. '

source_text: neither is there saluation in any other: for among men there is giuen none other name vnder heauen, whereby we must be saued.
target_text: ètu palème rai-haha ne, ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara leo dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. dhodhoka j'ara èci di, nuka yesus. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu bisa hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: now when they sawe the boldnes of peter and iohn, and vnderstoode that they were vnlearned men and without knowledge, they marueiled, and knew them, that they had bin with iesus:
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra sa re'a, na, petrus dènge yohanis se, dhoka dhèu biasa di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe baca-suri. te ngaa dhèu sèra malaa dènge babani dua ra, lula rèngu padhai lii dhu dènge boe pahuni-pahuni. tabha hari, ra re'a, na, dhèu dua se, dhèu pa'èci nèti yesus.

source_text: and beholding also the man which was healed standing with them, they had nothing to say against it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hèb'a dhèu se kutu mèno, toke ra padhai lii heka ae-ae, lula dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, titu dhii-dhii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: then they commanded them to goe aside out of the council, and conferred among themselues,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dhèu dua sèra, aku rèngu na, dua mi lami ku asa li'u ciki. ka ra padhue ho neo tenge j'ara aapa.

source_text: saying, what shall we doe to these men? for surely a manifest signe is done by them, and it is openly knowen to all them that dwell in hierusalem: and we cannot denie it.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èdhi hud'i tao dhèu dua se samia? te dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le, na, rèngu dua se ka dhu tao tadha malaa deo na. èdhi pasili tare heka, lula bukti nèngu abhu le!

source_text: but that it be noysed no farther among the people, let vs threaten and charge them, that they speake hencefoorth to no man in this name.
target_text: de hua iia èdhi tenge j'ara, sèna ka lii ne'e baku ra lolo palème asa mia-mia la'e. be'a risi èdhi pamadha'u si, sèna ka ra baku aj'a ia ka j'ara mamuri yesus. ladhe ra nanene boe, na, re'a mema!

source_text: so they called them, and commanded them, that in no wise they should speake or teach in the name of iesus.
target_text: hèia ra paroa dua ra maso hari asa d'ara, ka ra peka dènge si, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe unu mi, ee! miu bisa heka lolo, do, aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti yesus!

source_text: but peter and iohn answered vnto them, and said, whether it be right in the sight of god, to obey you rather then god, iudge ye.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dènge yohanis b'ala, peka na, cob'a ama-ama si pajiko ku laa. mia dhu be'a risi? madhutu paredha ama si, do, madhutu paredha ama lamatua?

source_text: for we cannot but speake the things which we haue seene and heard.
target_text: te ji'i ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i, aa tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i madha j'ara ae. de tasamia ji'i kutu hèb'a, ho baku lolo dènge dhèu leo!

source_text: so they threatened them, and let them goe, and found nothing how to punish them, because of the people: for all men praised god for that which was done.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi pama'ète lii langu èèna, kai hari rèngu. ka ra patalale eele dua si, lula ra re'a heka j'ara ho huku si. rèngu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka dhèu ae ètu li'u sèi pagama. te dhèu ae sèra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula dhèu karuku èèna èle le.

source_text: for the man was aboue fourtie yeeres olde, on whome this miracle of healing was shewed.
target_text: dhèu èèna karuku èpa nguru risi tèu le, ka heka bisa kako kèna.

source_text: then assoone as they were let goe, they came to their fellowes, and shewed all that the hie priestes and elders had said vnto them.
target_text: ropa ra patabuli eele petrus dènge yohanis, dua ra lèpa lasi asa angalai rèngu. hèia dua ra lole aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu kapai leo sèra kai rèngu ho baku palolo.

source_text: and when they heard it, they lift vp their voyces to god with one accord, and said, o lord, thou art the god which hast made the heaue, and the earth, the sea, and all things that are in them,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii lolo èèna, ka angalai rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ho ra manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. ama dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: which by the mouth of thy seruant dauid hast saide, why did the gentiles rage, and the people imagine vaine things?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake le baki daud ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka suri mema lula-nèti dhèu lab'a yesus, peka na, ‘dhèu nèti rai leo sèra nasa lula lii lai-ngèlu; dhèu se'e tao lèke boe, ho tao lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: the kings of the earth assembled, and the rulers came together against the lord, and against his christ.
target_text: dhèu aae rai-haha sèra pakaboko ho neo pamusu lab'a ama lamatua; sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu kapai sèra rare lii èci neo lasi lab'a ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka mai. '

source_text: for doutlesse, against thine holy sonne iesus, whome thou haddest anoynted, both herod and pontius pilate, with the gentiles and the people of israel gathered themselues together,
target_text: ka ngaa dhu baki daud suri na, limuri ne j'aj'i le. aa sasoa na led'a le. ètu kota ne'e, dhèu aae herodes, gubernur pontius pilatus, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el, dènge dhèu kapai suku leo sèra, pakaboko le. rèngu pare'a lii ho lab'a yesus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le.

source_text: to doe whatsoeuer thine hand, and thy counsell had determined before to be done.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a aa'i le j'ara sèra lèke mola-mola dènge dad'èi lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua peka tèke nèti uru ka.

source_text: and nowe, o lord, beholde their threatnings, and graunt vnto thy seruants with all boldnesse to speake thy word,
target_text: lamatua, èu me'a rèngu dhoka padhai lii neo pamadha'u ji'i di. de ji'i manèngi ho lamatua hia ji'i d'ara bani. sèna ka ladhe ji'i la'a padhue-padhai asa dhèu ètu mia-mia lii lolo be'a lamatua lula-nèti yesus, d'ara ji'i madha'u boe.

source_text: so that thou stretch forth thine hand, that healing, and signes, and wonders may be done by the name of thine holy sonne iesus.
target_text: ji'i manèngi lamatua hia ji'i koasa kahèi, sèna ka ji'i bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ji'i manèngi kahèi koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu re'a, koasa èèna mai nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu lamatua pua mai, nuka yesus. lamatua, d'ai sange èèna ka lii sabaj'a ji'i.

source_text: and when as they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together, and they were all filled with the holy ghost, and they spake the word of god boldely.
target_text: ropa ra manèngi-mangaj'i rare, ka èmu dhu rèngu sabaj'a na gaged'o. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. èle èèna ka, rèngu kalua, lasi lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, dènge d'ara bani.

source_text: and the multitude of them that beleeued, were of one heart, and of one soule: neither any of them said, that any thing of that which he possessed, was his owne, but they had all thinges common.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus sèra, mamuri d'ara èci, aa mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mèu-moke, aa rèngu biasa pahia-paj'ola. dhèu dhu dènge mèdha-panyau, na uri ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: and with great power gaue the apostles witnes of the resurrection of the lord iesus: and great grace was vpon them all.
target_text: ka lamatua hia koasa mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho ra lole mi dhèu, peka na, lamatua yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. aa rèngu ka dhu rèdhi dènge musi madha unu ra. ka lamatua udhu-bhori berkat hia rèngu.

source_text: neither was there any among them, that lacked: for as many as were possessours of landes or houses, solde them, and brought the price of the things that were solde, and layde it downe at the apostles feete, and it was distributed vnto euery man, according as he had neede.
target_text: nèti rèngu se, abhu kahèi dhu pahia rai, do èmu ra. ho kab'ua na, ra hia mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra. ra pake ho hia mi dhèu dhu parluu. nèti èèna ka, rèngu kura boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: also ioses which was called of the apostles, barnabas that is by interpretation the sonne of consolation being a leuite, and of the countrey of cyprus, where as he had land, solde it, and brought the money, and laid it downe at the apostles feete.
target_text: conto sèmi yusuf. nèngu ne, ana-èpu lewi, nèti pulu siprus. dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se pangare na ‘barnabas', dhu sasoa na, ‘dhèu dhu d'èi pa'èra d'ara dhèu leo'. la'e pahie rai na ca kasib'i. ka nèti mai kab'ua na hia dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra.

source_text: but a certaine man named ananias, with sapphira his wife, solde a possession,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu èci, ngara na ananias, dènge dhèu èmu na, safira. rèngu dua ra pahie rai ra ca kasib'i kahèi.

source_text: and kept away part of the price, his wife also being of counsell, and brought a certaine part, and layde it downe at the apostles feete.
target_text: te ngaa dua ra pare'a ho huni kab'ua rai èèna cahag'e. pahie rare, ka ananias la'e peka dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra, aku nèngu na, ji'i heka pahie ngare rai ji'i ca kasib'i kèna. de ji'i neo hia kab'ua na asa ama lamatua.

source_text: then saide peter, ananias, why hath satan filled thine heart, that thou shouldest lye vnto the holy ghost, and keepe away part of the price of this possession?
