source_text: neither murmure ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
target_text: èdhi baku ka'uu-kamuki kahèi. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e re'a dhoka ka'uu-kamuki di, ka ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga mai pamadhe si.

source_text: nowe all these things came vnto them for ensamples, and were written to admonish vs, vpon whome the endes of the world are come.
target_text: j'ara ne lèke mi dhèu isra'el, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha hia mi èdhi. ra suri se'e se, ho èdhi bisa te'a, sèna ka baku tao madhutu sasala rèngu. te lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: wherefore, let him that thinketh he standeth, take heede lest he fall.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! limuri ne èu ngee, na, èu èra le. te ngaa baku pamud'e, sèna ka baku manahu.

source_text: there hath no tentation taken you, but such as appertaine to man: and god is faithfull, which will not suffer you to be tempted aboue that you be able, but wil euen giue the issue with the tentation, that ye may be able to beare it.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ngee mèdhi neo tao bhabhelu, te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu leo dhu paraga rèdhi le kahèi, dadugu-rariu sèmi sèra. te ngaa èu bisa parcaya ama lamatua, sèna ka na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu peka. te lamatua soro tèke boe èu ho abhu dadugu-rariu risi nèti a'èra èu. ropa èu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, nèngu pad'elo j'ara kalua hia èu. nèngu neo pa'èra èu, ho baku manahu.

source_text: wherefore my beloued, flee from idolatrie.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe dhèu neo laka-seti miu sèna ka sogo-tagu nidhu, na, pakeso nèti era èèna! baku pamata!

source_text: i speake as vnto them which haue vnderstanding: iugde ye what i say.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a ngee madhera. hud'i laa miu mesa mi dadoo unu mi, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka-padhai èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: the cup of blessing which we blesse, is it not the communion of the blood of christ? the bread which we breake, is it not the communion of the body of christ?
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe èdhi pakaboko sèna ka ta'a-tinu ètu mei ama lamatua, hèia tare galaa ho manèngi makasi mi lamatua, ka tinu nèti galaa èèna, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. ropa na pasuti raa na ka na madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhutu madhe kahèi. ladhe èdhi pamae roti èèna, hèia ta'e, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ropa kristus madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi kahèi madhe sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: for we that are many, are one bread and one body, because we all are partakers of one bread.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ta'e nèti roti cue. de aa'i-aa'i dhu rare pala nèti roti cue ne, nuka sèmi èdhi dhu pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci, masi ka èdhi dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: beholde israel, which is after the flesh: are not they which eate of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
target_text: pangee sèku dhèu isra'el uru sèra. ropa rèngu roro badha ètu dedha mei korban sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, ama agama dhu roro ne ka dhu bisa na'e sisi èèna. sasoa na, rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, aa pa'èki kahèi dènge dhèu dhu rèti badha ho j'aj'i mi korban.

source_text: what say i then? that the idole is any thing? or that that which is sacrificed to idoles, is any thing? nay, but that these things which the gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to deuils, and not vnto god: and i would not that ye should haue fellowship with the deuils.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tasamia? lod'o dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua neo hia mèdha-panyau rèngu j'aj'i mi mèdha sogo-tagu ra, èèna dènge boe kab'ua, do? te mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, dhoka patung dhu madhe di! aad'o! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhèu roro badha ho j'aj'i badha sogo-tagu, rèngu sogo-tagu nidhu bhelu. te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi ama lamatua dhu lèke. de ja'a ko'o boe ho miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèmi sèra.

source_text: ye can not drinke the cup of the lord, and the cup of the deuils. ye can not be partakers of the lords table, and of the table of the deuils.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki dènge lamatua, ka minu nèti galaa ètu mei lamatua, na, miu bisa boe pa'èci dènge nidhu bhelu sèra, aa baku minu nèti galaa dhu ra pake pae'a nidhu. te ladhe miu minu sèmi èèna, sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu bisa boe mi'a ètu mei nidhu. goa, ee! te sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèra!

source_text: doe we prouoke the lord to anger? are we stronger then he?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu sèmi ngaa? neo papèd'a d'ara lamatua èdhi, do? èèna bahaya! ele boe miu ngee, na, miu èra risi lamatua, do?

source_text: all things are lawfull for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawfull for me, but all things edifie not.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a neo tao ngaa èèna ka, bisa. te èèna hak ja'a. tare'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra nèti babe'a hia èu. aa tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, bisa soru-bara èu ho pa'èra d'ara mu.

source_text: let no man seeke his owne, but euery man anothers wealth.
target_text: baku tenge dhoka leto pala ngi'u èu di. be'a risi tenge oto hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: whatsoeuer is solde in the shambles, eate ye, and aske no question for conscience sake.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe hèli sisi ètu d'ara pasa, na, mu'a laa. baku pakarèi ia ka, peka na, sisi pae'a nidhu, do? do pangee, na, ja'a bisa ku'a sisi ne, do aad'o?

source_text: for the earth is the lords, and all that therein is.
target_text: lula ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, rai-haha dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i, unu lamatua èdhi.

source_text: if any of them which beleeue not, call you to a feast, and if ye wil go, whatsoeuer is set before you, eate, asking no question for conscience sake.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus nèru miu, peka na, mai lati ta'a asa èmu ja'a! ladhe miu lami, na, mi'a ngaa dhu na hia miu. baku pakarèi ia ka, na, ja'a bisa ku'a nganga'a ne'e, do aad'o?

source_text: but if any man say vnto you, this is sacrificed vnto idoles, eate it not, because of him that shewed it, and for the conscience for the earth is the lords, and all that therein is
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu mai paka'uu, peka na, baku mu'a ne'e ne, te sisi ne sisi sogo-tagu nidhu, be'a risi èu baku mu'a. èu hud'i taru kira ku mi dhèu dhu mai peka lii deo na, ho baku pabia ne.

source_text: and the conscience, i say, not thine, but of that other: for why should my libertie be condemned of another mans conscience?
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, pangee paie-iie, madhutu ngangee dhèu deo na, bisa ku'e do aad'o. baku ngee dhoka dhu be'a madhutu ngangee èu mesa mu. aa te ngaa, ja'a bisa tao madhutu d'èi d'ara ja'a. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe nèngu ad'u-ue ca madha j'ara, nga tao ka ja'a bebas boe sa hèi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a, lula be'a boe bagi mi dhèu leo?

source_text: for if i through gods benefite be partaker, why am i euill spoken of, for that wherefore i giue thankes?
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia ja'a ku'a, na, nga tao ka dhèu padhai pamanahu ja'a?

source_text: whether therefore ye eate, or drinke, or whatsoeuer ye doe, doe all to the glory of god.
target_text: de miu neo mi'a do, minu do, tao ngaa èèna ka, na, tao aa'i-aa'i sèna ka pakapai kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: giue none offence, neither to the iewes, nor to the grecians, nor to the church of god:
target_text: baku pasusa dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, do dhèu unu lamatua dhu parcaya sèra.

source_text: euen as i please all men in all things, not seeking mine owne profite, but the profite of many, that they might be saued.
target_text: tao nuka sèmi ja'a tao. te ja'a neo cob'a pakarej'e si ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a mesa boe tao dhu be'a hia ja'a di, te ngaa neo tao dhu be'a bagi rèngu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka rèngu abhu sod'a kahèi.

source_text: be yee followers of mee, euen as i am of christ.
target_text: miu ladhe mi ja'a, aa tao madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a. te ja'a ladhe mi kristus, aa tao madhutu tatao nèngu.

source_text: now brethren, i commend you, that ye remember all my things, and keepe the ordinances, as i deliuered them to you.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu, lula tasamia èèna ka miu sanèd'e taruu ja'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu, miu tao madhutu era. be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but i wil that ye know, that christ is the head of euery man: and the man is the womans head: and god is christs head.
target_text: te ngaa ca j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu nuka: baku bhèlu j'aj'aj'i miu nèti mia. dhèu mone dhu parcaya sèra, kèni na nèti kristus, dhu j'aj'i kètu ra. dhèu bhèni j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone. aa kristus mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: euery man praying or prophecying hauing any thing on his head, dishonoureth his head.
target_text: dhèu mone baku pahutu kètu na lod'o nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i, do, ropa na peka-padhai lii moa lamatua. te èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae kristus, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi.

source_text: but euery woman that prayeth or prophecieth bare headed, dishonoureth her head: for it is euen one very thing, as though she were shauen.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni hud'i pahutu kètu na lod'o sabaj'a, do ropa nèngu lole lii moa lamatua. te ladhe aad'o na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae dhèu èmu na, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi. aa nèngu pamakae ngi'u nèngu unu na, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu lusu pakahoni kètu na.

source_text: therefore if the woman be not couered, let her also be shorne: and if it be shame for a woman to be shorne or shauen, let her be couered.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi boe pahutu kètu na, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha nèngu pakab'ua dhèu èmu na, be'a risi nèngu g'ute pabab'a rèu kètu na. te ngaa ladhe nèngu rasa kètu na kahoni pamakae nèngu, hua iia nèngu pahutu kètu na.

source_text: for a man ought not to couer his head: for as much as he is the image and glory of god: but the woman is the glory of the man.
target_text: ngee sèku sèmi ne'e: dhèu mone parluu boe hutu kètu na, te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu mone madhutu raropa na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. aa dhèu bhèni kahèi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha dhèu mone.

source_text: for the man is not of the woman, but the woman of the man.
target_text: te lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, na tao boe dhèu mone nèti dhèu bhèni. te ngaa paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone.

source_text: for the man was not created for the womans sake: but the woman for the mans sake.
target_text: aa lamatua tao boe dhèu mone hia mi dhèu bhèni. te ngaa na pangèd'u dhèu bhèni mi dhèu mone.

source_text: therefore ought the woman to haue power on her head, because of the angels.
target_text: de hua iia risi dhèu bhèni pahutu kètu ho dhèu re'a, na, nèngu pake hak na ho sabaj'a aa lole lii moa lamatua, madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ana pajuu nèti sorga re'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: neuertheles, neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man in the lord.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, bhèni dènge mone bisa boe èci-èci ka tao unu na.

source_text: for as the woman is of the man, so is the man also by the woman: but all things are of god.
target_text: ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru ku dhèu mone. hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone. te ngaa èle èèna ka, dhèu bhèni ka dhu nara iisi dhèu mone. aa ama lamatua ka dhu tao aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i.

source_text: iudge in your selues, is it comely that a woman pray vnto god vncouered?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe dhèu bhèni pahutu boe kètu ho sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, be'a, do aad'o?

source_text: doeth not nature it selfe teach you, that if a man haue long heare, it is a shame vnto him?
target_text: madhutu ad'a miu ètu kota korintus, ladhe dhèu mone rèu kètu madhera, èèna pamakae nèngu, do?

source_text: but if a woman haue long heare, it is a prayse vnto her: for her heare is giuen her for a couering.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni dhu rèu kètu na madhera, be'a titu kèna, si? lamatua hia ne rèu kètu madhera ho pa'abhe kab'a kètu na. èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: but if any man lust to be contentious, we haue no such custome, neither the churches of god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu loe boe pakarèi nèti j'ara ne'e, sanèd'e, te nèti ji'i dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at, aa nèti juma'at-juma'at, ne'e ne dhu tema le j'aj'i ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: nowe in this that i declare, i prayse you not, that ye come together, not with profite, but with hurt.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo padhai lii ca j'ara. te ngaa lii ne koa-kad'iri boe miu. te ropa miu pakaboko, miu tao boe j'ara dhu lèke, te ngaa miu asa tao maruru.

source_text: for first of all, when ye come together in the church, i heare that there are dissentions among you: and i beleeue it to be true in some part.
target_text: partama, dhu ja'a tadèngi, na, lod'o miu pakaboko tao kasasi, miu dhu mae-manyèla. nèti lii dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tatu abhu cahag'e dhu lèke tare'a.

source_text: for there must be heresies euen among you, that they which are approoued among you, might be knowen.
target_text: mema, lula mamae-manyèla miu èèna ka, bisa te'a cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lamatua èdhi, aa mia dhu nanene boe.

source_text: when ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eate the lords supper.
target_text: te lod'o miu dhèu sarani pakaboko ho mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku mi lamatua yesus. èèna ka dhu lèke. te ngaa miu tao boe sèmi èèna.

source_text: for euery man when they should eate, taketh his owne supper afore, and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
target_text: tadha na, nuka ropa miu madhèdi mi'a, abhu dhu mate boe dhèu leo, abhu dhu ra'a dènge gagoo, aa abhu leo dhu rinu mahu. toke abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu abhu boe pala, ka ra manganga.

source_text: haue ye not houses to eate and to drinke in? despise ye the church of god, and shame them that haue not? what shall i say to you? shall i prayse you in this? i prayse you not.
target_text: tasamia ka ne! ? miu dènge boe èmu ho mi'a-minu, do? do, miu neo pa'ele iie kolongara juma'at lamatua? do, miu neo pamakae dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra? miu neo ja'a padhai lii tasamia hari? neo sèna ka ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu d'ara tatao miu ne, do? baku maena!

source_text: for i haue receiued of the lord that which i also haue deliuered vnto you, to wit, that the lord iesus in the night when he was betrayed, tooke bread:
target_text: lamatua yesus ka dhu peka unu na dènge ja'a j'ara ne, de ja'a peka hari dènge miu. peka na, ropa dhèu pa'èra neo pamadhe ne, mèda èèna nèngu nare roti cue.

source_text: and when hee had giuen thankes, hee brake it, and sayde, take, eate: this is my body, which is broken for you: this doe ye in remembrance of me.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi'a roti ne, te ne'e ne ngi'u ja'a, dhu mae hia miu. de miu hud'i mi'a roti ne, sèna ka sanèd'e ja'a.

source_text: after the same maner also he tooke the cup, when he had supped, saying, this cup is the newe testament in my blood: this doe as oft as ye drinke it, in remembrance of me.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge galaa dhu isi èi anggor, aku nèngu na, èi anggor ne, sasoa na, ama lamatua neo pa'èki lii padhadha hiu dènge miu. ka ja'a hud'i pasuti raa ja'a toke madhe, heka lii padhadha èèna j'aj'i. lod'o-lod'o miu minu èi anggor sèmi ne'e, miu hud'i ngee mèdhi ku mamadhe ja'a.

source_text: for as often as ye shall eate this bread, and drinke this cup, ye shewe the lords death till hee come.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o miu tao j'ara sèmi ne'e, ho mi'a roti dènge minu nèti galaa sèmi ne'e, toke kristus lèpa hari mai, èèna nuka sèmi miu palolo hari mamadhe na.

source_text: wherefore, whosoeuer shall eate this bread, and drinke the cup of the lord vnworthily, shall be guiltie of the body and blood of the lord.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o dhèu ra'a roti dènge rinu nèti galaa èèna, sèna ka sanèd'e kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'ara na mola boe dènge dhèu leo, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne. lula, èèna ngi'u dènge raa nèti lamatua yesus. de ladhe d'ara dhu mola mèka, na, nèngu nia boe na'a dènge ninu, lula j'ara èèna pahahe lamatua yesus.

source_text: let euery man therefore examine himselfe, and so let him eate of this bread, and drinke of this cup.
target_text: be'a risi ca dhèu-dhèu ka parisa uuru ku d'ara na. ladhe d'ara na dhu mola le, heka bisa na'a roti aa ninu èi anggor kèna.

source_text: for he that eateth and drinketh vnworthily, eateth and drinketh his owne damnation, because he discerneth not the lords body.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhu ra'a dènge rinu dhu d'ara ra koe-kapengo. te ra pangee, na, mamadhe yesus èèna, dènge boe kab'ua. ngi'u yesus dènge boe sasoa bagi mi ja'a. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a dui rare pala ra, lula hahuku dhu sadia tèke le.

source_text: for this cause many are weake, and sicke among you, and many sleepe.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ètu talora aae miu sèra, abhu dhu èra boe, abhu dhu lèke papèd'a-tarègu, aa abhu dhu madhe le.

source_text: for if we would iudge our selues, we should not be iudged.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parisa paie-iie d'ara èdhi, èdhi abhu boe huku sèmi sèra.

source_text: but when we are iudged, we are chastened of the lord, because we should not be condemned with the world.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi huku èdhi, na tao sèmi èèna sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi ho èdhi madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te nèngu d'èi boe ladhe èdhi lèke huku sama sèmi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eate, tary one for another.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko ho mi'a-minu ètu mei lamatua, èci hud'i mate ku èci.

source_text: and if any man be hungry, let him eate at home, that ye come not together vnto condemnation. other things will i set in order when i come.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu taha boe manganga, be'a risi mi'a uuru ku ètu èmu, sèna ka ropa miu pakaboko pa'èci, baku abhu dhu lèke huku. j'ara leo dhu miu karèi sèra, pe ja'a dhiu ku, heka ator si kèna.

source_text: now concerning spirituall giftes, brethren, i would not haue you ignorant.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe miu me'a mèu nèti koasa dènge karunya dhu roh lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi pake.

source_text: ye know that ye were gentiles, and were caried away vnto the dumme idoles, as ye were led.
target_text: miu dhu me'a, na, lod'o miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu lamatua, miu sogo-tagu mèdha dhu lii aad'o sèra. miu madhutu rèngu iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: wherefore, i declare vnto you, that no man speaking by the spirit of god calleth iesus execrable: also no man can say that iesus is the lord, but by the holy ghost.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu me'a, na, tatu boe abhu dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, dhoo-saseo yesus èèna! aa tatu dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka na, yesus èèna, lamatua ja'a!

source_text: now there are diuersities of gifts, but the same spirit.
target_text: roh lamatua hia mi dhèu èci-èci ka dènge karunya na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge sasab'a-la'a ra. te ngaa karunya sèra mai nèti roh èci di.

source_text: and there are diuersities of administrations, but the same lord,
target_text: dhèu abhu karunya rupa-rupa ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu nanene dhoka lamatua èci di.

source_text: and there are diuersities of operations, but god is the same which worketh all in all.
target_text: dhèu unu rupa-rupa sasab'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a lamatua, èèna j'aj'i lula ama lamatua di dhu soru-bara rèngu ho ra pakako sasab'a-la'a sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but the manifestation of the spirit is giuen to euery man, to profite withall.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo roh na mi mamuri dhèu dènge j'ara dhu baka-leo hua, te ngaa dad'èi na sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra sama-sama abhu babe'a.

source_text: for to one is giuen by the spirit the word of wisdome: and to an other the word of knowledge, by the same spirit:
target_text: lamatua pangèd'u koasa roh na mi dhèu unu na. ka cahag'e abhu koasa, sèna ka ngangee madhera ho nori dhu lèke. cahag'e abhu koasa ho peka paled'a ngaa dhu rèngu re'a dènge be'a.

source_text: and to another is giuen faith by the same spirit: and to another the giftes of healing, by the same spirit:
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka parcaya pa'èra mi ama lamatua, lula rèngu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge roh na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: and to another the operations of great workes: and to another, prophecie: and to another, the discerning of spirits: and to another, diuersities of tongues: and to another, the interpretation of tongues.
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. cahag'e hari lole lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na. cahag'e abhu koasa sèna ka re'a, roh mia ka mai nèti ama lamatua, aa mia ka dhu aad'o. cahag'e hari, abhu koasa ho bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. aa cahag'e hari, bisa peka sasoa nèti lii sèra.

source_text: and all these thinges worketh one and the selfe same spirit, distributing to euery man seuerally as he will.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka roh èci di dhu bisa tao rèngu, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pangèd'u mi dhèu èci-èci, ka rèngu bisa sab'a madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua èèna.

source_text: for as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, which is one, though they be many, yet are but one body: euen so is christ.
target_text: ja'a neo pasoro karunya sèra dènge ngi'u dhèu. ngi'u èci, te ngaa bagian na ae-ae. te ngaa bagian se, pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci di. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu unu kristus sèra.

source_text: for by one spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we bee iewes, or grecians, whether we be bonde, or free, and haue bene all made to drinke into one spirit.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'èki dènge roh èci di. nèti èèna ka, lod'o èdhi abhu sarani, èdhi nuka sèmi ca suku. masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do dhèu bebas, ama lamatua pala hia èdhi roh èci di. èèna nuka sèmi tinu èi dhu hia mamuri nèti madha èi èci di.

source_text: for the body also is not one member, but many.
target_text: tare'a, ngi'u ne nèti boe ca bagian di. te na j'aj'i nèti bagian ae-ae.

source_text: if the foote would say, because i am not the hand, i am not of the body, is it therefore not of the body?
target_text: ladhe sèmi haga èu, peka na, ja'a ne, kacui-aai boe. de ja'a j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka nèngu peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i bagian nèti ngi'u èu era. tare'a, si?

source_text: and if the eare would say, because i am not the eye, i am not of the body, is it therefore not of the body?
target_text: aa ladhe dhilu èu peka na, ja'a ne, musi madha boe. de ja'a ne j'aj'i boe bagian nèti ngi'u èu. masi ka na peka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu bagian nèti ngi'u èu kahèi.

source_text: if the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? if the whole were hearing, where were the smellling?
target_text: pangee sèku! ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka musi madha di, tasamia èu bisa tadèngi? aa ladhe ngi'u èu dhoka rèu dhilu di, tasamia ho èu bisa sangèd'u?

source_text: but nowe hath god disposed the members euery one of them in the bodie at his owne pleasure.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, ama lamatua tao èdhi j'aj'i mi èci sama sèmi ngi'u èci, ka nèngu ator bagian se madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: for if they were all one member, where were the body?
target_text: ladhe ngi'u ne dhoka ca bagian di, ngara na ‘ngi'u' boe, sina ma?

source_text: but now are there many members, yet but one body.
target_text: te dhu lèke ka, ngi'u èdhi ne, dènge bagian ae-ae. se'e ka tao ne j'aj'i ngi'u kateme aae.

source_text: and the eye cannot say vnto the hand, i haue no neede of thee: nor the head againe to the feete, i haue no neede of you.
target_text: musi madha bisa boe pahahe kacui-aai, dhu peka na, ja'a parluu boe èu! aa kètu bisa boe peka dènge haga na, ja'a dale boe èu!

source_text: yea, much rather those members of the body, which seeme to be more feeble, are necessarie.
target_text: dhu lèke mola-mola ka, nuka, abhu bagian nèti ngi'u dhu roe, aa dhu dènge kab'ua ae boe, te ngaa èdhi parluu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and vpon those members of the body, which wee thinke most vnhonest, put wee more honestie on: and our vncomely parts haue more comelinesse on.
target_text: abhu bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, rèngu se gaguna ra ae boe, te ngaa èdhi haduli si paie-iie. aa abhu bagian dhu èdhi makae pacèu, ka pahutu pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: for our comely partes neede it not: but god hath tempered the body together, and hath giuen the more honour to that part which lacked,
target_text: te ngaa bagian dhu pamakae boe èdhi, èdhi tao boe si ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ama lamatua oru nare bagian aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. ka nèngu ator sèna ka bagian dhu èdhi pangee, na, dhu dènge boe kab'ua, èdhi ladhe-leru si be'a-be'a,

source_text: lest there should be any diuision in the body: but that the members shoulde haue the same care one for another.
target_text: te lamatua d'èi boe ngi'u èdhi pahag'a. dad'èi na sèna ka bagian se èci soru-bara èci.

source_text: therefore if one member suffer, all suffer with it: if one member be had in honour, all the members reioyce with it.
target_text: te ladhe bagian èci paraga dènge susa, na, aa'i-aa'i ra susa kahèi. aa ladhe ra pakab'ua èci, na, aa'i-aa'i karej'e kahèi.

source_text: now ye are the body of christ, and members for your part.
target_text: èci èèna ka dènge miu. te miu sama sèmi ngi'u kristus dhu kateme. dhèu parcaya èci-èci nuka sèmi ca bagian nèti ngi'u kristus.

source_text: and god hath ordained some in the church: as first apostles, secondly prophetes, thirdly teachers, then them that doe miracles: after that, the giftes of healing, helpers, gouernours, diuersitie of tongues.
target_text: te ètu talora miu dhèu parcaya, ama lamatua hia koasa sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a, nuka: partama, lamatua pua-paleha dhèu cahag'e ho lasi lole lii moa na. ka dua, na pake dhèu cahag'e, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai nèngu. ka tèlu, na hia dhèu cahag'e d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti nèngu. aa na hia koasa mi dhèu cahag'e, sèna ka bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa ho pad'elo dadedha na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. cahag'e hari abhu karunya ho soru-bara dhèu. cahag'e hari abhu karunya sèna ka uri dhèu ho sab'a sama-sama dènge be'a. aa lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii.

source_text: are all apostles? are all prophetes? are all teachers?
target_text: de ngangee miu tasamia? ama lamatua pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho lasi peka-padhai lii moa na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori, do? aad'o. na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa, do? aad'o.

source_text: are all doers of miracles? haue all the gifts of healing? doe all speake with tongues? doe all interprete?
target_text: na hia koasa mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèna ka puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii, do? aad'o. na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho bisa bhoke paled'a sasoa nèti lii se'e, do? aad'o.

source_text: but desire you the best giftes, and i will yet shewe you a more excellent way.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema-mema ho sèmi mere aa pake karunya dènge be'a dhu hia gaguna mi dhèu ae. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a neo pad'elo j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu.

source_text: though i speake with the tongues of men and angels, and haue not loue, i am as sounding brasse, or a tinkling cymbal.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a bisa padhai lii pake lii aa'i-aa'i, nèti dhèu rai-haha do, lii nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, te ngaa dènge boe sasue ciki sa ètu d'ara ja'a, kolo-karisi na ngaa? lii padhai ja'a sèra mola mèu lao, sama sèmi babha dhu lii cère-cère, do nuka sèmi dere dhu lii dhèru-dhèru di.

source_text: and though i had the gift of prophecie, and knewe all secrets and all knowledge, yea, if i had all faith, so that i could remooue mountaines and had not loue, i were nothing.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a dènge karunya ho lole peka lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na, aa dhu ke'a aa'i rahasia, dènge ke'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu se re'a, aa ladhe lalèka ja'a èra mi lamatua toke ja'a bisa pahari eele ledhe nèti era na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, na, gaguna na ngaa? rui-j'aj'èra ja'a guna boe mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and though i feede the poore with all my goods, and though i giue my body, that i be burned, and haue not loue, it profiteth me nothing.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pahie eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ja'a, ho sèna ka kab'ua ra panga'a dhèu unu aad'o, do, soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban, te ngaa ladhe ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, gaguna na ngaa? ja'a dènge boe j'ara dhu tao ja'a nged'e. te sèra sa parcuma! guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: loue suffreth long: it is bountifull: loue enuieth not: loue doeth not boast it selfe: it is not puffed vp:
target_text: te sasue èèna, d'ara taleo. sasue èèna, lii mako. sasue èèna, d'ara kura boe. sasue èèna, padedha boe iisi. sasue èèna, pamone-pabhèni boe.

source_text: it doeth no vncomely thing: it seeketh not her owne things: it is not prouoked to anger: it thinketh not euill:
target_text: sasue èèna, lii sakaa boe. sasue èèna, neo boe pasegi ngi'u unu na. sasue èèna, nasa malai boe. sasue èèna, tèka boe d'ara.

source_text: it reioyceth not in iniquitie, but reioyceth in the trueth:
target_text: sasue èèna, karej'e dènge ngaa dhu lèke, aa d'èi boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: it suffreth all things: it beleeueth all things: it hopeth all things: it endureth all things.
target_text: sasue èèna, taha taruu ètu d'ara madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i. sasue èèna, parcaya taruu. sasue èèna, sanao-maena taruu. sasue èèna, ma'ète boe.

source_text: loue doeth neuer fall away, though that prophecyings be abolished, or the tongues cease, or knowledge vanish away.
target_text: sasue dènge boe too-lane. te, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka le, nèbhu-nèbhu parluu heka. aa dhu dhèu padhai pake lii rupa-rupa, bèli-camèd'a parluu heka kahèi. aa ladhe ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra re'a, nèbhu-nèbhu guna heka kahèi.

source_text: for we knowe in part, and we prophecie in part.
target_text: limuri ne dhu te'a dhoka ciki oo'e di. aa ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu tèti lii padhai lamatua, èdhi peka dhoka j'ara dhu dhae tesa mèka.

source_text: but when that which is perfect, is come, then that which is in part, shalbe abolished.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, aa'i-aa'i sèra tesa dhe'i-dhe'i. lod'o èèna j'ara-j'ara dhu tesa mèka, guna heka mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: when i was a childe, i spake as a childe, i vnderstoode as a childe, i thought as a childe: but when i became a man, i put away childish thinges.
target_text: conto sèmi: lod'o ja'a ana iiki era, ja'a padhai lii sama sèmi ana iiki. ngangee ja'a sama sèmi mia dhu ana iiki pangee. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a dhèu ee'a le. nèti èèna ka, tatao ja'a sèmi heka ana iiki.

source_text: for nowe we see through a glasse darkely: but then shall wee see face to face. nowe i know in part: but then shall i know euen as i am knowen.
target_text: conto leo: limuri ne, èdhi tèdhi rango-rango era, dhae mèu iia mèka, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe asa d'ara tèru dhu ahu. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu pe aa'i-aa'i se mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe padètu iiki-iiki ètu madha èdhi. ne'e ne, ja'a ke'a dhoka ciki di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu bisa ke'a aa'i, nuka sèmi ama lamatua ladhe madhore d'ai adhe-usu ja'a.

source_text: and nowe abideth faith, hope and loue, euen these three: but the chiefest of these is loue.
target_text: de limuri ne, abhu tèlu j'ara dhu èdhi hud'i tao, dhu taha taruu. nuka: èdhi hud'i parcaya taruu lamatua; èdhi sanao-maena taruu, na, pe lamatua ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i be'a; aa èdhi hud'i pasue taruu. nèti tèlu j'ara se, dhu dedha risi ka, sasue. lula sasue ka dhu hua risi nèti aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: followe after loue, and couet spirituall giftes, and rather that ye may prophecie.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka pasue ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. te abhu heka j'ara leo dhu dedha risi. aa tenge j'ara kahèi, sèna ka roh lamatua hia miu koasa dènge karunya, ho bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. aa dhu be'a, nuka, ladhe miu abhu karunya sèna ka lole lii moa lamatua.

source_text: for hee that speaketh a strange tongue, speaketh not vnto men, but vnto god: for no man heareth him: howbeit in the spirit he speaketh secret things.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu abhu karunya ho padhai lii pake lii leo, roh lamatua hia ne koasa sèna ka peka paled'a j'ara dhu mèu iia mèka. te ngaa nèngu padhai lii boe dènge dhèu leo, te padhai lii dhoka dènge lamatua di. dhèu dhu pa'èci dènge ne ètu sèra, abhu boe èci sa dhu re'a lii padhai nèngu.

source_text: but he that prophecieth, speaketh vnto me to edifying, and to exhortation, and to comfort.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu abhu karunya ho lole lii moa lamatua, na, nèngu peka lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra. nèngu pa'èra ku parcaya dhèu mi lamatua, pa'èra d'ara dhèu, aa pakarej'e d'ara dhèu susa.

source_text: he that speaketh strange language, edifieth himselfe: but hee that prophecieth, edifieth the church.
target_text: dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, nèngu pa'èra dhoka ngi'u nèngu mesa na di. te ngaa dhèu dhu padhue-padhai lii moa lamatua èèna, nèngu pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko dènge ne, sèna ka juma'at kateme asa tabha èra.

source_text: i would that ye all spake strange languages, but rather that ye prophecied: for greater is hee that prophecieth, then hee that speaketh diuers tongues, except hee expound it, that the church may receiue edification.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. te ngaa ja'a d'èi risi, ladhe miu bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te dhèu dhu peka lii moa lamatua èèna, guna risi nèti dhèu dhu dhoka padhai pake lii leo di. ladhe padhai pake lii leo, èèna be'a, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu bisa peka paled'a sasoa na. dènge sèmi èèna, lii moa sèra bisa asa pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu juma'at, sèna ka re'a mèu.

source_text: and nowe, brethren, if i come vnto you speaking diuers tongues, what shall i profite you, except i speake to you, either by reuelation, or by knowledge, or by prophecying, or by doctrine?
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pangee sèku j'ara ne. ladhe sèmi ja'a dhiu ngad'o miu ho padhai pake lii dhu miu me'a boe sasoa na, miu abhu oto na ngaa? aad'o, si? te ngaa ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, be'a risi ja'a peka dènge miu dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka. be'a risi ja'a aj'a-nori miu ho me'a mèu risi hari j'ara sèra. be'a risi ja'a pasanèd'e miu lii holo-nori lamatua. be'a risi aj'a-nori miu. dènge j'ara sèmi sèra, heka miu abhu oto kèna, si?

source_text: moreouer things without life which giue a sounde, whether it be a pipe or an harpe, except they make a distinction in the soundes, how shall it be knowen what is piped or harped?
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge alat musiik. se'e se mèdha madhe, te ngaa lii ra rupa-rupa. pake sakino do, sasadhu do, gitar do, ladhe pangèci boe lii na, tatu dhèu re'a boe lii sod'a sèmi ngaa, si?

source_text: and also if the trumpet giue an vncertaine sound, who shall prepare himselfe to battell?
target_text: ladhe lii tèbhe mèu iia boe, na, tasa mera mia sordad'u bisa re'a, na, rèngu hud'i tao ngaa mi musu ra? bisa boe, si?

source_text: so likewise you, by the tongue, except yee vtter wordes that haue signification, howe shall it be vnderstand what is spoken? for ye shall speake in the ayre.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ladhe miu padhai lii, pake lii dhu dhèu bisa boe re'a mèu, èèna nuka sèmi miu padhai lii dènge lai ngèlu. parcuma, te dhèu bisa boe dhane rare lii padhai èu!

source_text: there are so many kindes of voyces as it commeth to passe in the world, and none of them is dumme.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne abhu lii ae titu kèna. lii se, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: except i know then the power of ye voyce, i shall be vnto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh, shalbe a barbarian vnto me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a ke'a boe lii dhèu leo, bagi ja'a lii ne dènge boe kab'ua. ja'a ke'a boe lii rèngu, aa rèngu re'a boe lii ja'a kahèi. ji'i baga taa, aa j'aj'i sèmi dhèu leo rai kara sa.

source_text: euen so, forasmuch as ye couet spirituall giftes, seeke that ye may excell vnto the edifying of the church.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu neo abhu karunya dènge koasa nèti lamatua. èèna be'a. te ngaa be'a risi ladhe miu tenge j'ara ho abhu koasa dènge karunya dhu miu bisa pake sèna ka pa'èra dhèu parcaya sèra!

source_text: wherefore, let him that speaketh a strange tongue, pray, that he may interprete.
target_text: de dhèu dhu padhai pake lii leo, be'a risi nèngu sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia ne karunya kahèi, ho peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna.

source_text: for if i pray in a strange togue, my spirit prayeth: but mine vnderstading is without fruite.
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii leo, ja'a sabaj'a pake d'ara ja'a, te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a padhai lii èèna.

source_text: what is it then? i will pray with the spirit, but i wil pray with the vnderstanding also: i wil sing with the spirite, but i will sing with the vnderstanding also.
target_text: de babe'a na, ja'a tao tasamia? ja'a pake dua-dua, te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake d'ara ja'a, aa ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii dhu ke'a mèu kahèi. ja'a neo sod'a pake lii sod'a koa-kio mi lamatua nèti d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa sod'a kahèi, pake lii dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: else, when thou blessest with the spirit, howe shall hee that occupieth the roome of the vnlearned, say amen, at thy giuing of thankes, seeing he knoweth not what thou sayest?
target_text: te ladhe èu pake lii leo ho koa-kio ama lamatua nèti d'ara èu, te ngaa abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu re'a boe lii deo na, tasamia nèngu bisa d'ara èci dènge èu? lod'o èu manèngi makasi mi lamatua pake lii leo, tasamia dhèu èèna bisa nare lii èci dènge èu, ka na peka na, lèke kèna! bisa boe, si? te nèngu ne'a boe lii padhai èu deo na.

source_text: for thou verely giuest thankes well, but the other is not edified.
target_text: èu bisa manèngi makasi sèmi èèna kahèi mi lamatua. te ngaa èèna pa'èra boe d'ara dhèu leo.

source_text: i thanke my god, i speake languages more then ye all.
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, te ngaa ja'a padhai lii pake lii leo risi nèti miu. aa ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula nèngu hia ja'a bisa padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: yet had i rather in the church to speake fiue wordes with mine vnderstanding, that i might also instruct others, then ten thousande wordes in a strange tongue.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, na, be'a risi ja'a padhai lii dhoka lèmi hèb'a dhu bab'a te ngaa re'a mèu, sèna ka aj'a-nori si. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii pamadhera-dhera pake lii leo, dènge pake lii riho-riho hèb'a dhu re'a boe, na, gaguna na aad'o.

source_text: brethren, be not children in vnderstanding, but as concerning maliciousnes be children, but in vnderstanding be of a ripe age.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu neo me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara, na, miu hud'i pangee nuka sèmi dhèu ee'a. mage pangee sèmi ana iiki! te ngaa re j'ara bhelu-katub'a, miu hud'i nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe tao bhabhelu, lula d'ara ra dhu mèu aadha-aadha.

source_text: in the lawe it is written, by men of other tongues, and by other languages will i speake vnto this people: yet so shall they not heare me, sayth the lord.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua èdhi peka, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo pake dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo sèra, ho padhai lii dènge dhèu isra'el. masi ka ja'a peka tasamia èèna ka, te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a. '

source_text: wherefore strange tongues are for a signe, not to them that beleeue, but to them that beleeue not: but prophecying serueth not for them that beleeue not, but for them which beleeue.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu dhu parcaya mèka lamatua, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. j'ara ne'e soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa ladhe dhèu lole lii moa lamatua, na, ne'e ne ka soru-bara rèngu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus.

source_text: if therefore when the whole church is come together in one, and all speake strange tongues, there come in they that are vnlearned, or they which beleeue not, will they not say, that ye are out of your wittes?
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pakaboko, ka miu padhai lii pake lii baka-leo, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a boe j'ara se'e, maso dhiu asa talora aae miu, dhèu se ngee sèmi ngaa sa? tatu ra peka na, dhèu ètu se'e se, huj'u aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: but if all prophecie, and there come in one that beleeueth not, or one vnlearned, hee is rebuked of all men, and is iudged of all,
target_text: aa ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i dhu padhue-padhai ho peka paled'a lii moa lamatua, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a mèu mèka j'ara-j'ara se, maso dhiu asa talora miu. tatu dhèu ne, neo nanene lii padhai miu. de, ngaa dhu miu peka-padhai sèra, pad'elo sasala na, toke neo parisa mamuri na d'ai lutu.

source_text: and so are the secrets of his heart made manifest, and so he will fall downe on his face and worship god, and say plainely that god is in you in deede.
target_text: ka bhabhelu dhu nèngu pahuni ètu d'ara na, èèna na bhoka patalele, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ètu talora aae miu di!

source_text: what is to be done then, brethren? when ye come together, according as euery one of you hath a psalme, or hath doctrine, or hath a tongue, or hath reuelation, or hath interpretation, let all things be done vnto edifying.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko, èci-èci ka dènge karunya na. abhu dhu sod'a koa-kio ama lamatua. abhu dhu aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti lamatua. abhu dhu peka paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni era. abhu dhu padhai pake lii leo. aa abhu dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo sèra. j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, rèngu hud'i tao ku ho pa'èra parcaya dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: if any man speake a strange tongue, let it be by two, or at the most, by three, and that by course, and let one interprete.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'èi padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna be'a. sad'i dua do tèlu dhèu di, baku pa'ae-ae. dhèu èci padhai lii uuru, èle ku heka dhèu leo kèna. aa hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka sasoa na.

source_text: but if there be no interpreter, let him keepe silence in the church, which speaketh languages, and let him speake to himselfe, and to god.
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu boe dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna, na, baku padhai lii pake lii leo ètu katanga madha dhèu ae-ae. hud'i laa rèngu padhai lii ètu d'ara ra. rèngu bisa padhai lii dènge lamatua sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: let the prophets speake two, or three, and let the other iudge.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, dua do tèlu dhèu di dhu padhai lii, lole lii moa lamatua. dhèu leo hud'i dadoo ku lii padhai nèti dhèu dhu padhai sèra.

source_text: and if any thing be reueiled to another that sitteth by, let the first holde his peace.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua bhoke ca j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka mi ca dhèu dhu madhèdi nanene ètu èèna, na, nèngu hud'i peka paled'a lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu èèna. aa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha, hud'i ae eele nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka hia dhèu dhu heka tadèngi lii moa lamatua, ho na padhai lii.

source_text: for ye may all prophecie one by one, that all may learne, and all may haue comfort.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te ngaa ladhe padhai lii, na, èci uru, ladhe èle heka dhèu leo kèna. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa nanene, bisa re'a j'ara, aa bisa pa'èra d'ara ra.

source_text: and the spirits of the prophets are subiect to the prophets.
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu lole lii moa lamatua, hud'i ne'a ator ngi'u na. ka èci pamata dènge èci, aa dhèu leo taha uru.

source_text: for god is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as we see in all ye churches of the saints.
target_text: te abhu boe maruru ètu ama lamatua, te ngaa mera dènge milu di. ètu mia-mia, ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, hud'i sèmi ne'e ku:

source_text: let your women keepe silence in the churches: for it is not permitted vnto them to speake: but they ought to be subiect, as also the lawe sayth.
target_text: dhèu bhèni madhèdi mau-mau, bisa boe padhai lii pa'ae. rèngu hud'i nanene kètu juma'at sèra. te atora ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna kahèi, si?

source_text: and if they will learne any thing, let them aske their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speake in the church.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu neo karèi j'ara èci, pe d'ai èmu ku heka karèi dhèu èmu na kèna. te ladhe bhèni maruru ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, sèra sa pamakae iisi ra!

source_text: came the worde of god out from you? either came it vnto you onely?
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? te lii holo-nori ama lamatua mai boe nèti miu. aa lii holo-nori na hia boe miu mesa mi ètu kota korintus di! de pangee paie ku!

source_text: if any man thinke him selfe to be a prophet, or spirituall, let him acknowledge, that the things, that i write vnto you, are the commandements of the lord.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu bisa lole lii moa lamatua, do pangee na, nèngu abhu koasa nèti roh lamatua, na, nèngu ne'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a suri hia miu sèra, atora dhu ja'a tao boe, te ngaa paredha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: and if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare j'ara se, na, miu baku sèmi mere dhèu ne.

source_text: wherefore, brethren, couet to prophecie, and forbid not to speake languages.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! tenge j'ara sèna ka miu abhu koasa ho bisa peka paled'a lii moa lamatua. aa mage kai dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku padhai pake lii leo.

source_text: let all things be done honestly, and by order.
target_text: de ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pakako aa'i-aa'i madhutu mola-mola. tao uuru ku èci, heka dhu leo kèna. pakako aa'i-aa'i dènge be'a, madhutu madha j'ara na. baku dènge maruru.

source_text: moreouer brethren, i declare vnto you the gospel, which i preached vnto you, which ye haue also receiued, and wherein ye continue,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo sèna ka miu sanèd'e lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu uru èèna ja'a peka-padhai le dènge miu. miu sèmi mere, hèia tao taruu madhutu lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: and whereby ye are saued, if ye keepe in memorie, after what maner i preached it vnto you, except ye haue beleeued in vaine.
target_text: te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri, sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra. te ngaa ladhe miu parcaya taruu boe ama lamatua, na, parcaya miu èèna ele iie d'ara.

source_text: for first of all, i deliuered vnto you that which i receiued, how that christ died for our sinnes, according to the scriptures,
target_text: ja'a aj'a le miu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele, dhu uru èèna dhèu aj'a-nori ja'a. nuka: kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, madhe le sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: and that he was buried, and that he arose the third day, according to the scriptures,
target_text: ra padhane ne. ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, lamatua pamamuri hari ne, lèke mola-mola sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua.

source_text: and that he was seene of cephas, then of the twelue.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kristus pad'elo iisi na mi petrus. nèngu pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra kahèi.

source_text: after that, he was seene of more then fiue hudreth brethren at once: whereof many remaine vnto this present, and some also are asleepe.
target_text: aa ca tèka, na pad'elo iisi na mi lèmi ngasu risi dhèu parcaya. dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ladhe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha rèngu. nèti rèngu se, ae dhu mamuri era, aa ciki di dhu madhe le.

source_text: after that, he was seene of iames: then of all the apostles.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi mi yakobis. hèia nèngu pad'elo iisi kahèi, mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and last of all he was seene also of me, as of one borne out of due time.
target_text: ja'a dhèu limuri tèka dhu ladhe kèdhi ne. te ja'a ne nuka sèmi ana dhu rara iisi limuri tèka.

source_text: for i am the least of the apostles, which am not meete to be called an apostle, because i persecuted the church of god.
target_text: dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra kapai risi nèti ja'a ne. madhutu mola-mola, na, ja'a nia boe j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te uru èèna, ja'a ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but by the grace of god, i am that i am: and his grace which is in me, was not in vaine: but i laboured more aboundantly then they all: yet not i, but the grace of god which is with me.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. hèia na tao ja'a j'aj'i sèmi ne'e ne. ropa nèngu tao j'ara be'a hia ja'a, na core eele boe lod'o iia d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ne'e ne ja'a sab'a bia risi nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra! ja'a mesa ku boe dhu sab'a, te ngaa d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu sab'a ètu mamuri ja'a.

source_text: wherefore, whether it were i, or they, so we preach, and so haue ye beleeued.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a, do, dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo dhu aj'a-nori èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te a'aj'a ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi èèna dhoka ca j'ara di. ji'i peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i parcaya lii lolo be'a dhu sama èèna.

source_text: now if it be preached, that christ is risen from the dead, how say some among you, that there is no resurrection of the dead?
target_text: ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. de, nga tao ka miu cahag'e peka na, dhèu madhe sèra, mamuri hari boe? ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: for if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is christ not risen:
target_text: te ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, kristus mamuri hari boe kahèi!

source_text: and if christ be not risen, then is our preaching vaine, and your faith is also vaine.
target_text: aa ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge dhèu, gaguna aad'o. aa lalèka miu mi kristus, parcuma kahèi!

source_text: and we are found also false witnesses of god: for we haue testified of god, that he hath raised vp christ: whome he hath not raised vp, if so be the dead be not raised. for if the dead be not raised, then is christ not raised.
target_text: aa ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, ji'i j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli mi ama lamatua. te ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kristus! mema tare'a dhu ji'i lole sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ladhe sèmi dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari boe kristus kahèi.

source_text: and if christ be not raised, your faith is vaine: ye are yet in your sinnes.
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, lalèka miu mi ama lamatua parcuma! aa miu pasae taruu sasala-sasigo miu!

source_text: and so they which are a sleepe in christ, are perished.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu madhe le, ladhe kristus kèd'i boe nèti mamadhe na, rèngu madhe pacèri nèti ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if in this life onely wee haue hope in christ, we are of all men the most miserable.
target_text: kristus j'aj'i era sarai èdhi, lula te'a, na, nèngu neo tao j'ara hua iia hia èdhi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi sanao-maena ho nèngu neo tao sèmi èèna dhoka ètu rai-haha di, na parcuma! aa èdhi j'aj'i dhèu kasia risi eele nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: but nowe is christ risen from the dead, and was made the first fruites of them that slept.
target_text: aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, si? te dhu lèke mola-mola ka: kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri le nèti mamadhe na! aa mesa boe nèngu di, te èèna na dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari kahèi. kristus ne, nuka sèmi hua uru dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari madhutu nèngu.

source_text: for since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
target_text: uru-uru èèna, dhoka dhèu èci di, nuka adam dhu sisu paredha ama lamatua. de hahuku na, nuka mamadhe. hahuku ne noto mi èdhi dhèu rai-haha kahèi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu hari, nuka kristus, dhu mamuri madhutu paredha ama lamatua. de, lula babe'a nèngu ka dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari!

source_text: for as in adam all die, euen so in christ shall all be made aliue,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sisu paredha lamatua, lèke huku madhe sama sèmi adam kahèi. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge kristus, èèna na ama lamatua pamamuri hari si.

source_text: but euery man in his owne order: the first fruites is christ, afterward, they that are of christ, at his comming shall rise againe.
target_text: te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. kristus dhèu partama dhu mamuri hari, nuka sèmi hua uru deo na. aa pe na lèpa hari mai asa rai-haha ne, dhèu unu na sèra heka mamuri hari kèna.

source_text: then shalbe the end, when he hath deliuered vp the kingdome to god, euen the father, when he hath put downe all rule, and all authoritie and power.
target_text: èle ku, heka rai-haha ne èle kèna. lod'o èèna, kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu pa'ele iie koasa aa'i-aa'i, paredha aa'i-aa'i, aa mamèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pamusu dènge lamatua. nèngu j'aj'i kahèi dhèu aae dhu pangèd'u hari hak paredha na mi ama na, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: for he must reigne till hee hath put all his enemies vnder his feete.
target_text: te ama lamatua hud'i nèd'u paredha taruu, toke na segi aa'i dhu lab'a kristus, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: the last enemie that shalbe destroyed, is death.
target_text: abhu ca j'ara dhu pamusu dènge èdhi era, nuka mamadhe. te ngaa d'ai limuri, ka lamatua segi kahèi koasa mamadhe. de lèpa lod'o limuri, dhèu madhe heka.

source_text: for he hath put downe all things vnder his feete. and when he saith that all things are subdued to him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put downe all things vnder him.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lamatua tao dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna. de dhu suri, peka na, dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu nèngu, de lèke, ladhe peka na, ama lamatua pahaha boe iisi mi dhèu unu nèngu èèna. lula ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu mi ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and when all things shalbe subdued vnto him, then shall the sonne also himselfe be subiect vnto him, that did subdue all things vnder him, that god may be all in all.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a ladhe aa'i-aa'i nanene tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èèna na ana ne pangèd'u aa'i-aa'i hari mi ama na, dhu ded'e ne j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra. èle èèna, ama lamatua paredha taruu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: els what shall they doe which are baptized for dead? if the dead rise not at all, why are they then baptized for dead?
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu neo sarani ho gati dhèu dhu madhe le dhu dhae sarani mèka. te ngaa ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, nga tao ka rèngu neo sarani hia dhèu madhe?

source_text: why are wee also in ieopardie euery houre?
target_text: aa nga tao ka ji'i oe madhe pahari-pahari ètu d'ara sasab'a ji'i, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe?

source_text: by your reioycing which i haue in christ iesus our lord, i die dayly.
target_text: te bèli-bèli ja'a oe madhe! te ngaa a'ari pasue! ja'a subha, te ja'a pangee, na, ngaa-ngaa tao boe ladhe ja'a madhe. te ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu pa'èki taruu dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua le mai.

source_text: if i haue fought with beastes at ephesus after ye maner of men, what aduantageth it me, if the dead be not raised vp? let vs eate and drinke: for to morowe we shall die.
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, ja'a patao-palaha dènge dhèu sèra nuka sèmi badha hui dhu bhelu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhoka patao-palaha, ho bisa segi mesa ku, aa hia boe lamatua, èèna parcuma. guna boe ngaa-ngaa! te ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, hua iia èdhi madhutu dhu dhèu peka, na, mai èdhi pesta rame-rame, aa ta'a-tinu be'a-be'a, te bèli èdhi madhe kèna!

source_text: be not deceiued: euill speakings corrupt good maners.
target_text: miu baku lèke tipu, ho pangee sèmi èèna! te abhu dhu peka na, ladhe èu pa'èci dènge dhèu bhelu, èèna pakaj'èu èu nèti mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: awake to liue righteously, and sinne not: for some haue not ye knowledge of god, i speake this to your shame.
target_text: ad'u-ue ia ka bhabhelu-katub'a! rèno ka! ator ngi'u mu! tao dhu lèke di! dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i me'a ku makae, te ètu talora aae miu, abhu era dhèu dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: but some man will say, howe are the dead raised vp? and with what body come they foorth?
target_text: abhu dhu pakarèi, na, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, j'ara na tasamia? aa ngi'u aae j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: o foole, that which thou sowest, is not quickened, except it die.
target_text: goa, ee! te ladhe sèle hini, hini ne hud'i roe ètu d'ara rai uuru ku, heka na bisa muri kèna.

source_text: and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shalbe, but bare corne as it falleth, of wheat, or of some other.
target_text: aa hini dhu èdhi sèle, rupa na leko-leo nèti dhu muri, èli, heka cèu rèu kèna. te nèngu èèna hini dhu mango-meto, nuka sèmi gandum, do are, do hini dhu leo.

source_text: but god giueth it a body at his pleasure, euen to euery seede his owne body,
target_text: èci-èci ka madhutu raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula nèngu ka dhu ator raropa nèti ana aaj'u sèra.

source_text: all flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, and another flesh of beastes, and another of fishes, and another of birdes.
target_text: badha dènge dhèu rai-haha sèmi èèna kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia ngi'u dhèu rai-haha madhutu raropa dhèu rai-haha. ngi'u badha èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra. manu-bhui dènge raropa ra. i'a dènge raropa ra. dhu leo sèra dènge raropa ra.

source_text: there are also heauenly bodies, and earthly bodies: but the glorie of the heauenly is one, and the glorie of the earthly is another.
target_text: abhu mèdha ètu dedha-liru, aa abhu ètu rai-haha. ètu dedha-liru dènge kolo-karisi na. te ngaa kolo-karisi ne, leko-leo nèti dhu ètu rai-haha. dhu ètu rai-haha abhu kolo-karisi kahèi. te ngaa kolo-karisi se, leko-leo nèti dhu abhu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: there is another glorie of the sunne, and another glorie of the moone, and another glorie of the starres: for one starre differeth from another starre in glorie.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru kolo-karisi madha lod'o leko-leo; kolo-karisi hèru leko-leo; aa kolo-karisi hua-hètu leko-leo kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge kolo-karisi ra. de aa'i-aa'i ra dènge kolo-karisi, si?

source_text: so also is the resurrection of the dead. the bodie is sowen in corruption, and is raysed in incorruption.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, èèna nuka sèmi hini deo na. te ladhe padhane ka dhèu madhe, ngi'u aae na ele iie, si? te ngaa ladhe mamuri hari, ngi'u na sèmi heka uru èèna. te ladhe mamuri hari, bisa heka madhe.

source_text: it is sowen in dishonour, and is raysed in glory: it is sowen in weakenesse, and is raysed in power.
target_text: ropa èdhi padhane dhèu madhe, èdhi mad'enge ngi'u aae ne. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èèna mamuri hari, na saraga titu kèna! te nèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci! dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao ngaa-ngaa lod'o dhèu padhane ne. te ngaa ropa na mamuri hari, nèngu èra titu kèna!

source_text: it is sowen a naturall body, and is raysed a spirituall body: there is a naturall body, and there is a spirituall body.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mamuri era, ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, si? te ngaa ropa na madhe, ho mamuri hari, na, roh lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu lèke. ka dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna.

source_text: as it is also written, the first man adam was made a liuing soule: and the last adam was made a quickening spirit.
target_text: dhèu rai-haha dhu uru-uru j'ara, dhu sama sèmi èdhi, nuka adam. madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, nèngu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu mamuri, dhu ne'a ngee dènge rasa. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha dhu raropa na sama sèmi adam, dhu dedha risi eele, nuka kristus. roh na ka dhu bisa hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: howbeit that was not first which is spirituall: but that which is naturall, and afterward that which is spirituall.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, ka bisa madhe. te ngaa dhu mamuri hari, nuka dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti roh lamatua.

source_text: the first man is of the earth, earthly: the second man is the lord from heauen.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tao nèti ahu rai. te ngaa raropa ka dua, nuka kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: as is the earthly, such are they that are earthly: and as is the heauenly, such are they also that are heauenly.
target_text: èdhi dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne ca ropa dènge dhèu partama dhu lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, ca ropa dènge kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and as we haue borne the image of the earthly, so shall we beare the image of the heauenly.
target_text: èdhi dhèu limuri ne, ca ropa dènge adam dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, gati dènge raropa hiu, sama sèmi kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: this say i, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherite the kingdome of god, neither doeth corruption inherite incorruption.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, sèmi ne'e: èdhi dhu ca ropa dènge dhèu partama, ngi'u èdhi j'aj'i nèti sisi dènge raa. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa boe abhu pusaka ho j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. bisa boe! te raropa dhèu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ngi'u ra ele iie, ka bisa boe sèmi rare ngaa dhu taha nare nèbhu.

source_text: behold, i shewe you a secret thing, we shall not all sleepe, but we shall all be changed,
target_text: de nanene paie-iie! te ja'a neo bhoke paled'a rahasia èci. èèna na abhu dhèu parcaya cahag'e dhu madhe boe. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èèna na gati raropa hiu.

source_text: in a moment, in the twinckling of an eye at the last trumpet: for the trumpet shall blow, and the dead shalbe raysed vp incorruptible, and we shalbe changed.
target_text: ropa lii tiu tèbhe limuri tèka, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i dènge sahèka. malai risi nèti ate musi madha. te ropa tèbhe limuri tèka lii, cag'ag'a laa dhèu madhe mamuri hari. aa ladhe ra mamuri hari, dhèu se madhe heka, aa ele iie heka. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu raropa hiu.

source_text: for this corruptible must put on incorruption: and this mortall must put on immortalitie. so when this corruptible hath put on incorruption, and this mortall hath put on immortalitie, then shalbe brought to passe the saying that is written, death is swallowed vp into victorie.
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi dhu bisa ele iie ne'e ne, j'aj'i ngi'u hiu dhu ele iie heka! aa èdhi dhu bisa madhe ne'e ne, neo ub'a j'aj'i raropa hiu dhu madhe heka! èèna madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua palaho eele le koasa mamadhe, aa segi le mamadhe! nèti èèna ka èdhi madhe heka.

source_text: o death where is thy sting? o graue where is thy victorie?
target_text: he, mamadhe! koasa èu ètu mia? he, mamadhe! dhudhu èu ètu mia?

source_text: the sting of death is sinne: and ye strength of sinne is the lawe.
target_text: nga tao ka mamadhe nèti rasa pèd'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha? lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala. tasamia ka sasala sèra dènge koasa? lula atora ama lamatua peka na, sasala èdhi, nuka sisu paredha na!

source_text: but thankes be vnto god, which hath giuen vs victorie through our lord iesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i leko-leo le! de èdhi hud'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua. te nèngu ka tao èdhi bisa segi bhabhelu-katub'a lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. mema tare'a, te kristus ka dhu segi aa'i!

source_text: therefore my beloued brethren, be ye stedfast, vnmoueable, aboundant alwayes in the worke of the lord, forasmuch as ye knowe that your labour is not in vaine in the lord.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra d'ara! baku roe! sasab'a miu hia mi ama lamatua hud'i asa be'a, aa asa ae. te miu me'a le, na, sab'a bia hia lamatua èdhi èèna, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: concerning the gathering for the saintes, as i haue ordeined in the churches of galatia, so doe ye also.
target_text: ne'e ne, ja'a suri hia miu lula-nèti doi dhu miu pakaboko hia dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. ja'a peka le dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi galati, j'ara tasamia rèngu hud'i pakaboko doi èèna. miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: euery first day of the weeke, let euery one of you put aside by himselfe, and lay vp as god hath prospered him, that then there be no gatherings when i come.
target_text: ladhe hari migu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'oru doi ciki nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu. baku mate ja'a dhiu ku, heka miu parai-oru kèna.

source_text: and when i am come, whomsoeuer ye shall alowe by letters, them will i send to bring your liberalitie vnto hierusalem.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, miu paj'uj'u dhèu dhu miu lèka, sèna ka rèti doi soru-bara sèra asa dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. pe ja'a suri sasuri ho patadha rèngu dènge kètu juma'at ètu nèi.

source_text: and if it be meete that i goe also, they shall goe with me.
target_text: aa ladhe miu ngee, na, be'a ladhe ja'a madhutu hèi, na, ji'i la'a palere.

source_text: nowe i will come vnto you, after i haue gone through macedonia for i will passe through macedonia.
target_text: ladhe ja'a kako palème le propensi makedonia, ja'a heka dhiu asa miu kèna. de mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a hud'i laku uuru ku asa makedonia.

source_text: and it may be that i will abide, yea, or winter with you, that ye may bring me on my way, whither soeuer i goe.
target_text: èle èèna, pe ja'a dhiu pea taha dènge miu ako panèbhu ciki; ele boe d'ai èle hèru pacuhi. hèia miu bisa lere ja'a asa era leo hari.

source_text: for i will not see you nowe in my passage, but i trust to abide a while with you, if the lord permit.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, ja'a dhiu ne ca lod'o boe di. te ja'a neo pea dènge miu ako panèbhu, ladhe lamatua d'èi.

source_text: and i wil tary at ephesus vntill pentecost.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo pea era ètu kota epesus ne, toke lod'o babe'a pantekosta, nuka lèmi nguru lod'o èle kalela paska.

source_text: for a great doore and effectuall is opened vnto me: and there are many aduersaries.
target_text: lula ètu ne'e ja'a abhu lod'o taleo ae, ho sab'a taruu, masi ka abhu dhèu ae dhu lab'a sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: nowe if timotheus come, see that he be without feare with you: for he worketh the worke of the lord, euen as i doe.
target_text: ladhe timotius j'aj'i dhiu paraga dènge miu, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, sèna ka baku na ngee rupa-rupa. te nèngu ne dhèu sab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sama sèmi ja'a ne kahèi.

source_text: let no man therefore despise him: but conuey him foorth in peace, that he may come vnto me: for i looke for him with the brethren.
target_text: mage soro tèke dhèu laladhe ne dènge hui madha di. soru-bara ne toke na lèpa asa ja'a dènge be'a. te ja'a dènge a'ari dhu leo se, dhu mate tatae ne.

source_text: as touching our brother apollos, i greatly desired him, to come vnto you with the brethren: but his mind was not at all to come at this time: howbeit he will come when he shall haue conuenient time.
target_text: ca j'ara era dhu miu hud'i me'a ku. ja'a dhu pamako le angalai èdhi apolos, ho na dhiu pangad'o dènge a'ari dhu leo. te ngaa no'o mèka dhiu. de mi mate, pe na abhu lod'o taleo, heka na dhiu kèna.

source_text: watch ye: stand fast in the faith: quite you like men, and be strong.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga ngi'u miu paie-iie! miu hud'i pa'èra-èra ho parcaya taruu ama lamatua! mage madha'u! pa'èra iisi!

source_text: let all your things be done in loue.
target_text: sad'i miu sab'a ngaa èèna ka, pad'elo la sasue.

source_text: nowe brethren, i beseeche you ye knowe the house of stephanas, that it is the first fruites of achaia, and that they haue giuen themselues to minister vnto the saintes
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu me'a, na, stefanus dènge isi èmu na ka dhèu partama dhu parcaya kristus ètu propensi akaya nèi. rèngu sab'a re'a boe j'èra, sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu parcaya ètu nèi. de ja'a manèngi ho

source_text: that ye be obedient euen vnto such, and to all that helpe with vs and labour.
target_text: miu nanene dhèu sèmi sèra. nuka rèngu dhu sab'a bia ho sama-sama lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: i am glad of the comming of stephanas, and fortunatus, and achaicus: for they haue supplied the want of you.
target_text: d'ara ja'a neo dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lula mamai stefanus, fortunatus dènge akaikus asa ne'e. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa gati miu.

source_text: for they haue comforted my spirite and yours: acknowledge therefore such men.
target_text: tèlu ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a, sama sèmi ra pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi. miu hud'i pakab'ua dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: the churches of asia salute you: aquila and priscilla with ye church that is in their house, salute you greatly in the lord.
target_text: juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi asia hia miu lii maho'o. akila dènge dhèu èmu na, priskila, aa dhèu leo dhu tema pakaboko ètu èmu ra, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhu pa'èki kahèi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: all the brethren greete you. greete ye one another, with an holy kisse.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi. ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci, pake uu dhu nia hia dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: the salutation of me paul with mine owne hand.
target_text: mi laladhe! te ja'a, paulus, suri dènge kacui-aai unu ku: saloom!

source_text: if any man loue not the lord iesus christ, let him be had in execration maran-atha.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu sue boe kètu èdhi, pe ama lamatua huku ne. ja'a d'èi tabea dhèu madhutu lii aram èdhi dhèu yahudi, dhu peka, marana ta! dhu sasoa na, lamatua! mai ka!

source_text: the grace of our lord iesus christ be with you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: my loue be with you all in christ iesus, amen. ‘the first epistle to the corinthians, written from philippi, and sent by stephanas, and fortunatus, and achaicus, and timotheus. '
target_text: ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. sasuri ja'a sèmi ne'e ka. saloom! nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: pavl an apostle of jesvs christ, by the will of god, and our brother timotheus, to the church of god, which is at corinthus with all the saints, which are in all achaia:
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a sèna ka laku lole lula-nèti yesus kristus dènge dhèu asa mia-mia. yesus kristus èèna, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. ari èdhi timotius ètu ne'e kahèi. na hia lii maho'o. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne'e mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu biasa pakaboko ètu kota korintus dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: grace be with you, and peace from god our father, and from the lord iesus christ.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, nuka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra dènge miu, sèna ka miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be god, euen the father of our lord iesus christ, the father of mercies, and the god of all comfort,
target_text: dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rasa kasia aa'i-aa'i kapua nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi.

source_text: which comforteth vs in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any affliction by the comfort wherewith we our selues are comforted of god.
target_text: nèngu ka pamaho'o d'ara èdhi ladhe èdhi ètu d'ara sasusa. nèti èèna ka, èdhi kahèi bisa pamaho'o dhèu leo dhu paraga dènge sasusa. te èdhi bisa pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sama sèmi lamatua pa'èra le d'ara èdhi.

source_text: for as the sufferings of christ abounde in vs, so our consolation aboundeth through christ.
target_text: kristus abhu le susa ae-ae hia èdhi. de, lula kristus rasa le susa sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama na pa'èra d'ara èdhi taruu, ladhe èdhi paraga dènge susa.

source_text: and whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and saluation, which is wrought in the induring of the same sufferings, which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and saluation.
target_text: ladhe ji'i ètu ne'e abhu susa, ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i. aa ladhe ji'i paraga dènge j'aj'èra, hèia taha dènge d'ara taleo, na, miu hud'i me'a kahèi, lamatua pake j'ara sèmi ne'e sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, ho patalale miu nèti koasa bhabhelu-katub'a. te ladhe miu abhu sasusa sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere dènge d'ara taleo kahèi.

source_text: and our hope is stedfast concerning you, in as much as we know that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a mèu, na, miu bisa taha mere dènge èra. te ji'i nge'a, na, ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi ji'i, lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, aa nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i kahèi.

source_text: for brethren, we woulde not haue you ignorant of our affliction, which came vnto vs in asia, howe we were pressed out of measure passing strength, so that we altogether doubted, euen of life.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i sèna ka miu me'a mèu sasusa dhu ji'i abhu ètu propensi asia. ji'i rasa bia, risi nèti dhu ji'i bisa pasae, toke ji'i oe ele ngangee, lula ji'i pangee, na, ji'i madhe kèna.

source_text: yea, we receiued the sentence of death in our selues, because we shoulde not trust in our selues, but in god, which rayseth the dead.
target_text: ji'i rasa bia, nuka sèmi dhèu èci ropa tadèngi hakim pama'ète hahuku pamadhe ne. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, sèna ka ji'i parcaya ama lamatua, aa baku parcaya ngi'u ji'i unu mi. te lamatua èèna ka dhu unu koasa ho pamamuri hari dhèu madhe.

source_text: who deliuered vs from so great a death, and doeth deliuer vs: in whom we trust, that yet hereafter he will deliuer vs,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pakaj'èu le ji'i nèti bhabhelu, lod'o ji'i oe madhe. bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pakaj'èu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a kahèi. aa ji'i ma'ète boe sanao, sèna ka na pakaj'èu taruu ji'i nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: so that ye labour together in prayer for vs, that for the gift bestowed vpon vs for many, thankes may be giuen by many persons for vs.
target_text: ladhe miu loe boe sabaj'a hia ji'i, èèna ka soru-bara ji'i kahèi, te ama lamatua neo tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae hia mi ji'i. nèngu tao j'ara èèna, lula dhèu ae dhu sabaj'a hia ji'i. hèia lod'o dhèu ae sanèd'e ji'i, rèngu manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for our reioycing is this, the testimonie of our conscience, that in simplicitie and godly purenesse, and not in fleshly wisedome, but by the grace of god wee haue had our conuersation in the worlde, and most of all to you wardes.
target_text: ji'i bisa koa-kad'iri iisi ji'i, lula ji'i nge'a ètu d'ara iiki ji'i, ngaa dhu ji'i ad'u-ue ètu rai-haha ne, madhutu dad'èi lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ji'i. ji'i rai boe nèti sasab'a-la'a ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi ji'i sab'a dènge d'ara mola. ji'i pakako sasab'a ji'i, pake boe mamèu dhu mai nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa mamèu dhu kapua na nèti ama lamatua. te lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa asa tabha èra ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a lod'o ji'i bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: for wee write none other thinges vnto you, then that ye reade or els that ye acknowledge, and i trust ye shall acknowledge vnto ye end.
target_text: ja'a suri hia miu dhodhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu miu bisa baca aa bisa me'a mèu. limuri ne miu me'a le naneo ja'a cahag'e. te ngaa ja'a sanao, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a miu bisa me'a mèu risi hari.

source_text: euen as ye haue acknowledged vs partly, that we are your reioycing, euen as ye are ours, in the day of our lord iesus.
target_text: ne'e ne, miu me'a ciki era lula-nèti ji'i se. te ngaa èèna na, lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mai hari ka, ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara ae-ae. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa koa-kad'iri ji'i, sama sèmi ji'i koa-kad'iri miu kahèi.

source_text: and in this confidence was i minded first to come vnto you, that ye might haue had a double grace,
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, nèti èèna ka ca hari na, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho dhiu ngad'o hari miu, sèna ka miu bisa abhu mèngi-nale dua hari.

source_text: and to passe by you into macedonia, and to come againe out of macedonia vnto you, and to be led foorth towarde iudea of you.
target_text: de uru èèna ja'a dhu pangee, ladhe j'aj'i laku asa propensi makedonia, na, ja'a bisa dhuli ngad'o miu. ho ladhe ja'a lèpa nèti makedonia, ja'a bisa dhuli hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa soru-bara ja'a, ho bisa laku taruu asa propensi yudea.

source_text: when i therefore was thus minded, did i vse lightnesse? or minde i those thinges which i minde, according to the flesh, that with me should be, yea, yea, and nay, nay?
target_text: te ngaa tasamia? lod'o-lod'o ja'a peka, neo dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, ele boe mi pangee, na, ja'a uri kore mèka, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a dhodhoka pama'ète madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a di, sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, si? do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ne dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo, ho d'èi, peka na, oo. aa te ngaa ja'a ngee ètu d'ara ja'a, na, aad'o! ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: yea, god is faithfull, that our worde towarde you was not yea, and nay.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua, lula nèngu peka ca j'ara, tatu na tao madhutu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i sama sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ji'i dhaa, peka na, oo, na ji'i pangee boe, na, aad'o.

source_text: for the sonne of god iesus christ, who was preached among you by vs, that is, by me, and siluanus, and timotheus, was not yea, and nay: but in him it was yea.
target_text: ja'a, silas dènge timotius dhu aj'a le miu lula-nèti yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua. nèngu dhu kapod'e-kabèli boe, peka na, oo, te ngaa a'abhu na, aad'o. nèngu ne ub'a boe, te ladhe na peka na, oo, a'abhu na tare'a-re'a, oo.
